title: CRM Data Migration & Automation Specialist
description: ???? Remote | Full Time We are a UK hospitality business. Our customer data is scattered across four separate platforms and nobody can see the full picture of any single customer. We have bought GoHighLevel and we need one person, for four weeks, to consolidate everything into it properly and build the core automations on top. This is a fixed 4-week contract, 40 hours per week, at $7 USD per hour. If the work is excellent there is a strong chance of extension into later phases. This is a data job first and an automation job second. Roughly two of the four weeks are careful spreadsheet work. If deduplicating 29,000 messy rows into 21,000 clean ones sounds satisfying rather than tedious, you will enjoy this. Background: what we are doing and why We would rather you understood the point of the work than just followed instructions, so here is the honest picture. The business. A long-established UK venue with several separately bookable spaces, plus a second smaller venue next door. It is busy at weekends and has a lot of unused capacity midweek. Around 21,000 customers have passed through it over more than a decade. The problem we are solving. UK nightlife is shrinking. This business cannot grow by pulling in more walk-up customers on its busiest night, because that night is already close to full. Growth has to come from planned occasions instead — private room hire, group bookings, seasonal parties, corporate events. Those get booked weeks ahead, are paid for by organisers or company budgets, and happen on the nights the venue is half empty anyway. To make that shift, the business needs to be able to reach the customers it already has. Right now it cannot. That is what you are fixing. How the data got into this state. Nobody planned it. Platforms were adopted one at a time over a decade as they were needed — a booking system, then a ticketing platform, then a replacement ticketing platform, then an email tool. None of them were ever connected to each other. Each holds a partial, overlapping view of the same people. What is actually broken today: The same customer exists three or four times over, so a loyal regular looks like several strangers Booking counts are calculated per platform, so the loyalty tiers are wrong and the genuine best customers are invisible Enquiries arrive in six different places, get replied to once, then are never chased. Nobody knows how many are lost, because nothing counts them. Opt-out records exist in only one system — which is a legal risk, and the reason the suppression work matters so much The four things this programme is meant to achieve: Re-engage people who enquired but never booked Re-engage customers who came once and never returned Get the customer base signed up to a free loyalty scheme (whose real purpose is collecting proper marketing consent) Make sure no booking enquiry is ever missed again Where your four weeks fit. The full programme is about 18 stages and 165–225 hours. Your contract is the first and most important slice: the foundation and the data migration. Later stages are blocked by things nobody can speed up — API credentials from a supplier, business verification with Meta, and a mandatory 3–4 week email domain warm-up. So you are not expected to finish the whole programme. You are expected to complete your part to a standard that lets the next stage start cleanly. Who you will work with. A UK project owner (your daily contact), the venue's general manager and assistant manager (who you will train at handover), an external developer handling the API work, and a UK marketing agency who own the CRM account at the top level. What you will actually be doing The work falls into four areas. We will agree the running order at kickoff, once we have looked at the data exports together and seen what condition they are in. Setting up the foundation Set up and configure a GoHighLevel sub-account from scratch Build 13 custom fields, around 40 tags and a 9-stage pipeline, exactly to a written specification Audit an email marketing platform we are retiring: its lists, automations, forms and API keys Export data from four platforms and log everything The data migration — this is the main event Build a master suppression list of everyone who has opted out, and load it into the CRM before anything else Normalise four very different exports into one consistent 14-column format Deduplicate on email and phone, applying precise merge rules supplied to you Score and tag every record by frequency, recency, value and product using formulas Import in tranches, reconciling the numbers after each one Produce a one-page reconciliation report Building the core automations An enquiry acknowledgement that fires within 60 seconds A follow-up chase sequence that stops the instant a customer replies on any channel An automated review request flow A signup form that captures marketing consent correctly A webhook feed from a ticketing platform Testing and handover Work through a supplied test checklist, evidencing every item Write a runbook someone non-technical can follow Record a walkthrough and hand over cleanly You will be given a detailed written build manual covering every step. You are not being asked to design the approach. You are being asked to execute it accurately and to tell us immediately when something does not add up. What we need from you Essential Advanced spreadsheet skills. This is the single most important requirement. You must be genuinely comfortable deduplicating tens of thousands of rows, writing lookup and conditional formulas, cleaning inconsistent data, and reconciling totals back to a source. Hands-on CRM administration. You have personally configured a CRM — custom fields, tags, pipelines, imports, automations. GoHighLevel is ideal. HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, Zoho or Keap experience is acceptable if you are a fast learner. Automation building. Multi-step workflows with conditions, waits and branching. Zapier or Make experience. Strong written English. You will write audit notes, a reconciliation report and a runbook a non-technical person must be able to follow. Precision over initiative. On this project, following the specification exactly matters more than clever improvisation. Reliability. 40 hours a week, with at least 4 hours daily overlapping UK business hours (roughly 4pm to 8pm Philippine time). Nice to have, not required Familiarity with UK GDPR or PECR marketing consent rules Email deliverability basics (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) Experience migrating between email marketing platforms Light scripting for data cleaning (Python or Google Apps Script) Hospitality, events or booking system experience The terms Rate $7.00 USD per hour Hours 40 per week, Monday to Friday Term 4 weeks, fixed Payment TBD Equipment Your own computer and reliable internet How to apply Please do not send a generic application. We read the ones that follow these instructions and skip the rest. It takes about 15 minutes and we promise to reply either way. Step 1: Start your message with the word RECONCILE This tells us you read to the end. Applications without it are not opened. Step 2: Give us these details You will be asked to fill out a form where all the necessary documents and questions are. - ---------- If you have any questions, feel free to send it to ----------

title: MEP Design Engineer - Plumbing (PHE)
description: We are looking for an experienced Plumbing & Fire-Fighting Design Engineer to join our team and take ownership of plumbing and fire-fighting design projects from concept through detailed design. This is not a general MEP drafting role. We are looking for a design engineer who can independently perform the engineering calculations behind the drawings, develop complete systems, coordinate with other disciplines, and ensure that designs meet applicable codes, project specifications, and engineering standards. You will work on residential and commercial projects, including hotels, schools, restaurants, fitness clubs, and similar buildings. What You'll Do Develop plumbing and fire-fighting systems from concept through detailed design. Design cold water, hot water, and hot water return systems. Design sewer, drainage, and venting systems. Design stormwater drainage and rainwater harvesting systems. Design sewage ejector systems. Design fire-fighting systems, including: Fire sprinkler systems Hydrant systems Fire pump systems Perform engineering calculations, including: Water supply hydraulic calculations Drainage hydraulic calculations Sprinkler hydraulic calculations Water demand calculations Tank capacity sizing Pipe sizing throughout the system Prepare detailed plumbing and fire-fighting layouts, schematics, and 3D models. Develop designs using AutoCAD 2020, Revit MEP 2020, and BIM 360. Participate actively in BIM 360 coordination. Identify, analyze, and resolve multidisciplinary clashes involving architectural, structural, electrical, and other MEP systems. Prepare BOQs, material take-offs, and complete project documentation. Review and update designs based on project requirements and coordination changes. Ensure all designs comply with applicable building codes, fire codes, engineering standards, and project specifications. Manage assigned design work independently while meeting project deadlines and quality requirements. What We're Looking For 4+ years of professional experience in plumbing/PHE and fire-fighting design. Strong hands-on experience designing plumbing and fire-fighting systems for residential and commercial buildings. Proven experience with: Plumbing/PHE system design Fire sprinkler, hydrant, and fire pump system design Hydraulic calculations for water supply, drainage, and sprinkler systems Water demand calculations Tank capacity sizing Pipe sizing calculations Cold water, hot water, and hot water return systems Sewer, drainage, and venting systems Rainwater harvesting and stormwater drainage Sewage ejector systems Proficiency in AutoCAD 2020. Proficiency in Revit MEP 2020. Working experience with BIM 360 and BIM coordination. Experience preparing BOQs and material take-offs. Strong understanding of multidisciplinary coordination and clash detection/resolution. Ability to interpret architectural, structural, and MEP drawings. Strong understanding of applicable plumbing, fire-fighting, and engineering codes and standards. Ability to work independently, take ownership of designs, and meet deadlines. Strong attention to detail and engineering judgment. Important This position is intended for a full design engineer, not a CAD/Revit drafter. You should be comfortable taking responsibility for the engineering analysis, calculations, system design, coordination, and final design output — not simply producing drawings based on instructions. Nice to Have Experience with SketchUp. Experience with STAAD.Pro. Experience working on hotels, schools, restaurants, fitness clubs, or other commercial projects. Experience working with international/U.S.-based projects and standards. Strong experience working in a remote, multidisciplinary environment. What We Offer Fully remote work. Opportunity to work on diverse residential and commercial projects. Long-term opportunity with a collaborative engineering team. Work directly on design, coordination, and engineering responsibilities rather than purely drafting tasks. PLEASE ATTACH YOUR CV WHEN APPLYING

title: Technical Engineering Coordinator | US-Based Client
description: One seat. Technical judgment. Full accountability. This is not a “hold the calendar and smile” support role. We’re looking for a Technical Engineering Coordinator who can move comfortably between engineering calculations, technical correspondence, project coordination, and executive-level administrative support. You should be able to look at a structural or mechanical calculation sheet, understand what you’re looking at, identify potential discrepancies, communicate clearly with a client, and keep the project moving — without everything being divided across three different people. If you’re an engineer who is organized, commercially minded, technically sharp, and comfortable owning a moving workload, this could be a very strong fit. What You’ll Do * Own the inbox, don’t babysit it. Monitor and triage incoming emails based on urgency and complexity. Handle routine matters independently, route appropriately when needed, and respond directly to technical inquiries when you have the knowledge and judgment to do so. * Review and validate engineering calculations. Check calculations for accuracy, consistency, and potential discrepancies before they become project or client issues. * Keep engineering projects moving. Track timelines, deliverables, dependencies, follow-ups, and outstanding items across multiple active projects. * Review and mark up technical documents. Use Bluebeam or equivalent redlining/markup software to review plan sets, submittals, drawings, and technical documentation. * Provide high-level administrative and executive support. Handle scheduling, correspondence, coordination, documentation, follow-ups, and the many operational details that keep an engineering practice running smoothly. * Communicate with clients professionally. Draft clear, concise, technically appropriate responses where required and ensure communication does not get lost in translation. * Use technology intelligently. Leverage Microsoft Office and AI tools to improve drafting, research, documentation, organization, and workflow efficiency. * Take ownership. Identify what needs to happen next and make it happen rather than waiting for someone to assign every step. Non-Negotiable Requirements * Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering or Mechanical Engineering** * 5+ years of executive assistant, administrative, coordination, or comparable professional experience**, ideally supporting engineering or technical leadership * Demonstrated project management experience with the ability to manage timelines, deliverables, priorities, and follow-ups * Strong Microsoft Office proficiency, particularly Excel * Familiarity with Bluebeam or comparable document markup/redlining software * Strong spoken and written English * Ability to understand and communicate technical information clearly * Comfortable using AI tools for drafting, research, organization, and document-related tasks * Strong technology skills and the ability to learn new systems quickly * Comfortable working independently in a remote environment * Excellent judgment, organization, attention to detail, and follow-through We’ll Evaluate You On Relevant Work Experience Your previous roles, scope of responsibilities, engineering/technical exposure, project coordination experience, and ability to operate at a high level. Software & Technical Proficiency Your working knowledge of Microsoft Office, Excel, Bluebeam or equivalent markup tools, project management platforms, communication tools, and AI-enabled productivity tools. Remote Work Experience & Adaptability Your ability to stay productive, organized, responsive, and accountable without someone physically supervising your work. English Proficiency — Spoken & Written You must be able to communicate confidently and professionally with US-based clients and engineering professionals. Professionalism & Attitude We value ownership, maturity, good judgment, respect, and a solution-oriented mindset. We’re looking for someone who brings solutions, not just problems. Response Time & Clarity In engineering, delays and vague communication can become expensive very quickly. You should be responsive, concise, and clear — especially when something requires immediate attention. Internet & Work Setup You must have a reliable internet connection, dependable computer/workstation, and professional remote-work environment suitable for full-time client-facing work. Commitment to Role & Availability This is a role that requires consistent attention and accountability. We’re looking for someone who can commit to the position and maintain reliable availability during agreed working hours. Time Management & Dependability You should be capable of managing competing priorities, meeting deadlines, following through on commitments, and keeping stakeholders informed without constant reminders. Problem-Solving Skills We want someone who can assess a situation, investigate, make reasonable decisions, and move things forward — not someone who stops at “there’s a problem.” Willingness to Learn & Adapt Engineering workflows, software, and client requirements evolve. You should be comfortable learning new tools and processes quickly and applying what you learn. Hubstaff & Remote Accountability This is a remote position, and Hubstaff will be used for time tracking and work accountability. You should be comfortable using Hubstaff appropriately and maintaining accurate work activity during scheduled hours. Remote work requires trust — and trust works both ways when expectations and accountability are clear. Nice to Have * Previous experience in an engineering firm, consultancy, construction company, or other technical environment * Experience supporting engineering leadership or technical executives * Exposure to construction documentation, plan review, submittals, or project workflows * Formal project management certification * Experience communicating directly with US-based clients * Strong familiarity with Bluebeam * A healthy sense of humor for those moments when the “urgent” email turns out to be a font complaint Why This Role Matters You won’t be sitting on the sidelines waiting for instructions. You’ll be part of the workflow that connects engineering, clients, documentation, administration, and project execution. The right person will become someone the team can trust to say: “I’ve reviewed it. Here’s the issue. Here’s what I recommend. And here’s what I’m doing next.” If that sounds like you, we’d like to hear from you. Applications without a CV and introduction video may not be considered. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. Applicants who do not meet the Civil Engineering or Mechanical Engineering degree requirement will not be considered.

description: Interior Designer / 3D Virtual Stager Dreamweaver is a US company that virtually stages real estate photos. Realtors send us photos of empty homes, we send back the same rooms furnished. If you are an exceptional interior designer, we have the most comprehensive interior design furniture library in the world (over 20,000 pieces) and design over 10,000 rooms every month. We're hiring designers who can do the following: - 3D modeling: build and adjust furniture and room scenes, keep furniture consistent across photos of the same home - QA: review staged photos, approve or reject them, catch mistakes (wrong scale, mismatched furniture, bad placement), publish the final images What we need: - Interior design or architecture background - Experience with a 3D tool (Blender, 3ds Max, SketchUp, etc.) - Detail-oriented - Working written English (tools and team chat are in English, no customer contact) - Own computer and reliable internet Full-time remote contractor. Familiarity with Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, or other social media platforms. Experience using tools such as Shopify, Shopline, CRM systems, or other e-commerce platforms. Our business operates with field technicians who travel to customers’ homes and businesses every day. Our office team is responsible for answering incoming calls, booking jobs, following up with leads, coordinating technicians, handling customers, ordering materials, working with vendors, and keeping the entire operation organized. We are continuing to grow, and we are looking for an exceptional Virtual General Manager / Senior Operations Manager who can become the owner’s right hand and eventually take responsibility for much of the company’s day-to-day operations. This is NOT a Virtual Assistant position. This is NOT simply a customer service or call-answering position. This is NOT a traditional 8-hour-a-day, Monday-Friday job. We are looking for an extremely capable, intelligent, resourceful, and dependable person. We don’t need someone who waits for instructions all day. We need someone who can see a problem, understand it, research it when necessary, make a good decision, take action, and follow through until the problem is solved. Our goal is to find someone we can eventually trust to run the daily operations of the company with minimal supervision. What You’ll Be Responsible For You will be involved in nearly every part of the business, including: * Managing the daily schedule of technicians, jobs, and appointments * Answering and managing customer calls professionally * Following up with new leads, estimates, and existing customers * Negotiating with customers and helping close sales * Coordinating technicians throughout the day * Making sure technicians arrive at jobs on time and jobs are completed efficiently * Handling customer complaints and finding solutions * Identifying operational problems before they become bigger problems * Ordering equipment, materials, tools, and supplies * Managing relationships with existing vendors * Finding better vendors, suppliers, and business partners * Opening new supplier and vendor accounts * Keeping track of unfinished tasks and making sure nothing falls through the cracks * Monitoring employee and technician performance * Improving company systems, procedures, and organization * Researching solutions independently when you don’t know the answer * Helping recruit and manage employees as the company grows * Working directly with the owner on company growth and daily decision-making * Taking responsibility for getting things done instead of simply reporting problems to the owner The Person We’re Looking For Intelligence, common sense, and problem-solving ability are extremely important for this position. We’re looking for someone who: * Thinks like an operator and business owner * Is exceptionally sharp and learns quickly * Has excellent judgment and common sense * Takes initiative without constantly waiting for instructions * Can solve complicated problems independently * Is extremely organized * Remembers details and follows through * Can manage many things happening at the same time * Communicates professionally and confidently * Can manage employees and technicians * Can negotiate with customers and help close sales * Is comfortable making decisions * Knows when to make a decision independently and when something truly needs the owner’s attention * Takes accountability for results, not just completed tasks * Can be trusted with increasing levels of responsibility We do not want someone whose mentality is: “Tell me what to do and I will do it.” We want someone whose mentality is: “I understand what needs to be accomplished. I will figure out how to make it happen.” Requirements * Previous experience as a General Manager, Operations Manager, Office Manager, Executive Operations Manager, or similar leadership position * Excellent spoken and written English * Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities * Excellent customer service skills * Strong sales and negotiation skills * Experience managing employees, schedules, and daily operations * Strong computer skills and ability to learn new software quickly * Ability to research and find answers independently * Ability to work with limited supervision * Reliable high-speed internet * Quiet and professional workspace * Long-term commitment Experience with a U.S.-based home-service, HVAC, restoration, construction, plumbing, electrical, cleaning, or similar field-service company is a major advantage. Schedule & Availability This position requires 7-day-a-week availability. This does not necessarily mean you will be actively working every hour, seven days a week. However, this is a senior operational position, and you must have the flexibility to respond when important situations require your attention. We are not looking for someone who wants to work a strict shift, clock out, and completely disconnect from the business. We need someone who understands that being responsible for operations sometimes requires handling an urgent customer, technician, scheduling, or operational issue outside normal working hours. The regular working schedule, time off, and exact availability expectations will be discussed during the interview. Compensation & Growth Starting Salary: $1,200 USD per month This is the starting salary, not the maximum salary. We want someone who can grow with the company. As you prove that you can independently manage more of the operation, solve problems, manage employees, improve performance, and reduce the amount of day-to-day involvement required from the owner, your compensation can increase. There is significant long-term growth potential for the right person. The more responsibility you can successfully take off the owner’s shoulders, the more valuable you become to the company. We are looking for someone who wants to build a long-term career and eventually become one of the company’s key leaders. IMPORTANT — READ BEFORE APPLYING We are not looking for hundreds of average applications. We are looking for one exceptional person. When submitting your application, you MUST include a brief explanation answering the following: “Why do you believe you are the best person for this position, and why should we trust you to eventually help run the company?” Tell us about relevant experience you’ve had, difficult problems you’ve solved, teams or operations you’ve managed, and what makes you different from other applicants. Generic answers will not help you. We want to understand how you think. Applications that do not include this explanation will NOT be considered. If you’re simply looking for another virtual assistant job where you answer calls and complete assigned tasks, please do not apply. If you’re highly intelligent, ambitious, resourceful, dependable, and want the opportunity to become the right hand of a business owner and grow into a major leadership position, we want to hear from you.

title: HubSpot CRM - Apollo.io Set up
description: My HubSpot account is half-built and still not delivering what I need. I work alone, so the portal must be streamlined for a single user who relies heavily on cold-calling. The core pieces I want finished are: • Outbound marketing configuration tailored to cold calls (calling queues, sequences, templates, reporting) • End-to-end lead tracking so every prospect moves cleanly from first touch to closed deal • Follow-up automation that keeps tasks, reminders, and nurture emails firing without manual effort I have already connected Apollo.io, Google Calendar, Calendly, and a ChatGPT integration, yet none of these are talking to HubSpot the way they should. You’ll review each link, clean up any mis-mapped fields, and make sure data flows smoothly in both directions. Please outline: 1. The exact steps you will take to finish the setup and integrations. 2. A realistic timeline. 3. Your fixed or milestone-based price to get everything live and tested. Once complete, I expect to log in, click a prospect, and see all activities, calls, tasks, and follow-ups automatically lined up—no extra hands required.

title: GTM & Sales Coordinator
description: The Role: WatchDog Security is looking for a proactive, highly organized GTM & Sales Coordinator to become the day-to-day coordination point for our commercial pipeline. We already run inbound and outbound campaigns that generate conversations. Your job is to make sure those conversations are handled well, followed up consistently, tracked properly, and moved toward the right next step. This is an early-stage role working closely with the founders. It combines inbound sales support, CRM ownership, proposal follow-up, warm prospecting, partner/customer coordination and practical GTM projects. It is not a cold-calling role. What We Are Looking For Required: -Excellent written and spoken English; comfortable representing a North American B2B technology company. -Strong organization and follow-through across many small conversations and deadlines. -Good judgment: able to read context, recognize what matters, and ask before making unsupported claims. -Experience in sales support, SDR/BDR work, customer support/success, lead generation, executive/virtual assistance, sales operations or a similar client-facing coordination role. -Comfort using a CRM such as Pipedrive, HubSpot, Salesforce or Dynamics. -Comfort researching prospects using LinkedIn and/or Sales Navigator. -Self-directed remote work habits and reliable communication. -Comfort working in an early-stage environment where processes are improving quickly. Nice to Have -B2B SaaS experience. -Experience supporting founders or small business owners. -Experience with MSPs/MSSPs, cybersecurity, compliance/GRC or technology services. -Experience coordinating webinars, customer feedback or lightweight marketing/GTM projects. What You Will Own -Monitor and respond to appropriate inbound LinkedIn and email conversations during working hours. -Follow up with prospects, open opportunities and proposals so worthwhile conversations do not disappear due to lack of follow-through. -Maintain Pipedrive for legitimate opportunities, including accurate stage, notes, next action and next-action date. -Re-engage suitable past prospects and opportunities using context rather than generic mass messages. -Research strong prospects and partners within the founders' existing LinkedIn network and start natural, relevant conversations. -Coordinate partner/MSP and customer follow-ups, feedback requests and meeting scheduling. -Prepare simple pre-call context and own the commercial follow-up after selected sales/partner calls. --Help with practical GTM projects during available capacity - for example webinar coordination, customer/partner feedback campaigns, testimonial outreach, prospect research or content/social coordination. -Escalate technical, legal, pricing, contract or strategic questions instead of guessing. What This Role Is NOT -No high-volume cold calling. -No expectation to be a cybersecurity expert on Day 1. What Success Looks Like -Inbound: Legitimate inbound is responded to promptly and professionally. -Follow-up Due follow-ups happen without a founder remembering or prompting them. -CRM Active opportunities are accurate and have a clear next action/date. -Proposals: Outstanding proposals always have a current follow-up plan. -Warm outreach: Relevant people are selected thoughtfully and approached naturally - no spam. -Relationships: Partners/customers receive appropriate follow-through and feedback coordination. -Autonomy: You increasingly identify useful work and bring the founders decisions, not task requests. Working Arrangement & Compensation Hours: Full-time, approximately 40 hours/week, with meaningful overlap with North American Eastern Time. Exact working schedule will be agreed with the successful candidate. Compensation: $800 USD/month for the ongoing full-time role. First 30 days: Paid onboarding and probation period at the same compensation rate, paid weekly during the first 30 days. Either side may determine that the role is not the right fit in accordance with the written engagement terms. 60 + 90-day review: Formal performance review after 60 & 90 days based on ownership, reliability, communication quality, initiative and results. This is intended to be a stable, long-term role for the right person.

title: Paid Ads Specialist
description: *About the Role* We are a growing social media marketing agency working with clients across a variety of industries. We are looking for an experienced Paid Ads Specialist to join our team on a contract basis and take ownership of paid advertising strategy and execution for a dedicated portfolio of women’s health clinic clients. This role is ideal for someone who understands how to create high-performing, conversion-focused paid campaigns while navigating the unique considerations of the healthcare and wellness space. You should be comfortable working independently, analyzing campaign performance, optimizing based on data, and collaborating with our internal team to align paid media with broader social and marketing strategies. *What You’ll Do* Develop and manage paid advertising campaigns primarily across Meta platforms (Facebook and Instagram), with the potential to expand to additional platforms as needed. Create paid media strategies designed to support client goals such as lead generation, appointment bookings, brand awareness, and patient acquisition. Set up, monitor, and optimize campaigns, audiences, budgets, placements, and creative performance. Collaborate with our social media and creative teams to identify strong content and develop paid ad creative recommendations. Conduct audience research and testing to identify opportunities for improved performance. Monitor campaign performance and make ongoing optimizations based on key metrics. Provide clear, easy-to-understand reporting and insights on campaign results, wins, challenges, and next steps. Stay up to date on platform changes, advertising best practices, and healthcare-related advertising policies. Help ensure campaigns are compliant with applicable advertising policies and guidelines, particularly within the women’s health and healthcare space. Communicate proactively with our agency team regarding campaign performance, needs, and recommendations. *What We’re Looking For* Proven experience managing paid social advertising campaigns, particularly on Meta Ads Manager. Experience with lead generation and conversion-focused campaigns. Previous experience working with healthcare, wellness, medical, or other regulated industries is highly preferred. Strong understanding of audience targeting, retargeting, campaign optimization, and A/B testing. Ability to analyze data and translate performance into actionable recommendations. Experience managing campaigns with varying budgets and client goals. Familiarity with tracking, pixels, conversion events, and campaign attribution. Strong communication and organizational skills. Ability to work independently and manage priorities within a limited weekly time commitment. Detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership of your area of expertise. *Nice to Have* Experience marketing specifically to women and/or working with women’s health brands or clinics. Experience with Google Ads or other paid advertising platforms. Familiarity with appointment booking funnels and local lead generation. Experience working with agencies and managing multiple client accounts. Knowledge of HIPAA-conscious marketing practices and healthcare advertising restrictions. Time Commitment & Compensation This is a contract position requiring approximately 5–10 hours per week, depending on campaign needs and client workload. Compensation will be based on experience, scope of work, and level of responsibility.

title: Social Media & UGC Sourcing
description: Growing DTC pet brand. This role owns the brand’s social presence and reputation, working directly alongside the Creative Strategist and Founder. THIS ROLE IS NOT A CONTENT-CALENDAR ROLE. The goal is not posting volume. The goal is compounding trust — customers who follow, engage, defend the brand in comments, and buy again. WHO ARE YOU Someone who has run social media for a DTC brand and has the results to prove it. Someone who has sourced and worked with UGC creators before and knows how to find the right fit for a brand, not just anyone with a camera. THE ROLE Reports to: Creative Strategist and Founder Type: Independent contractor, ongoing Focus: Managing social media pages, resolving or removing comments, and building brand reputation around the brand's core values WHAT YOU WILL DO - Manage posting across social media pages and moderate comments — resolve, respond, or remove as needed - Monitor comments daily; flag anything that needs the attention - Post organic content on social pages and manage the schedule - Grow follower count and engagement rate organically, month over month - Protect brand reputation — handle negative comments and reviews calmly and on-brand, escalate anything serious - Coordinate with the Creative Strategist on messaging consistency between organic and paid - Keep a simple content calendar and stay on schedule without needing to be chased - Source and vet UGC creators relevant to the brand REQUIREMENTS - Proven organic growth on Facebook, Instagram or TikTok for a consumer brand — portfolio required - Track record sourcing and working with UGC creators - Strong instinct for tone: warm, trustworthy, pet-owner voice — not corporate, not salesy - Comfortable handling public criticism without getting defensive or going silent - Native-level written English - Self-managed — comes with a weekly plan, doesn't wait to be told what to post NOT FOR YOU IF - You think growth means posting more, not posting better - You go quiet when a comment thread turns negative - You need a script for every caption - You disappear for days without an update How to apply: - Put “Caring SMM” at the top of your application letter. - Portfolios required — no exceptions. Applications without proof of past work will not be considered. - Don’t send an AI-generated or generic letter. We read every application and can tell when it’s AI-generated, so don’t bother. Compensation: To be discussed with the founder.

title: Tanero Engineering Team — 10 Specialized Full-Time Roles
job_title: Tanero Engineering Team — 10 Specialized Full-Time Roles
description: Tanero is building a small, highly specialized engineering team. We are NOT hiring immediately. We are currently identifying and evaluating exceptional candidates, with hiring expected to begin in approximately 3 months. This is not a general developer recruitment post. We are building a team of exactly 10 specialized full-time engineers. Each person will own a major area of the product and will be expected to work independently, think deeply, use modern AI coding tools, and take responsibility for the quality of their area. We are looking for engineers who want long-term ownership of a product, not freelancers looking for short projects. REMOTE Full-time 40 hours per week Long-term Direct hire Work from home Claude Code, Codex, and other professional AI development tools will be provided by Tanero. AI tools are expected to increase your speed, but you remain responsible for architecture, decisions, code quality, testing, security, and production reliability. We do NOT accept “the AI wrote it” as an explanation for poor work. --- AVAILABLE POSITIONS You MUST apply for ONE of the following positions. Applications that do not clearly identify one of these 10 roles will not be reviewed. 1. PRINCIPAL SOFTWARE ARCHITECT / ENGINEERING LEAD Salary: USD $1,500/month You will be responsible for the overall technical architecture of Tanero. We are looking for someone with strong experience in: * large software systems * architecture and system boundaries * TypeScript / Node.js * backend systems * distributed or event-driven systems * databases and state management * API architecture * code review * technical debt reduction * reliability and scalability You must be capable of understanding an existing large production codebase before proposing changes. We are NOT looking for someone whose first reaction is “rewrite everything.” You must be able to identify what should remain, what should be refactored, what should be replaced, and what should be removed. --- 2. AGENT RUNTIME / DEEPSEEK HARNESS ENGINEER Salary: USD $1,500/month This is NOT an n8n, Zapier, Make.com, or simple workflow automation position. You will work deeply with agent runtimes and eventually DeepSeek Harness or equivalent agent infrastructure. Strong knowledge expected in several of the following: * LLM agent loops * tool calling * agent orchestration * persistent sessions/state * background jobs * subagents * retries and failure recovery * permission systems * sandboxing * context management * event-driven systems * long-running tasks * model adapters/routing * TypeScript / Node.js * Python * production AI systems Experience with LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, AutoGen, CrewAI or similar systems is useful, but using a framework alone does NOT qualify you. We want someone who understands what happens underneath the framework. --- 3. SMART TOOLS / AUTONOMOUS AGENT ENGINEER Salary: USD $1,400/month You will own Tanero's autonomous client interaction and qualification system. This role requires strong understanding of: * autonomous agents * persistent state * long-running conversations * tool execution * client context * event processing * retries * duplicate prevention * background execution * decision systems * AI evaluation * failure handling * production reliability This is NOT workflow automation. If your primary experience is connecting OpenAI to Gmail using n8n, Zapier, Make or GoHighLevel, this position is not for you. --- 4. ORBIT / AGENT PRODUCT ENGINEER Salary: USD $1,300/month You will own Tanero's on-demand digital execution experience. Strong experience desired in: * AI agents * multi-step tool execution * conversational systems * browser automation * voice systems * approvals * background tasks * session management * agent UX * API integrations * tool calling * real-time applications You should understand how to turn an AI agent into a reliable product, not just a chatbot. --- 5. INTEGRATIONS & CHANNELS ENGINEER Salary: USD $1,100/month You will own external application connectivity. Strong experience with: * OAuth 2.0 * APIs * webhooks * Gmail / Google APIs * Microsoft Graph * calendars * email systems * messaging APIs * voice APIs * real-time events * authentication * token refresh * retries * integration reliability Experience with Composio or similar integration platforms is useful. Experience with n8n, Zapier or Make is acceptable for THIS ROLE, but you must also understand direct API integration and production backend development. --- 6. BACKEND / DATA SYSTEMS ENGINEER Salary: USD $1,200/month You will own core backend services and data consistency. Strong experience required in: * TypeScript / Node.js * APIs * SQL * data modeling * multi-tenant systems * queues * concurrency * idempotency * state management * event-driven architecture * security * performance * backend testing --- 7. PLATFORM / CLOUDFLARE / SRE ENGINEER Salary: USD $1,200/month You will own production infrastructure and reliability. Experience desired in: * Cloudflare Workers * Cloudflare Queues * Durable Objects * D1 * R2 * Containers * deployment pipelines * CI/CD * monitoring * logging * incident response * performance * security * infrastructure automation Strong general SRE / DevOps candidates are welcome even if they have not used every Cloudflare product. --- 8. LEAD PRODUCT DESIGN ENGINEER Salary: USD $1,200/month You will own the visual identity and product experience of Tanero. This is NOT a marketing website designer position. We need someone experienced in complex SaaS/product interfaces. Strong skills expected in: * product UX * visual hierarchy * typography * spacing * design systems * responsive design * mobile UX * interaction design * motion * complex application interfaces * component systems React / TypeScript / Tailwind experience is strongly preferred. You must be capable of owning the visual consistency of an entire product, not just designing individual screens. A strong portfolio is mandatory. --- 9. FRONTEND PRODUCT ENGINEER Salary: USD $1,000/month You will implement Tanero's product interface under the shared design system. Strong experience required in: * React * TypeScript * modern frontend architecture * reusable components * responsive interfaces * accessibility * complex SaaS applications * performance * state handling * frontend testing We are not looking for someone who primarily builds landing pages. --- 10. QA / RELIABILITY / AI EVALUATION ENGINEER Salary: USD $1,000/month You will be responsible for proving that Tanero works correctly before changes reach production. Strong experience desired in: * automated testing * Playwright * end-to-end testing * integration testing * regression testing * API testing * failure injection * edge-case discovery * CI quality gates * production debugging * AI/LLM evaluations * agent testing You must enjoy finding ways software can fail. This role is extremely important to us. --- WHO WE DO NOT WANT Please do not apply if: * You are an agency. * You are representing another developer. * You want project-based freelance work only. * You are applying to every software job without reading the description. * Your primary technical experience is only Zapier, Make, n8n, GoHighLevel or basic workflow automation and you are applying for an AI engineering role. * Your AI experience consists mainly of calling an LLM API and displaying the response. * You cannot show evidence of previous work. * You expect detailed instructions for every small task. * You cannot independently investigate and solve technical problems. * You are applying for a position not listed above. WE WILL NOT REVIEW APPLICATIONS OUTSIDE THESE 10 POSITIONS. --- HOW WE WORK Tanero expects engineers to use AI development tools aggressively and responsibly. Each engineer will receive professional AI development tools such as Claude Code and Codex. The expected workflow is: Understand the problem → investigate the existing system → design the correct solution → use AI to accelerate implementation → personally review the output → test aggressively → verify the result → take responsibility for production quality We value results, engineering judgment, reliability and speed. A small task should not become a one-week project without a legitimate technical reason. At the same time, we do not expect employees to sacrifice their health or work unreasonable hours. We expect approximately 8 focused working hours per day, 40 hours per week. If you become blocked, communicate early. Do not spend several days silently stuck on a problem. --- HOW TO APPLY Your FIRST LINE must contain: ROLE: [exact position name from the list above] Then provide: 1. Your requested monthly salary in USD. 2. Your current location. 3. Confirmation that you can work full-time, 40 hours/week. 4. GitHub profile, if available. 5. Portfolio or personal website, if relevant. 6. LinkedIn profile, if available. 7. Two or three projects most relevant to the role. 8. For each project, explain exactly what YOU personally designed or built. 9. Your primary programming languages and technologies. 10. A short answer to: “What is the most technically difficult system you personally built, what went wrong while building it, and how did you make it reliable?” AI/Agent candidates must also answer: “Describe the most complex production AI agent system you have built. Explain its tool execution, state management, background work, retries, failure recovery, and how unsafe or duplicate actions were prevented.” Do not send a generic ChatGPT-generated cover letter. We care far more about what you have actually built and how you think. --- IMPORTANT Hiring is expected to begin approximately 3 months from now. This posting is currently being used to identify and evaluate the strongest candidates in advance. We are willing to wait for exceptional people. We would rather hire 10 excellent engineers than 30 average engineers. If selected for the next stage, candidates will later receive a short paid practical evaluation relevant to the exact position they applied for.

title: Ecommerce Growth Operator | AI Creative Production, Shopify, Meta Ads & Customer Support
job_title: Ecommerce Growth Operator | AI Creative Production, Shopify, Meta Ads & Customer Support
description: We are building and testing multiple ecommerce brands and are looking for someone who can help us move products from research and testing into profitable growth. We need someone who understands ecommerce from the customer’s point of view and can help with product research, Shopify product pages, AI-powered ad creative production, competitor research, Meta creative testing, and eventually customer support and day-to-day store operations. This is not a basic task-based VA role. We are looking for someone who can think, research, make recommendations, create original advertising assets, organize projects, and help us move quickly based on real market data. We are currently in a product-testing and growth phase, so the initial role will be **project-based and paid per assignment or creative batch**, with the opportunity to grow into consistent part-time or full-time work as our brands scale. What success looks like Within the first few days, you should be able to understand one of our products, study the competitors and advertising landscape, identify strong creative angles, and turn those insights into original ads we can test. Once a product is approved for testing, you should be able to help prepare: * High-converting Shopify product pages * Product offers and bundles * Static Meta ads * Short-form video ads * AI-generated product and lifestyle creative * UGC-style concepts * Competitor creative research * Multiple hooks and creative variations * Organized launch materials As products begin generating consistent orders, responsibilities may expand into customer service, order support, returns, supplier communication, and store maintenance. The goal is to **test quickly, produce more quality creative, protect margins, learn from advertising data, and scale products that show real potential.** ## What you will do 1. Research ecommerce products and competitors across categories such as fashion, accessories, jewelry, home, beauty, pet, automotive, gifting, lifestyle products and other high-potential niches. 2. Use multiple research sources to understand product demand and competitor activity. This may include: * Kalodata * WinningHunter * PipiAds * Facebook Ads Library * TikTok Creative Center * Organic TikTok * Similarweb * Google Trends * Amazon reviews * Competitor websites * Instagram * Other ecommerce research sources 3. Review competitor: * Advertising * Offers * Pricing * Product pages * Bundles * Reviews * Customer language * Creative angles * Shipping promises * Guarantees * Upsells 4. Identify the strongest advertising patterns competitors are using and explain why you believe they are working. 5. Turn competitor research into **original advertising concepts** for our brands. 6. Create static ads for Meta using product images, lifestyle imagery, customer benefits, reviews, offers, bundles and strong direct-response hooks. 7. Create short-form video advertisements using product footage and AI tools. 8. Use AI tools to create or enhance: * UGC-style ads * Product demonstrations * Lifestyle footage * Product backgrounds * Models * Image-to-video content * Voiceovers * B-roll * Product scenes * Hooks * Creative variations 9. Create multiple variations from promising concepts rather than constantly starting from scratch. 10. Build or improve Shopify product pages with: * Premium product images * Strong headlines * Product benefits * Reviews * FAQs * Trust elements * Shipping information * Bundle offers * Upsells * Mobile-friendly layouts 11. Help prepare products for Meta advertising tests. 12. Review advertising results with us and understand metrics such as: * CTR * CPM * CPC * Add-to-cart rate * Checkout rate * Cost per purchase * ROAS * Conversion rate 13. Use advertising performance to decide which creative concepts should be iterated. 14. Keep product research, competitor ads, supplier information, creative files, images, videos and test results organized. 15. As our brands grow, assist with: * Customer emails * Tracking questions * Order issues * Returns * Exchanges * Supplier follow-up * Shopify order management * Customer service * General store maintenance ## Creative standards We are not looking for random AI-generated content. Every creative should have a clear reason behind it. A strong ad should ideally have: 1. Strong visual stopping power 2. A clear hook 3. Obvious product visibility 4. One main customer desire or pain point 5. Strong mobile readability 6. Clear product benefits 7. A compelling offer where appropriate 8. Social proof where available 9. A clear CTA 10. Enough originality that it feels like our brand rather than a copied competitor advertisement We want someone who understands the difference between: **a nice-looking piece of content** and **an advertisement designed to generate a purchase.** ## Competitor creative research We will often give you competitor websites and advertising examples. Your responsibility is to understand **why the advertisement works**, not simply copy it. For example: A competitor may be running: **Buy 1 Get 1 Free + product close-up + customer lifestyle footage** Your job may be to turn that concept into: **Our own product footage + our own brand + different environment + original hook + our own offer + original editing** You must understand the difference between **creative research and creative copying**. Do not simply download competitor advertisements, change the logo and reuse them. ## Product standards Products we move forward with should ideally have: 1. Strong visual appeal 2. A clear customer desire or problem 3. Existing demand or social interest 4. Reliable supplier options 5. Enough margin for product cost, shipping and paid advertising 6. Strong creative potential 7. Bundle or upsell possibilities where appropriate 8. Low trademark or intellectual-property risk 9. Reasonable shipping times 10. Enough perceived value to support paid customer acquisition ## Tools and experience we value Please tell us which of these you have personally used and what you use them for. **Research** Kalodata WinningHunter PipiAds Facebook Ads Library TikTok Creative Center Organic TikTok research Similarweb Google Trends Amazon reviews Competitor store analysis **Shopify and conversion** Shopify Shrine Elixir Atlas Kopy PagePilot Replo PageFly Kaching Bundle Klaviyo Loox **Creative production** Canva CapCut Higgsfield Kling Runway Veo Midjourney Adobe Firefly Gemini Nano Banana ChatGPT Claude ElevenLabs **Ads and tracking** Meta Business Manager Meta Ads Manager Meta Pixel Conversions API Triple Whale WeTrack GA4 Shopify Analytics You do not need to have used every tool listed. We care more about your **actual workflow, judgment, quality of work, speed and ability to learn.** ## Initial work structure and compensation This will initially be a **paid project-based position**, not a fixed monthly salary. We are currently testing multiple ecommerce products, so the amount of work may change from week to week. You may be assigned individual projects or creative batches such as: * 3–5 static ads * 2–4 short-form video ads * AI UGC concepts * Hook variations * Product-page improvements * Competitor creative research * Creative iterations based on winning advertisements Please provide your pricing for: 1. One static ecommerce advertisement 2. One 15–30 second video advertisement 3. One AI UGC-style advertisement 4. A batch of 4 static ads + 2 video ads 5. Your hourly rate for Shopify or customer-support work if needed If the relationship works well and our brands continue growing, this can become a consistent part-time or full-time role with increased responsibilities. ## Customer support Customer support will **not necessarily be the main responsibility at the beginning**. Initially, the priority will be ecommerce creative production, product testing support and Shopify work. As order volume grows, we may also need assistance with: * Customer emails * “Where is my order?” requests * Tracking updates * Returns * Exchanges * Refund requests * Address changes * Supplier follow-up * Order issues Experience with ecommerce customer support is therefore a strong bonus. ## Trial Shortlisted applicants will complete a **paid trial assignment**. You may receive: * One product * One product page * Product images * Competitor advertisements * Competitor website * Creative references You may then be asked to produce: **1 original static Meta ad* and **1 original 15–30 second video ad** We are not looking for copies of the competitor's advertisements. We want to see whether you understand the underlying strategy and can turn it into something original that we can actually test. ## How to apply Start your proposal with: # **ECOM OPERATOR** Then answer the following: 1. How many ecommerce products or brands have you personally worked on? 2. Show us 3–5 ecommerce advertisements you personally created. 3. Include at least one static advertisement. 4. Include at least one video advertisement. 5. Include at least one AI-assisted advertisement if available. 6. Explain exactly what part of each advertisement you personally created. 7. Which AI tools do you currently use for image and video production? 8. Have you personally used Facebook Ads Library, WinningHunter, PipiAds, Kalodata or TikTok Creative Center? 9. Explain how you research competitor advertisements before creating your own version. 10. If we gave you 10 competitor ads and one product page, how would you decide which creative concepts to test first? 11. What Shopify themes, page builders or apps have you worked with? 12. Have you managed ecommerce customer service, returns or order issues before? 13. What Meta advertising metrics do you understand? 14. How quickly could you deliver: * 4 static ads * 2 video ads * 3 additional hooks 15. Give us your price for: * 1 static ad * 1 video ad * 4 statics + 2 videos * Hourly Shopify/customer-support work 16. What hours are you normally available and what timezone are you in? 17. Confirm that you are willing to complete a **paid trial assignment**. Generic applications will not be considered. We are looking for **real examples, real process, clear thinking and someone who wants to grow with an ecommerce operation long term.*

title: Remote Appointment Setter & Lead Conversion Specialist | Warm Leads | US Hours
job_title: Remote Appointment Setter & Lead Conversion Specialist | Warm Leads | US Hours

title: Graphic Design / Prepress Technician
description: Unicorn Graphics is a leading commercial print provider with digital, offset and wide format print capabilities. Located in New York. We are currently seeking candidates for the position of Prepress Technician / Operator. The position is responsible mainly for preparing files for offset and digital printing as well as communicating with clients directly. job_title: Senior Executive Assistant to Founder — AI, Operations & Personal Support
description: I’m the founder of a growing marketplace that helps businesses and individuals find financial professionals. I’m looking for a senior Executive Assistant who can become my operational right hand. This is not a basic virtual assistant role, and I am not looking for someone who waits for a daily task list. I move quickly, have a lot happening at once, and need someone who can bring structure to that environment, keep track of commitments, make good decisions independently, and make sure important things actually get finished. The goal of this role is simple: reduce the number of things that require me. WHAT YOU WILL OWN You will gradually take ownership of: - Managing and triaging my inbox - Drafting and eventually handling routine communications on my behalf - Calendar management, scheduling, conflicts, and meeting preparation - Turning meetings, transcripts, voice notes, and ideas into clear tasks and follow-ups - Making sure things I committed to actually happen - Following up with customers, vendors, contractors, partners, and other stakeholders - Travel planning, flights, hotels, transportation, reservations, and itineraries - Event logistics, guest lists, invitations, RSVPs, and follow-up - Personal administrative tasks such as gifts, appointments, purchases, and travel - Tracking invoices, payments, outstanding requests, and administrative loose ends - Coordinating with contractors and developers when something needs to be fixed or completed - Supporting outreach and maintaining accurate CRM/task information - Scheduling approved social content and helping prepare basic assets when needed - Researching questions and presenting recommendations rather than simply sending me links - Building systems, SOPs, and processes as you learn how I operate - Identifying repetitive work that can be improved or eliminated with AI and automation You will have access to sensitive business and personal information. Judgment, discretion, security, and attention to detail are extremely important. AI AND AUTOMATION ARE A MAJOR PART OF THIS ROLE I am specifically looking for someone who is already highly proficient with AI. Using ChatGPT to rewrite an email is not enough. You should be comfortable using tools such as ChatGPT and Claude every day and ideally have experience with tools such as Zapier, Make, n8n, ClickUp, Notion, Slack, Google Workspace, Fireflies, or similar systems. I want someone who sees a repetitive process and asks: “Why are we still doing this manually?” Strong candidates should be able to show examples of workflows, automations, systems, agents, or processes they personally built or materially owned. You do not have to be an engineer. You do need to be resourceful enough to figure things out. WHAT I AM LOOKING FOR Ideally, you have: - 5+ years of professional experience - 3+ years directly supporting a founder, CEO, entrepreneur, or senior executive - At least one role where you stayed long enough to earn significant trust and responsibility - Experience working directly with U.S.-based executives - Excellent spoken and written English - Strong executive communication skills - Experience owning inboxes, calendars, follow-up, travel, projects, and confidential information - Demonstrated use of AI and automation beyond simple content generation - Strong project-management and organizational ability - Excellent judgment about what you can handle independently versus what needs to be escalated - The confidence to manage up and respectfully push back when appropriate - The ability to work full-time, Monday–Friday, approximately 9:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time, with occasional flexibility around travel and events - Reliable internet, equipment, and a backup plan for power/connectivity THE PERSONALITY THAT WILL SUCCEED HERE You are calm when things are moving quickly. You do not become overwhelmed because priorities changed. You do not need every process documented before you can begin. You research before asking questions. When you encounter a problem, you prefer to come back with: “Here are the three options. I recommend option two because…” rather than: “What do you want me to do?” You are comfortable reminding a founder about things, following up repeatedly when necessary, protecting their time, and telling them when they are creating too many priorities. THIS ROLE IS PROBABLY NOT A FIT IF - You need detailed step-by-step instructions for most tasks - Your AI experience is primarily asking ChatGPT to draft emails - You become uncomfortable when priorities change - You prefer a highly structured corporate environment - You are uncomfortable receiving direct feedback - You routinely need your executive to remind you about follow-ups - You are looking to work multiple overlapping full-time jobs COMPENSATION $2,000–$2,500 USD per month, depending on experience and demonstrated ability. Full-time, long-term role. There will be a compensation and performance review after your first 90 days. Benefits include 10 paid vacation days after 90 days, paid U.S. holidays, and a long-term growth opportunity. HOW TO APPLY Start your application with the words: FOUNDER OPS Applications that do not include those words will not be reviewed. Please include: 1. Your resume or LinkedIn profile. 2. A 2–3 minute video answering: - Who is the most demanding founder or executive you have supported? - What did they trust you to handle independently? - What is one system, automation, or workflow you personally built or significantly improved? - What AI and automation tools do you personally use today? - What are your current work commitments, and when could you begin working full-time Eastern Time? 3. Tell me your desired monthly salary. 4. Answer this scenario in no more than 200 words: It is Friday at 4:00 PM. Your executive has 15 important unread emails, three people waiting on promised documents, two appointments that still need to be scheduled, and has not given you any additional instructions. What do you do? Candidates who advance will complete a paid, two-hour work sample designed to test judgment, prioritization, communication, ownership, and practical AI/automation ability. Finalists will also be asked for professional references. I am looking for someone who wants to become deeply trusted, learn the business, take on increasing responsibility, and build a long-term working relationship with a founder.

Demonstrable experience with UK personal debt, business debt or insolvency cases - Strong knowledge of UK creditor procedures and debt-recovery practices - Experience preparing statements of affairs, creditor schedules and affordability assessments - Excellent written English and professional communication skills - Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills - Meticulous, confidential and non-judgmental - Able to distinguish between administrative support and advice that legally requires UK authorisation HIGHLY DESIRABLE - Experience with Northern Ireland bankruptcy and insolvency procedures - UK accounting, bookkeeping, debt-advice or insolvency qualifications - Previous employment with a UK accountancy practice, insolvency firm, debt-advice organisation or creditor-negotiation service - Experience with director guarantees, tax debts, Bounce Back Loans, VAT liabilities and dissolved or insolvent companies - Existing access to a qualified UK insolvency practitioner or solicitor for regulated matters IMPORTANT This role requires genuine UK experience. Which parts of this work can you personally undertake, and which would require a UK-authorised insolvency practitioner or solicitor? 8. What is your preferred hourly rate and availability? title: PROPERTY DAMAGE SPECIALISTS
description: Champion Injury Attorneys is seeking an experienced Property Damage Specialist to manage our clients’ property damage claims from beginning to end. In your down time assist case managers. This is a dedicated property damage position supporting our case managers and clients. We are looking for someone who already understands plaintiff side property damage claims and can independently move files forward without waiting to be told what the next step is. The right person understands that property damage is often one of the first serious problems a client faces after a collision. Our clients may be without transportation, dealing with a totaled vehicle, facing storage charges, waiting on repairs, or trying to understand an insurance company’s position. We want someone who takes ownership of those problems, communicates clearly, and works toward a prompt and favorable resolution. Responsibilities The Property Damage Specialist will be responsible for managing assigned property damage claims from beginning through final resolution, including: • Open and manage first party and third party property damage claims • Communicate directly with clients regarding the status of their vehicles and property damage claims • Communicate and negotiate with insurance adjusters • Obtain photographs, estimates, repair information, police reports, vehicle information, and supporting documentation • Coordinate vehicle inspections and appraisals • Assist clients with repair claims and repair facility issues • Handle total loss claims from beginning through resolution • Review total loss evaluations for accuracy • Review vehicle valuations, comparable vehicles, mileage, options, condition, and other factors affecting value • Challenge inaccurate or unreasonable total loss valuations when appropriate • Negotiate property damage settlements • Assist clients with rental vehicles • Address rental extensions and unreasonable rental termination issues • Handle loss of use claims when appropriate • Address towing and storage issues • Work to prevent unnecessary storage charges and avoidable delays • Communicate with body shops, tow yards, rental companies, lienholders, insurance companies, and other parties involved in the property damage claim • Help clients obtain payment once the property damage claim has been resolved • Follow through until repairs, total loss payments, rentals, and related property damage issues are completed • Prepare and timely file California DMV SR 1 Reports of Traffic A ---------- Occurring in California when required • Prepare and submit SR 6 documentation when appropriate • Monitor DMV related deadlines and confirm required filings have been completed • Maintain accurate file notes, documentation, follow up dates, and status updates in the case management system • Keep the assigned case manager informed of significant developments • Immediately escalate unusual coverage issues, liability disputes, unreasonable carrier conduct, or other issues requiring case manager or attorney involvement • Confirm that the property damage portion of the file is properly completed before closing it out What We Are Looking For The ideal candidate has: • At least 2 years of successful property damage experience at a plaintiff personal injury law firm • Strong knowledge of California automobile property damage claims • Experience handling both repairable vehicles and total losses • Experience reviewing and challenging total loss evaluations • Knowledge of rental claims and loss of use • Experience handling towing and storage issues • Experience communicating and negotiating with insurance adjusters • Familiarity with California DMV a ---------- reporting requirements, including SR 1 filings • Strong follow through and organizational skills • The ability to manage multiple active property damage claims at the same time • Excellent client communication skills • Strong written and verbal communication skills • The judgment to recognize when something does not look right and investigate it • The ability to work independently while communicating effectively with case managers • A strong sense of urgency when a client is without transportation or facing rental, towing, storage, repair, or total loss problems What Success Looks Like We are not looking for someone whose job is simply to make follow up calls. A successful Property Damage Specialist: • Knows what needs to happen next on every assigned claim • Does not allow property damage files to sit without action • Identifies problems before they become larger problems • Keeps clients informed throughout the process • Pushes insurance companies when claims are unnecessarily delayed • Carefully reviews total loss valuations instead of simply accepting the insurance company’s number • Protects clients from unnecessary rental, towing, storage, and repair related problems • Makes sure required DMV filings are completed timely • Documents the file thoroughly • Keeps case managers informed without requiring them to manage the property damage process • Takes ownership of the claim until it is actually resolved Required Experience At least 2 years of experience successfully handling property damage claims for a plaintiff personal injury law firmis required. Prior insurance adjusting experience is helpful but not required. REMOTE Position This is a dedicated Property Damage Specialist position supporting the personal injury case management team at Champion Injury Attorneys.
