title: SEO Specialist & Website Manager
description: We're a U.S.-based digital marketing agency specializing in SEO, websites, content and lead generation for contractors and home service businesses. We're looking for an experienced SEO Engineer & Website Manager to join our team in a long-term, full-time position. This is not an entry-level role, and this is not a checklist-following VA position. We're looking for someone who understands how websites, SEO, local search, structured data and modern AI-driven search work together — someone who can look at a website or task, understand the goal, identify what is missing or wrong, and make smart decisions without needing every step spelled out. You should be comfortable saying: **“I found the problem, here's why it's happening, and here's what I recommend we do.”** Not: **“Please tell me exactly what to do next.”** What You'll Do You will help own the technical and execution side of SEO and website management across multiple U.S.-based client accounts. Your responsibilities will include: * Manage ongoing WordPress website updates and SEO implementation * Work extensively in **WordPress, Elementor and WP Engine** * Perform on-page SEO optimizations, including: * title tags and meta descriptions * headings and page structure * internal linking * external linking * image optimization * content formatting * service and location-page optimization * indexing and canonical checks * Review websites for missing, outdated, thin or poorly optimized content and proactively flag what needs attention * Implement approved website content rather than allowing completed content to sit unpublished * Build, update and troubleshoot landing pages, service pages and other website sections * Perform website QA before and after launches and major updates * Troubleshoot Elementor display conditions, responsive issues, forms, navigation, templates and other front-end problems * Coordinate website changes with developers when development support is required * Review developer work instead of assuming that a completed ticket means the work was completed correctly * Clearly document bugs, screenshots, expected behavior and required fixes when escalating development issues SEO & Local Search You will also support our organic search work across multiple client accounts, including: * Conduct detailed on-page SEO reviews * Perform Google Business Profile audits * Identify inconsistencies or missed optimization opportunities across client websites and local profiles * Review Google Search Console for indexing, performance and technical issues * Help identify why rankings, traffic or visibility changed rather than simply reporting that they changed * Review existing content performance and identify pages that should be improved, consolidated, expanded or reformatted * Help optimize content for both traditional search engines and AI-driven search experiences * Support internal linking strategies and entity relationships across client websites * Research competitors when needed to understand why they may be outperforming a client * Flag technical, content or authority issues before they become larger problems Schema & Structured Data Structured data is an important part of our SEO process. You will: * Complete and review schema intake information * Help implement and QA advanced JSON-LD schema * Understand connected schema entities rather than treating schema as isolated markup * Review Organization, LocalBusiness, Service, Person, ProfilePage, WebSite, WebPage and related schema * Test implementation using schema validation tools * Identify incorrect, incomplete or conflicting schema * Coordinate with developers when schema implementation requires development support * Verify the final implementation rather than considering a task complete simply because code was added You do not need to be the world's foremost schema expert on day one, but you must be technically curious and capable of learning advanced implementation quickly. Website Ownership One of the biggest things we need from this position is ownership. When you are responsible for a website task, we expect you to follow it through to completion. That means: * confirming requirements before work begins * identifying missing information early * completing what you can independently * escalating true blockers quickly * following up on delegated development work * testing the completed work * documenting what changed * confirming the task actually solved the original problem You should not require a manager to repeatedly check whether something was completed, remind you of the deadline or discover that a task was only partially finished. Think, Don't Just Execute We are specifically looking for someone with professional judgment. If you're given a task and notice something else is wrong, say something. If instructions conflict with what you see on the website, investigate. If a developer's solution doesn't make sense, question it. If an SEO recommendation could hurt the client, don't blindly implement it. If you aren't sure whether something is technically correct, research it and come back with a recommendation. We would rather hear: “I investigated this and recommend Option B because…” than receive ten questions that could have been answered through reasonable research and professional judgment. Internal AI & Automation We want this person to become one of Elevation Marketing's internal **AI power users**. You will help us: * stay current on meaningful developments in AI, search and marketing technology * identify AI tools or workflows that could improve efficiency or client results * help create and maintain custom GPTs and internal AI tools * improve prompts and workflows used by our team * research new capabilities and determine whether they are genuinely useful or simply hype * help document repeatable AI-assisted processes * find opportunities to automate repetitive work without sacrificing quality or judgment We're not looking for someone who uses AI to replace thinking. We're looking for someone who uses AI to think and execute better. Project & Team Support You will work closely with our project-management and SEO teams and help keep execution moving. This includes: * maintaining clear updates in ClickUp * reviewing assigned tasks and understanding the desired outcome before beginning * raising blockers early rather than at the deadline * communicating clearly with project managers, writers, designers and developers * documenting work completed and next steps * helping Josefina keep website and SEO projects moving forward * recognizing when you can solve something yourself versus when it genuinely needs to be escalated ClickUp experience is preferred but not required. We can teach the platform. We cannot teach ownership, curiosity or professional judgment. What We're Looking For Must Have * 4+ years of hands-on SEO and/or website-management experience * Strong WordPress experience * Strong Elementor experience * Experience working with **WP Engine** * Strong on-page SEO knowledge * Technical SEO troubleshooting ability * Experience managing or maintaining multiple websites * Experience with Google Search Console * Familiarity with GA4 * Working knowledge of Google Business Profiles and Local SEO * Experience implementing or reviewing schema / structured data * Ability to troubleshoot website problems independently * Strong written English communication * Excellent attention to detail * Ability to work U.S. business hours * Experience working successfully with a remote team Agency experience is strongly preferred. Experience working with U.S. contractors, home services or local service businesses is a major plus. Nice to Have * ClickUp experience * Advanced JSON-LD/schema experience * Google Tag Manager experience * Technical GA4/tracking troubleshooting * Basic HTML/CSS knowledge * Experience with Cloudflare * Experience with Gravity Forms * Experience with Rank Math * Experience building custom GPTs or internal AI workflows * Familiarity with SEO tools such as Ahrefs or Semrush * Experience with website migrations and launches Who We're Looking For We want someone who is curious, resourceful and proactive. You do not need permission to notice a problem. You do not blindly check a box because a task says “complete.” You understand that: **Task completed ≠ outcome achieved.** If a form was installed, you test it. If schema was implemented, you validate it. If a page was published, you check it on desktop and mobile. If a developer says something is fixed, you verify the fix. If something looks wrong, you investigate before passing it along to someone else. And when you need help, you come to us with context: What you were trying to accomplish → what you checked → what you found → what you think the solution is. We're looking for someone who wants a long-term position, continued professional growth and the opportunity to become a trusted technical member of our team. Compensation PHP 107,000–150,000/month, based on experience. We're willing to pay competitively for someone with the expertise and judgment we're looking for. How to Apply 1. Include the word “Frog” as the first word in the subject/title of your application. 2. Use exactly 5 Apply Points when submitting your application. Then answer the following: 1. Briefly introduce yourself and tell us how many years of hands-on SEO and WordPress experience you have. 2. Describe your experience with WordPress, Elementor and WP Engine. Include one example of a website problem you personally diagnosed and solved. 3. You're asked to implement something on a client website, but while reviewing the page you realize the requested change probably isn't the real problem. What do you do? Answer in 3–5 sentences. 4. Tell us about your experience with technical SEO, Google Search Console, Local SEO and schema/structured data. Please be specific about what you personally implemented versus what another team member handled. 5. Tell us how you currently use AI in your work and give one example of a workflow, custom GPT, automation or process you would be excited to build inside a digital marketing agency. Please keep your response concise. We're less interested in certifications and more interested in how you think, investigate problems, communicate and take ownership. We are looking for an experienced professional who can become a trusted part of our team — not someone waiting for the next instruction. We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Digital Marketing Assistant
description: Join AEK Media, an award-winning digital marketing agency, and work remotely with a global team. You’ll help manage paid campaigns across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, Pinterest and more. This role is ideal for someone who already has hands-on paid media experience, wants to take greater ownership of campaign performance, and is eager to develop into a well-rounded digital marketer. ---------- Your Role Manage Paid Advertising Build, manage, monitor and optimise campaigns across Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, Pinterest and other platforms. Own Campaign Performance Regularly analyse results, identify opportunities and make optimisation decisions rather than simply following a checklist. Client Setup & Tracking Assist with client onboarding and ensure conversion tracking is implemented accurately across advertising platforms, GA4 and Google Tag Manager. Reporting Build and maintain clear reporting dashboards using Looker Studio and Google Sheets, turning campaign data into useful insights. Strategy & Analysis Develop campaigns around the customer journey, understand the role of different channels and use data to determine where budget should be allocated. Commercial Thinking Understand that campaign success goes beyond clicks and leads. Consider lead quality, conversion rates, acquisition costs, customer value and the commercial objectives of each client. Collaboration Work closely with strategists, creatives, developers and account managers to improve campaign performance and deliver strong client outcomes. Website Updates Make minor updates to client websites and landing pages, and coordinate larger changes with our development team. About You 2+ years of hands-on experience managing paid advertising campaigns, ideally across multiple client accounts. You should be comfortable independently working inside Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager, rather than having only reporting or account coordination experience. You have experience with campaign setup, audience targeting, keyword research, bidding, budget management, creative testing and ongoing optimisation. You can look at campaign data and explain what is happening, why it is happening and what you would do next. You understand key performance metrics such as CPA, CPL, ROAS, conversion rate, CTR and CPC, and know when each metric matters. You have working knowledge of GA4, Google Tag Manager and conversion tracking. Experience troubleshooting tracking issues is highly regarded. You are comfortable working with Google Sheets or Excel and can confidently analyse campaign data. You have strong attention to detail. You notice tracking discrepancies, incorrect URLs, budget issues, broken landing pages and other small problems before they become bigger ones. You are proactive and comfortable taking ownership. If you see an issue, you investigate it and suggest a solution rather than waiting to be told what to do. You can manage multiple client accounts and competing priorities in a fast-paced remote environment. You communicate clearly in writing and can explain marketing performance to people who may not have a technical marketing background. You are curious and want to understand why something works rather than simply replicating what you have seen elsewhere. Highly Regarded Experience managing campaigns across both lead generation and eCommerce accounts Experience with LinkedIn Ads, Pinterest Ads or other paid media platforms Looker Studio reporting experience WordPress or Elementor experience Landing page and CRO knowledge Basic understanding of SEO Experience working within an agency Experience managing meaningful advertising budgets across multiple accounts Why AEK Media? Work remotely with a globally recognised, award-winning team. Work across a diverse range of industries, campaign types and digital channels. Develop your skills beyond simply managing ads, with exposure to strategy, analytics, CRO, creative, websites and broader digital marketing. Take on greater responsibility as your skills develop, with genuine opportunities for career progression. Join a culture that values transparency, merit and action. Our Values No Black Boxes – Transparency in all we do Do Things Today, Not Tomorrow – Take action and keep things moving Open Forum – Good ideas can come from anyone Don’t Avoid the Details – The small things often make the biggest difference Consider the Commercial – Marketing needs to deliver meaningful business outcomes How to Apply We welcome applications from people who may not meet every requirement. However, we are looking for candidates with genuine hands-on paid media experience who can demonstrate how they think about campaign performance. Along with your CV, please include brief answers to the following: 1. Which advertising platforms have you personally managed? 2. What approximate monthly advertising budgets have you been responsible for? 3. Tell us about one campaign you improved. What was underperforming, what did you change and what happened? 4. What is your experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager and conversion tracking? 5. How many client accounts or campaigns have you managed simultaneously? 6. What is one optimisation you would investigate if a campaign’s CPA suddenly increased by 50%? 7. Which areas of digital marketing are you most interested in developing over the next two years? We’re less interested in textbook answers than in understanding how you think, how much ownership you’ve had, and how you approach solving problems.

title: Local SEO
description: About the work We manage digital marketing for a family dental practice in Gilbert, Arizona. The practice has a strong local reputation, over 358 Google reviews at a 4.9 average, and a Google Business Profile that performs well. The problem is specific. The website ranks at position 1.7 for the practice name and almost nowhere for the services people actually search: dental implants, extractions, fillings, oral surgery. Those keywords generate hundreds of impressions per month at positions 30 to 50 and produce close to zero clicks. This is a long term role, not a one off project. We want someone who takes ownership of local SEO and citations and keeps improving them month after month. What you will do Citations, ongoing (a core part of this role) Audit and correct existing listings. There are currently at least four incorrect phone numbers and one incorrect suite number published across the web Build new citations every month on dental, medical, and local directories such as Healthgrades, Zocdoc, Vitals, WebMD, and relevant Arizona and Gilbert directories Find and resolve duplicate or unclaimed listings Re check listings on a regular schedule, because directories change data without warning Keep a running tracker of every listing, its status, and the exact name, address, and phone published on it On-page SEO in WordPress Write and set title tags, meta descriptions, and Open Graph tags using Rank Math Fix missing H1 headings on service and contact pages Set up 301 redirects for pages that changed URLs Find and fix broken internal links Resolve duplicate URL variants (for example /reviews and /reviews/) Google Business Profile Optimize categories, services, business description, Q&A, and photos Deploy and validate LocalBusiness and Dentist schema markup on the website Reporting Track keyword position changes in Google Search Console Report every week on what was completed, what changed, and what you recommend next What we need from you 2 or more years doing local SEO for US-based businesses Real citation building and cleanup experience, including handling duplicate listings Comfortable working inside WordPress with the Elementor page builder You have used Rank Math or Yoast for real client work, not just tutorials You can read Google Search Console and Google Business Profile data and explain what it means Clear written English. You will be reporting your own work, so we need to understand you You finish things. This matters more to us than anything else on this list Nice to have Experience with WP Rocket caching and Cloudflare Experience with healthcare or dental clients Basic HTML and CSS for small page edits Familiarity with the Medicross WordPress theme About finishing Our biggest problem with past work has not been skill. It has been tasks that were 80 percent done and called finished. A page went live but had no title tag. A broken link was fixed on the homepage but no redirect was created, so the old URL still returned a 404. A new page was published but was never added to the site navigation, so nobody could find it. For us, a task is done when: the change is live, the metadata is set, internal links point to it, redirects exist if a URL changed, and you have verified it yourself in a logged out browser with the cache cleared. If you check your own work before calling it complete, you will do well here and we will keep you busy long term. What this is not This is not a link building or content writing role. We write our own content. We do not want private blog networks, purchased links, bulk directory spam, or AI generated filler pages. We are a real practice with real patients and we are building this properly.

title: SEO Copywriter – AI-Assisted SEO & Website Content
job_title: SEO Copywriter – AI-Assisted SEO & Website Content
description: We are a Canadian digital marketing company looking for an experienced SEO Copywriter to join our team on a long-term, part-time basis. Our company specializes in SEO, web design and digital marketing, primarily for home-service businesses in Canada. We are looking for an excellent writer who understands both traditional copywriting and modern AI-assisted content production. The position will begin at approximately 10 hours per week, with the opportunity to expand to approximately 15-20 hours per week over the coming months. Most assignments will involve writing approximately 800–1,200 words of content for SEO landing pages, service pages and location pages. What You'll Be Doing Your primary responsibility will be researching, writing and editing high-quality website content. Our workflow uses LLMs such as ChatGPT and Claude to assist with research and first drafts. However, we do not want someone who simply generates AI content and submits it. You will be expected to: - Use ChatGPT, Claude and other LLMs to research and produce strong initial drafts. - Follow SEO content briefs containing target keywords, entities and other important terms. - Write natural, engaging website copy for Canadian and North American audiences. - Create effective H1, H2 and H3 heading structures. - Incorporate important SEO keywords and terms naturally into headings and body copy. - Manually rewrite and edit AI-assisted drafts so the finished content reads like professional, human-written copy. - Improve sentence structure, word choice, transitions and overall readability during the editing process. - Use copywriting frameworks such as PAS (Problem-Agitate-Solution) and AIDA (Attention-Interest-Desire-Action) where appropriate. - Understand the needs of home-service customers and communicate important value propositions effectively. - Work with on-page SEO/content optimization tools. Required Qualifications We are looking for someone with: - A post-secondary degree in English, Writing, Humanities, Marketing, Communications or a related field. - Exceptional written English and the ability to write professional website copy for English-speaking Canadian and North American audiences. - Good spoken English for occasional video meetings or calls with your manager - Strong experience using LLMs such as ChatGPT and Claude for professional copywriting - Experience with on-page SEO, including keyword research, search intent, heading structures and incorporating keywords naturally into copy. - Working knowledge of at least one on-page SEO/content optimization tool such as Surfer SEO, PageOptimizer Pro (POP), On-Page.ai or NeuronWriter. - Strong manual editing and rewriting skills. You should be comfortable rewriting AI-assisted content rather than simply making minor changes. - An understanding of direct-response and website copywriting principles. - Excellent attention to detail and the ability to follow detailed SEO and content briefs. Home Services Experience A large percentage of our clients are home-service companies, including contractors and businesses serving homeowners. Experience writing for industries such as home improvement, construction, roofing, garage doors, home inspection, HVAC, plumbing, windows and doors, landscaping or similar industries is highly desirable. You should understand the value propositions that matter to home-service customers, including reliability, experience, customer reviews, warranties, free quotes, transparent pricing, fast response times and local expertise. Bonus Skills The following experience is not required but would be an advantage: - Writing copy for non-SEO webpages such as Home Pages, About Us pages, Galleries, Contact pages and other web-design-focused pages. - Writing digital press releases for distribution on news and media websites. - Writing SEO guest posts or editorial articles for publication on third-party websites. - Experience working with WordPress or other content management systems. - Experience working with Google Docs and collaborative content workflows. Working Hours & Communication This is a remote position and most of the work can be completed on your own schedule. You must, however, be available for occasional video calls during either: 8:00 AM–10:00 AM Philippines Time and/or 9:00 PM–11:00 PM Philippines Time Calls will be infrequent - typically only 1–2 times per month. Day-to-day communication will primarily take place on Slack messaging. Who We're Looking For The ideal candidate combines excellent traditional writing ability with strong AI skills. You should view ChatGPT and Claude as professional writing tools - not replacements for your own judgment, research and writing ability. If you are primarily looking for a job where you generate an article with ChatGPT and submit the output with minimal editing, this position will not be a good fit. Compensation & Opportunity for Additional Hours $15 USD per hour This position will begin on a part-time basis while you learn our clients, SEO processes and content standards. For the right candidate, there is significant opportunity for the role to grow. Once you have demonstrated that you can consistently produce high-quality work and work effectively within our content-production process, we expect the position could expand to approximately 15-20 hours per week as our client base and content requirements continue to grow. Our goal is to find someone who can become a long-term member of our team and take on increasing responsibility as the company grows. How to Apply To apply for this position, please answer the following questions in your application: 1. SEO Writing Examples (maximum 100 words) Please provide links to 2–3 webpages that you personally wrote for SEO. For each example, briefly explain what type of page it was (service page, location page, blog article, etc.) and your role in creating it. Examples of content written for home-service businesses or contractors are particularly appreciated. 2. Your AI-Assisted Writing Process (maximum 200 words) Describe how you currently use ChatGPT, Claude or other LLMs when writing website content. Please briefly explain your process from receiving an assignment to delivering the finished copy. 3. Human Editing & Rewriting (maximum 200 words) After creating a first draft with an LLM, how do you rewrite and edit the content so that the finished page sounds naturally human-written rather than like AI-generated copy? 4. On-Page SEO Tools (maximum 100 words) Which on-page SEO tools have you used, such as Surfer SEO, PageOptimizer Pro (POP), On-Page.ai, NeuronWriter or others? Please briefly describe how you have used these tools when writing or optimizing a webpage.

title: Business Operations & Marketing Manager — Local Service Company
job_title: Business Operations & Marketing Manager — Local Service Company
description: We are a growing U.S.-based junk removal/local service company looking for a highly capable **Business Operations & Marketing Manager** to become a key part of our company. This is **NOT a basic Virtual Assistant position.** We are looking for someone who can eventually become the owner's **right-hand person** and help keep the business organized, marketed, followed up and moving forward every day. You will begin with clearly defined systems and responsibilities, but as you learn the company, we want you to become someone who can identify problems and opportunities without waiting for the owner to tell you everything that needs to be done. ## YOUR ROLE Your responsibilities will cover several parts of the business. ### BUSINESS OPERATIONS You will help: * Keep daily business tasks organized * Monitor open leads and opportunities * Help manage scheduling and appointments * Keep customer information organized * Make sure leads receive proper follow-up * Monitor jobs moving through our CRM/pipeline * Identify leads or customers that are being missed * Maintain business trackers and systems * Help organize estimates and customer information * Assist with customer communication * Monitor important business KPIs * Prepare weekly performance reports * Identify problems that need the owner's attention * Help create and improve business processes * Make sure assigned work actually gets completed The goal is for you to eventually understand the business well enough to recognize what needs attention before the owner has to ask. ### MARKETING You will also help operate our marketing system, including: * Local SEO * Website updates * WordPress / website builder * Google Search Console * Google Business Profile * On-page SEO * Internal linking * City and service page optimization * Keyword/ranking tracking * Review management * Competitor research * Citation and backlink research * Local partnership outreach * Facebook and Instagram * YouTube / short-form content * Canva and/or CapCut * Repurposing raw job photos and videos * Facebook/Meta advertising support * Marketing performance tracking We already have a detailed SEO and marketing strategy being built. We are **not hiring someone to throw away the existing strategy and start over.** Your job will be to learn the system, execute it, help improve it and document results. ### CRM & LEAD MANAGEMENT We use GoHighLevel as part of our business. You may help with: * New lead management * Pipeline organization * Lead follow-up * Picture requests * Appointment/booking workflows * Missed lead follow-up * Customer communication * Review requests * Lead source tracking * Reactivation campaigns * Basic workflow management GoHighLevel experience is a major advantage, but we can train the right person. ## AI WILL BE PART OF YOUR JOB We use ChatGPT heavily throughout the business. You will have access to documented company information, operating procedures and marketing strategy. ChatGPT will help walk you through unfamiliar tasks, research, marketing work and processes. However, you are responsible for checking your work. We do NOT want someone who blindly copies AI-generated answers. We want someone who knows how to use AI to become **faster and more capable.** ## ACCOUNTABILITY We care about results, not vague activity reports. For example, we do NOT want: > "Worked on SEO today." We want: > "Updated the Ringgold service page, added 4 internal links, researched 8 local backlink prospects, contacted 5 businesses and recorded everything in the tracker." Completed work should include evidence whenever possible. This may include: * URLs * Screenshots * Tracker updates * Published content * Outreach records * Lead results * Advertising results * Ranking changes ## WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR You should be: * Highly organized * Dependable * Comfortable taking responsibility * A strong problem solver * Detail-oriented * Able to follow systems * Able to work independently * Comfortable communicating with customers * Comfortable learning new software * Comfortable using ChatGPT * Comfortable with Google Sheets * Good at online research * Strong in written English * Able to recognize when something needs attention * Interested in a long-term position Previous experience managing operations for a U.S. local service business is a **major advantage**. Experience with any of the following is also valuable: * GoHighLevel * Local SEO * WordPress * Google Business Profile * Google Search Console * Facebook/Instagram marketing * Meta Ads Manager * Canva * CapCut * CRM management * Customer service * Appointment scheduling You do NOT need to be an expert in every one of these. We care more about finding someone intelligent, dependable and capable of learning quickly. ## WHAT WE DO NOT WANT Please do not apply if you: * Need constant supervision * Frequently disappear during working hours * Apply to jobs without reading the instructions * Cannot follow documented processes * Are uncomfortable being accountable for results * Make major business or marketing changes without approval * Submit work without checking it * Cannot communicate when there is a problem * Want only simple repetitive VA tasks This position will have real responsibility. ## HOURS **Full-Time — approximately 40 hours per week** Our company operates in the United States on **Eastern Time**. You do not necessarily need to work the entire U.S. daytime schedule, but regular overlap with our operating hours will be required. ## COMPENSATION **$800–$1,100 USD per month depending on experience and demonstrated ability.** There will be an initial evaluation period. Someone who proves they can take significant responsibility off the owner's plate will have opportunities for increased compensation, responsibility and long-term growth. ## HOW TO APPLY Start your application with the words: **RED TRUCK** Applications that do not begin with RED TRUCK will not be considered. Then answer ALL of the following: **1.** Tell me about a business you previously helped operate or manage. What were you personally responsible for? **2.** Have you worked for a U.S. local service business before? If yes, explain the business and your responsibilities. **3.** What experience do you have managing leads, customers, appointments or a CRM? **4.** Have you used GoHighLevel? If yes, explain what you have personally done inside it. **5.** Tell me about your SEO experience. What SEO work have you personally performed? **6.** Have you used Google Search Console or Google Business Profile? Explain how. **7.** What experience do you have with Facebook, Instagram, YouTube or content creation? **8.** Have you used Meta Ads Manager? If yes, what were you responsible for? **9.** How do you currently use ChatGPT or other AI tools in your work? Give a real example. **10.** Give an example of a problem you noticed at a previous job BEFORE your manager asked you to fix it. What did you do? **11.** Provide links, screenshots or examples of previous work when possible. **12.** What hours can you work and how much overlap can you provide with U.S. Eastern Time? **13.** What monthly salary are you requesting? ## FINAL SCENARIO Imagine you begin work Monday morning and notice: * 7 new leads came in over the weekend * 3 leads have not received a response * Tomorrow's schedule has an open time slot * A customer completed a job but was never asked for a Google review * A Facebook ad has spent significantly more than normal without generating a lead * Two marketing tasks from last week were never completed **Explain what you would do and in what order.** There isn't one perfect answer. We want to see how you **think, prioritize and take responsibility.** ## HIRING PROCESS We are hiring quickly. Strong applicants will receive a short practical test based on real tasks you would perform in this position. Top candidates will have a brief interview. The right candidate can **start immediately.** We are looking for someone who wants to grow into an important long-term position within the company.

title: Junior SEO & GEO Specialist
description: About Us We are a growing cabinetry and custom millwork company based in San Jose, California. We work with homeowners, designers, contractors, builders, and commercial clients across the San Francisco Bay Area. We are looking for a **Junior SEO & GEO Specialist** to help us improve and maintain our online visibility across Google Search, Google Maps, Google Business Profile, and emerging AI search platforms such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, and Perplexity. This is an entry-level / junior position. We are not looking for a senior SEO strategist. We are looking for someone who has a good understanding of basic SEO, is comfortable working with websites and digital tools, and most importantly is reliable, detail-oriented, proactive, and eager to learn. You will receive direction on overall marketing priorities and will be responsible for consistently executing, monitoring results, and improving our online presence over time. What You’ll Do: Website SEO * Review and optimize page titles, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, and image alt text * Perform basic keyword research using tools such as SEMrush or similar platforms * Help organize keywords by service, product, location, and search intent * Optimize existing website pages based on target keywords * Improve internal linking between important pages * Identify missing, duplicate, or poorly optimized metadata * Help monitor indexing and website SEO health * Assist with basic technical SEO issues when needed * Keep website information, product pages, project pages, and other content updated Content & Website Updates * Publish and update blog posts, project pages, service pages, FAQs, and other website content * Optimize new content using SEO best practices * Research relevant content topics based on keyword opportunities and customer search behavior * Update older content when opportunities for improvement are identified * Use AI tools such as ChatGPT to assist with research, outlines, editing, and content optimization * Make sure website content is clear, accurate, organized, and useful to both users and search engines Local SEO & Google Business Profile A major part of this position will be maintaining and improving our local search presence. Responsibilities include: * Maintain and optimize our Google Business Profile * Create and publish regular Google Business Profile posts * Upload new project photos, showroom photos, products, and business updates * Monitor and professionally respond to Google reviews * Keep services, business descriptions, hours, contact information, and other GBP information accurate * Monitor Google Maps visibility and local keyword rankings * Help maintain consistent business information across online directories * Identify relevant local directories and citation opportunities * Monitor local competitors and their Google Maps / Google Business Profile activity * Identify opportunities to improve our visibility for local searches SEO & GEO Reporting You will regularly use data to understand what is working and what needs improvement. You will: * Monitor keyword rankings * Review Google Search Console performance * Review basic GA4 website traffic reports * Monitor Google Business Profile performance * Track organic traffic, impressions, clicks, rankings, and local visibility * Use SEMrush or similar SEO tools to identify website issues and opportunities * Use tools such as **OtterlyAI** or similar platforms to monitor our visibility in AI-generated search results * Track whether our company and competitors appear in ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity, and other AI search platforms * Prepare simple weekly and monthly reports * Identify basic opportunities or problems from the data * Make ongoing optimizations based on results and established marketing strategy Tools You May Work With Experience with some of the following is preferred: * SEMrush * Google Search Console * Google Analytics / GA4 * Google Business Profile * Google Maps * OtterlyAI or other GEO / AI visibility tools * ChatGPT * Gemini * Perplexity * WordPress or other CMS platforms * Google Sheets / Excel * Canva What We’re Looking For We care more about your **attitude, reliability, and ability to learn** than the number of years on your resume. You should be: * Reliable and consistent * Detail-oriented * Organized * Curious and willing to learn * Comfortable learning new software and AI tools * Able to follow instructions and documented processes * Able to work independently once a task has been explained * Proactive about identifying problems instead of waiting for someone to tell you everything * Comfortable working with numbers and basic performance reports * Able to communicate clearly in written and spoken English * Comfortable asking questions when something is unclear * Responsible about deadlines and recurring weekly tasks Qualifications Ideal candidates may have: * 1–2 years of SEO or digital marketing experience * Internship, freelance, school, or personal project experience is welcome * Basic understanding of on-page SEO * Basic understanding of keyword research * Basic understanding of Local SEO * Experience with Google Business Profile is strongly preferred * Familiarity with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Ubersuggest, or similar SEO tools * Familiarity with Google Search Console and GA4 * Basic understanding of how AI tools such as ChatGPT and Google AI search are changing online search Recent graduates with strong hands-on skills and personal projects are encouraged to apply. Nice to Have These are helpful but **not required**: * WordPress experience * Basic website editing skills * Basic HTML knowledge * Canva * Schema markup knowledge * Citation / directory management * Basic backlink research * Experience with OtterlyAI * Experience with Local SEO * Experience with home improvement, construction, interior design, architecture, cabinetry, or related industries There will be opportunities for compensation growth as you develop your skills, take on more responsibility, and demonstrate results. Schedule * Part-time remote position, about 25 hours/ week. * Some overlap with Pacific Time business hours may occasionally be required for meetings and communication * Most SEO and content work can be completed independently according to agreed deadlines How to Apply Please send: 1. Your resume 2. A short introduction about yourself 3. A **1–2 minute Loom video** introducing yourself in English 4. Any SEO, website, Google Business Profile, content, or digital marketing projects you have worked on — school projects and personal projects are welcome Please also answer these questions: **1. What SEO tools have you used before?** **2. What tasks have you done inside Google Business Profile?** **3. If a website page has impressions on Google but very few clicks, what are 2–3 things you would check first?** **4. What do you know about GEO or optimizing a business to appear in AI search results such as ChatGPT or Google AI Overviews?** It is completely okay if you are still learning GEO. We want to understand how you think. **5. Tell us about one software, tool, or skill you taught yourself recently. How did you learn it?** We are looking for someone who wants to **build real skills and grow with the company long-term**, not someone who is simply looking to complete a list of repetitive tasks. If you are hardworking, curious, organized, and enjoy learning how search and AI are changing digital marketing, we would love to hear from you.

title: Senior SEO & AI Visibility Strategist
description: Senior SEO & AI Visibility Strategist Are you passionate about driving growth through SEO, AI search, and innovative web solutions? Do you have a proven track record of not just reporting on results, but proactively finding what we should do next? If this sounds like you, we have the perfect opportunity. This role is for someone ready to make a big impact in a growing organization. You’ll lead the charge in improving organic growth, search rankings, AI visibility, website performance, and ultimately qualified leads for our clients. This is not a role where you wait for a task list. We’re looking for someone who can look at a client’s website, competitors, data, and market and tell us what we should be doing next. You’ll work alongside a dynamic marketing, design, and development team while owning SEO and AI visibility strategy across multiple client accounts. You’ll be working across SEO, AEO/GEO, backlinking, content, local search, website optimization, and emerging AI search strategies. The role is intentionally built to evolve as search evolves. Role & Responsibilities Own the ongoing execution, optimization, and delivery of SEO, Local SEO, and AI search strategies for a portfolio of 30+ client accounts, ensuring every client receives consistent, proactive attention, measurable progress, and strategic recommendations on a recurring basis. To accomplish this, you will be responsible for the following: SEO Strategy & Management Perform comprehensive keyword, search intent, competitor, and opportunity research. Conduct regular technical SEO audits and implement or coordinate fixes. Optimize titles, metadata, headers, internal linking, site architecture, indexing, and crawlability. Develop topical authority strategies across service pages, landing pages, blogs, FAQs, and other content. Implement structured data and advanced schema markup. Identify opportunities to refresh, expand, consolidate, redirect, or improve existing content. Track organic traffic, rankings, qualified leads, conversions, and share of search. Continuously adjust strategy based on performance, competition, algorithm changes, and business goals. AI Search Visibility, AEO & GEO Search is changing quickly, and we want someone who is excited to help us stay ahead of it. Develop strategies to increase client visibility across Google AI Overviews and AI Mode, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Bing Copilot, Claude, and emerging AI search experiences. Implement Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) strategies. Improve entity signals, semantic relevance, structured data, content architecture, and brand authority. Monitor where clients and competitors appear, get cited, or are recommended within AI-generated answers. Identify important questions and searches where clients should be visible but currently are not. Develop content and authority strategies designed to improve both traditional search and AI visibility. Stay ahead of changes in how AI platforms discover, interpret, cite, and recommend businesses. Experiment with emerging strategies and tools while measuring whether they actually create business value. Backlinks, Authority & Digital PR Build and maintain high-quality backlink and authority strategies. Identify competitor backlink gaps and new link opportunities. Develop campaigns around editorial links, digital PR, industry citations, partnerships, directories, and relevant placements. Identify and reclaim broken links and unlinked brand mentions. Prioritize relevance and authority over simply generating backlink volume. Look for creative opportunities to strengthen client authority beyond traditional link-building tactics. Local SEO & Google Business Profile Create, audit, and optimize Google Business Profiles. Optimize categories, services, products, descriptions, photos, attributes, hours, and business information. Develop GBP content and posting strategies. Monitor reviews, rankings, competitor activity, and unauthorized profile changes. Conduct citation and NAP audits and manage directory campaigns. Optimize Bing Business and other relevant local search properties. Develop local strategies for multi-location businesses and individual provider profiles. Proactively identify opportunities to improve local rankings, visibility, calls, leads, and conversions. Website Development & Optimization Ensure websites are fast, secure, technically healthy, and mobile-friendly. Implement changes in WordPress and Elementor. Improve Core Web Vitals, page speed, navigation, and user experience. Monitor uptime, troubleshoot issues, and collaborate with developers and hosting providers. Maintain plugins, themes, integrations, redirects, sitemaps, and technical configurations. Identify website improvements that can increase both organic traffic and conversions. Work proactively with our development team when larger technical changes are required. Content & Conversion Optimization Collaborate with marketing and copywriting teams to create SEO and AI-friendly content. Develop content clusters, pillar pages, FAQs, service pages, location pages, and supporting content. Identify content gaps and new opportunities based on competitors, search behavior, and AI visibility. Recommend improvements to calls-to-action, landing pages, forms, and conversion paths. Utilize A/B testing, analytics, heatmaps, and user behavior when appropriate to improve conversion rates. Think beyond traffic. Help us determine how organic visibility can produce more qualified business opportunities. Performance Tracking & Proactive Strategy Reporting is only part of the job. We expect you to tell us what we should do next. Monitor performance through GA4, Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, and other platforms. Track traditional SEO performance alongside AI visibility and authority growth. Provide monthly reporting with clear insights, not just numbers. Identify new opportunities, risks, competitor movement, and quick wins every month. Maintain a rolling 90-day strategy for each client. Provide a 3–6 month forecast of priorities, expected opportunities, risks, and recommended initiatives. Clearly communicate: What happened What we learned What we're doing next Why we're doing it Proactively bring recommendations to the team rather than waiting for someone to request them. Collaboration & Innovation Work closely with marketing, design, development, paid media, and copywriting teams. Bring proactive ideas and recommendations to the team without waiting to be asked. Stay current on Google algorithm changes, AI search developments, SEO best practices, and emerging tools. Test new strategies and technologies when they can create measurable client value. Manage freelancers or contractors when needed to ensure deliverables and timelines are met. Help improve our internal SEO processes, systems, reporting, and service offerings as we scale. Necessary Skills & Qualifications 4+ years of proven SEO experience, preferably managing multiple agency clients. Demonstrated success growing organic visibility, qualified traffic, leads, and conversions. Strong understanding of technical SEO, Local SEO, content strategy, backlinking, and authority building. Working knowledge of AEO, GEO, entity SEO, AI search visibility, and emerging search behavior. Proficiency with WordPress, GA4, Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, and Screaming Frog. Experience working with WordPress and Elementor. Strong understanding of HTML, CSS, schema, and basic JavaScript. Ability to turn data into proactive recommendations and long-term strategy. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Ability to manage multiple client strategies and priorities simultaneously. Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where priorities and opportunities evolve. A proactive ownership mentality. We should not have to ask you what we should be doing next. How We Measure Success We care about rankings, but rankings alone aren't the goal. Success includes: Qualified organic traffic and lead growth Organic conversions and measurable business impact Search visibility and market share AI search visibility, citations, and recommendations Topical and brand authority High-quality backlinks and mentions Local and Google Business Profile performance Website health and conversion improvements Progress against 90-day strategies and 3–6 month forecasts Consistently bringing new ideas and opportunities to clients Ultimately, we want our clients to feel that we are thinking about their business before they have to ask us to. The Mindset We're Looking For We're not looking for someone who simply wants to execute tasks. We're looking for someone who wants to help build something exceptional. We are growing quickly, and we're investing heavily in becoming a leader in SEO, Local SEO, and AI search. That means we're looking for someone who is excited by the opportunity to shape processes, improve our services, introduce new ideas, and help define what great looks like as we continue to scale. We don't want someone who waits for a checklist. We want someone who: Takes ownership. Finds opportunities. Challenges existing strategies when necessary. Tests new ideas. Thinks strategically about our clients' businesses. Proactively leads the charge. The question we want you constantly asking is: “If this were my business, what would I do next?” If you love figuring out what's next, staying ahead of SEO and AI search, testing new ideas, and turning those ideas into measurable growth, we want to hear from you. Work Hours & Availability This is a remote position, but you must be available and actively working during U.S. business hours. Our standard working hours are: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Pacific Time (PT), Monday through Friday You do not need to live in the United States, but you must be able to consistently work these hours, collaborate with our U.S.-based team in real time, attend meetings, and be responsive during the workday. Please make sure this schedule works for you before applying. How to Apply We care about initiative, communication, and attention to detail, so there is one important part of the application: Send Us a Personalized Video Please send us a personalized 2–3 minute video created specifically for this application. At the beginning of the video, address our team directly so we know this isn't a generic or recycled application video. Then answer these three questions: 1. Why this role? Why do you want this position, and why do you believe you would be a great fit for our team specifically? 2. What's a result you've personally driven? Tell us about one SEO result you're most proud of. Explain what you personally did and, whenever possible, include the measurable result. 3. What do you see coming next? SEO and AI search are changing quickly. What are you doing right now to stay ahead, and what is one strategy or opportunity you think most agencies are currently missing? Keep it natural. We care much more about how you think, communicate, and solve problems than production quality. Send Your Application To Send your application here: ---------- Use the subject line: “Hire Me – SEO & AI Visibility Strategist” Please include: Your personalized 2–3 minute video Your resume or LinkedIn profile 1–2 examples of SEO results, case studies, or work you personally contributed to Please do not send a generic introduction video. The personalized video is an important part of our application process. If you're excited about owning strategy, finding opportunities before someone asks, and helping define what great SEO and AI visibility looks like moving forward, we'd love to hear from you.

Copy -Write the ad copy that goes with your designs: hooks, primary text, headlines, descriptions, CTAs -Write landing page copy — headlines, subheads, body, bullets, form microcopy, CTA buttons -Write follow-up email and SMS sequence copy for leads who come through the funnel -Deliver copy in variation sets so there's something to test 3. What You Need to Have 1. Design -2+ years designing static ad creative, ideally for paid social -Strong command of layout, hierarchy, typography, and spacing — your work looks professionally made, not templated -Fluent in Figma, Photoshop, Canva Pro, or equivalent -You can work from a brand kit and stay consistent across a large set of assets 2. General -Available for live calls 9:00 AM – 2:00 PM PST on weekdays -Fast turnaround without dropping quality — volume matters in this role -Reliable communicator who flags problems early instead of going quiet Nice to Have: -Experience creating marketing assets for law firms, legal services, or other regulated industries -Short-form video editing for ad creative (not required now, useful later) -Basic HTML / CSS for page fixes -Experience producing creative at volume against a weekly quota How to Apply: Send the following. title: Executive Operations Coordinator

You should be the type of person who notices an unanswered email, an approaching deadline, an incomplete task, or missing information—and takes initiative to move it forward. The position will initially average approximately 20 hours per week, with the opportunity to increase hours and responsibilities over time. For the right person, this role could eventually grow into a full-time Practice Manager or Operations role. What You’ll Do Executive Support Help keep the executive organized, informed, and focused on the highest-priority work. Responsibilities may include: Monitor and organize designated executive email inboxes Identify emails, documents, and requests requiring attention Draft email responses for executive review and approval Flag urgent or high-priority items Track emails and requests requiring follow-up Independently follow up on routine matters when appropriate Manage and coordinate calendars Schedule meetings and identify potential scheduling conflicts Prepare meeting agendas and supporting materials Take meeting notes and document decisions Create and maintain follow-up action items Maintain executive task and priority lists Organize files, records, and documentation Assist with recurring administrative responsibilities You will initially draft executive communications rather than sending responses on the executive’s behalf. General Operations & Special Projects Because this role supports growing businesses, no two weeks will look exactly the same. You may also assist with: Research Data entry Report preparation Spreadsheet organization CRM maintenance SOP documentation Website updates Photo and document organization Project coordination Client or prospect follow-up Process improvement Quality-control checks Miscellaneous administrative and operational projects Who We’re Looking For The ideal candidate doesn’t simply wait for a list of tasks each morning. We’re looking for someone who: Thinks several steps ahead Is proactive rather than reactive Loves organization and creating order Notices details other people miss Has exceptional follow-through Is comfortable reminding others about deadlines and commitments Can identify when something doesn’t look right and investigate further Writes excellent English Communicates professionally with U.S.-based team members and clients Is comfortable asking questions when information is missing Can prioritize competing responsibilities Learns new software quickly Can work independently without constant supervision Understands when to handle something independently and when to escalate it Is dependable and responsive during assigned working hours Can handle confidential client and company information with discretion Enjoys improving processes rather than simply following them Qualifications Required Approximately 2–3+ years of experience in administrative support, executive assistance, operations, project coordination, customer service, or a similar role Excellent written English Strong verbal English communication skills Strong organizational and time-management skills Excellent attention to detail Experience managing email, calendars, tasks, and deadlines Ability to work independently in a remote environment Reliable high-speed internet connection Comfortable working U.S. Central Time hours Comfortable learning new technology and systems A college degree is not required. Preferred Experience Experience with any of the following is helpful but not required: Zoho CRM or Zoho One Microsoft Office Google Workspace Canva WordPress ChatGPT or other AI tools Project management systems Digital marketing SEO or Google Ads Website management Supporting U.S.-based executives or businesses Tax, accounting, or professional-services firms We care more about your ability to learn, communicate, organize, and follow through than whether you already know every system we use. Schedule This is a remote, part-time position averaging approximately 20 hours per week, although weekly hours will vary based on business needs. The typical schedule will include: Availability approximately 7:00–9:00 AM U.S. Central Time, Monday–Friday An additional 1–2 flexible hours per day based on workload Occasional additional availability as projects or deadlines require Our tax and accounting business is seasonal. Hours will typically increase during: January through April September and October During the primary tax season, you should expect at least 10 additional hours per week, and there may be opportunities to work up to full-time hours depending on workload and your availability. We will communicate significant seasonal schedule changes in advance whenever possible. Compensation Starting pay: $5.00 USD/hour There is opportunity for: Increased compensation based on performance and expanded responsibilities Performance bonuses Additional hours Increased responsibility Long-term advancement within the organization Growth Opportunity We’re not simply looking for someone to complete a list of administrative tasks. We’re looking for someone who can become increasingly valuable to the businesses over time. As you learn our team, clients, systems, and processes, there will be opportunities to take ownership of additional responsibilities and increase your hours and compensation. For the right person, this role has the potential to develop from Executive Operations Coordinator into a Practice Manager or broader Operations Management position. What Success Looks Like You’ll be successful in this role when: Important emails and requests don’t get forgotten Leadership knows what requires attention before it becomes urgent Meetings result in clear action items and follow-through Reports are accurate and delivered on time Deadlines are monitored without leadership constantly checking them Team members receive appropriate follow-up on outstanding tasks Marketing projects continue moving forward Missing information and potential problems are identified early Systems and documentation become more organized over time The executive and Leadership Team spend less time tracking administrative details because they trust you to keep things moving Ultimately, we’re looking for someone who sees what needs to happen next—and helps make sure it happens.

title: Brand Marketing Coordinator
description: # Brand Marketing Coordinator **Karst — North Charleston, SC** Karst is a strategic merch and creative agency. We help lifestyle and growth-stage brands extend who they are into the physical world — intentionally, at scale, never the disposable junk that ends up in a drawer. We've been doing it since 1996. Here's the honest version of why this role exists: Our founder has the marketing strategy. The ideas, the calendar, the direction — all there. What's missing is the person who takes it and *makes it real*. Designs it, builds it, posts it, ships it. That's you. This isn't a brief-and-wait role. You'll own marketing execution end to end, so the strategy actually leaves the building instead of dying in a doc. ## What you'll own - **Internal marketing.** You turn strategy and rough ideas into finished, on-brand work. - **Social content.** We hand you a bucket of ideas and raw material — you finesse it, design it, schedule it, and actually hit publish. - **HubSpot.** Email, landing pages, workflows, keeping the CRM working for us instead of the other way around. - **WordPress.** Updates, campaign hubs, landing pages, keeping the site sharp. - **Quality control** on any overflow design we send to contractors — so the founder doesn't have to babysit it. ## Who you are - You've spent **at least 3 years doing marketing execution** — not studying it, not "assisting with" it. Designing, building, posting, owning it. - You can design *and* organize. Rare combo. That's the whole point of this seat. - **HubSpot:** you've built emails, workflows, and landing pages in it — not just hit "send" on a campaign someone else set up. - **WordPress:** you've built and edited pages, not only written blog posts. - You're sharp in Canva and ideally Adobe, and you have a portfolio that proves it. - You'd rather own a thing than wait for instructions. You won't get daily art direction here. - You have taste, you sweat the details, and you'll tell us when something's off-brand or not good enough yet. Honestly? I care less about the exact year count than what you can show me. But green won't cut it for this seat — you'll be running things, not learning them on our dime. ## This isn't your seat if - You need a detailed brief and a sign-off before every task. - "Marketing" to you means scheduling posts someone else designed. - You're juggling five other clients and this would be gig number six. - You don't have work to show. ## What the first 90 days look like - The backlog of strategized-but-never-posted content is live. - Social is consistent — and it looks like us. - The founder is out of the execution weeds and back in the strategy seat where she belongs. ## Logistics - **Type:** Full-time, remote - **Hours:** Some daily overlap with US Eastern time (we'll work out specifics) ## To apply Read this whole post first. Then: - Send your **portfolio link.** No link, no read. We want social, email, and web work you actually made. - Pick one piece you took from idea to live, and tell us in a few sentences what you'd change about it now. We're reading how you think, not just what you made. - Start your message with the word **"Unsupervised"** so we know you made it to the bottom. Applications that skip these get deleted. Nothing personal — it's just the first test.

This is an in-house seat: one company, one stack, permanent, not agency or client-rotation work. THE ROLE You keep two things running: our clients' experience of working with us, and the systems underneath it. Our website, funnels, calendar, and automations stay accurate underneath it all, and our search optimization work moves forward every week. On the client side, logistical questions get answered the same business day, sessions get booked and rescheduled without friction, and the recordings and materials our clients paid for reach them when they expect them. When something needs judgment rather than logistics, you route it to the right person rather than guessing. On the publishing side, our marketing content goes out on schedule: social posts loaded and verified live, emails scheduled and sent, articles published to the websites. Whatever our team and outside partners produce, you get it out correctly and confirm it landed. Our website, funnels, calendar, and automations stay accurate underneath it all, and our search optimization work moves forward every week. Creative and build work is produced by our senior team and outside partners. Your work starts where theirs ends. Day to day, you will: • Resolve client logistics in our support inbox: scheduling, session links, reschedules, sending recordings, and access issues, using our documented reply guides • Escalate anything that calls for judgment rather than logistics, routed to the right person on our team using our documented rules • Manage our session and events calendar end to end: booking, rescheduling, cancelling, and rebooking through our approved process • Administer our client membership site: recording uploads, content updates, member access, and setup for each new session • Onboard and offboard clients to our checklist: access, calendar, and enrollment set up correctly at the start, and closed out cleanly at the end • Load our weekly social publishing schedule from prepared asset packages across our platforms, write captions from our documented guides, and verify daily that every post actually published • Assemble and send our weekly client email and announcements from finished drafts, and load approved campaign sequences in GoHighLevel, verifying every send before it goes out • Publish finished articles to WordPress and to our external article publishing platforms, applying our SEO specification to every website post and confirming it renders correctly • Receive deliverables from our outside partners, check them against spec, and queue them • Execute our SEO update plan across the existing site and content, to a written specification • Make small updates to existing GoHighLevel pages, load approved email sequences and broadcasts, and improve existing automations alongside our operations manager • Monitor automation alerts, run first diagnosis, and escalate with a written report • Collect weekly performance metrics across our platforms and prepare them for reporting membership site current within 1 business day of any release • Client emails and weekly articles out on schedule, every week • The SEO update specification executed at 25 URLs per month WHAT THIS ROLE description: **READ THE HOURS BEFORE YOU APPLY. This is a night shift.** Apply at this link: ---------- You need at least 3 working hours between 10pm and 4am Philippine Time, every weekday. That's how we overlap with our US morning. If you can't work nights, don't apply. We've been helping students raise their test scores since 2005. We run lean: a small team, a lot of automation, and systems that need to keep working while we focus on students. **The role** You'll be our hands-on tech assistant, working directly with our founder and supporting our tech lead and operations manager. This isn't a build-from-scratch engineering role. You're the person who keeps our marketing and operations machine running: setting up email campaigns, updating sales pages, fixing the automation that broke, and catching problems before students notice them. Most tasks are small and specific. A typical week: schedule a launch email sequence, swap testimonials on a checkout page, figure out why a lead got the wrong text message, update our automations library so the next person can see how things work. **Hard requirement: GoHighLevel** You must already know GoHighLevel well. Funnels, workflows, calendars, products, email and SMS. Not "I watched some tutorials." Not "I can learn it fast." You've built in it, broken things in it, and fixed them. This is the tool you'll live in, and we don't have time to teach it. If GHL isn't on your resume, this role isn't for you. **Hard requirement 2: you use AI to do the work** This is not a bonus point. It's how the job gets done. We expect you to use Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT, or whatever you already like, as your default way of working. Especially on website and sales page updates. Instead of hand-coding a section, you describe it and iterate. Instead of clicking through 40 pages hunting for broken links, you run a script. Instead of eyeballing a mobile layout that broke, you paste the CSS in and ask why. Real examples of what we mean: - We hand you a Google Doc of copy. You turn it into a publish-ready GHL funnel page that matches our fonts and colors, using AI to write the HTML and CSS for the custom code blocks. - A section looks wrong on mobile. You screenshot it, work the CSS out with AI, test it, ship it. - We change a URL structure. You generate the redirect map instead of writing 60 redirects by hand. - You need to check every page on the site for broken links and missing images. You write a script once and rerun it monthly. - A popup needs to fire on exit intent for one traffic source only. You work out the trigger logic with AI rather than waiting on our developer. You don't need to be a developer. You need to be someone who reaches for AI first, reads what it gives you, tests it, and fixes it when it's wrong. If your answer to "can you build this page section" is "I'd need a developer," this isn't the role. To be clear about one thing: we want you using AI on the work. We don't want AI pretending to be you. More on that in the application. Apply at this link: ---------- **What you'll do** Core responsibilities: 1. Email and SMS campaign setup. Build, schedule, and update sequences in GoHighLevel. Swap dates, links, and copy before launches. 2. Website and sales page updates, AI-assisted. Website edits, GHL funnel and checkout pages, redirects, broken links and images, popups, and publishing new pages from content we provide. You'll use AI to write and fix the HTML and CSS rather than waiting on a developer or clicking through a page builder for 3 hours. 3. AI bot changes. Adjust prompts and flows on our GHL conversation bots and voice agent when they need tuning. 4. Automation library updates. Document new workflows and keep our internal library current. 5. Automation QA and monitoring. Test workflows end to end, run recurring checks, and investigate when something fires wrong or doesn't fire at all. 6. GHL email deliverability. Domain health, SPF and DKIM, spam placement investigations, list hygiene. 7. Small scripts and automations. Use Claude Code or a similar tool to build the thing that saves you 2 hours next month. You'll also pitch in on: 1. CRM and data hygiene in GHL: tags, smartlists, custom fields, duplicate and spam contact cleanup. 2. Google Sheets maintenance: formula fixes, mapping GHL data to trackers, backups. 3. Checkout and product plumbing: creating and cloning GHL and Thinkific checkout pages, basic Stripe product edits, price changes. 4. First-line tech triage: "the site is down," "a student can't log in," "why did she get this email." Diagnose, fix, or escalate. 5. Owning projects end to end. Sometimes we'll hand you a whole project, not a task list. You scope it, break it down, manage your own deadlines, and keep us posted without being chased. **Tools we use** You must be strong in GoHighLevel, and you must already work with AI daily. Basic HTML and CSS helps a lot here. You don't need to write it fro ---------- mory. You need to be able to read what AI hands you, spot what's wrong, and fix it. You should be comfortable with, or able to pick up quickly: WordPress, Zapier, ---------- , Thinkific, Stripe, and Google Sheets. We also touch ManyChat, Typeform, Calendly, Slack, and Asana. Apply at this link: ---------- **Who does well in this role** 1. You debug before you escalate. When an automation misfires, your first instinct is to open the workflow and trace it, not to ask what to do. 2. You test your own work. Every link clicked, every workflow run end to end, before you mark a task done. 3. You write clearly and fast in English. We work async through Asana and Slack, so your writing is how we know you. 4. You're organized enough to handle 10 to 20 small tasks a week without dropping any. 5. You can project manage yourself. Hand you a project and you come back with a plan, then updates, then a finished result. 6. You reach for AI before you reach for us. When a page section needs building or a layout breaks, your first move is to work it out with AI, not to send a question and wait 12 hours for an answer. 7. You don't trust AI blindly. You check the output, click the links, and load the page on your phone before you say it's done. **Details** 1. 10 hours per week to start, with room to grow if it's a fit 2. $450 to $650 USD per month, depending on experience 3. Fully remote and async-first, but you need at least 3 working hours between 10pm and 4am Philippine Time so you're available for meetings 4. **Hubstaff time tracking is required.** You track your hours in Hubstaff while you work. This is not optional and it's not negotiable. If you're not willing to track time, stop reading here. 5. Paid every 2 weeks based on tracked Hubstaff hours 6. Independent contractor role 7. Long-term. We're not looking for a 3-month project. **How to apply** Apply at this link: ---------- The form takes about 10 minutes and ends with a short video. Yes, a video is required. It's a 3 minute recording of you talking about your GHL and AI work, with your screen shared. No video, no interview. That's the whole filter. One note, since we're asking for two things that sound opposite. Use AI on the job as much as you want, that's the point of the role. Don't use it to answer for you in the application. We want to hear you talk about work you actually did, in your own words, with your screen up. Polish isn't what we're grading. If the video is a dealbreaker for you, that's fine, this just isn't your role.

title: Graphic Designer / High-Volume Content Designer

This averages approximately 20 completed images per working day. The monthly workload will include a planned mix of branded article graphics, featured images, comparison graphics, checklists, diagrams and infographics. Some assignments will use established templates for efficient production, while others will require original concepts and layouts. You will receive written content, design instructions and client brand guidelines. Select appropriate licensed stock photos, illustrations and icons when required. Use AI-assisted design tools when appropriate, while carefully reviewing and correcting every result. Check all text for spelling, grammar, accuracy and readability before submitting a design. Resize and export graphics according to the required website dimensions. Optimize files for the web without creating noticeable quality loss. Deliver images in the requested PNG, JPG or WebP format. Provide organized and editable source files when required. Use consistent and descriptive file names. Complete assigned revisions promptly and accurately. Keep project statuses and production records current. Report missing information, unclear instructions or potential delays promptly. Never use stolen, unlicensed or copyrighted visual assets without authorization. You must be proficient with at least one professional design workflow using Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Canva, Figma or similar software. Strong written English is required because the designs will contain legal and marketing information. Because this role involves producing a large number of graphics for multiple clients, you must be organized, dependable and comfortable working within repeatable production systems. Experience creating reusable templates and organized brand systems is highly desirable because they allow us to maintain consistency at scale. Knowledge of image compression, WebP conversion, website accessibility and WordPress image requirements is beneficial. Experience working with law firms, SEO agencies, content-marketing companies or other high-volume creative teams is a plus. Familiarity with AI image-generation and editing tools is welcome, provided you can identify and correct inaccurate text, visual artifacts and other quality problems. How Success Will Be Measured Success will be measured by completing at least 400 approved images each month. At least 95% of assignments should be delivered by their deadlines. At least 95% of submitted designs should pass the first quality review without requiring major corrections. Designs must follow the correct client branding and assigned dimensions. Completed graphics should not contain spelling mistakes, incorrect information, distorted logos, unreadable text or improperly licensed assets. Files and editable source materials must be named, organized and stored according to company procedures. After onboarding, you should be able to complete routine assignments and revisions independently while communicating problems promptly. Working Conditions and Benefits This is a fully remote, long-term opportunity with consistent monthly work. You will receive client brand guidelines, design instructions and reusable templates while working with a small, experienced digital marketing team. The position provides opportunities to build a large professional portfolio, work with multiple law firm brands and strengthen your infographic, digital-design and production skills. We value dependable team members and provide greater creative independence as trust, consistency and experience grow. How to Apply Please provide a brief introduction describing your graphic-design experience and the software you use. Include a link to your portfolio containing at least five relevant examples. Explain your role in creating the submitted work and identify which designs were based on templates versus original concepts. Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a small paid design assessment.
