title: Marketing Specialist with Technical Expertise (GTM, Ads, Landing Pages)
job_title: Marketing Specialist with Technical Expertise (GTM, Ads, Landing Pages)
description: We are Pilot Practice (KloudMD) — a US company that builds software and marketing systems for medical practices. This is a MARKETING job. You will own campaigns, tracking, landing pages, and “why didn’t this convert.” You are not a software engineer, and this is not a VA / Canva / social-media-poster seat. WHO WE NEED A digital marketer who is technical enough to implement, not just recommend. You can read a Google Ads or Meta account, spot wasted spend, and write a one-page diagnosis. You can also open Google Tag Manager, check a pixel, fix a thank-you event, and tell us why Ads says 41 conversions while the CRM shows 6 contacts. Zapier / n8n / Make / workflow-building counts as technical. You do not need to write Laravel. You DO need to get your hands dirty in the tools. You will work with our US marketing team (ads + social already exist). You are the technical marketing executor. WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO - Run and diagnose paid campaigns (Google Ads, Meta). Landing pages, offers, conversion paths — not just “boost the post.” - Own conversion tracking: GTM, GA4, Meta Pixel, Google Ads conversions (including the difference between a form-open, a lead, and an appointment actually booked). - Build and QA landing pages (WordPress / HTML). Headlines, forms, mobile, thank-you pages. - Diagnose broken funnels. Ad click ? landing page or booking widget ? CRM ? (sometimes) EHR. Find which hop died. - Call tracking / number swap (DNI). Ads have a tracking number. The website footer often still shows the main office line. - UTM + source slugs so we can see which ad, keyword, and page made the lead. - Light automations (Zapier / similar) between ads, forms, and CRM when needed. - Implement, not just recommend. MUST HAVE - You have shipped real ads or tracking work, not only a course certificate. - You have published or edited a GTM container (or can do it on a shared screen). - You can explain pageview vs form submit vs “consult requested” vs “appointment actually booked” without mixing them up. - You can look at a landing page or booker and say why it will not convert — including healthcare landmines (fake urgency, guaranteed outcomes, missing DOB, slots at 2am). - WordPress (or equivalent) without breaking the header. - English a US doctor's office would trust. Video interview. - Night-shift overlap with Arizona, USA (MST). At least 4 hours overlap with 8am–5pm Arizona. 40 hrs/week. NICE TO HAVE - Google Ads or Meta you personally ran, with numbers (spend, CPA, what you changed). - GA4 / Looker Studio weekly report you built. - Zapier, n8n, Make, or HubSpot/GHL workflows. - Healthcare, clinics, or any regulated lead gen. - Enough HTML/CSS/JS to inspect a page and a dataLayer push. PHP/Laravel is a bonus, not the job. PAY $3,000 USD/month. 40 hours/week. Paid 4-hour trial before any long-term offer. HOW WE THINK — A REAL CLIENT EXAMPLE (READ THIS) This is a real i ---------- we had. We are giving you the answer so you see the bar. Do not copy this structure blindly into your application. What the client said: "People on our booking page are seeing 2:00am and 3:00am appointment times. We are a Chicago clinic. We are open 8am–5pm." What a ChatGPT answer looks like: "Please verify timezone settings are consistent across your systems and consider using a timezone library." What actually happened: the clinic's location timezone was Chicago. The booking-channel hours were 8–5. A hidden availability row still defaulted to UTC. The booker used that row. 8am Chicago became 2–3am on the public widget. Ads were sending paid traffic to a page that looked broken. "Fix the ads" would have done nothing. What we needed someone to do in the first 20 minutes, talking the whole time: 1. Open the live booker as a visitor (not logged into WordPress). Pick tomorrow. Write down the first three slot times. 2. Ask: what city is this clinic in, and what hours do they tell patients? 3. If slots are outside 6am–10pm in that city, stop talking about pixels. The conversion problem is the product, not GTM. 4. Compare one slot to what the clinic's calendar / EHR shows for the same day. 5. Only after the slots look human, check whether ads conversions match CRM bookings. If you cannot follow that kind of thinking, you will hate this job. YOUR APPLICATION — A DIFFERENT REAL CASE. DO NOT PASTE THIS INTO CHATGPT AND REWRITE IT. Most applications we get are written by ChatGPT. We will not interview those. 1) First line of your application must be exactly: WIRE-MANGO-18 2) Do not start with "I am writing to express my interest" or "I am a results-driven professional." 3) Answer THIS case in 8–12 sentences, no bullet lists. Use your own words. Name the exact screens you would open, in order. If you have seen this in real life, say what the actual cause was last time. THE CASE: A Phoenix-area medical practice. We spent $1,800 on Google Search ads last week. Google Ads shows 41 conversions. Our CRM (Pilot Practice) shows 6 new contacts whose source looks like Google. Only 2 of those 6 have an appointment on the calendar. The doctor says "the phones rang all day, ads must be working, why is your report so low?" The website footer and the booking widget both show the main office number, (480) ---------- . In Google Ads, the call-extension number is a different number we provisioned for tracking. The booking widget is an embed on a WordPress page. Some thank-you / "consult requested" tags fire when someone only opens the booker, not when they finish. The practice's EHR will reject a new-patient booking that has no date of birth. What are the 2–4 most likely explanations, ranked? What would you check first, and what would you refuse to "fix" in Ads until you had looked at the live page? Do not give a generic "audit the pixel" essay. 4) Paste a 60–90 second video (Loom / Drive / unlisted YouTube). Camera on. Handwritten paper with today's date and WIRE-MANGO-18. Then talk — do not read — about the last tracking, call-tracking, or landing-page problem you personally fixed. For 10 seconds, show the actual tool (GTM, Ads, WordPress, or Zapier). If you cannot do the video, do not apply. If you use AI to write #3, we will know on the live call and we will end it. We hire the person who can do the work on a shared screen, not the person with the prettiest cover letter.

title: Website Production Automation Engineer (WordPress & AI)
description: Website Production Automation Engineer (WordPress & AI) Location: Philippines — Remote Type: Part-time contractor Initial Hours: Approximately 10–15 hours/week Starting Pay: $7–$12 USD/hour, depending on demonstrated capability Growth: Opportunity for increased hours, compensation, responsibility, and technical ownership Build the System Behind the Websites RNRF builds and operates a growing portfolio of websites for local service markets. We already have a functioning WordPress production system with cloneable websites, reusable page structures, structured site variables, documented workflows, QA standards, and AI-assisted production. Our production team can already build the websites. Your job is to make each future website require less human work. We are not primarily hiring someone to manually build WordPress websites. We are looking for someone who sees a repetitive or error-prone process and thinks: “How can I turn this into a reusable system so we don’t have to keep doing it manually?” You will identify production bottlenecks and build practical automation that makes our team faster, more accurate, and less dependent on repetitive work. If you enjoy building useful tools, automating real workflows, debugging edge cases, and seeing your systems actually used in production, this role may be a strong fit. ? The Problem You’ll Help Us Solve Our production system currently uses: * WordPress * GeneratePress / GenerateBlocks * Rank Math * Cloudways * Structured site data * Cloneable website environments * Reusable page structures and patterns * AI-assisted content workflows * SOPs and QA systems When we create a new website from an existing production framework, information needs to be updated and validated across areas such as: * Page content * Headers and footers * Navigation * Global components * SEO metadata * Phone numbers * Buttons and CTAs * Forms * Internal links * Service pages * Location pages Doing this manually creates repetitive work and opportunities for mistakes. Instead of solving that problem by simply adding more people, we want to engineer better systems. That’s where you come in. ? What You Might Build Your projects may include systems that: * Validate structured website inputs before production begins * Automate repetitive WordPress updates * Safely replace business information across cloned websites * Detect old website information that should have been replaced * Identify unresolved variables or placeholders * Generate dry-run previews before making changes * Validate SEO titles and meta descriptions * Check internal links and navigation * Verify phone links, buttons, CTAs, and forms * Generate exception reports when information is missing or conflicting * Automate browser-based production tasks * Improve content-placement workflows * Automate repetitive QA checks * Capture before/after evidence * Measure production time saved and errors prevented Depending on the problem, you might use: * Python * JavaScript / TypeScript * APIs * WordPress REST API * Browser automation * Playwright / Puppeteer / Selenium * n8n * Git / GitHub * AI coding tools * Structured data * Custom scripts * Other appropriate technologies We care more about the quality and reliability of the solution than which specific tool you choose. ? What Success Looks Like Imagine a production workflow where someone currently has to: 1. Review structured website information 2. Find values throughout WordPress 3. Update those values manually 4. Search for old website information 5. Check metadata and links 6. Identify missing or conflicting information 7. Perform QA A successful automation might turn that into: 1. Provide structured inputs 2. Validate the inputs automatically 3. Preview proposed changes 4. Apply approved updates 5. Generate an exception report 6. Have a human review only what actually requires judgment The goal isn’t automation for its own sake. The goal is: * Less repetitive work * Fewer mistakes * Faster production * Easier QA * Better documentation * More repeatability If you build something impressive that only works when you operate it, the project isn’t finished. ? How We Approach Automation We don’t expect every task to be automated. Good engineering judgment matters. Some work should be automated. Some should be AI-assisted. Some should remain human-reviewed. Some may not be worth automating yet. We value systems that are: * Reusable * Configurable * Understandable * Maintainable * Testable * Safe * Practical That means thinking about structured inputs, validation, dry runs, error handling, exceptions, logging, repeatability, rollback, documentation, and the person who will actually use the system. A clever script that works once is less valuable to us than a simple system that works reliably across many websites. You’ll have freedom to propose the right technical approach while working within real production constraints and avoiding unnecessary complexity. ? Who You’ll Work With You’ll work directly with the people who design and operate the production system, so you’ll get fast feedback on whether what you build actually works. The business side determines which production bottlenecks are worth solving. Our lead website production engineer understands the existing workflow deeply and helps identify problems, test solutions, and provide feedback from the user’s perspective. Your role is to turn recurring production problems into reliable technical systems. You aren’t expected to arrive knowing every detail of our workflow. You are expected to learn it, question inefficient parts, and build practical improvements. ? What We Need You should be able to demonstrate: * At least one real automation, script, internal tool, integration, or production system you personally built or materially contributed to * Practical ability with at least one programming or automation environment such as Python or JavaScript/TypeScript * Understanding of structured inputs and outputs * Ability to debug when the happy path fails * Basic understanding of web technologies * Ability to explain what you personally implemented * Ability to document technical work clearly * Enough written and spoken English to collaborate effectively with a remote team We care much more about demonstrated ability than degrees, certifications, prestigious companies, or years of experience. ? Strongly Preferred Experience with some of the following is valuable: * Python * JavaScript / TypeScript * APIs and webhooks * Browser automation * Playwright, Puppeteer, or Selenium * WordPress / WordPress REST API * HTML / CSS * JSON / structured data * Git / GitHub * n8n or similar workflow tools * QA/testing automation * Logging and exception handling * AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar * Building tools used by non-developers You do not need experience with everything on this list. WordPress experience is useful, but strong automation and systems ability are more important than mastery of our exact WordPress stack. If you’re a capable Python/JavaScript automation builder with only moderate WordPress experience, we still want to hear from you. ? High-Potential Junior Engineers Are Welcome You don’t need ten years of professional engineering experience. We’re open to candidates with limited commercial experience who can demonstrate strong ability through: * Personal projects * Freelance projects * Internal tools * Automation experiments * Open-source work * Systems built for previous employers A technically curious junior who can build, debug, explain their work, and learn quickly may be a better fit than someone with a more impressive résumé but little interest in hands-on implementation. ? You May Be a Strong Fit If You: * Notice repetitive work and look for ways to eliminate it * Enjoy building and debugging practical tools * Think about edge cases and failure conditions * Prefer reusable solutions over one-off fixes * Can explain technical ideas simply * Learn unfamiliar tools quickly * Take ownership and finish what you start You should also be comfortable receiving feedback from the people who actually use your systems. ? This Role Is Probably Not a Fit If This position probably isn’t right for you if: * Your experience is mainly manually building WordPress pages * Your “AI automation” experience is mostly writing prompts * You can’t demonstrate a real working technical system * You only build happy-path demos and ignore failures * You prefer discussing architecture rather than implementing it * You want to replace the existing platform before understanding it * Your background is primarily general VA work without technical automation experience A strong website portfolio by itself is not enough for this position. We’re looking for someone who builds systems, not just pages. ? Hours, Compensation & Growth This position begins as a part-time remote contractor role based in the Philippines. Initial workload: Approximately 10–15 hours per week Starting compensation: $7–$12 USD/hour Your starting rate will depend on demonstrated technical ability, relevant experience, and performance during the hiring process. The role has room to grow. Someone who consistently creates measurable production leverage may earn: * More hours * Higher compensation * Greater technical ownership * Larger projects * Increased responsibility for the systems behind our production operation Growth will be based on demonstrated results rather than tenure alone. ? How to Apply We care about evidence more than résumés. Please submit the requested application information plus two short videos. Video 1 — Personal Introduction 60–90 seconds maximum Briefly tell us: * Who you are * What kinds of technical or automation projects you enjoy building * Why this role interests you * What you want to become significantly better at over the next 1–2 years * Anything useful for us to know about how you work Phone or webcam quality is completely fine. We’re interested in clear communication and genuine interest—not professional video production. Video 2 — Technical Demonstration 5 minutes maximum The technical demonstration is the most important part of your initial application. Show us one real automation or technical system you personally built or materially contributed to. Show and explain: * The problem or manual process that existed before * The system actually working * The input * The output * What you personally built * The tools or languages you used * One bug, failure, or edge case you had to solve * The result or improvement the system produced A finished website alone does not count. Slides or screenshots alone do not count. We want to see a working system. We would rather see a simple but real system that you understand deeply than a polished presentation of something you cannot explain. If previous client work is confidential, use a sanitized version, personal project, or recreated example. If possible, also include a link to relevant source code, workflow export, repository you are permitted to share, or sanitized technical documentation. This is helpful but not required. Applications without both requested videos will not be considered. Please also include: * Current weekly availability * Earliest possible start date * Requested hourly rate (USD) Strong applicants may be invited to a short technical interview. Finalists will complete a paid technical assessment. If building practical automation that actually gets used sounds like the kind of work you want to do, apply.

title: Descript Video Editor
description: Descript Video Editor Trendstop fashion trend forecasting agency is looking for a Descript Video Editor to join our team and help us turn existing recordings into clear, polished and engaging video content. Our video content includes online workshops and website demos, website training videos and social reels. This is a hands-on editing role with Descript at the centre of the workflow, including using its AI and script-based editing tools to make the production process faster and more efficient. What You’ll Be Doing You’ll take existing recordings and turn them into polished, ready-to-publish videos. Your work will include: - Using Descript’s AI tools to clean up and optimise recordings, including improving audio and removing filler words, pauses and other unwanted content. - Editing videos using Descript’s script/transcript editor, particularly to turn longer recordings into shorter, more focused versions. - Reviewing recordings and using good editorial judgement to d ---------- what can be removed while retaining the important information and natural flow. - Tightening pacing and removing mistakes, repetition, unnecessary explanations and technical interruptions. - Adding and editing overlay slides, screenshots, graphics and other supporting visuals. - Selecting and inserting appropriate B-roll clips to make videos more engaging and visually varied. - Creating, correcting and formatting subtitles so they are accurate, readable and consistent. - Editing screen recordings, presenter footage and voiceovers. - Reformatting existing content to create short-form social reels. - Applying consistent branding, layouts and visual styles across our videos. - Quality-checking finished videos for editing, audio, subtitles and visual accuracy. - Exporting videos in the correct resolution, aspect ratio, quality and file format for their intended use, including videos for WordPress website pages and social platforms. - Keeping Descript projects, source recordings and supporting assets organised. - Making revisions based on feedback. What We’re Looking For - You should be confident and experienced with Descript and comfortable using it as your primary video editing platform. We’re looking for someone with: - Strong practical experience editing video in Descript. - Good knowledge of Descript’s AI-powered editing and audio tools. - Experience using script/transcript-based editing to efficiently shorten and restructure recordings. - The ability to take a long recording and turn it into something shorter, clearer and more engaging. - Experience working with screen recordings, demonstrations, webinars, workshops or training content. - Experience adding slides, overlays, screenshots, graphics and B-roll. - Good subtitle editing and formatting skills. - Experience creating short-form and vertical video content. - A good understanding of video formats, aspect ratios, resolution, compression and export settings. - An understanding of preparing and optimising video for web use, including WordPress pages. - Strong attention to detail and good editorial judgement. - The ability to work independently and efficiently across multiple videos. About You - You don’t just know how to make cuts – you understand why and where to make them. - You can look at a long workshop or training recording, quickly understand what matters and use Descript to turn it into a much tighter finished video without losing the key information. - You’re comfortable using AI to speed up the editing process, but you also know where human judgement is required. You notice awkward cuts, inaccurate subtitles, unnecessary pauses, inconsistent audio and sections where an overlay or B-roll would make the content easier to understand. - You’re also comfortable with the technical side of delivery and can make sure the finished video is correctly formatted and optimised for wherever it will be published. Our Content You’ll primarily be working on: - Online workshops & website demos · Website training videos · Social reels - The source material will often already exist, so a significant part of the role is about editing, improving, shortening and repurposing recordings rather than producing videos from scratch. How to Apply - Please send us your CV and examples of video editing work. - Please provide a link(s) to samples of your recent video projects or your portfolio in your application. - We’d particularly like to see examples of work created in Descript, as well as screen-recorded tutorials, training content, webinars or workshops and short-form social videos. - Please also tell us briefly about your experience using Descript’s AI and script-based editing tools and which features you use regularly.

They move by telling the client early and agreeing a new one, never by missing them. Nobody here kills themselves to absorb work that lands mid-month. job_title: Senior AI Systems Architect & Engineer — Data Platform, Agents & Automation
description: ABOUT ENGAGE Engage Studio is a Toronto-based custom jewellery company building an AI-native operating system for its sales, marketing, design, production, inventory, and administrative workflows. Our company goal is to create the most thoughtful engagement experience in the world and AI is integral to assisting us achive this. Our business operations information is currently siloed in multiple systems and platforms. We are undertaking an AI makeover to establish a secure, connected AI foundation that understands the complete client and order journey—from first marketing contact through consultation, design, production, delivery, and future purchases. We want to unify this environment around a shared data and AI foundation. Our objective is not to add another disconnected AI tool. We want to build production AI systems and agents that can progressively replace redundant SaaS platforms, manual data entry, and fragmented workflows. WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR You are a senior, hands-on AI engineer who can architect and build this system. You investigate unfamiliar systems, identify root causes, and turn complex business needs into maintainable production software. You communicate trade-offs clearly, challenge weak assumptions constructively, and take ownership from discovery through architecture, implementation, testing, documentation, training, and handover. WHAT YOU WILL DO You will design a unified AI-native operating layer consisting of shared data services, domain models, APIs, event-driven workflows, specialized agents, and role-based interfaces. The system must connect information across the complete client and order journey while preserving security, traceability, human oversight, and operational reliability. You will also identify where existing platforms should: • Remain the authoritative system of record. • Be integrated temporarily. • Be reduced to a limited function. • Be replaced by purpose-built AI agents and internal applications. • Be retired after their data and workflows have been safely migrated. Platform consolidation must be evidence-based and incremental. We do not want a risky, simultaneous replacement of every system. Core responsibilities will require you to: • Define canonical data models and identifiers for clients, leads, appointments, orders, stones, designs, CAD files, vendors, invoices, payments, shipments, and related entities. • Establish data ownership, lineage, reconciliation, and source-of-truth rules. • Design the appropriate operational data platform using technologies such as PostgreSQL, object storage, search, vector retrieval, event queues, and workflow orchestration where justified. • Build reliable integrations with authentication, idempotency, retries, monitoring, audit logs, and failure recovery. • Design and implement production AI agents using tool calling, structured outputs, retrieval, deterministic validation, and human approval. • Build shared agent tools and services instead of duplicating integrations for every use case. • Create role-based internal interfaces and work queues for sales, production, design, administration, and management. • Implement automated evaluations, data-quality checks, access controls, and observability. • Document the architecture, code, data models, operating procedures, and platform-replacement roadmap. The engineer must determine which capabilities require an LLM, conventional application logic, workflow automation, statistical models, computer vision, or human judgment. We are not looking to force an LLM into every process. MINUMUM REQUIREMENTS • You must work during our business hours (9:30am to 6pm EST) • Strong Python and/or TypeScript software engineering. • LLM APIs, tool calling, structured outputs, retrieval, evaluations, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop workflows. • Data engineering, relational modelling, SQL, and PostgreSQL or comparable databases. • API, webhook, database, document, and event-driven integrations. • Identity resolution, data lineage, reconciliation, and conflict handling. • Queues, idempotency, retries, monitoring, logging, and failure recovery. • Secure handling of confidential business and customer data. • Role-based access control, auditability, and credential management. • Git-based development, automated testing, deployment, and documentation. HIGHLY DESIRABLE • Salesforce, ---------- , NocoBase, n8n, WordPress, Google Workspace, Calendly, WhatsApp, or similar integrations. • ERP, CRM, manufacturing, inventory or production systems. • Multimodal AI, document extraction, transcription, image similarity, or computer vision. • Vector and hybrid search. • CAD, 3D files, technical catalogues, or product information management. • Marketing attribution, forecasting, anomaly detection, and financial reconciliation. • Experience replacing third-party SaaS workflows with internal applications or AI-enabled systems. WHAT WE OFFER: 100,000 to 230,000php per month salary (for full-time based on qualification assessed) Upon successful passing of a probationary period: 13th month bonus pay (pro-rated depending on start date) SSS premium benefit PhilHealth premium benefit Private health insurance HOW TO APPLY Please put the following phrase in the subject heading: CONNECTED AI FOUNDATION Please provide: 1. A short video walkthrough showing the most sophisticated production AI system you personally built. 2. An example where you replaced or consolidated existing software platforms, including the migration strategy and measurable result. 3. An example of a system you inherited from another developer. Explain how you understood it, collaborated with its existing owner, and made changes without destabilizing it. Shortlisted candidates will be given a paid, time-boxed exercise to complete. We will assess architecture, implementation skill, speed, reliability, systems thinking, communication, and judgment—not presentation polish alone.

title: WordPress Malware Removal & Website Security Specialist — Immediate Need
job_title: WordPress Malware Removal & Website Security Specialist — Immediate Need
description: ## Job Title **WordPress Malware Removal & Website Security Specialist — Immediate Need** ## Job Description We are a U.S.-based digital marketing and web development company looking for an experienced **WordPress security specialist** to help us investigate and remediate suspected hacking across multiple client websites. This is a defensive website-security role. We need someone who can do more than install a security plugin. You must be able to identify how a site was compromised, locate hidden malware and backdoors, safely clean the website, and prevent the problem from returning. Our immediate need is to audit a group of WordPress websites, determine which sites are compromised, clean any infected sites, and provide clear documentation of the evidence and work completed. This may become an ongoing position for the right person. ## Responsibilities * Audit WordPress websites for malware, injected code, redirects, spam pages, backdoors, unauthorized administrators, and altered files. * Determine whether each site is hacked, clean, or inconclusive. * Identify the likely point of entry whenever possible. * Remove malware without damaging the website or losing legitimate content. * Inspect WordPress core files, themes, plugins, databases, uploads, cron jobs, user accounts, and server files. * Review server logs, file changes, DNS records, redirects, and security warnings. * Find hidden or recurring backdoors that may survive a basic malware cleanup. * Compare infected files against clean WordPress, plugin, and theme versions. * Restore clean files or backups when appropriate. * Update and harden WordPress installations after cleanup. * Configure or review Sucuri WAF and other website-security protections. * Check whether multiple compromised websites are connected to the same server, user account, plugin, theme, or vulnerability. * Document the evidence found on every website, including screenshots, file paths, malicious code, dates, and recommended next steps. * Provide a concise written report that a nontechnical business owner can understand. * Work carefully with backups and staging environments before making major changes. * Communicate immediately when a compromised website presents a risk to other websites or servers. ## Required Experience You must have real, hands-on experience with: * WordPress malware investigation and removal * PHP and JavaScript malware * Malicious database injections * Hidden administrator accounts and credential compromises * Backdoors, web shells, redirects, SEO spam, and phishing pages * WordPress core, plugin, and theme vulnerabilities * SSH, SFTP, cPanel, phpMyAdmin, MySQL, and server logs * DNS, A records, nameservers, SSL certificates, and website firewalls * Sucuri or comparable website-security platforms * Website backups, restoration, and post-cleanup testing * WordPress security hardening * Managing security work across multiple websites Experience with **MainWP, dedicated servers, website migrations, Cloudflare, Linux servers, or hosting-company i ---------- response** is strongly preferred. ## What We Are Not Looking For * Someone whose only solution is installing Wordfence or another plugin * A general WordPress designer with limited security experience * An agency that will rotate different people through the account * An intern or entry-level developer * Anyone performing offensive, unauthorized, or illegal hacking activities We want **one consistent, experienced individual** who will personally perform the work. ## Work Process * Work will be assigned and documented through Basecamp. * Time must be accurately tracked. * Website access will normally be provided through our approved systems, including MainWP when appropriate. * You must follow strict confidentiality and access-control requirements. * You may not copy, retain, or share client files, credentials, databases, or personal information. * Payment will be made through ---------- to the individual performing the work, not to an agency. * Some overlap with U.S. Eastern Time will be required for communication and urgent i ---------- . ## To Apply Please answer all of the following. Applications without complete answers will not be considered. 1. How many years have you worked specifically on WordPress malware removal and website security? 2. Describe the most difficult WordPress compromise you personally investigated and cleaned. 3. How do you determine whether malware has created a persistent backdoor? 4. What areas of a WordPress installation do you inspect besides plugin and theme files? 5. How do you determine the likely point of entry? 6. What steps do you take before cleaning a live website? 7. What steps do you take after the malware has been removed? 8. What experience do you have with Sucuri WAF? 9. Are you comfortable using SSH, reviewing logs, and examining MySQL databases? 10. Are you an individual freelancer or part of an agency? 11. What hours can you overlap with U.S. Eastern Time? 12. What is your requested hourly rate? 13. How soon can you begin? 14. Provide an example of a security or malware-removal report you created. Remove all confidential client information before sending it. At the beginning of your application, include the words: **“I FIND THE ENTRY POINT”** This confirms that you read the entire job description. ## Paid Skills Test Final candidates may be given a paid test involving a WordPress website or sanitized website files. The test may require the candidate to: * Identify signs of compromise * Locate suspicious files or database records * Explain the likely method of entry * Recommend a safe cleanup procedure * Prepare a short evidence-based report Do not apply unless you are comfortable documenting exactly what you found and how you reached your conclusion.

title: Local SEO Specialist (WordPress) — Map Pack + AI Overviews — Full Time

Off-Page SEO Citation building and cleanup — NAP consistency across all directories Google Business Profile optimization: categories, services, descriptions, posts, photos, Q&A, review strategy Local link building — niche directories, local sponsorships, relevant outreach Monitoring and cleaning up bad or spammy backlinks AI Search / AI Overviews Structuring content so it gets pulled into AI Overviews and AI-generated answers Direct-answer formatting, question-based headings, entity clarity, strong schema Tracking which queries our sites appear in across AI results and adjusting Staying current — this area changes fast and we want someone who follows it closely Reporting Weekly progress updates in a shared tracker Rank tracking by city and keyword Monthly summary: what moved, what didn't, what's next What we're looking for 3+ years of hands-on local SEO — real Map Pack and local organic results, not just theory Strong WordPress working knowledge — Elementor or similar page builders, plugin management, comfortable making changes without breaking a site Solid grasp of Google Business Profile optimization and local ranking factors Experience with US-based local businesses specifically Excellent written English — you'll be writing customer-facing content Comfortable working across many sites at once using systems and repeatable processes Self-directed. You'll get direction and priorities, but we're not going to manage every task. Reliable daily availability with at least a few hours overlapping US business hours Nice to have (not required) WordPress design skills — page layouts, theme customization, redesigning outdated sites Basic HTML/CSS Experience with BrightLocal, Whitespark, Ahrefs, or SEMrush Experience running or supervising a small SEO team Any experience in the auto transport, moving, or home services niches What we provide All tool subscriptions and software licenses Clear priorities, templates, and existing processes to build on Long-term stable work — we've been doing this for years and we're growing HOW TO APPLY Applications that skip these steps get deleted. title: SQUARESPACE WEBSITE DESIGNER + CONVERSION COPYWRITER
description: Creative Experience Brand | Project With Ongoing Work Please read the entire post before applying. Generic applications will not be considered. THE PERSON I AM LOOKING FOR You must have: • Strong, current Squarespace experience, including Fluid Engine • A portfolio of Squarespace websites you personally designed and built • Strong visual taste and command of typography, spacing, imagery, and hierarchy • Experience with service businesses, experience brands, consultants, workshops, retreats, hospitality, events, or personal brands • The ability to make a service understandable and desirable • Strong English writing and editing skills • An understanding of conversion-focused website design • The ability to explain your design and content choices • Comfort working iteratively as the brand, copy, and visual assets improve • Good judgment about when AI helps and when human taste must take over You may use AI for research, ideation, wireframes, copy exploration, image concepts, or workflow support. THIS IS NOT THE RIGHT PROJECT IF • You mainly install and modify templates • Your portfolio is attractive but the websites do not clearly sell anything • You need finished copy and a complete brand guide before beginning • You specialize in e-commerce product stores rather than service businesses • You design in Figma but cannot implement the work accurately in Squarespace • Your writing relies heavily on generic marketing language • You recommend changing platforms instead of working within Squarespace • You cannot show live websites that you personally built HOW TO APPLY Use this application title: PRESENT WONDERS WEBSITE — [YOUR FIRST NAME] Begin your application with: “Painting is the medium, but the experience is the product.” Then provide all of the following: 1. LINKS TO THREE LIVE SQUARESPACE WEBSITES These must be websites you personally designed and built. ONE SERVICE-BUSINESS CASE STUDY Show one example of a website that had to sell an experience, expertise, or service rather than a physical product. Explain: • What was unclear before • What you changed • How you organized the information • How you d ---------- what belonged on the homepage • What action you wanted visitors to take • Any measurable improvement in inquiries, bookings, calls, or conversions Before-and-after screenshots are strongly preferred. 3. Do not provide a complete redesign or create free sample pages. 4. WRITING SAMPLE Choose one heading or paragraph from my current website. Show: • The original wording • Your edited version • A brief explanation of why you changed it 5. WORKING RELATIONSHIP Tell me: • Your hourly rate and typical project rate • Your current availability • Your estimated timeframe for an initial audit and redesign • How you manage feedback and revisions • Whether you personally do all design, writing, and Squarespace work • Which work, if any, you subcontract • What AI tools you use and how you use them • Your preferred process for ongoing website updates Applications missing any requested item will not be considered. HIRING PROCESS 1. Portfolio and application review 2. Short video interview 3. Paid website and marketing-material audit 4. Agreement on redesign scope, timeline, and price 5. Initial design phase 6. Squarespace build and mobile review 7. Ongoing updates as new content becomes available This is initially a project-based position with the potential for a long-term working relationship. title: Overseas E-Commerce & Administrative Assistant

Ensure accurate pricing, clear and SEO-friendly copy, complete product details, and visually appealing presentation. • Categorization: Assign products to the correct categories and collections based on site logic, subject to final CEO approval. • Configurator Backend: Oversee the custom product configurator and coordinate with the IT team and 3D renderer to troubleshoot functionality, update pricing parameters, and accurately upload new digital fabric swatches. • Site Maintenance: Regularly test the checkout flow, identify glitches, document issues clearly, and follow up with the IT team until fixes are completed fora seamless shopping experience. • Google Business Profile: Upload and organize products on the company's Google Business Profile to support local search visibility. Research & Administration • Market Research: Conduct ongoing competitor research on pricing, services such as white-glove delivery, customer experience, and social media strategies to inform business decisions. • Logistics Research: Identify and vet suitable local dispatch and delivery companies for the company's delivery network. • Record Keeping: Maintain accurate internal records of pricing changes, product updates, and operational information using shared Excel files and other company systems. Requirements • Experience: Minimum of 2 years of professional experience in e-commerce operations, including product management, website backend administration, customer support, or a closely related function. • Communication: Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to communicate warmly, clearly, and professionally with customers and internal teams. • Core Tools: Working proficiency in ClickUp, Gmail, Excel, PowerPoint, and Word, with the ability to learn new systems quickly. Hands-on experience using WordPress for product uploads, page updates, or website administration. • Brand Awareness: A solid understanding of luxury or high-value product branding and the elevated customer experience it requires. • Work Style: A proactive mindset and the confidence to identify problems, suggest process improvements, and follow through rather than waiting for step-by-step instructions. • Attention to Detail: A high level of accuracy and strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple moving parts across time zones. • Availability: Reliable availability during the agreed California afternoon schedule, along with dependable internet access and a professional remote-working environment. Nice to Have • Familiarity with the furniture, interior design, or home decor industry. • Basic experience with SEO research or reporting tools such as Ahrefs or Semrush. • Experience using Canva, photoshop for quick image, presentation, or marketing-asset edits. First 90 Days: Success Scorecard During the first 90 days, success in this role will be measured by the following standards: • 100% assigned products are listed accurately and on schedule, with correct pricing, categories, variants, specifications, imagery, and required website fields. • CEO messages are acknowledged and responded to within 5 minutes during scheduled working hours, except when actively handling a customer call or another urgent assignment. • Initial customer chat message response time remains under 2 min during scheduled working hours, with complex matters escalated promptly and clearly. All customer emails respond within 12 hours, with complex matters escalated to CEO promptly and clearly. • No checkout bug remains unresolved, unassigned, or without a documented action plan and escalation for more than 24 hours. • Pipeline maintenance: Update every active customer lead by the end of each week, with the next action and follow-up date clearly recorded. • Shipment communication: Send 100% of scheduled customer shipment updates on time, even when there is no material change in shipment status. • After-sales follow-up: Contact 100% of delivered customers within a week and accurately record reviews, issues, and referral opportunities. • Task ownership: No assigned task becomes overdue without advance communication, a reason for the delay, and a revised completion date. Compensation & Trial Period • Hourly Rate: USD $8-$10 per hour, depending on relevant experience, communication skills, technical capability, and performance during the selection process. • Paid Trial and Probation: The hiring process will include a paid trial task. The selected candidate will begin with a one-month probationary period to confirm fit, responsiveness, accuracy, and ability to manage the role independently. What We Value We value people who are dependable, thoughtful, resourceful, and genuinely care about the customer experience. The right candidate will not simply complete assigned tasks; they will notice what needs attention, communicate early, and help create more organized and reliable systems as the company grows.

description: # Google Ads / PPC Specialist + WordPress Web & Landing Page Designer **Part-Time | Long-Term Position | UK Company | $8 USD per hour** We are an established and growing commercial cleaning company based in the UK looking for a talented **Google Ads/PPC Specialist who also has strong WordPress web design and landing page skills**. We are looking for someone to work with us long-term, rather than someone completing a single project. ## IMPORTANT – THE WEBSITE COMES FIRST Although Google Ads will become a major part of this role, **we do not want to start spending money on advertising until our website and landing pages are ready to convert visitors into enquiries.** Your first project will therefore be improving and developing our existing WordPress website. Once we are happy with the website, you will then take responsibility for launching and managing our Google Ads campaigns. ## Phase 1 – Website & Landing Pages Initially, your main responsibility will be improving our existing WordPress website. We want you to: * Improve the overall look and professionalism of the website * Improve the homepage and key service pages * Create dedicated commercial cleaning and office cleaning pages * Create high-converting landing pages for future Google Ads campaigns * Improve calls-to-action and enquiry forms * Make sure the website works extremely well on mobile * Improve page speed and user experience * Add new written content, images and videos supplied by us * Present our reviews, guarantees, accreditations and service benefits effectively * Make the website focused on **generating qualified business enquiries**, not simply looking attractive * Install and correctly configure analytics and conversion tracking ready for advertising We already have a clear understanding of our target customers, competitors, key messages and what differentiates our company. We need someone who can help turn this into a professional, conversion-focused website. ## Phase 2 – Google Ads / PPC Once the website and landing pages are ready, you will take responsibility for our Google Ads campaigns. This will include: * Keyword and competitor research * Google Search campaign creation * Ad copywriting and testing * Geographic targeting * Negative keyword management * Bid and budget management * GA4 and Google Tag Manager * Conversion tracking * Form and telephone enquiry tracking * Landing page testing * Regular campaign optimisation * Monitoring cost per qualified lead * Simple performance reporting * Ongoing improvements to the website and landing pages based on campaign results Our objective is **not clicks, impressions or website traffic**. Our objective is to generate **qualified enquiries from UK businesses looking for ongoing commercial cleaning contracts.** ## Essential Skills & Experience You must have: * **Strong Google Ads/PPC experience** * **Proven lead-generation experience** * **Previous experience working with UK businesses** * **WordPress experience** * **Strong web and landing page design skills** * **Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO) knowledge** * **SEO knowledge** * **Google Analytics 4 (GA4) experience** * **Google Tag Manager experience** * **Conversion tracking experience** * **Good written and spoken English** * **Ability to work independently and make recommendations rather than simply waiting for instructions** ## Desirable Skills It would also be useful if you have: * Elementor experience * B2B lead-generation experience * Local/service business PPC experience * Graphic design skills * Ability to add and optimise video content for websites * Experience working with ongoing service/contract businesses You do **not** need to be a professional video editor. We can provide finished or semi-finished video content for you to add to the website. ## Internet & Equipment Requirements As this is a fully remote position, you must have: * Your own reliable computer suitable for the work * A **fast and stable internet connection** * Reliable access to video calls with UK management * A suitable backup internet option in case your main connection goes down * The ability to upload and download website assets and video files without significant problems We will ask shortlisted applicants to provide evidence of their current internet speed. ## Hours & Pay ### Initial Website Phase Approximately **15–20 hours per week** while the website, landing pages, analytics and advertising infrastructure are being developed. ### Ongoing Role Once the website is complete and Google Ads is running, we expect approximately **10 hours per week**. These hours will be used for: * Google Ads management and optimisation * Monitoring campaign performance * Landing page testing and improvements * Website updates * SEO improvements * Creating additional landing/service/location pages where appropriate * Reporting and recommendations ### Pay **$6 USD per hour** This is intended to be a **long-term position** for the right person. ## Before You Apply – Please Answer These Two Questions We are looking for people who have read and understood the full job description. **Applications that do not answer BOTH of the following questions will not be considered.** ### **1. WHAT IS THE MOST SUCCESSFUL GOOGLE PPC CAMPAIGN THAT YOU HAVE RUN?** Please explain what the campaign was, what type of business it was for, what you personally did, how much was spent and what results you achieved. Where possible, include **the number of leads/conversions generated and the cost per lead/conversion**. ### **2. WHAT IS YOUR FAVOURITE LANDING PAGE THAT YOU HAVE EVER DESIGNED, AND WHY?** Please provide a **link or example of the landing page**. Tell us what you personally designed or built, what the objective of the page was and **why you believe it was successful at converting visitors into enquiries or customers**. ## About Us We are **Evolve Commercial Cleaning**, a growing commercial cleaning company based in North West England. We provide ongoing contract cleaning to businesses and organisations and are now investing significantly in our website, marketing and lead generation. Our aim is not simply to generate more website traffic. We want to build a strong online lead-generation system that consistently attracts businesses looking for high-quality commercial cleaning services. We are looking for someone who wants to become a **long-term part of our marketing team** and help us develop and improve that system over time.

title: Performance Video Editor (DTC / Paid Social)
description: About the role Monkedia is a fast-growing digital marketing agency, and we're looking for a Performance Video Editor who thinks like a marketer first and an editor second. This is a role for someone who understands consumer psychology and direct response, and who can turn that understanding into short-form video ads that stop the scroll and drive conversion for ecommerce brands. We care less about polish for its own sake and more about whether you understand why an ad works: how to open on a hook that lands in the first two or three seconds, how to structure that hook both visually and through audio, how to pace a story for a specific brand, platform, and format, and how to hold attention all the way to the CTA. Ideally you've already edited video for DTC ecommerce brands, for organic social and, even better, as paid ads that ran on the Meta platform. Strong, fast, detail-oriented video editing is the core of the job. AI is how we move faster, not the point of the role. We want you comfortable using AI video and image tools to generate B-roll, fill gaps, and produce variations at speed, without leaning on them as a crutch. The editing instinct and the marketing brain come first; the AI tooling supplements them. What you'll do Edit and produce short-form video ads for DTC ecommerce (feed, stories, reels) built to perform, not just to look nice. Structure hooks that work in the first few seconds, visually and through audio, and pace the whole cut to hold attention to the CTA. Adapt tone, pacing, and format to each brand and each placement so the ad feels native and on-brand. Bring a conversion mindset to every cut: you understand the funnel the ad sits in and what it needs to do. Use AI video and image tools to generate B-roll, fill gaps, and spin up variations quickly, as a supplement to your editing, not a replacement for it. Clean and shape audio so it sounds natural: voiceover, music, pacing, sync, and sound design. Add motion graphics, text animation, captions, transitions, and effects that lift retention and clarity. Produce supporting static creative and variations when a campaign needs them. Work to brief, manage multiple brands at once, and keep tasks moving in our project-management tools. Qualifications Must-have A marketer's understanding of what makes ads convert: consumer psychology, direct response, hooks, retention, and CTA, not just production skill. ~2+ years editing short-form video for paid social or ecommerce (agency, in-house, or freelance). A portfolio of DTC / ecommerce video ads. We want to see performance work, ideally ads that ran as paid Meta creative, not only brand reels or logo work. Strong, fast video editing (Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci, CapCut, or similar). A real point of view on hook structure, visual and audio, and on how format changes by platform and placement. Detail-oriented, organized, responsive, and able to manage multiple brands at pace. Available during U.S. working hours (EST/CST overlap preferred). Nice-to-have (strong pluses) Hands-on with AI video and image generation (Runway, Sora, Kling, Veo, Pika, etc.) for B-roll, variations, and speed, with a sense of which tool fits which job. Natural-sounding AI audio: voice generation/cloning and sound design that doesn't sound synthetic (ElevenLabs or similar). Motion-graphics depth, plus strong layout, typography, and visual hierarchy. Graphic design in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator). Landing-page / web design, and familiarity with Shopify, WordPress, or similar. Exposure to AI ad-production platforms (e.g. SuperScale) and creative-analytics tools. Why this role Own performance video creative for a range of ecommerce brands. Fast-paced, hands-on, with real ownership of the output and the results it drives. Use AI to move faster than traditional editors, without losing the marketing craft that makes ads actually convert.

WordPress or similar website platforms - Managing multiple client accounts - Maximizing results with limited advertising budgets - Using AI tools for research, ad copy, analysis, testing, and workflow efficiency AI experience is a plus, but you must be able to review its output, make sound strategic decisions, and produce original, accurate work. ## What Success Looks Like A successful person in this role will: - Catch tracking and campaign problems before the client does. - Improve SEO visibility and qualified website traffic. - Reduce wasted advertising spend. - Improve the quality and cost of leads, bookings, or sales. - Provide clear recommendations based on evidence. - Complete work accurately and on time. - Communicate progress without needing repeated follow-ups. - Treat each client’s budget as carefully as their own. ## Compensation and Growth This role will begin with a **paid trial project or trial period** so we can evaluate your technical knowledge, strategic thinking, communication, reliability, and quality of work. Successful candidates may receive: - Ongoing client accounts - Recurring monthly work - Increased responsibility - Compensation growth based on performance, reliability, communication, and account capacity - A long-term position within our growing team Some clients may begin with smaller advertising budgets, so you must know how to prioritize effectively and set realistic expectations. ## How to Apply Use the subject line: **“I Am Your Digital Marketing Strategist”** Please include: 1. A brief introduction and overview of your experience. 2. Your experience with website SEO, Google Ads, and Meta Ads. 3. Examples of SEO improvements or advertising results you produced. 4. The analytics, reporting, and tracking tools you use. 5. An example of a conversion-tracking problem you identified and corrected. 6. Your availability and normal working hours, including your time zone. 7. Your desired hourly or monthly compensation. 8. Screenshots, reports, case studies, or other proof of results where available. Please begin your application with the word **“ELEVATE”** so we know you read the complete job post. Do not send a generic or AI-generated application without specific examples of your work. ## Screening Questions Please answer each question clearly: 1. Walk us through an SEO audit you completed. What problems did you identify, what changes were made, and what results followed? 2. How would you determine whether a website’s forms, phone calls, and bookings are being tracked correctly? 3. Describe a Google Ads or Meta Ads campaign you improved. What did you change, and what measurable results did you achieve? 4. What steps do you take when a campaign is spending money but producing few or no conversions? 5. How do you approach marketing when a client has a limited advertising budget? 6. Which SEO and reporting tools do you use regularly, and why? 7. How do you explain performance to a client who does not understand digital marketing? 8. How do you use AI in your work, and how do you verify that its output is accurate? ## Practical Strategy Question A boutique hotel has: - A website with low organic traffic - An unoptimized Google Business Profile - Google Ads and Meta Ads accounts with uncertain conversion tracking - A limited monthly advertising budget - A goal of increasing direct bookings **What would you audit first, what would you prioritize during the first 30 days, and how would you measure success?** We are looking for thoughtful, specific answers—not generic marketing definitions. title: Senior SEO Specialist
description: Most agencies pay their best SEO roughly what they pay their average one. We built this role, and the entire hiring process behind it, for the top 20% of SEO specialists, and we pay accordingly. Every application is scored against a rubric, every claim is checked against your CV, and only people who can show real numbers reach the interview. If your results so far have been average, this will not be the role for you. If you are genuinely good and tired of being paid like everyone else, keep reading. We are an SEO and digital marketing agency in Ireland. Our clients stay with us: zero client churn in the last eighteen months, organic traffic up 113% for one client, around 2,000 conversions a month for another. We are now growing the team behind those results, and the last person we hired through this exact process has become one of our best people. How we work Three things matter here, and they will matter to you every day in this role. The first is real results: we report numbers clients can verify, which is why they stay, and it is why your work will be judged on outcomes rather than hours or optics. The second is ownership: you run your accounts like they are your own business, and nobody asks you to route changes through a ticket queue. The third is straight talk: we tell clients the truth about what is working and what is not, and we expect the same honesty inside the team, including telling us when we are wrong. What you will do You will own client accounts end to end, from SEO strategy through execution. The day-to-day work covers technical audits, keyword research, on-page implementation, local SEO and Google Business Profile management. You will work in WordPress every day and implement changes yourself instead of handing them to a developer. We also expect ideas: when you look at a client, we want to hear what you would try next. We are an automation-first agency, so you will work with AI daily, and you will learn more here in six months than in three years elsewhere. What we require (we check every one of these) At least 5 years of hands-on SEO with results you can show us WordPress plus basic HTML and CSS Ahrefs or SEMrush, GA4, Google Search Console and Screaming Frog A real local SEO and Google Business Profile track record Strong written and spoken English Hands-on vibe coding experience with AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Codex Bonus points Knowledge of backlinks and off-page SEO, including link building and digital PR, is the biggest bonus of all. Experience with Google Ads or Facebook Ads, DNS and hosting setup, basic JavaScript or Python, an eye for design, or ecommerce SEO will also score higher in our process. Pay and growth We pay at the top of your local market, full-time and long-term, reviewed on results. We can pay at that level precisely because we only hire at that level. We do not publish a number because we pay for skill rather than titles: tell us your rate and show us the results that justify it. There is a genuine manager track as the agency grows, and when we say results over hours we mean it, because nobody here watches your clock. How hiring works The application takes about fifteen minutes and consists of a short profile, your CV and six scenario questions, with no cover letter. If your thinking stands out, we send you a paid test task. Pass that and you get a single interview with the founder, with no five-round panels. After that comes a 30-day paid trial before we both commit long-term. How to apply Apply at ---------- oagencydublin.ie/roles/digital-marketing-specialist There is no email application; everything goes through the form so every candidate is assessed the same way.

title: SEO Manager
description: The Opportunity: We are seeking an experienced SEO Manager to own and execute SEO work across our active client portfolio. This is a highly hands-on full time position responsible for turning established search strategy into account-level plans and executing the technical SEO, on-page optimization, local search, link building, content direction, migrations, and reporting required to deliver results. The ideal candidate combines strong technical SEO expertise with excellent organization, accountability, and communication. Key Responsibilities: SEO Strategy & Account Management: - Build and execute account-level SEO roadmaps based on established strategy and methodology. - Manage priorities and deliverables across the full portfolio of active SEO accounts. - Ensure contracted SEO work is completed accurately and on schedule. - Identify scope, capacity, or delivery risks and escalate them proactively. - Conduct competitive, keyword, content gap, and opportunity analysis. Technical & On-Page SEO: - Perform technical SEO audits and implement recommendations. - Manage site architecture, internal linking, URL structures, redirects, crawlability, and indexation. - Implement schema markup and structured data. - Monitor and improve Core Web Vitals and page performance. - Perform routine SEO and configuration work directly within WordPress. - Plan and execute website migrations, consolidations, and large-scale URL restructuring. Content & Search Visibility: - Develop SEO-focused content briefs based on search intent. - Apply topical clusters and resource hub strategies. - Optimize content for traditional search and emerging AI-driven search experiences. - Strengthen EEAT signals, authorship, credentials, and entity consistency. - Incorporate SEO, AIO, AEO, GEO, and local search into account planning. Reporting & Client Communication: - Monitor rankings, organic traffic, conversions, traffic quality, and AI visibility. - Maintain accurate reporting and performance data. - Turn performance data into actionable recommendations. - Participate in recurring client calls and respond to SEO-related questions. - Communicate delays, blockers, risks, and performance issues proactively. Team & Operational Support: - Manage and develop a part-time local search resource. - Delegate responsibilities as capabilities develop. - Follow and improve established SEO SOPs, templates, and checklists. - Document account-specific processes and technical decisions clearly. - Support onboarding of new SEO accounts. - Conduct SEO audits and competitive analysis for qualified prospects. Compensation: Competitive monthly compensation based on experience and role scope. Monthly compensation ranges from ?70,000 – ?90,000, depending on experience and role scope. Final compensation is aligned with the candidate’s experience level. Required Experience: - 5+ years of hands-on SEO experience, preferably within an agency or performance-driven environment. - Proven experience owning SEO accounts and deliverables from planning through execution. - Experience with law firms or other highly competitive local service industries strongly preferred. - Demonstrated experience with website migrations, consolidations, or large-scale URL restructuring. - Strong WordPress proficiency and ability to make routine SEO changes without developer support. - Working knowledge of HTML, schema markup, and structured data. - Experience managing or developing at least one other contributor. - Strong written and verbal communication skills. - Highly organized, proactive, accountable, and comfortable managing multiple client priorities independently. - Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience considered. Tools & Platforms: Experience with: - Semrush - Ahrefs and/or Majestic - Screaming Frog - Google Search Console - Google Analytics 4 (GA4) - Google Tag Manager - BrightLocal or comparable local SEO platforms - WordPress What Success Looks Like: The successful SEO Manager consistently delivers contracted SEO work on schedule, independently manages day-to-day priorities, and identifies problems before they become missed deadlines. They demonstrate strong technical execution, improve organic and AI search visibility, successfully manage complex migrations and local SEO initiatives, and keep leadership informed of meaningful risks and opportunities. Above all, this person takes ownership of SEO delivery—staying on top of accounts, priorities, and performance without needing to be repeatedly asked for updates. Application Process If you meet the requirements outlined above and are interested in this opportunity, please complete our quick application form by uploading your resume and submitting a short 1-minute introduction video. In your video briefly share: - Your professional background - The types of work you specialize in - Why this opportunity interests you We will review applications and contact qualified candidates regarding next steps.

accounting processes Prepare financial information and supporting documentation for external accountants as required General Accounting Responsibilities Take ownership of the complete bookkeeping and accounting function Maintain the chart of accounts and ensure transactions are correctly classified Process journals, accruals, prepayments and adjustments where required Maintain accurate records for GST and other applicable tax obligations Assist with BAS preparation and reporting requirements where applicable Maintain accurate records of business assets and liabilities Ensure intercompany transactions are correctly recorded and reconciled Maintain organised supporting documentation and accounting records Identify accounting errors and correct them proactively Develop and improve accounting processes and internal controls where required Systems & eCommerce Accounting Our businesses operate in a high-volume eCommerce environment, so experience working with integrated accounting, inventory and eCommerce systems is highly desirable. title: Marketing Manager
description: About Starbond Starbond is a growing direct-to-consumer brand focused on delivering high-quality products and an excellent customer experience. We are looking for a hands-on Marketing Manager who can turn data, customer insights, and strong execution into profitable growth. About the Role The Marketing Manager will own Starbond’s direct-to-consumer growth engine across paid acquisition, retention, lifecycle marketing, content, SEO, answer engine optimization (AEO), social media, conversion optimization, and agency performance. This role requires a strong command of unit economics—including customer lifetime value (LTV), customer acquisition cost (CAC), CAC payback period, gross margin, and contribution margin—and the ability to convert these metrics into sound growth decisions. You will directly manage marketing agencies across Meta, Google, email, and AEO while leading the internal Marketing team, setting clear performance standards, and giving the CEO timely visibility into results, risks, and recommended actions. Key Responsibilities DTC Growth and Customer Acquisition Develop and lead the DTC acquisition strategy across Meta Ads, Google Ads, Shopify, email, SEO, social media, Amazon alignment, and other relevant channels. Manage marketing for profitable growth—not revenue or ROAS alone—by incorporating product margin, contribution margin, retention, and customer quality into decisions. Establish acceptable CAC thresholds by product, customer segment, campaign, and channel, and recommend when to scale, restructure, reduce, or discontinue investment. Align advertising, creative, landing pages, offers, product positioning, inventory availability, and operational readiness. LTV, Retention, and Lifecycle Marketing Maintain a clear and consistent LTV methodology using customer revenue, purchase frequency, retention, gross margin or contribution margin, and cohort data. Analyze LTV and retention by acquisition source, product, cohort, and customer segment, and use the findings to improve channel and offer decisions. Lead strategies that improve repeat purchase rate, purchase frequency, average order value, cross-sell, replenishment, retention, and win-back performance. Oversee email and lifecycle marketing quality, segmentation, deliverability, revenue contribution, and customer communication accuracy. Paid Advertising and Conversion Oversee paid media strategy, budget pacing, campaign structure, audience strategy, creative testing, attribution, and landing-page performance. Establish clear testing, scaling, optimization, and stop-loss rules, and require decisions to be supported by sufficient data and financial context. Review performance at the channel, campaign, audience, creative, product, and cohort levels. Partner with the Web Developer on Shopify priorities, site performance, conversion rate optimization, tracking, and quality assurance. Agency and Vendor Management Directly manage marketing agencies across Meta, Google, email, and AEO, including scopes of work, deliverables, timelines, communication standards, SLAs, KPIs, reporting, ownership, and escalation procedures. Use agency scorecards and recurring performance reviews to track KPI attainment, SLA compliance, output quality, timeliness, efficiency, and business results. Require root-cause analysis and time-bound corrective action plans for missed targets, SLA breaches, quality issues, reporting gaps, or inefficient spend. Independently validate agency recommendations and recommend contract expansion, renegotiation, reduction, replacement, or termination when appropriate. Ensure Starbond retains access to and ownership of advertising accounts, data, dashboards, creative files, documentation, and intellectual property. Content, Creative, and Brand Maintain an active content and creative pipeline supported by clear briefs, owners, deadlines, QA standards, and success metrics. Ensure reliable content-production support is available when external resources are required. Create a structured process for testing creative concepts, hooks, formats, messages, offers, and calls to action. Protect product positioning and perceived value by avoiding excessive reliance on discounting and ensuring marketing claims are accurate and supportable. Ensure approved assets are properly named, organized, and stored in company-owned systems. Team Leadership, Process, and Reporting Lead the internal Marketing team by setting clear responsibilities, deadlines, quality standards, KPIs, communication expectations, and individual performance targets. Conduct regular coaching, one-on-ones, performance reviews, and accountability conversations; identify skill gaps and coordinate development or corrective action with HR. Make timely recommendations regarding training, role clarity, workload changes, reassignment, or other performance actions when standards are not met. Create and maintain marketing processes, approval flows, reporting definitions, campaign documentation, and quality-control systems. Maintain a weekly marketing scorecard that distinguishes leading and lagging indicators and explains what changed, why it changed, and what action is required. Proactively escalate material risks and present concise, financially grounded recommendations to the CEO. What Success Looks Like Marketing data, forecasts, campaign reports, creative briefs, and recommendations are accurate, validated, and financially grounded. Campaigns, agency deliverables, reports, corrective actions, and launches are completed on time, with blockers escalated early. CAC, LTV, LTV:CAC, MER, ROAS, contribution margin, retention, and cohort performance are consistently defined and used to guide decisions. Marketing investment produces profitable customer growth, stronger retention, faster learning, higher-quality execution, and stronger brand protection. The Marketing team and external agencies operate with clear ownership, measurable standards, and consistent accountability. What We’re Looking For Proven experience leading DTC or e-commerce marketing across paid acquisition, retention, lifecycle marketing, content, and conversion optimization. Strong working knowledge of CAC, LTV, LTV:CAC, MER, ROAS, contribution margin, retention, cohort analysis, and marketing attribution. Experience managing Meta Ads, Google Ads, email marketing, SEO, AEO, Shopify, and agency partners. Demonstrated ability to manage budgets and make channel decisions based on profitability and customer quality. Experience leading and developing marketing team members, setting KPIs, and managing performance. Strong analytical judgment with the ability to challenge assumptions, validate agency recommendations, and translate data into clear actions. Excellent written and verbal communication, with a proactive and concise reporting style. Highly organized, accountable, and comfortable working in a remote, fast-moving environment. Tools and Platforms Google Workspace, ClickUp, Shopify, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, Amazon advertising and marketplace reports, Google Analytics, Looker Studio or Power BI, Klaviyo or a similar lifecycle platform, spreadsheets, and agency reporting systems. How to Apply Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter that addresses the following: Describe a DTC or e-commerce business you helped grow and the results you personally influenced. Share an example of how you used CAC, LTV, contribution margin, retention, or cohort data to make a marketing decision. Describe your experience managing marketing agencies and holding them accountable to KPIs and deadlines. List the advertising, analytics, e-commerce, and lifecycle marketing platforms you have used. Applications that include specific examples and measurable outcomes will receive priority consideration.
