description: $300 USD PER WEEK - FULL TIME - PAID EVERY WEEK That is $1,300/month. Reviewed at 6 months, with a real path to $1,550/month in your first year. That number is firm. It is not a starting point we negotiate down from. It is at the top of the market because this role is wider than a normal support job and we need someone who can handle that. We are a US home decor e-commerce company. 25+ years in business, over 100,000 customers. We sell through our own website plus Amazon, wholesale, and dropship channels. Small team, no bureaucracy, and you will report directly to the owner. This role sits on a two-person support team. Between the two of you, you will cover everything below - but we are hiring THIS seat specifically for the phone. If you would rather live in email and tickets, the other seat is the one you want, and this is not it. -------------------------------------------------- WHAT THIS JOB ACTUALLY IS -------------------------------------------------- It is two things, and you need to be good at both. THE PHONE IS THE BIGGEST PART - AND IT IS ADVISORY WORK, NOT SCRIPT-READING We sell natural cowhide and sheepskin rugs. Every hide is different - different size, markings, colour, shape. A customer calls and says: "I need something for under my dining table, my walls are cream, I have two dogs, and I don't want it to look too busy." Your job is to actually think about that. Ask the right questions, narrow eighty options down to three, explain why, and give her the confidence to spend $300. You will also sell furniture and take custom orders over the phone. Our customers are mostly women aged 45 to 70. They call rather than email, and they can tell instantly when they are being handled instead of helped. You will also cover email, website chat, and Facebook messages. THE REST IS E-COMMERCE OPERATIONS - AND IT CHANGES DAILY - Calling the carrier when a truck does not show up - Filing a lost-package claim and following it until it is paid - Processing returns - Catching an order and killing it before it ships - Checking stock and flagging what needs restocking - Ordering supplies for the warehouse - Freight and delivery paperwork - Updating pricing across our channels - Amazon and dropship order issues - Wholesale dealer enquiries - Scheduling social posts Nobody will hand you a list every morning. Things will land on you mid-shift and you will have to work out what matters first. If that sounds stressful rather than interesting, this is not your role. -------------------------------------------------- SCHEDULE ------------------------------------------ ---------- :00am - 5:00pm US Eastern, Monday to Friday. That is 9:00pm - 5:00am MANILA TIME. You must already work these hours and have done for at least two years. We verify it - current employer, your role, your exact shift, and a reference we will call. Do not apply hoping to switch onto nights. We have been burned by that. -------------------------------------------------- WHAT WE REQUIRE -------------------------------------------------- NON-NEGOTIABLE: - 3+ years customer service with US customers ON THE PHONE. Not chat. Not email. Voice. - HANDS-ON SHOPIFY EXPERIENCE. You have worked in a real store admin - finding orders, editing them, processing refunds, issuing replacements, checking inventory. Not "I have seen it." You have used it. - Already on US night hours for 2+ years - English clear enough that a 68-year-old in Ohio understands you the first time, every time - 60+ WPM typing - THE ABILITY TO THINK. Hold several things in your head at once, notice what a customer has NOT told you and ask about it, and work out what is urgent when four things land at the same time. - OWNERSHIP. If a package is lost, you chase the carrier until it is resolved. Nobody will remind you. This is the single biggest difference between people who last here and people who do not. - SELF-DIRECTION. You do not wait to be told. You see the thing that needs doing, you do it, and you tell us it is done. - Reliable computer, quality noise-cancelling headset, wired internet with a backup connection, quiet room with a door - NO other job or client. This is exclusive. A BIG PLUS - NOT REQUIRED: - Project management experience. Anyone who has run a process end to end, kept a board clean, and made sure nothing fell through the cracks will do well here and will be given more to run. - Amazon Seller Central - Freight, carrier claims, or logistics experience - Home decor, furniture, or interior product background TRAINABLE - DO NOT SKIP APPLYING OVER THESE: - Asana, helpdesk software, social scheduling tools - Our product knowledge - Our specific procedures We can teach our tools and our product. We cannot teach judgment, warmth, urgency, or the instinct to ask one more question. Apply on those. A LAST WORD ON FIT The person who succeeds here gets things done without being chased. They finish what they start, they close loops, and when something is broken they fix it or flag it the same day rather than letting it sit. If you need a supervisor watching you to stay productive, you will not enjoy working here and we will both know it by week two. -------------------------------------------------- WHAT WE OFFER -------------------------------------------------- - $300 USD per week, paid weekly. No waiting two weeks or a month to get paid. - A discretionary year-end bonus in December for people who have performed - Review at 6 months. If you are performing, $1,550/month within your first year. We would rather pay one great person well than two average ones. - Paid training week, then a structured ramp. Phone and email first, operations added month by month. You will not be handed everything on day one. - A long-term seat. We are not staffing a project. We want you still here in five years, running more than you started with. - Written procedures for most situations, and a manager who answers you at 2am Manila instead of leaving you stuck -------------------------------------------------- HOW WE HIRE ------------------------------------------ ---------- . Written application - the five questions below 2. Recorded video interview. Fair warning: ONE TAKE per question, 15 seconds of thinking time. No scripting, no re-recording until it is perfect. That is deliberate. We are hiring for how you sound when you are NOT ready, because that is what a ringing phone is. 3. Live call with us. Unscripted, including one simulated upset customer. 4. Paid trial week, on the phone from day two 5. 14-day and 30-day check-ins If step 2 sounds unpleasant, that is useful information. The people who do well here read it and feel relieved. ------------------------------------------ ---------- HONEST NOTES -------------------------------------------------- We use time-tracking software with screenshots. We measure results, not keystrokes, but we are telling you upfront. Use AI to research answers all you like once you are hired. Do not use it to write your application. We can tell, and it is an automatic no. -------------------------------------------------- HOW TO APPLY -------------------------------------------------- START YOUR MESSAGE WITH THE WORD: TANNERY Anything without it is deleted unread. Then answer these five. Short is fine. Specific is required. 1. What company do you work for right now, what is your exact shift in Manila time, and how many months have you been on it? 2. What Shopify store did you work in, what did the company sell, and what did you personally do in the admin? Name specific things you did in there. 3. Roughly how many phone calls per day in your most recent role, and what were they usually about? 4. Tell us about a problem you had to chase over several days - something that was not resolved on the first attempt and that nobody was reminding you about. What was it, what did you do, and how did it end? 5. A customer tells you: "I love the black and white rug but I'm worried it'll look too busy in my living room." What do you say back to her? Write your ACTUAL WORDS, not a description of your approach.

job_title: Influencer Outreach & Partnerships Manager – Luxury Fashion Brand
description: HOLT, a luxury women's fashion brand specializing in statement pieces handmade in Miami, is looking for a highly motivated **Influencer Outreach & Partnerships Manager** to aggressively grow our influencer, celebrity, stylist, and creator network. This is primarily an **OUTREACH position**. We are looking for someone who can spend every day discovering the right influencers, contacting them, following up, negotiating collaborations, coordinating gifting, and building long-term relationships that generate exposure, content, traffic, and sales for HOLT. ## Your Main Responsibility **Get HOLT into the hands of the right women and get HOLT seen.** You will build and manage a large pipeline of: * Fashion influencers * Luxury lifestyle influencers * Miami influencers * New York and Los Angeles influencers * Resort and travel creators * Celebrity stylists * Fashion stylists * Models and personalities * Reality-TV personalities * Micro-influencers with highly engaged audiences * Content creators and UGC creators * Fashion editors and other relevant industry contacts ## Responsibilities * Research new influencers and creators every day * Identify influencers whose audience and aesthetic match HOLT * Find contact emails, management information, agencies, and other contact methods * Conduct high-volume daily outreach through Instagram DM, email, TikTok, LinkedIn, and other appropriate channels * Introduce influencers and stylists to HOLT * Pitch gifting, collaborations, events, affiliate opportunities, and partnerships * Follow up consistently with influencers who do not initially respond * Communicate with influencer managers and agencies * Negotiate gifted and paid collaborations when appropriate * Coordinate product selections, sizing, shipping information, and gifting * Follow up after products are received * Make sure agreed-upon content is actually posted * Request photos and videos for HOLT to repost * Obtain appropriate content usage permissions * Develop long-term relationships with high-performing influencers * Invite influencers to HOLT events, launches, pop-ups, shoots, and other activations * Identify opportunities for celebrity and stylist placements * Track discount codes, affiliate links, traffic, engagement, and sales when applicable * Maintain an organized influencer CRM/database * Keep detailed records of every contact, response, product sent, collaboration, post, and result * Report results weekly ## Daily Outreach Expectations This is a proactive position. We do not want someone waiting for influencers to contact us. You should be comfortable maintaining a consistent daily pipeline of **new outreach + follow-ups + active collaborations**. Quality matters. We are not interested in randomly messaging thousands of accounts. Every influencer should be evaluated for: **Brand Fit + Audience + Engagement + Location + Content Quality + Sales Potential** ## What Success Looks Like We will measure: **Qualified Influencers Contacted → Responses → Products Requested → Collaborations Confirmed → Products Sent → Content Posted → Reach/Engagement → Website Traffic → Sales** The goal isn't simply to send free clothing. The goal is to turn influencer outreach into **brand awareness, beautiful content, relationships, and revenue.** ## Ideal Candidate You should: * Understand Instagram and TikTok extremely well * Have excellent written English * Be comfortable sending large amounts of personalized outreach * Be persistent with follow-ups * Have a strong eye for fashion and aesthetics * Understand luxury positioning * Know the difference between follower count and real influence * Be able to evaluate engagement and audience quality * Be extremely organized * Communicate professionally with influencers, managers, and stylists * Understand gifting and influencer collaborations * Be comfortable negotiating * Work independently * Be highly responsive * Be motivated by measurable results Previous experience with **fashion, beauty, luxury, influencer marketing, PR, celebrity placement, or creator partnerships** is strongly preferred. ## Tools Experience with any of the following is helpful: Instagram • TikTok • Shopify • Canva • Google Sheets • Influencer databases • CRM platforms • Affiliate platforms • ChatGPT/AI tools ## To Apply Please send: 1. Your resume 2. Your previous influencer-marketing experience 3. Fashion, beauty, or luxury brands you have worked with 4. Examples of influencer campaigns you have managed 5. Your expected monthly salary 6. Your availability and time zone ### REQUIRED TEST Please identify **10 influencers you believe would be a strong fit for HOLT**. For each influencer, provide: **Name | Instagram/TikTok | Follower Count | Why They Fit HOLT | How You Would Approach Them** Then write: **1 Instagram DM** you would send to an influencer you want to gift HOLT. **1 email** you would send to an influencer's manager proposing a collaboration. We are looking for someone who can become the person responsible for **building HOLT's influencer network from the ground up and turning relationships into meaningful exposure and sales.**

description: Hiring DTC - ECOM CREATIVE STRATEGIST Remote | Full-Time | Meta Ads Focus | Restricted Categories About Growing Pains Marketing Growing Pains Marketing is a performance marketing agency focused on scaling DTC eCommerce brands through paid social, creative strategy, and direct response advertising. Client-Facing Communication Communicate clearly and professionally with clients when needed. Experience with tools like Triple Whale, Motion, Foreplay, Meta Ad Library, TikTok Creative Center, Shopify, or GoHighLevel. Experience working inside an agency. Role Overview As our Creative Strategist, you will be responsible for researching markets, developing creative angles, writing briefs, coordinating creative production, uploading/launching ads in Meta, and monitoring performance to identify what is working. You should be comfortable working across multiple DTC eCommerce accounts and moving quickly without sacrificing strategy or quality. You will work closely with media buyers, designers, video editors, UGC creators, and leadership to ensure each account has a strong pipeline of new creative. Key Responsibilities: Creative Strategy Develop creative strategies for DTC eCommerce brands running Meta ads. Research customer avatars, pain points, desires, objections, competitor positioning, reviews, Reddit threads, TikTok trends, Meta Ad Library, Amazon reviews, landing pages, and customer language. Identify new hooks, angles, offers, formats, and messaging opportunities. Create clear creative testing plans based on performance data and market research. Understand direct response principles, buyer psychology, and how to structure ads that convert. Creative Briefs Write detailed creative briefs for designers, video editors, and UGC creators. Include hooks, concepts, scripts, visual direction, claims/compliance notes, CTA, product positioning, and references. Make sure briefs are specific enough that the creative team can execute without confusion. Provide examples of winning ads, swipe files, and references when needed. Meta Ads Execution Upload, launch, and organize ads inside Meta Ads Manager. Understand Meta campaign structure, ad sets, ad naming conventions, creative testing, and basic performance monitoring. Know how to read creative performance inside Meta and identify winners, losers, and patterns. Work with media buyers to understand what creative needs to be tested next. Monitor active ads and help determine when creative needs to be paused, iterated, or scaled. Creative Performance Analysis Review ad performance by hook, angle, format, offer, product, audience, and creative type. Identify why certain ads are working or not working. Use performance data to inform future creative briefs. Track winning patterns across accounts. Help build a repeatable creative testing system. Client-Facing Communication Communicate clearly and professionally with clients when needed. Present creative strategies, explain why certain angles are being tested, and provide updates on creative direction. Strong written and spoken English is required. You must be able to explain your thinking clearly on calls, in Slack, and in Loom videos. Requirements You must have experience with DTC eCommerce creative strategy. You must understand Meta ads deeply, especially for purchase/conversion campaigns. You must be able to upload, launch, and monitor ads inside Meta Ads Manager. You must know how to create creative briefs that designers, editors, and UGC creators can actually execute. You must understand customer research, competitor research, and offer positioning. You must have excellent written and spoken English. You must be comfortable recording Loom videos explaining your strategy. You must be organized, fast, and able to manage multiple accounts. You must be comfortable working with restricted or compliance-sensitive categories. You must be available during some U.S. working hours. Between 6-9 am and 3-5 PM depending on your starting shift. We are not hiring candidates located in North America, or citizens of North America for this role. Nice to Have Experience with CBD, supplements, peptides, telemedicine, health/wellness, or other restricted categories. Experience sourcing or managing UGC creators. Experience writing UGC scripts. Experience with tools like Triple Whale, Motion, Foreplay, Meta Ad Library, TikTok Creative Center, Shopify, or GoHighLevel. Experience working inside an agency. Compensation Base pay: $1,500–$3,000 USD per month, depending on experience and skill level. Bonus: $100/month per account that maintains KPI on a monthly basis. Expected account load: 10–20 accounts per month. If you are able to handle more accounts while maintaining quality, that is a plus. Hiring Process: Step 1: Application You will complete the application questions below and submit examples of your previous work. Step 2: Level 1 Test If your application looks strong, we will send you a short Level 1 creative strategy test. Step 3: Interview If your Level 1 test is strong, we will schedule an interview. Step 4: Level 2 Test Final candidates will complete a paid, more advanced creative strategy test before an offer is made. Application Requirements Please answer the questions below carefully. Generic answers will not be considered. You must also include a Loom video under 5 minutes explaining your experience and walking us through how you think about creative strategy. Application Questions Experience How many years of experience do you have with DTC eCommerce creative strategy? What types of products or industries have you created ad strategies for? Have you worked with Meta ads specifically? Explain your experience with campaign setup, ad launching, and performance monitoring. Creative Strategy Walk us through your process for going from product research to creative angles. What makes a strong Meta ad creative for a DTC eCommerce brand? Share 2–3 examples of creative briefs you have personally created. Include links or screenshots if possible. Research Process What sources do you use when researching customers, competitors, and ad angles? How do you find customer pain points, objections, and buying triggers? Give an example of a time your research led to a winning ad angle. Performance Analysis What metrics do you look at when judging whether an ad creative is working? How do you d ---------- whether to kill, iterate, or scale a creative? Give an example of an ad that failed and what you learned from it. Communication This is a client-facing role. How comfortable are you explaining creative strategy to clients? You MUST include a Loom video under 5 minutes introducing yourself and explaining your creative strategy process. Rate your spoken and written English from 1–10 and briefly explain. Availability & Fit What country and time zone are you located in? Are you available to work some U.S. business hours? What monthly compensation are you looking for in USD? How to Apply DO NOT MESSAGE ME ON ONLINEJOBS.PH YOU MUST submit the following to ---------- portfolio. Examples of creative briefs you have created. Examples of ads you helped strategize. A Loom video under 5 minutes explaining your creative strategy process. Answers to the application questions above.

title: Supply Chain & Inventory Planning Manager
description: We are a fast-growing consumer brand operating across DTC, retail, and wholesale channels. As the business continues to scale, we're looking for a seasoned Supply Chain & Inventory Planning Manager to take strategic ownership of our supply chain, inventory planning, and procurement function. This is not a PO-processing or inventory tracking role. We're looking for a senior operator who can lead with a critical, commercial mindset — someone who has done this before in a CPG or food & beverage environment, knows what good looks like, and doesn't need to be told what to look for. The ideal candidate is highly analytical, exceptional in Excel, and ready to take full ownership of the supply chain function with the ability to grow into a broader operations leadership role over time. Work Structure & Requirements Location: Remote / Virtual Schedule: Part-time initially, with opportunity to grow into full-time Time Zone: Pacific Time Zone Compensation: $10 USD per hour Key Responsibilities 1. Inventory Planning & S&OP Leadership Own key components of the S&OP process end to end — connecting demand forecasts, inventory requirements, production schedules, and purchasing decisions Partner closely with the Growth team to understand demand forecasts and translate these into actionable inventory and raw material requirements Build, maintain, and continuously improve detailed Excel-based inventory planning and forecasting models Monitor inventory levels, lead times, safety stock, and expected demand to proactively identify potential shortages, excess inventory, or production constraints Apply senior-level critical thinking to forecasts and assumptions — proactively challenge numbers where they don't make operational sense Develop a clear view of upcoming production requirements and confidently communicate assumptions, risks, and recommendations to leadership 2. Procurement & Vendor Management Translate production and inventory plans into raw material and ingredient purchase schedules Source and order ingredients, packaging, and other required raw materials Prepare, issue, and manage purchase orders through to delivery Build and maintain strong, professional relationships with suppliers including farms and ingredient producers Lead negotiations on pricing, minimum order quantities, payment/net terms, lead times, and other commercial terms Track inbound materials and shipments, following up proactively to ensure production timelines remain on schedule 3. Financial & Cross-Functional Planning Partner with the Finance team to translate upcoming purchasing requirements into a forecast of expected cash outlays Maintain clear visibility into when cash will be required for ingredients, production, and other inventory-related commitments Work cross-functionally with Growth, Finance, and Operations to ensure demand, purchasing, and financial planning remain tightly aligned Serve as the go-to voice for supply chain decisions — clearly communicating inventory recommendations, assumptions, risks, and upcoming requirements to stakeholders 4. Systems & Operational Leadership Work confidently across Excel and our broader supply chain technology stack, including ERP, 3PL, Shopify, and other operational platforms Lead the effective use and ongoing development of our ERP environment — NetSuite or comparable ERP experience is highly valuable Maintain accurate inventory, purchasing, and supplier records across all relevant systems As the role develops, take broader ownership of omnichannel operations across DTC, retail, wholesale, and distribution Required Skills & Experience Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in supply chain, inventory planning, procurement, and S&OP — ideally within food & beverage or CPG; prior experience in a senior associate, manager, or director-level role is strongly preferred Excel & Modelling: Exceptional Excel and financial/operational modelling skills — this is critical to the role Supply Chain: Deep understanding of the end-to-end CPG supply chain, from raw materials and manufacturing through 3PL/distribution and ultimately DTC and retail channels Analytical: Strong analytical ability with the confidence to interrogate data, challenge assumptions, and make independent recommendations — not just process information ERP: Experience with NetSuite or another leading ERP platform Communication: Excellent written and verbal English communication skills; comfortable presenting recommendations and assumptions clearly to leadership Profile: Senior operator with strong commercial judgment, comfortable owning decisions in a fast-moving entrepreneurial environment, and able to manage multiple moving pieces across vendors, inventory, production, and logistics independently To Apply: Kindly send your resume and introduction video

title: Static Creative Strategist (AI Image Generation) — DTC Menswear Brand
job_title: Static Creative Strategist (AI Image Generation) — DTC Menswear Brand
description: Read this first This is not a "generate images from a prompt" job. We've hired that profile before and it doesn't work for us. We're looking for someone who thinks like a creative strategist and executes like an art director — someone who can look at a market, understand why an ad works, decide what we should make, and then produce it themselves using AI generation. The strategy and the execution are the same job here. If you generate good-looking images but can't explain why an ad converts, this role isn't for you. If you understand direct response but your images look obviously AI-generated, it isn't either. We need both. About us ARES is a men's underwear brand doing high-volume DTC in the US and Worldwide market. We sell silk-blend boxer-briefs on Shopify and Amazon, and we acquire mainly through Meta Ads, Google, and Applovin. Creative is our number one lever — it decides whether we're profitable or not. We produce a lot: ad statics, Instagram content, product page imagery. Almost all of it is AI-generated. That's a deliberate production system, not a shortcut. The standard is simple — the final image has to look like a real photoshoot. If someone can tell it's AI, it failed. What you'll own Ad statics — you research the market, decide the angle, and build the ad. Layout, hierarchy, copy overlay, visual concept. You bring us ideas, we don't hand you a shot list. Instagram content — lifestyle and editorial imagery that reads as shot on set. Product page images — sequential visual storytelling, one narrative beat per image with copy overlay. Not a product gallery. Realism — skin texture, fabric behavior, lighting coherence, hands, faces, logo accuracy. You retouch and composite until the AI tells are gone. Consistency — same product, same colorway, same brand codes across hundreds of images. Our product has precise specs that have to be right every single time. What we need from you On strategy: You understand direct response. Hierarchy, focal point, where the eye lands, why one layout converts and another doesn't. You research competitors and the broader market on your own, and you can defend a creative decision with reasoning instead of taste. You can take a rough business objective ("we need a back-to-school offer") and come back with a concept, not a question. On execution: Deep command of AI image generation — Nano Banana, Midjourney, Flux, Imagen, ComfyUI, whichever you genuinely master. You control the output, you don't roll the dice on it. Structured, repeatable prompting. Retouching and compositing (Photoshop or equivalent). Generation alone will not reach our quality bar — the finishing pass is what makes an image usable. Photographic literacy: lighting setups, lens behavior, depth of field. The people who make AI look real are the ones who understand how a camera actually sees. Volume without quality drop. We work in batches. English communication, reliable turnaround, comfortable working from written briefs. Bonus: apparel or underwear experience, anything where fabric rendering matters. Paid social creative experience. How to apply Answer these questions one by one. Applications that send a general pitch instead of answering will not be reviewed. Ad thinking — Take an ad image you made that performed well. Why did it work? Walk me through what you decided visually and the intent behind each choice. If you have performance data, include it. Strategy from scratch — You're given one line: "we need a static for a back-to-school offer." No further brief. Walk me through how you get from that sentence to a finished ad — your research, your decisions, your reasoning. Realism method — What's your actual process for making an AI image undetectable as AI? Name the specific tells you hunt for and how you fix each one, from generation to final file. Control and consistency — I need the same product, same colorway, same logo, across 100 images. How do you guarantee that? Describe your setup. Failure case — Describe a project where the AI output kept failing on something specific. What was breaking, what did you try, how did you finally solve it? Toolstack and day one — Which tools do you use daily and for what? If you started next week, what would your first two weeks look like? Track record — Which brands or clients have you done this work for? Name them. Send a portfolio with AI-generated work where the AI isn't visible — and if you have before/after (raw generation vs final delivery), send that too. It's what I'm most interested in seeing. Test: We don't hire off a portfolio. Shortlisted candidates get a paid test, and we agree the fee before you start. We're not testing whether you can operate a generator. We're testing whether you can think about an ad and then build it yourself. Read the product section carefully — most of what we reject fails on product accuracy, not on artistic quality. What to deliver 5 images. Format 4:5. Highest resolution you can produce. Few brand asset for this test: ---------- Three are briefed. Two are yours. Image 1 — Outdoor shoot, ancient Greek setting A man wearing the boxer, an elegant woman beside him. Ancient Greek atmosphere — the brand is named after the Greek god of war, so the reference is ours to own. How you interpret that is up to you: stone, light, landscape, styling, era treatment, mood. We want to see your taste and your restraint. It should look like an editorial fashion shoot, not a costume set. Image 2 — Back-to-school sale A sale creative built around the boxers. Back-to-school timing, US market. Our offer structure: Buy 2 Get 2 Free ($59.99) · Buy 3 Get 5 Free ($89.99 — $11 a pair). Two copy rules: never show a percentage discount, and never lead with the single-unit price. Frame the value through the bundle. Image 3 — Professional studio shoot A clean studio image. Pro lighting setup, controlled environment. This is where we judge pure craft — lighting, fabric rendering, product accuracy. Nowhere to hide. On these three: we want them to look genuinely different from each other. Different lighting, different energy, different treatment. Three variations of the same look tells us nothing. Range is what we're measuring. Images 4 and 5 — Two Meta ads (your concept) No brief. This is the real test. Research the market — our category, adjacent DTC brands, what's running on Meta right now. Decide what angle we should be running. Then build two static ads for it. You choose the angle, the layout, the copy, the format. Bring us ads you'd actually put spend behind. Good luck. Richard CEO Ares Underwear ----------

job_title: US Wholesale Business Development Manager – Gifts, Museums & Independent Retail
description: ABOUT A BIT OF ART A Bit of Art is a design-led wholesale brand developed by ARTiSTORY. We transform art, museum collections, literature, and living cultural heritage into distinctive products for retailers and cultural institutions. Our B2B Shopify store is ready, and we are now building our wholesale presence in the United States. We are looking for an experienced US Wholesale Business Development Manager who understands the American retail market and can help us develop long-term relationships with qualified buyers. Visit us at: ---------- THIS IS NOT A GENERAL VA OR BASIC LEAD-GENERATION ROLE We are specifically looking for someone with proven experience selling physical consumer products through US wholesale channels. You should understand how independent retailers and institutional buyers evaluate new products, place opening orders, request samples, negotiate terms, and make reorders. Existing professional relationships with US retailers, buyers, distributors, corporate gift companies, or museum stores are strongly preferred. All relationships must be used professionally and legally. We do not ask candidates to share confidential customer lists or proprietary information belonging to former employers. TARGET CHANNELS - Independent gift and lifestyle stores - Museum and cultural institution gift shops - Bookstores - Design-led and specialty retailers - Home, stationery, art, and cultural product stores - Zoos, botanical gardens, libraries, and visitor attractions - Corporate gifting companies and corporate gift buyers - Selected hospitality and interior retail accounts KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Wholesale Business Development - Introduce A Bit of Art to qualified US retailers and institutional buyers. - Reconnect with relevant professional contacts where appropriate. - Identify and approach new wholesale prospects through email, LinkedIn, telephone, industry directories, and other suitable channels. - Develop warm, personalized outreach rather than generic mass emails. - Understand each retailer's customers and recommend a relevant curated product assortment. - Secure buyer conversations, sample requests, wholesale account applications, opening orders, and reorders. - Conduct buyer calls independently or arrange qualified meetings with the founder. Account and Pipeline Management - Maintain an accurate wholesale pipeline in HubSpot or another CRM. - Record communications, buyer interests, follow-up dates, samples, quotations, orders, and next actions. - Follow up consistently without damaging the brand relationship. - Support buyers through product selection, pricing, MOQ, lead-time, and ordering questions. - Coordinate samples and follow up after delivery. - Help existing wholesale accounts place reorders and discover additional products. - Escalate major negotiations and strategic opportunities to the founder. Market Development - Provide practical feedback on which products, price points, stories, and assortments are most relevant to US retailers. - Identify promising customer segments, regional opportunities, trade associations, and events. - Help refine wholesale sales materials, line sheets, outreach messages, and buyer presentations. - Share competitor and market insights based on actual buyer conversations. REQUIRED EXPERIENCE - At least three years of relevant experience in US wholesale sales, business development, key account management, or retail account development. - Proven experience selling physical consumer products—not only software, real estate, or appointment-setting services. - Experience with gifts, stationery, home decor, lifestyle products, museum products, books, art products, beauty, fashion accessories, corporate gifts, or other design-led consumer goods. - A track record of developing relationships with US retailers or institutional buyers. - Ability to explain measurable past results, such as accounts opened, sales generated, reorders secured, or retailer relationships managed. - Excellent written and spoken English. - Confidence communicating with American buyers by email, video call, and telephone. - Strong commercial judgment, organization, and follow-through. - Availability for agreed overlap with US Eastern business hours. STRONGLY PREFERRED - Existing professional relationships that can legally and appropriately be re-engaged. - Experience with independent retailers, museum stores, gift stores, bookstores, corporate gifting, or visitor attractions. - Experience using Shopify, Faire, HubSpot, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ---------- , or similar tools. - Experience working with an emerging consumer brand. - An appreciation for art, cultural heritage, museums, literature, and design-led products. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE Performance will be measured by meaningful commercial outcomes: - Qualified buyer conversations - Sample and quotation requests - New wholesale account applications - Opening orders and reorders - Quality and accuracy of the sales pipeline - Consistent and professional follow-up - Useful feedback from buyers and the market We are not primarily measuring success by the number of emails sent. SCHEDULE AND COMPENSATION - Part-time: approximately 20 hours per week - Long-term opportunity with potential for increased responsibility - Base compensation: US$800–1,200 per month, depending on relevant experience and proven channel relationships - Additional performance-based commission or bonuses for qualified new accounts, collected opening orders, and successful reorders - At least two to three hours of overlap with US Eastern business hours on agreed working days HOW TO APPLY Begin your application with the word "WHOLESALE2026" so we know you have read the complete job post. Please include: 1. Your CV or resume. 2. A short video introduction explaining your wholesale and US retail experience. 3. The physical-product categories you have represented. 4. The types of US retail or corporate accounts you have developed or managed. 5. Measurable results, such as accounts opened, annual wholesale sales, average order size, reorder rate, or pipeline managed. 6. Whether you have professional retail relationships that could legally and appropriately be re-engaged for a new brand. 7. The sales tools and wholesale platforms you have used. 8. A brief explanation of what you would do during your first 30 days with A Bit of Art. 9. Your expected monthly compensation for 20 hours per week. Please do not send confidential customer lists, private CRM exports, or proprietary information from a current or former employer. Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a brief paid assessment based on A Bit of Art's products and target retail channels. We are looking for a commercially minded relationship builder—not simply someone who sends cold emails. If you understand US wholesale, enjoy discovering distinctive products, and know how to turn buyer interest into long-term accounts, we would like to hear from you.

You will be expected to: * Know the current asking price * Understand approved negotiation ranges * Respond to reasonable offers * Recognize serious buyers * Avoid unnecessarily discounting inventory * Escalate offers that fall outside your approved authority Example: If a card is listed at $500 and an offer falls within an approved range, you may be authorized to continue the negotiation. If an offer falls below the approved range or involves an important card, immediately send the offer to Connor Lyons for a decision. Do not guess. Do not make unauthorized discounts. ⸻ 3. CARD INVENTORY INTAKE A major responsibility will be helping Lyons Cards rapidly load inventory into Card Dealer Pro, our inventory management system. We are intentionally simplifying this process. The goal is: GET THE CARD INTO THE SYSTEM QUICKLY AND ACCURATELY. You may receive batches of card photographs from Connor or another Lyons Cards team member. Example: Connor sends you 20–50 card photographs and basic instructions. You then create/import the batch and make sure those cards are properly entered into inventory. ⸻ 4. TWO PRIMARY INVENTORY BATCHES Inventory will generally begin in two major categories: GRADED / SLABS Examples: * PSA * BGS / Beckett * SGC * Other approved grading companies Important information may include: * Player * Year * Set * Card number * Parallel * Serial number * Grading company * Grade * Certification number * Image * SKU * Physical location * Selling price * Status RAW CARDS Raw cards are cards that have not been professionally graded. Information may include: * Player * Year * Set * Card number * Parallel * Serial number * Image * SKU * Physical location * Selling price * Status We do NOT want unnecessary data entry that slows down the operation. Accuracy and speed are both important. ⸻ 5. INVENTORY STATUS / USE Cards may be assigned different jobs inside the company. Examples: AVAILABLE Normal inventory available to sell. HOLD Do not sell without management approval. REPACK Reserved or considered for Lyons Cards repack products. GRADE Raw card intended for professional grading. REVIEW Management decision required. You must make sure special inventory is not a ---------- sold. ⸻ 6. PRICING SUPPORT Market value — not historical purchase cost — drives our selling decisions. Management will establish pricing using current card-market information and revenue-management principles. You may be given a price directly by Connor or management. Example: Connor sends: Card photos + $349 list price + AVAILABLE Your responsibility is to enter the cards correctly and make sure the correct selling price/status appears in the system. As you develop, you may assist with basic market research and comparable sales. Final pricing authority remains with Lyons Cards management unless otherwise delegated. ⸻ 7. SHOPIFY / E-COMMERCE SUPPORT Card Dealer Pro is the primary inventory system. Shopify / ---------- is the consumer storefront. You may help: * Review products before they go live * Verify images * Verify titles * Verify pricing * Confirm availability * Correct listing errors * Organize collections * Monitor customer inquiries * Identify products that need updated pricing * Ensure sold inventory is properly handled across channels You should become comfortable working inside modern e-commerce software. ⸻ 8. WHATNOT / LIVE-COMMERCE SUPPORT Lyons Cards is building a significant live-commerce business on Whatnot. You may assist with: * Show listings * Product setup * Customer messages * Auction preparation * Post-show order review * Buyer questions * Sales follow-up * Analytics * Inventory reconciliation You will not automatically be responsible for hosting shows. Your job is to help the hosts and management operate efficiently behind the scenes. ⸻ 9. CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE Lyons Cards is built around a simple principle: WE ARE NOT TRYING TO WIN ONE TRANSACTION. WE ARE TRYING TO WIN THE CUSTOMER. We expect: * Fast responses * Professional communication * Honest descriptions * No misleading claims * No aggressive pressure * No unauthorized discounts * Strong follow-up * Respect for collectors * Immediate escalation when something appears wrong Customers should feel that Lyons Cards is organized, responsive and trustworthy. ⸻ 10. SOFTWARE / SYSTEMS You should be comfortable learning and using systems such as: * Card Dealer Pro * Shopify * Whatnot Seller Hub * eBay * Google Sheets * Google Drive * Email * Messaging platforms * Basic image/file management * Marketplace dashboards Training will be provided on Lyons Cards-specific processes. You must be comfortable learning technology quickly. ⸻ REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS * C2 / near-native English proficiency — REQUIRED * Excellent written communication * Strong attention to detail * Fast computer skills * Comfortable working with large numbers of images/files * Strong organizational ability * Reliable internet connection * Ability to follow pricing/negotiation rules * Strong judgment * Ability to work independently * Ability to recognize when management approval is required * Comfortable learning new software * Reliable and responsive * Commercial/sales mindset ⸻ PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Experience with any of the following is a major advantage: * Sports cards * Trading cards * Whatnot * eBay * Shopify * Online selling * Marketplace customer service * Sales negotiation * Inventory management * PSA/BGS/SGC cards * Sports knowledge * E-commerce * Live commerce Sports-card expertise is preferred but not mandatory if you are highly intelligent, commercially minded and able to learn quickly. ⸻ IMPORTANT PERSONALITY TRAITS We want someone who is: * Fast * Accurate * Resourceful * Commercially minded * Calm under pressure * Detail-oriented * Comfortable asking questions * Not afraid to make decisions within established authority * Able to recognize when NOT to make a decision * Interested in becoming an important member of a growing company We do not want someone who simply waits for instructions all day. ⸻ HOW SUCCESS WILL BE MEASURED This role will eventually be measured on things such as: * Response time * Customer inquiries handled * Sales conversions * Offers converted into sales * Inventory entered per hour * Listing accuracy * Inventory errors * Pricing/listing errors * Customer satisfaction * Speed of inventory activation * Marketplace follow-up * Revenue supported The ultimate goal is: GET INVENTORY ACTIVE → GET IT IN FRONT OF CUSTOMERS → HELP TURN IT INTO REVENUE. ⸻ WORKING WITH MANAGEMENT You will work closely with: Connor Lyons Owner / Operator / Product & Card Lead Connor will provide card/product knowledge, pricing guidance and decisions on offers requiring approval. You will also work with Lyons Cards management, operations, social-media and website personnel. Clear communication is critical. When escalating something, do not simply say: “Customer has a question.” Instead say: Card: [exact card] Listed Price: $___ Customer Offer: $___ Relevant information: ___ Decision Needed: Accept / Counter / Decline Management should be able to understand the situation immediately. ⸻ GROWTH OPPORTUNITY This role is being created while Lyons Cards is building its operating platform. A strong performer may grow into responsibility for: * Marketplace sales * E-commerce management * Inventory operations * Pricing support * Sales management * Customer service leadership * Live-commerce administration * Marketplace analytics * Team supervision We want someone who can grow with the business. ⸻ HOW TO APPLY Please include: 1. What would you do, and what would you send to Connor? 9. Begin your application with the words: BUILT FOR COLLECTORS Applications that do not follow the instructions may not be reviewed. ⸻ LYONS CARDS LLC Sports Cards • Breaks • Repacks • Collectibles Family-Owned • Live from St. Louis Built for Collectors.

title: Financial Controller with Ecommerce Experience
description: About the Role We are building an in-house finance function with an offshore team based in the Philippines and are seeking an experienced Financial Controller to lead the finance function remotely. This is a pivotal role responsible for overseeing all aspects of financial management, reporting, budgeting, cashflow, and strategic financial analysis, as well as directly managing the company Bookkeeper. The successful candidate will work closely with the Directors in Sydney to drive financial performance and support business growth, with hours aligned to Australian Eastern Time. This is a hands-on role ideal for someone with strong Xero skills, solid accounting fundamentals, and experience in Australian businesses operating globally. Key Responsibilities Team Management • Directly manage and mentor the in-house Bookkeeper, providing day-to-day guidance and oversight • Review and approve work prepared by the Bookkeeper including reconciliations, payroll, AP batches, and Cin7 Omni updates • Set priorities, manage workload, and ensure all finance team deadlines are consistently met • Support the onboarding and ongoing development of the Bookkeeper Financial Reporting & Analysis • Prepare and deliver monthly management accounts including qualitative commentary and analysis • Manage and maintain the Fathom reporting platform showing variances between actual results versus budget and last year and produce insightful financial dashboards • Conduct balance sheet reconciliations on a monthly basis, including but not limited to, PayPal, Shopify, Stripe and Afterpay clearing and receivable accounts and Cin-7 detailed inventory ledger with inventory control account in Xero. • Oversee quality control between the inventory system and the accounting system • Liaise with external accountants for year-end compliance and tax return preparation Budgeting & Forecasting • Prepare the annual budget (simple version) based on prior year actuals with applied growth rates • Monitor, maintain, and roll forward the budget on a quarterly basis, replacing completed months’ results with actual results • Analyse variances between actual results and budget, and provide insights and recommendations • Prepare and manage the operational cashflow, aligning cash inflows and forecast outflows Accounts Payable & Payroll Oversight • Oversee accounts payable processes including bill entry, aged payables reporting, and batch payment preparation (ABA files) • Manage the AP system (e.g. Hubdoc, Lightyear) and ensure data integrity • Prepare and approve fortnightly payroll processing and superannuation obligations • Manage STP (Single Touch Payroll) fortnightly lodgements and year-end finalisation • Coordinate annual Workers Compensation renewal and annual wages declaration Systems & Compliance • Manage Xero including integrations with all bank accounts, Cin7 Omni and payment gateway systems • Oversee syncing between Cin7 Omni and Xero regularly to identify any errors and resolve discrepancies promptly • Ensure compliance with GST, BAS, IAS, Payroll tax and other statutory obligations (in coordination with external tax agent) • Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial records and documentation Key Requirements • CPA or CA qualified (or working towards) • Minimum 5 years’ experience in a Financial Controller or senior accounting role • Experience supporting Australian businesses (understanding of GST, BAS, STP, and superannuation obligations) • Strong Xero experience is essential - Xero certification highly regarded • Proficiency with reporting tools such as Fathom with the ability to build and modify financial reports, as required • Demonstrated experience working with consumer products and e-commerce businesses is essential • Demonstrated experience working within a global business with foreign currency reporting and FX transactions as well as the ability to consolidate results of multiple entities • Hands-on experience with inventory management systems; experience with Cin7 Omni is highly desirable • Strong understanding of Australian payroll legislation and STP obligations • Advanced Excel and financial modelling skills • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal • Reliable internet connection and a suitable home office setup • High attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities independently • Prior experience in effectively managing and overseeing performance of all direct reports What We Offer • Competitive salary package commensurate with experience • Full-time, stable remote role with an established Australian business • Opportunity to build and lead the in-house finance function from the ground up • Direct exposure to business strategy and senior leadership • Collaborative and supportive team environment • Work-from-home flexibility with consistent Australian business hours

title: E-Commerce Growth & Operations Specialist
description: Shopify + Klaviyo + CRO + Customer Acquisition Work Setup: 100% Remote (Work from Home) Position Type: Independent Contractor / Growth Partner Hours: Flexible | Approx. 10–12 focused hours per week Compensation: $400 USD Monthly Retainer + 5% Uncapped Performance Commission About Maison Mnandi Africa Maison Mnandi Africa is a growing African lifestyle and e-commerce brand celebrating authentic African craftsmanship, heritage and contemporary living. We curate distinctive artisan-made fashion, accessories and home décor from across the continent, connecting traditional craftsmanship with the modern global customer. Our Shopify store and brand foundation are established. We are now looking for a commercially minded, hands-on E-Commerce Growth & Operations Specialist to help us move into our next stage: increasing qualified traffic, improving conversion and building consistent monthly sales. The Role You will work directly with the founder to improve the commercial performance of our Shopify store. Your role will span Shopify optimisation, conversion rate optimisation (CRO), Klaviyo email marketing, SEO and customer acquisition support. This is not simply a website-maintenance position. Your objective is to help us understand and continuously improve the complete customer journey: Qualified Traffic → Product Discovery → Add to Cart → Purchase → Repeat Customer We are looking for someone who is proactive, analytical and comfortable taking ownership rather than waiting for a task list every week. Key Responsibilities 1. Shopify & Conversion Optimisation Continuously improve the Shopify storefront to increase conversion and create a smooth, premium shopping experience. Responsibilities include: * Improve product and collection pages for conversion. * Optimise site layout, navigation and mobile shopping experience. * Improve calls-to-action, product merchandising and trust signals. * Identify and reduce friction in the customer journey. * Organise sold-out products and inventory displays. * Implement and optimise Back in Stock notifications. * Improve cross-selling, upselling and product recommendations. * Review customer behaviour and identify opportunities to improve conversion rate and AOV. * Maintain the premium visual presentation of the Maison Mnandi Africa brand. 2. Klaviyo Email Marketing & Retention Build and manage our email marketing system to convert visitors and encourage repeat purchases. Set up and continuously optimise key automated flows, including: * Welcome Series * Browse Abandonment * Abandoned Cart * Checkout Abandonment * Post-Purchase * Review Request * Customer Win-Back * Back in Stock You will also: * Create and optimise email capture forms/popups. * Segment customers based on behaviour and purchase activity. * Plan and send relevant promotional/editorial campaigns. * Monitor email revenue, conversion and engagement. * Test subject lines, offers, timing and content to improve performance. 3. SEO & Organic Customer Acquisition Help build sustainable organic traffic with genuine purchasing intent. Responsibilities include: * Keyword and search-intent research. * Optimising product and collection titles, descriptions and metadata. * Improving internal linking and on-page SEO. * Identifying high-value organic search opportunities. * Supporting SEO-led editorial/blog content. * Optimising product descriptions for both search visibility and luxury brand storytelling. Our goal is not simply more website visitors. We want relevant visitors who are genuinely interested in purchasing our products. 4. Traffic & Sales Growth Help develop and execute customer acquisition strategies across relevant channels, including: * Pinterest * Meta / Instagram / Facebook * Google * Organic search * Retargeting * Email Identify which products, collections, audiences and campaigns have the strongest potential to attract purchasing customers. Where paid advertising is used, campaigns should begin with controlled testing and scale based on results rather than simply increasing spend. 5. Analytics & Growth Reporting Track the commercial health of the store and use data to determine what should be improved next. Monitor key metrics including: * Conversion Rate * Add-to-Cart Rate * Average Order Value (AOV) * Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) * Revenue * Email Revenue * Returning Customer Rate * ROAS / MER where applicable Provide a concise weekly update covering: What happened → Why it happened → What we learned → What we are doing next. Requirements * 3+ years of hands-on Shopify/e-commerce experience. * Strong practical experience with Klaviyo, including flows, forms, segmentation and campaigns. * Strong understanding of e-commerce conversion optimisation and online buyer behaviour. * Working knowledge of SEO and organic customer acquisition. * Experience with digital acquisition channels such as Meta, Google and/or Pinterest. * Strong analytical skills and ability to interpret e-commerce performance data. * Excellent written English for product descriptions, landing pages and email copy. * Strong attention to detail. * Ability to work independently and consistently meet agreed deadlines. * Comfortable working in a small, growing business where initiative is highly valued. Experience with fashion, accessories, home décor, artisan products or premium/luxury e-commerce is an advantage. Compensation & Growth Opportunity Monthly Retainer $400 USD per month Approximately 10–12 focused hours per week, with flexible working hours. Performance Commission 5% uncapped performance commission on qualifying sales revenue, subject to agreed attribution and commission terms. As the store grows, your earning potential grows with it. Growth Opportunity This position is intended to develop into a long-term growth partnership. Strong performance and increasing store revenue can lead to: * Increased monthly retainer * Expanded responsibilities * Increased working hours * Long-term leadership of e-commerce growth We want someone who can grow with the business, rather than simply complete isolated tasks. How to Apply Please begin your application title/headline with: MNANDI Applications without this will not be prioritised. Then provide: 1. Portfolio / Results Share links to 2–3 Shopify stores you have personally worked on. Where possible, briefly explain what you were responsible for and provide measurable results from Shopify, CRO, Klaviyo, SEO or customer acquisition work. 2. Quick Store Assessment Visit ---------- . In no more than 3–5 sentences, tell us: What are the TWO things you would investigate or change first to help Maison Mnandi Africa generate more sales — and why? We are not looking for a full free audit. We want to understand how you think. 3. Klaviyo Experience Briefly describe one Klaviyo setup you have personally built or improved and the result it achieved. 4. Your Skill Level Rate yourself from 1–5 in each area: Shopify | CRO | Klaviyo | SEO | Meta Ads | Google Ads | Pinterest | GA4 5. Resume / Profile Provide an up-to-date resume, LinkedIn profile or professional profile showing your relevant experience. ⸻ One Final Question A Shopify store has attractive products and is receiving visitors, but very few people are purchasing. What would you investigate before recommending that the business spend more money on advertising? Keep your answer concise. We are looking for someone who understands that sustainable e-commerce growth isn’t about generating the most traffic. It’s about attracting the right customers — and giving them compelling reasons to buy.

title: Executive Assistant / Project Coordinator to Founder | Organization + AI + Marketing | Work From Home
job_title: Executive Assistant / Project Coordinator to Founder | Organization + AI + Marketing | Work From Home
description: Full-Time Remote | Philippines | Starting at ₱40,000/Month | U.S. Eastern Time Hours | Permanent Work From Home About the Role I'm an entrepreneur managing several online businesses, and I'm looking for a highly organized, intelligent, and resourceful Executive Assistant / Project Coordinator to work directly alongside me full-time. This is not a traditional Executive Assistant position focused mainly on calendar management, travel booking, or basic administrative work. The most important part of this role is organization, follow-through, and keeping multiple priorities moving at the same time. I have several businesses, projects, meetings, advertising accounts, ideas, deadlines, and tasks moving at once. I need someone who genuinely enjoys bringing order to that environment, keeping track of details, following up on loose ends, making sure nothing falls through the cracks, and helping me stay focused on what needs to happen next. This is not an entry-level Virtual Assistant position. You must already have professional experience working as an Executive Assistant or Executive Virtual Assistant and understand the fundamentals of supporting a founder, CEO, entrepreneur, or senior executive. I will teach you my businesses, advertising, reporting systems, processes, and how I use AI. I am not expecting you to already know everything. What I care about most is finding someone who is extremely organized, smart, proactive, reliable, resourceful, communicates well, learns quickly, and wants to grow into a much larger role over time. Required Experience Prior Executive Assistant experience is required. You must have: At least 1 year of professional experience working as an Executive Assistant, Executive Virtual Assistant, or in a very similar role. Experience directly supporting a founder, CEO, entrepreneur, business owner, or senior executive. Experience managing multiple tasks, deadlines, follow-ups, and priorities. Strong written and spoken English. Experience using task-management, project-management, calendar, or collaboration tools. Experience working independently and communicating directly with an executive. 2+ years of Executive Assistant experience is preferred, particularly if you have supported an entrepreneur, founder, agency owner, or executive managing multiple projects or businesses. What You'll Primarily Do Executive Organization & Task Management This is the most important part of the job. You will help make sure my priorities, tasks, deadlines, follow-ups, and open projects are organized and visible. Responsibilities include: Maintain and continuously update my master task list in Notion. Capture tasks from messages, meetings, voice notes, screenshots, and conversations. Keep priorities, deadlines, statuses, next steps, and open items organized. Maintain your own task list and keep me updated on what you are working on. Help prepare a short daily list of what needs my attention. Make sure important deadlines, commitments, and follow-ups are not forgotten. Join a short daily call with me to review priorities and outstanding work. Keep Google Calendar updated when meetings, deadlines, or important commitments need to be reflected there. Flag anything that is blocked, overdue, missing information, or requires my input. Provide a short end-of-day update covering what was completed, what remains open, and what should happen next. The goal is simple: Important things should not disappear because I forgot to follow up on them. Project Coordination You will also help keep projects moving across several different businesses. This may include: Track projects, owners, deadlines, statuses, and next actions. Follow up on assigned work and make sure projects continue moving. Keep project documentation current. Identify missing information or blockers preventing something from being completed. Organize information so I can quickly understand what is happening without digging through messages and documents. Keep track of several unrelated projects without losing context. Make sure action items from meetings make their way into our task system. Help turn rough ideas into organized next steps. Follow up with me or other team members when something important is still outstanding. I will provide direction and context. Your job is to help turn that direction into organized execution. Meetings, Research & Documentation A lot of important information comes through meetings, calls, messages, and conversations. You may: Review meeting transcripts and AI-generated notes. Extract decisions, action items, owners, deadlines, and important follow-ups. Update Notion after meetings. Prepare concise meeting summaries. Keep important documentation organized and easy to find. Research clearly assigned business questions, competitors, products, software, or other topics. Compare options and summarize your findings. Marketing & Paid Advertising Exposure I work heavily in digital marketing, e-commerce, and paid advertising. Because of that, this role will gradually get exposure to: Google Ads Meta Ads E-commerce Shopify Landing pages Marketing analytics Advertising creative Performance marketing Conversion optimization Prior media-buying experience is not required. Flag unusual changes or potential problems for me to investigate. Maintain a log of important advertising changes. Help organize marketing projects and creative work. If you are interested, analytical, and learn quickly, there will be opportunities to learn much more about media buying and performance marketing over time. AI, ChatGPT & Claude AI will be an important part of how we work. You should be comfortable with technology and preferably already have some experience using tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar AI tools. You do not need to be an AI expert. I can teach you how I use AI. What matters more is that you are curious, willing to experiment, and interested in becoming very good at using these tools. You may use AI to help: Research unfamiliar topics. Organize messy information. Analyze information and reports. Summarize meetings and documents. Draft emails and written communication. Create first drafts of LinkedIn posts, newsletters, and other marketing content. Improve processes and workflows. Turn rough notes or ideas into organized work. Learn unfamiliar topics faster. I do not want someone who blindly copies and pastes whatever ChatGPT produces. You should be willing to think, review the output, fact-check important details, improve weak answers, and make sure the final work actually solves the assignment. The Person I'm Looking For This section matters more to me than having the perfect résumé. Extremely Organized You naturally create structure. You keep track of deadlines, details, follow-ups, next steps, and unfinished work without needing someone to constantly remind you. You should genuinely enjoy keeping things organized. Intelligent and a Fast Learner You can learn unfamiliar software, businesses, processes, and concepts quickly. You do not need every new task explained five different times before you understand it. Resourceful When you do not know how to do something, your first instinct should be: "Let me look into this and see if I can figure it out." You research, use the tools available to you, make a reasonable attempt, and then ask intelligent questions if you are still blocked. Proactive You do not need to be told every tiny next step. If something obvious needs to happen, you notice it. If an important deadline is approaching, I should not have to be the person reminding you about it. Detail-Oriented You notice missing information, inconsistencies, errors, unfinished tasks, and things that do not make sense. Excellent at Managing Multiple Priorities You can move between several businesses and unrelated projects during the same day while still knowing where everything stands. Strong Communicator Excellent written and spoken English is important. You should be able to take complicated information and communicate it clearly and concisely. Reliable and Responsive If you say something will be completed, I should be able to trust that it will be completed or that you will tell me immediately if something is preventing it. Comfortable Working Closely With a Founder You should be comfortable with frequent communication, changing priorities, rough ideas, and occasionally receiving incomplete instructions. You should be able to create structure from that information rather than becoming overwhelmed by it. Curious You should be genuinely interested in learning about business, AI, digital marketing, e-commerce, systems, and entrepreneurship. Comfortable With Feedback You will receive feedback, especially while learning how I work. I want someone who uses feedback to improve quickly. Strong Plus, But Not Required Experience with any of the following would make you a stronger candidate: 2+ years of Executive Assistant experience. Experience supporting an entrepreneur or founder. Project Coordinator or Operations Coordinator experience. Digital marketing agency experience. E-commerce experience. Google Ads or Meta Ads exposure. Shopify. Notion. Google Sheets. Google Workspace. Slack. ChatGPT. Claude. Marketing reporting or analytics. You do not need all of these. I care much more about having a strong Executive Assistant foundation and the right personality than checking every technical box. What Working With Me Will Be Like You will work directly with me and communicate with me frequently throughout the day. There will be more communication at the beginning while you learn the businesses, my priorities, and how I work. You should be comfortable receiving information through: Messages Calls Voice notes Screenshots Documents Spreadsheets Meeting transcripts Sometimes my instructions may begin as a rough idea rather than a perfectly organized assignment. Part of becoming excellent at this role will be learning how to take that messy information and turn it into organized action. I do not want to micromanage someone forever. The goal is for you to gradually learn how I work, become more independent, and take increasing responsibility off my plate. Growth Opportunity I'm looking for someone who wants a long-term opportunity, not simply another temporary VA job. For the right person, this role can grow significantly. Depending on your interests and abilities, you may gradually learn and take on more responsibility involving: Paid advertising Marketing analytics E-commerce AI workflows Content creation Business operations Process improvement Project ownership Reporting and analysis Systems and automation Someone who becomes highly valuable, reliable, and increasingly independent can grow into a much larger role with significantly greater responsibility. Compensation can grow with that responsibility and demonstrated value. Compensation Starting compensation: ₱40,000 PHP per month, full-time. This is a starting point, not necessarily a hard maximum. There is also meaningful opportunity for compensation growth over time as you become more capable and take on additional responsibility. Schedule Full-time, 40 hours per week. This position requires reliable working-hour overlap with U.S. Eastern Time. Please only apply if you are genuinely comfortable consistently maintaining this schedule. How to Apply Please submit: Your résumé. A short written introduction explaining why you think you would be a strong fit for this specific role. A 3 to 5 minute Loom or video introduction answering the following questions: Tell me briefly about yourself and your recent Executive Assistant experience. Who have you directly supported in the past, and what were your main responsibilities? How do you personally keep track of many tasks, deadlines, follow-ups, and projects at the same time? Give me an example of something important that could have fallen through the cracks, but you caught it or followed up on it. Give me an example of something you had to learn quickly without already knowing how to do it. How do you currently use ChatGPT, Claude, or other AI tools? Have you had any exposure to digital marketing, paid advertising, e-commerce, or working with an entrepreneur? If yes, tell me about it. This experience is not required. Please speak naturally. Do not read an AI-generated script. I care much more about seeing how you naturally communicate and think than receiving a perfectly polished answer.
