title: E-Commerce Growth & Merchandising Strategist – Part-Time to Full-Time
job_title: E-Commerce Growth & Merchandising Strategist – Part-Time to Full-Time
description: E-Commerce Growth & Merchandising Strategist – Part-Time to Full-Time Esszett Luxury is a German e-commerce company specializing in furniture, lighting, home accessories, plants and lifestyle products. We are currently building our own long-term in-house e-commerce and marketing team and are looking for an experienced E-Commerce Growth & Merchandising Strategist. This is a strategic and commercially focused role. We are not looking for someone who only manages one marketing channel. We are looking for someone who understands the complete e-commerce business, studies our full product catalogue, develops marketing strategies and gives clear direction to our internal specialists. Your goal will be to help us build a structured, data-driven and profitable e-commerce marketing system. Your Main Responsibility You will be responsible for understanding our complete e-commerce business and translating this knowledge into clear growth initiatives. You should continuously analyze: * Our complete product catalogue * Brands * Product categories * Product prices * Product margins * Bestsellers * Slow-moving products * New products * Seasonal products * Product availability * Conversion rates * Average order values * Google Ads performance * Customer behavior * Competitors * Market trends You should know which products have the highest potential and determine how they should be presented, marketed and prioritized. You Must Know Our Product Catalogue A very important part of this position is becoming deeply familiar with our products. We do not want a strategist who only looks at dashboards. You should actively study our catalogue and understand: * Which brands are important to us * Which categories have growth potential * Which products have strong margins * Which products sell well organically * Which products perform well through advertising * Which products should receive more visibility * Which products should be bundled or cross-sold * Which products are suitable for seasonal campaigns * Which products need better product pages * Which products should potentially be excluded from advertising Over time, we expect you to develop a very strong understanding of the Esszett catalogue and use this knowledge when making marketing decisions. Marketing Strategy You will create and continuously improve our overall e-commerce marketing strategy. This includes: * Monthly marketing planning * Quarterly growth planning * Annual marketing calendar * Seasonal campaigns * Promotional campaigns * Product launches * Category campaigns * Brand campaigns * Funnel planning * Merchandising strategy * Landing-page strategy * Upselling and cross-selling concepts * Campaign analysis * Competitor analysis * Growth opportunities * Testing priorities We want to move away from simply running advertising campaigns and instead build a structured marketing system. Seasonal & Promotional Planning You should plan campaigns well in advance. Examples include: * Spring * Easter * Mother’s Day * Summer * Outdoor and garden season * Autumn * Lighting season * Black Week * Christmas * New Year * Other commercially relevant periods For every major campaign, you should define: * Which products and categories should be promoted * Which products have sufficient margin * Which offer or promotion makes commercial sense * Which landing pages are required * Which product pages need improvement * Which creatives are required * Which advertising campaigns should be created * Which upsells and cross-sells should be used * Which KPIs will define success CRO & Shopify Strategy You will work closely with our Shopify CRO & UX Specialist. You are not expected to personally code every Shopify change. However, you should actively identify what needs to be improved and give the CRO Specialist clear priorities and tasks. For example: You analyze one of our important product categories and determine that the product pages need: * A stronger USP section * Better delivery information * More prominent trust elements * Improved mobile layout * Product bundles * Better cross-selling * A sticky Add-to-Cart button * Better product comparison * Improved product information * Better image hierarchy * Improved navigation * A dedicated landing page You should then create a clear briefing for our CRO Specialist explaining: * What should be changed * Why it should be changed * Which products or pages are affected * What the expected impact is * How success should be measured The Shopify CRO & UX Specialist will then design and technically implement the changes in Shopify. You will review the results together and d ---------- what should be tested or improved next. Example Workflow You identify that one of our lighting brands has strong margins and good demand but weak conversion. You analyze the complete customer journey. You then create clear tasks: Product Listing Team * Improve missing product information * Update product attributes * Improve category structure Creative Designer * Create new USP graphics * Produce new campaign assets * Create comparison or benefit graphics Shopify CRO Specialist * Redesign the product-page information hierarchy * Improve mobile Add-to-Cart experience * Implement trust elements * Build a cross-selling section * Create a dedicated collection landing page Google Ads & Shopping Specialist * Create a dedicated campaign structure * Adjust product segmentation * Increase budget for profitable products * Exclude low-margin or poor-performing products You coordinate the overall strategy and measure whether the changes improve profitable revenue. Funnel & Customer Journey Strategy You should understand the complete customer journey: Traffic → Landing Page → Collection → Product Page → Cart → Checkout → Purchase → Repeat Purchase You should identify friction throughout this journey and continuously develop improvement ideas. You should understand: * Paid traffic funnels * Product-page funnels * Collection funnels * Landing pages * Cart optimization * Upselling * Cross-selling * Bundles * Retargeting * Customer retention * Average order value optimization Internal Team You will work closely with: E-Commerce Team Lead Responsible for internal coordination and task management. Product Listing Team Responsible for product information, listings, tags, categories and product data. Creative Designer Responsible for product images, USP graphics, banners and advertising creatives. Google Ads & Shopping Specialist Responsible for Google Ads, Shopping, Performance Max, Merchant Center and product feeds. Shopify CRO & UX Specialist Responsible for Shopify implementation, CRO, UX, product pages, landing pages and technical store improvements. Your role is to connect these specialists through a clear commercial and marketing strategy. Important Difference Between Your Role and Our Team Lead Our E-Commerce Team Lead manages the internal team and coordinates operational tasks. Your responsibility is the marketing and growth strategy. You determine what should be prioritized from a commercial and marketing perspective. The Team Lead helps ensure that the work is organized and completed. What We Are Looking For You should ideally have experience with: * E-commerce growth strategy * E-commerce merchandising * Shopify * Large product catalogues * Conversion Rate Optimization * Customer journey optimization * Funnel strategy * Google Ads * Paid advertising * Product profitability * Campaign planning * Seasonal marketing * Promotional strategy * Landing pages * Product-page optimization * Upselling * Cross-selling * A/B testing * Analytics Experience with furniture, lighting, home & living, interior or lifestyle e-commerce would be a major advantage. Commercial Thinking Is Essential We are not looking for someone who only focuses on revenue. You should understand: * Product margins * Contribution margin * Advertising costs * CAC * ROAS * Conversion rate * Average order value * Profitability * Inventory * Repeat purchases Your decisions should always answer the question: How can Esszett generate more profitable revenue? German / European Market Experience with German or European e-commerce businesses is highly preferred. Experience with the DACH market — Germany, Austria and Switzerland — would be a major advantage. Working Model We would like to start this position as part-time. Initially: Approximately 10–20 hours per week If the cooperation is successful, your strategies deliver good results and the workload increases, we are very open to developing this into a full-time long-term position. Our goal is to find someone who wants to grow together with Esszett and eventually take significant responsibility for our e-commerce growth strategy. * Remote * Monday to Friday * Long-term cooperation * Initially part-time * Opportunity to grow into a full-time position How to Apply If you are interested, please contact: ---------- Please include: * Your CV * Your previous e-commerce experience * Examples of e-commerce stores or brands you have worked with * Your experience with Shopify * Your experience with large product catalogues * Your experience with growth strategy * Your experience with CRO and customer journeys * Examples of seasonal or promotional campaigns you planned * Your experience with paid marketing * Your expected hourly rate * Your availability Please also answer the following question: Imagine you become responsible for the growth strategy of Esszett, a German furniture, lighting and lifestyle Shopify store with a large product catalogue. How would you spend your first 90 days understanding the catalogue, identifying growth opportunities and d ---------- which tasks should be assigned to the CRO Specialist, Google Ads Specialist, Creative Designer and Product Team? We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Marketing Associate
description: ABOUT IDL IDL is building the first global professional dance league. Our first season brings together six pro teams, live events, major content moments, ticket on-sales, team announcements, and ecommerce drops for fans who want to support the league and represent their teams. We are looking for a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to build and run the email and SMS engine that connects all of those moments. This role is for someone who is strong at lifecycle marketing execution: campaign calendars, segmentation, email/SMS builds, automated flows, QA, reporting, and weekly optimization. Ecommerce products are part of the business, so you will support merch and product campaigns through lifecycle marketing. You do not need to own Shopify store operations. ABOUT THE ROLE You will own IDL's lifecycle marketing program across the full fan journey. That means planning and executing campaigns around content drops, roster and team announcements, ticket on-sales, event reminders, merch drops, post-event follow-up, and fan re-engagement. You will build the flows, segments, QA process, and reporting rhythm that make email and SMS a reliable channel for fan engagement and revenue. This is a build role, not a maintenance role. IDL has a full season calendar and a growing audience, but the lifecycle program is still early. The right person will turn a busy marketing calendar into clear, well-timed, well-targeted fan communication. What you'll own: *Lifecycle campaign calendar - Build and maintain the email/SMS calendar across IDL's season. - Translate marketing, content, ticketing, event, and ecommerce priorities into clear lifecycle campaigns. - Plan send timing, audience segments, message sequence, and channel mix for each major moment. - Coordinate with internal stakeholders so campaigns have the copy, creative, links, offers, and approvals they need before launch. - Flag conflicts, gaps, and missing inputs early instead of waiting until the send date. *Email and SMS campaign execution - Build, schedule, QA, and launch email campaigns. - Build, schedule, QA, and launch SMS campaigns where appropriate. - Write or adapt clear lifecycle copy from provided campaign direction. - Personalize campaigns by fan behavior, city, ticketing status, team affinity, ecommerce behavior, and engagement level. - QA every campaign before launch: links, tracking, discounts or offer logic, audience rules, send time, rendering, and mobile readability. *Lifecycle flows and automations - Build and improve the core lifecycle flows, including: - Welcome and onboarding - Event city interest - Ticket interest and ticket purchase follow-up - Event reminder sequence - Post-event recap and re-engagement - Merch drop awareness and post-purchase follow-up - Browse abandon, cart abandon, back-in-stock, and win-back where supported by the tools - Monitor flow health and recommend improvements based on performance. - Keep flows current as IDL's season, teams, events, and product calendar evolve. *Segmentation and list health - Build and maintain useful audience segments across the fan base. - Segment by ticket buyers, event attendees, city interest, team affinity, merch buyers, SMS subscribers, engaged non-purchasers, and lapsed fans. - Improve list growth, opt-in capture, engagement, deliverability, and unsubscribe health. - Make sure sends are targeted and useful, not generic blasts. *Ecommerce lifecycle support - Support lifecycle campaigns for IDL merch and product drops. - Build email/SMS sequences for launches, back-in-stock moments, limited-time offers, team product pushes, and post-purchase engagement. - Partner with the ecommerce or merch owner on campaign inputs such as product details, offer logic, inventory constraints, and launch timing. - Report on lifecycle contribution to ecommerce revenue, conversion, repeat purchase, and sell-through where data is available. This role does not need to own Shopify product setup, PDP maintenance, inventory updates, theme edits, checkout QA, or fulfillment operations. Reporting and optimization Deliver a weekly lifecycle report with the key numbers and the recommended next actions. Track campaign performance, flow performance, list growth, SMS opt-ins, deliverability, unsubscribe rates, revenue contribution, ticketing contribution, and ecommerce contribution. Identify what worked, what did not, and what should change next. Run practical tests around subject lines, send timing, segmentation, offers, and lifecycle sequencing. WHAT YOU BRING: *Must have - 3+ years of hands-on lifecycle, CRM, email, SMS, or retention marketing experience. - Direct experience building campaigns and flows in Klaviyo or a comparable ESP/SMS platform. - Strong campaign calendar discipline across multiple launches, events, or business priorities. - Experience with segmentation, automation, QA, campaign reporting, and performance recommendations. - Comfortable supporting ecommerce marketing campaigns, especially product drops, limited-time offers, post-purchase flows, or abandoned-cart flows. - Strong written English and clean async communication. - Detail-oriented QA mindset. You catch broken links, wrong segments, missing tracking, bad timing, and unclear copy before customers do. - Able to work US hours from the Philippines, with meaningful overlap with US Pacific Time. *Nice to have - Experience with sports, entertainment, live events, creators, communities, apparel, merch, or fan-driven brands. - Experience with ticketing, event reminders, attendance-driving campaigns, or post-event re-engagement. - SMS compliance familiarity, including consent, STOP/HELP language, quiet hours, and double opt-in where needed. - Basic ecommerce analytics experience across revenue, conversion, AOV, repeat purchase, and sell-through. - Basic HTML/CSS for email cleanup. - Working style You are a strong fit if you: - Like turning messy calendars into clear campaign plans. - Are comfortable asking for missing inputs early. - Can operate with direction but do not need daily hand-holding. - Think in segments, timing, journeys, and QA checklists. - Care about whether fans receive the right message at the right time. - Can move fast without being sloppy. - Know when to make a recommendation instead of only reporting numbers. You are probably not a fit if you: Only want strategy and do not want to build campaigns yourself. Need someone else to define every step before you can act. Think lifecycle marketing means sending the same newsletter to everyone. Are looking for a pure ecommerce operations role. Are not available for US-hour overlap. FIRST 90 DAYS: By the end of the first 90 days, you will have: - Mapped IDL's season calendar into a lifecycle campaign calendar. - Audited current email/SMS lists, segments, flows, forms, and reporting. - Launched or improved the core flows: welcome, event interest, ticket purchase follow-up, event reminder, post-event re-engagement, merch drop support, abandoned cart, and post-purchase. - Created a repeatable campaign QA process. - Built a weekly lifecycle reporting format. - Launched lifecycle campaigns for at least one major content moment, ticketing moment, event moment, and ecommerce product moment. - Recommended the next highest-impact lifecycle improvements based on performance data. LOGISTICS Location: Philippines-based remote contractor Schedule: US hours required, with core overlap during US Pacific business hours Engagement: Full-time contractor Compensation: [Insert monthly range] Start date: [Insert target start date] Tools: Klaviyo or comparable ESP/SMS platform, Shopify data as needed, Google Workspace, Slack, Asana, analytics/reporting tools as available HOW TO APPLY: Please send: Your resume or LinkedIn profile. A 1 minute intro loom video A short note on the most relevant lifecycle program you have run. The ESP/SMS tools you have used hands-on. Examples of flows or campaigns you have built, with sensitive information removed. One example of a lifecycle metric you improved and what you changed to improve it. Your availability for US Pacific Time overlap.

job_title: E-Commerce Virtual Assistant – Poshmark Store Operations
description: We are looking for a reliable and experienced E-Commerce Virtual Assistant to help with the daily operation of multiple Poshmark stores. This is a long-term position for someone who already has experience working with e-commerce platforms such as Poshmark, eBay, Shopify, Mercari, Amazon, Etsy, or similar online marketplaces. title: Finance Manager / Accounting Manager
description: Facelove is a fast-growing DTC beauty brand in the US. About the Role: You'll own Facelove's finances: the close, the cash, the numbers everyone else makes decisions from. This is a hands-on role, not a supervisory one. You'll do the reconciliations, build the models, and run the payment cycles yourself, while working alongside our external Dutch accountants on statutory filings. You'll report directly to the founder and COO. The person who succeeds here is comfortable being the only finance person in the building. You'll set up the systems, then run them. What you'll own Full monthly close on a fixed calendar, with a close you can stand behind Bank, payment processor and intercompany reconciliations Chart of accounts, accrual policy, and the discipline to keep both clean as we scale Documentation and audit trail good enough that a new person could pick it up 13-week rolling cash forecast, with paid media and inventory as the two variables that matter Weekly cash position and runway, and early warning when something is drifting Working capital: inventory purchase timing, supplier terms, processor payout cycles Annual budget and quarterly reforecast, built with the founders and then held to Unit economics and margin reporting Contribution margin by channel, product and cohort, not just top-line P&L The finance side of CAC, MER, AOV, LTV and payback, in partnership with paid media Landed cost per unit and true gross margin, including freight, duties and 3PL fees Calling out where we're losing money before it shows up in a quarterly number Inventory accounting across manufacturing, freight and 3PL COGS accuracy, standard cost maintenance, and variance analysis Inventory reconciliation against 3PL reporting, including shrinkage and damages Flagging stock and cash risk on reorders early enough to act on Revenue recognition across Shopify and all payment methods Processor reconciliation: fees, holds, reserves, payout timing Refunds, chargebacks and disputes, tracked as a cost line with an owner Subscription and repeat revenue reporting, if and as we build it Monthly payment runs for a contractor-heavy team across multiple countries and currencies Contractor documentation and compliance records, kept current rather than reconstructed Accounts payable, vendor terms, and the discipline to pay correctly and on time Working with HR on payroll verification, so hours, invoices and payments actually agree Dutch statutory obligations for ODAQ B.V., managed with our external accountants VAT filings and multi-currency treatment US sales tax nexus and registrations as our footprint expands Keeping us clean in every market we sell in, and telling us before a threshold becomes a problem A monthly reporting pack a founder can read in ten minutes and trust A weekly one-page view of cash, spend and margin Ad hoc analysis that answers the question asked, with the assumptions visible Skills Required: 5+ years in accounting or finance, with at least 2 in ecommerce, DTC or consumer products You have owned a monthly close yourself, not contributed to someone else's Inventory and COGS accounting experience, including landed cost Multi-currency and multi-entity experience, comfortable with FX and intercompany Strong modelling ability in Excel or Google Sheets. You build the model, you don't just maintain someone else's tab Fluency with Shopify or a comparable ecommerce platform, payment processors, and a cloud accounting system (Xero, QuickBooks, Exact or similar) You can explain a variance to a non-finance founder without jargon and without hedging Excellent written English, and the judgement to escalate things in writing before they become urgent Strong plus Experience with a Netherlands-registered entity, or comfort working with Dutch statutory requirements and external accountants US sales tax nexus and multi-state registration experience Beauty, skincare or supplements High paid-media environments, where ad spend is the largest line and reconciles across four platforms 3PL and inventory planning exposure CPA, ACCA, CIMA, CMA or local equivalent You've been the first finance hire somewhere and built the function from a messy starting point What we offer - Real ownership of the most important function in the business, with a direct line to the founders - Remote-first, async-friendly, results-measured - A brand with genuine product-market fit and room to scale CLICK THE LINK TO APPLY: ---------- ==

title: PayPal & Shopify Dispute Manager
description: About us We're a growing direct-to-consumer footwear brand selling in the US market. We run a lean operation and take customer experience seriously — which means when a dispute lands, we want it handled fast, professionally, and with a strong chance of winning. What we're looking for We need an experienced dispute specialist who knows PayPal's resolution process and Shopify's chargeback flow inside and out — someone who has handled chargebacks and "Item Not Received" / "Item Not as Described" claims repeatedly and knows exactly what evidence to submit, how to frame responses, and how to maximize win rates. This is not a role for someone learning on the job. We want a proven operator. What you'll do -Respond to and manage PayPal disputes -Handle credit card chargebacks submitted directly through Shopify Payments -Gather and submit the right evidence (tracking info, order details, correspondence) in a compelling, structured way -Keep us informed of case status and outcome -Flag any patterns you notice (e.g. a spike in a certain dispute type) Volume & commitment Current volume is around 5 disputes/month, growing as we scale. This is an on-call arrangement — we are not looking for a fixed weekly commitment. We're open to hearing your preferred rate structure (per dispute, hourly, or monthly retainer) in your proposal. You're a great fit if you: -Have handled PayPal disputes and Shopify credit card chargebacks for DTC eCommerce brands -Can show a concrete win rate or track record (please include this in your proposal) -Understand PayPal's Seller Protection policies and Shopify's chargeback response process -Are responsive — disputes have deadlines and we move fast How to apply To filter out generic applications, your proposal must include both of the following: -Describe a dispute you won that initially looked difficult. What was the claim type, what evidence did you use, and what was the outcome? -Attach screenshots or documentation showing disputes you have handled — this can be anonymized win/loss records, a dispute dashboard, resolved case summaries, or similar. Proposals without proof of work will not be considered.

title: Virtual Executive Assistant
description: I'm the founder of a digital growth marketing company that helps mission-driven founders scale their businesses with more ease & less overwhelm - and I'm looking for a small team of highly-skilled Executive Assistants to help take over the marketing and management tasks that make a huge difference in the lives of the people that hire us. If you have the following skill sets, I encourage you to apply: REQUIRED EXPERIENCE: - Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in Digital Marketing, Video Editing, Social Media Management, Content Creation, and Executive Assistant Work (Administrative Tasks, Calendar & Email Management, etc) You’re trusted to manage marketing deliverables while providing high-level executive support, keeping priorities organized, systems moving, and leadership focused on growth instead of day-to-day execution. You've done it all from managing schedules to email & calendar management. You have a meticulous eye for detail where Prioritization and Organization are your love language - 1+ years of experience in Sales Funnels and Shopify You're a professional who is passionate about helping changemakers simplify their lives by setting up systems that will allow them to operate their businesses with more ease and less overwhelm. You have experience with sales funnel and CRM software - 1+ years of experience advertising on platforms like Instagram, Facebook, Tik Tok, within a Marketing team consisting of Paid Acquisition, Organic Marketing, Customer Retention, & Product Marketing You're an emerging leader who has the potential to head a team in the future that will report directly to you. Having leadership experience is a MAJOR plus - Creating SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) You’ll ensure each business function has detailed documentation for repeatable and scalable growth if it isn't already place. If you see gaps, you take the initiative to fill them and produce results without anyone knowing there was an issue (yea, all that and a bag of chips :-) - Experience working at a digital/online product/platform: You’re familiar with online courses, digital products & platforms and popular tools in the business space ranging from landing page builders and email service providers to CRMs, and course hosting platforms aren’t foreign to you (We teach tools like Shopify, Convertkit, Kajabi, Teachable, Learnworlds, Calendly, etc) ABOUT YOU: - “You down with SOP? Yeah you know me!”—You’re an advocate for SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) to make our systems repeatable & scalable. - Your love language is processes & predictable, meteoric growth. We never question company progress towards the quarterly and yearly goals because you keep real-time metrics for all projects. - You’re aware of new software and can look at current systems and identify how to automate tasks a company has been doing manually for months. - You’re addicted to digital processes & automation in the world of social media because you love building connections in the digital space and you’ve seen how powerful it can be in business growth - You’re driven by metrics & tracking. You know that you can’t improve something unless you measure it, so you develop ways to measure performance so your company is always predictably improving. - Timeliness and deadlines are your jam. When we have a team call at 10:00am, you show up at 9:55am. When the deadline is Tuesday at 5:30pm, you have it done Monday. - You overcommunicate clearly and confidently. If you agree/disagree with something, you communicate that without hesitation or overthinking. You’re no stranger to asking why we do things a certain way to ensure we’re intentional with our resources. - You’re a leader and team player. Ego? What ego? If something needs to be done, you dive in to make sure all critical tasks are accounted and cared for. If you’re nodding your head “Yes” to the above, proceed below to apply. PERKS: I'm committed to setting our staff up for success with access to trainings that will certify your skills in: - Task & Calendar Management - Launch/Sales Strategy Planning - Sales Funnel Tech Setup (For E-Commerce or Service Based Businesses) - Social Media Management - Digital Media Marketing (Including Email and SMS Marketing) - Lead Generation After one week of training and assessment, you're officially certified under our internal training program, which means hitting the ground running with your new skills. Perks include: - Part time work hours - Work from anywhere in the world (as long as your internet signal is strong and computer is fast) - Starting Salary at $400-$500 USD a month ($4800-$6000 USD annual) - Internal certification program to enhance your professional skills in your career (I have helped clients amass at least $10M from the same digital growth marketing strategies I will require you to learn) Interested? Please reply to this post with the secret keyword "APPLES" so I know you can pay attention to detail - from there, I'll let you know next steps if you qualify.

title: Bookkeeper for Canadian E-Commerce Brand
description: ABOUT US We're a Canadian DTC tea brand and sell through our Shopify store. We ship to the US and Canada from warehouses in both countries. We're a startup and currently mid-six figures in annual revenue and growing. We transact in both USD and CAD, with most sales in USD. We want to transition from an automated bookkeeping tool (Finaloop) to QuickBooks Online and looking for a detail-oriented bookkeeper to own our books going forward. We're looking for someone who wants to build a long-term relationship and grow with us - not a short-term gig. THE SCOPE Phase One: Catchup & Cleanup (First 1-2 Months) You'll start by reconciling and cleaning up our books for the current year so far. This includes setting up a clean chart of accounts in QuickBooks Online, importing historical transactions, and getting everything reconciled and audit-ready. Phase Two: Ongoing Monthly Management Once the books are clean, this transitions into a long-term monthly role covering everything below. RESPONSIBILITIES Transaction Management - Categorize and reconcile all bank and credit card transactions in QuickBooks Online - Reconcile Shopify payouts against actual orders and refunds - Reconcile multi-currency accounts (USD + CAD) - you must ensure the bank balance in QBO matches the statement exactly, including handling exchange rate differences - Match and track Meta (Facebook/Instagram) ad spend invoices against bank withdrawals - Process and track expenses - supplier invoices, 3PL fees, freight, customs charges, software subscriptions - Ensure every transaction has proper supporting documentation Canadian Tax Compliance - Prepare and file quarterly GST/HST returns - Match receipts and invoices to maximize input tax credits (ITCs) - Track provincial sales tax obligations - Track US sales tax exposure (we use Shopify's auto-tax, but you'll verify) Monthly Reporting - Prepare monthly Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow statements - Flag anomalies, unusual charges, or budget variances - Provide financial clarity to founders - not just numbers, but what they mean Inventory & COGS - Track landed costs (product cost + ocean freight + customs duties + warehousing) - Maintain accurate COGS records aligned with inventory movements - Reconcile inventory valuation quarterly Expense Tracking - Track recurring software costs - Track supplier invoices, 3PL fees, freight, and customs charges - Ensure all expenses are properly categorized and documented Year-End - Prepare working papers and schedules for our CPA/accountant - Support annual corporate tax return preparation - Prepare any required slips REQUIRED TECH STACK (Do Not Apply Without This Experience) - QuickBooks Online - Expert level. This is non-negotiable. - Multi-Currency Banking - We operate in USD and CAD. You must have experience reconciling multi-currency accounts and handling exchange rates so the bank balance in QBO matches the statement to the penny. - Shopify - Experience reconciling Shopify payouts to QBO. - Google Sheets - Comfortable with ad-hoc reports and collaboration. REQUIREMENTS Must Have: - 3+ years of bookkeeping experience using QuickBooks Online - Experience with Canadian GST/HST filing and input tax credits - Experience with e-commerce businesses (Shopify strongly preferred) - Experience reconciling multi-currency accounts (USD + CAD) - Strong attention to detail - we have zero tolerance for sloppy entries - Fluent in English with strong written communication Nice to Have: - Experience with DTC or subscription-based businesses - Experience with inventory accounting and landed cost tracking - Previous experience transitioning a company from another system onto QuickBooks HOURS & COMPENSATION - Part-time to start - most likely 10-20 hours a month as we're still a small business, but expect it to grow as we scale - Schedule: Flexible, but must have overlap with Pacific Time for communication - Rate: $5–$10 USD/hour depending on experience - Long-term: We want someone who grows with us. This is not a one-off project. WHAT THIS ROLE IS - A key financial support role for a growing e-commerce brand - Someone who brings order, accuracy, and visibility to our finances WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT - Not basic data entry - Not a once-a-month check-in - Not suitable for someone who needs constant direction HOW TO APPLY We ignore generic cover letters. To show us you've read this posting and have the attention to detail we need, please follow these steps: **Step 1:** Start your message with the word TEA. **Step 2:** In your message, answer the following questions: **Question A:** We use multi-currency banking (USD and CAD). How do you handle the exchange rate difference in QBO when reconciling a multi-currency account to ensure the bank balance matches the statement? **Question B:** We receive Shopify payouts approximately 3 times per week. Each payout bundles sales, refunds, fees, and adjustments. How would you reconcile these in QBO? Walk us through your approach. **Question C:** What is your experience with Canadian GST/HST input tax credits? Give us a specific example of how you've maximized ITCs for a previous client. **Question D:** We track our true landed COGS (product cost + inbound freight + duties + 3PL) in a separate inventory system that produces a monthly COGS figure. In QuickBooks Online, walk us through exactly how you'd record COGS each month so our P&L and balance sheet stay accurate. Be specific about which accounts you'd use and what entries you'd make. **Step 3:** Include the following: - A short intro about yourself and your bookkeeping experience - Your experience with e-commerce / Shopify businesses specifically - Your expected monthly rate in PHP - Your available hours and timezone - Your QuickBooks Online proficiency self-rating (1-10) Applications that do not answer the screening questions will not be considered. We value accuracy, initiative, and clear communication.

Then pinpoint where it's leaking: where leads get lost, where data is missing or duplicated, whether tags and fields are applied correctly, whether each lead enters the right workflow, whether the sales team can see the next required action, and whether conversions can be attributed to the correct source and campaign. 2. Build dashboards management can d ---------- from. Clear, self-serve dashboards across five areas: Lead acquisition — volume by day/week/month, source/channel/campaign/ad, cost per lead where ad data exists, Become a Stockist applications, lead quality by source, and duplicate/incomplete/invalid leads. Wholesale pipeline — new applications, awaiting review, approved vs declined, approved-but-not-ordered, lead-to-approval and approval-to-first-order conversion, average time to first order, revenue by acquisition source, and repeat/reactivation performance. Sales activity — calls made, contact rate, follow-ups completed vs overdue, lead response time, appointments booked, stage conversion, conversion by salesperson, lost-lead reasons, and revenue influenced by follow-up. Automations & welcome flows — contacts entering each workflow, email/SMS delivery, opens/clicks, replies, unsubscribes, first orders generated, revenue influenced, conversion by message and by workflow, and drop-off points. Distributor pipeline — prospects by country/territory, current stage, last contact and next action, estimated value, samples/proposals sent, negotiation status, expected decision date, won/lost with reasons, conversion by country and stage, and revenue from active distributors. 4. Rebuild segmentation. Applications that do not follow the instructions at the end will not be considered. About the Role We are an established pet supplies e-commerce company looking for a hands-on E-Commerce Operations Manager to own and grow our Shopify store. This is not primarily a delegation or team-coordination role. You will personally manage the day-to-day store, analyze performance, improve conversion, create campaigns and content, handle customer inquiries, maintain inventory accuracy, and continuously look for ways to increase revenue and profitability. You will report to the General Manager and work with a small remote team, including a Graphic Designer and external marketing partners. Key Responsibilities: 1. Shopify & E-Commerce Growth * Own the day-to-day management of our Shopify store. * Manage products, collections, merchandising, pricing, inventory, promotions, apps, and website content. * Monitor and improve revenue, conversion rate, AOV, engagement, and other key e-commerce metrics. * Identify CRO opportunities and improve product pages, navigation, landing pages, offers, and onsite messaging. * Recommend promotions and other initiatives to grow profitable sales. * Proactively identify and fix website issues rather than waiting for them to be assigned. 2. Email, Content & SEO * Plan, write, build, and schedule email/newsletter campaigns. * Write and improve product descriptions, landing pages, collection copy, and promotional content. * Perform keyword research and on-page SEO. * Create, refresh, and fact-check AI-assisted blog content. * Develop enough product knowledge to create accurate content and confidently research information when needed. 3. Analytics & Reporting * Analyze Shopify and GA4 performance and explain why results are changing. * Maintain a weekly e-commerce performance scorecard. * To confirm that you read the entire listing, include your favorite cartoon cat in the first sentence of your cover letter. * Prepare basic profitability reports covering revenue, COGS, shipping, ad spend, discounts, and other major expenses. * Understand Google Ads reporting well enough to evaluate paid traffic and collaborate with our advertising agency. * Turn data into specific recommendations and actions. 4. Customer Service & Operations * Personally handle our relatively low volume of customer inquiries. * Process orders with dropshipping suppliers according to existing SOPs. * Ensure orders are sent accurately and on time. * Maintain accurate inventory availability and pricing. * Follow through on issues until they are actually resolved. This Is a Hands-On Role Although this is a manager-level position, we are a small company and expect this person to be comfortable doing the work, not simply delegating it. If a newsletter needs to be built, you should be able to build it. If an image needs a simple resize, you should be able to resize it. If product copy needs improvement, you should be able to rewrite it. If an app isn't working, you should investigate the problem and look for a solution or workaround. Routine execution is part of this role. What We're Looking For: * 5+ years of relevant e-commerce experience preferred, with meaningful hands-on Shopify experience. * Demonstrated experience improving e-commerce sales or conversion - not just maintaining a website. * Strong understanding of Shopify, CRO, merchandising, and e-commerce best practices. * Experience with GA4 and e-commerce reporting. * Experience with Klaviyo or similar email marketing platforms. * Working knowledge of Google Merchant Center and Google Ads reporting. * Experience with SEO and tools such as Ahrefs, Semrush, or similar. * Strong copywriting and editing skills. * Comfortable calculating basic store profitability. * Basic Liquid/HTML/CSS knowledge is a plus, but development expertise is not required. * Excellent written and spoken English. We want someone who is proactive, analytical, resourceful, trustworthy, detail-oriented, and highly accountable. We value people who find solutions rather than simply report blockers. We also expect honesty and ownership when something goes wrong. Mistakes can happen; concealing or misrepresenting them is unacceptable. How Success Will Be Measured: You will have meaningful ownership of Shopify performance, including: * Revenue growth * Conversion rate * AOV and website engagement * Email/promotional performance * Inventory and order accuracy * Profitability and reporting * Successful execution of CRO and website improvements You will participate in a weekly e-commerce meeting and should be able to explain what happened, why it happened, what you're doing about it, and what you recommend next. Work Arrangement & Benefits: * Full-time, 40+ hours/week on a fixed U.S. Eastern Time schedule. * Remote position for candidates based in the Philippines. * Exclusive professional commitment required; side jobs/freelancing are not permitted. * Productivity tracking with periodic screenshots is required. * Performance-based bonuses and 13th-month pay. * Unlimited PTO upon regularization. How to Apply: Please send your resume and a short cover letter. In your cover letter, briefly describe one specific improvement you personally made to a Shopify/e-commerce store that produced a measurable result. Tell us the problem, what you personally did, and the result. Selected candidates will go through an interview, a short practical exercise, and professional reference checks.

title: Dispute & Chargeback Prevention Manager
description: # Dispute & Chargeback Prevention Manager **Salary:** $5/hour **Employment Type:** Full-time **Role:** Remote ## About the Role We are looking for an experienced **Dispute & Chargeback Prevention Manager** to take full ownership of customer disputes, PayPal claims, credit card chargebacks, and backend payment-risk operations across our eCommerce stores. This is a hands-on role for someone who understands how **PayPal disputes, credit card chargebacks, and payment processor disputes** work and knows how to prevent disputes before they happen, resolve customer issues proactively, and build strong evidence packages when a dispute or chargeback is filed. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and experienced in managing disputes from start to finish. ## Key Responsibilities ### Chargeback & Dispute Prevention * Monitor orders and customer issues that could potentially result in disputes or chargebacks. * Identify high-risk or problematic orders before they escalate. * Proactively communicate with customers to resolve delivery, product, refund, or service issues. * Work closely with customer support and operations to resolve complaints before customers contact PayPal or their bank. * Maintain accurate records of refunds, replacements, tracking information, customer communications, and resolutions. * Identify recurring reasons for disputes and recommend improvements to reduce future chargebacks. ### PayPal Dispute Management * Manage **PayPal disputes, claims, and escalations** from start to finish. * Investigate each case and determine the appropriate response. * Prepare strong and well-organized evidence packages. * Submit dispute responses within PayPal's deadlines. * Track open cases, deadlines, responses, and outcomes. * Analyze successful and unsuccessful cases to continuously improve the dispute process. ### Credit Card Chargeback Management * Manage **credit card disputes and chargebacks** filed through banks and card networks. * Investigate chargeback reason codes and determine why the customer disputed the transaction. * Collect and organize supporting evidence, including: * Order details * Customer communications * Shipping and tracking information * Delivery confirmation * Product information * Refund/replacement records * Payment information * Checkout/order information * Relevant terms and policies * Prepare clear, accurate, and compelling chargeback responses. * Submit responses within processor deadlines. * Monitor chargeback outcomes and maintain detailed records of wins and losses. * Identify recurring chargeback reasons and recommend preventive measures. ### Backend Dispute Operations * Maintain a centralized **dispute and chargeback tracking system**. * Track every case, including: * Customer * Order number * Dispute/chargeback reason * Amount * Payment method * Deadline * Evidence submitted * Current status * Outcome * Make sure no dispute deadline is missed. * Coordinate with customer support, fulfillment, suppliers, and management when additional information is required. * Escalate serious, unusual, or high-value cases to management. * Maintain accurate documentation for every customer/payment issue. * Prepare regular reports showing dispute volume, chargeback rate, win rate, losses, and common dispute reasons. ## What We Are Looking For * **Strong previous experience managing PayPal disputes and credit card chargebacks.** * Practical understanding of how payment disputes and chargebacks work. * Experience preparing evidence and successfully winning disputes. * Experience with PayPal and other payment processors. * Experience handling **credit card chargebacks/disputes through payment processors or merchant platforms**. * Strong understanding of chargeback reason codes and evidence requirements. * Proven ability to prevent customer complaints from becoming chargebacks. * Excellent organizational and documentation skills. * Extremely strong attention to detail. * Ability to manage a large number of cases without missing deadlines. * Comfortable working with Shopify, Google Sheets, customer support platforms, payment processors, and eCommerce tools. * Strong written English. * Ability to investigate problems independently and make practical decisions. * Experience with eCommerce, dropshipping, or online retail is highly preferred. ## What Makes a Great Candidate We are **not looking for someone who simply responds to chargebacks after they happen.** We want someone who understands the complete process: **Identify the problem → Contact the customer → Resolve the issue → Prevent the dispute → If a dispute occurs, investigate it → Build the evidence → Submit the response → Track the outcome → Learn from the case.** The ideal candidate should think proactively about **reducing chargebacks**, while also maximizing the chances of winning legitimate disputes that have already been filed. ## Compensation **$5/hour** The position may grow into a larger operational role based on performance, organization, dispute win rates, and measurable improvements in chargeback prevention. ## How to Apply Please include the following in your application: 1. Your previous experience with **PayPal disputes**. 2. Your previous experience with **credit card chargebacks**. 3. Which payment processors/platforms you have worked with. 4. Your experience with chargeback prevention. 5. Your experience preparing dispute evidence. 6. The types of eCommerce businesses/stores you have worked with. 7. Your previous role and responsibilities. 8. Your availability and time zone. 9. Your experience using Shopify, Google Sheets, payment processors, or customer support platforms. **Candidates with proven PayPal and credit card chargeback experience will receive priority.**

We're not asking you to start from scratch or fix a mess. What we need is someone to own the day-to-day: watch the numbers, cut what's wasting money, scale what's working, and keep the product feed clean. Alongside that, we'll be running brand campaigns that won't be judged on last-click ROAS — you'd help us run and measure those properly. Roughly 15 hours a week. We've set it there because that's honestly what the work needs right now. If you get in and find the account justifies more — or if we grow and it does — we're happy to increase your hours and your pay to match. We'd rather start realistic and grow it than promise you a full week and quietly shrink it. This is not low-ticket ecommerce, and we're being upfront about that If your experience is mostly dropshipping or £20–50 products, this will be frustrating for both of us. Here, conversion volume is low, smart bidding is under-fed, a single sale is worth more than a hundred cheap ones, and discount-and-urgency tactics actively damage trust with a nervous buyer. We need someone who's worked in that world and understands why it's different. What you'd own Google Ads — Search, Performance Max and Shopping. Weekly search-term mining, negative keyword lists, budget pacing, bid strategy adjustments, new ad copy variants. Meta Ads — campaign and ad set management, audience testing, creative rotation, pausing fatigued ads, scaling the winners. Brand campaigns — running upper-funnel activity and measuring it honestly, on the right metrics rather than on last-click ROAS. Google Merchant Centre — feed health, product disapprovals, attribute fixes. Keeping Shopping actually eligible to serve. Reporting — one short weekly report. Spend, CPA, ROAS, what changed, what you'd do next. Written in plain English, not a dashboard screenshot. What you would NOT own Setting or changing overall budgets — Matt does that Designing creative (you'd flag what's needed, we produce it) Website, email, SEO, or customer service Strategy and pricing decisions Required 3+ years running live Google Ads and Meta accounts — hands in the account, not reading reports someone else built Real high-ticket experience. You've run paid media for products or services at £500+ per sale, with a considered purchase cycle. Tell us which brands and what the price points were. Brand campaign experience. You've run upper-funnel or brand activity and can explain how you measured whether it worked without falling back on last-click ROAS. Managed at least £5,000/month in spend and can tell us specifically what you did with it Comfortable in Google Merchant Centre and product feeds for an ecommerce store Can look at a search terms report and immediately see the waste Clear written English — you can explain a decision without hiding behind jargon Work independently. We brief weekly, not hourly. Nice to have Shopify ecommerce experience UK or European market experience Premium, craft, design or homeware brands specifically Any interest in pottery, ceramics or making things (genuinely — it shows in the work) Portfolio — please include this We want to see actual work, not a list of skills. Include whatever you can share: Named companies or brands you've run paid media for, with the price point of what they sold and roughly how long you were there Screenshots of real account performance you were responsible for — blur the client name if you're under NDA, but show us the numbers and tell us what you changed A brand campaign you ran — what the objective was, what you did, and how you knew whether it worked Links to anything public: case studies, ads still running, a LinkedIn profile If you're under NDA and can't name clients, say so and describe the business type and price point instead. We'd much rather have an honest "premium furniture brand, £800–2,000 AOV, can't name them" than a vague claim we can't check. What we offer $700 USD/month, paid on time, every month ₱2,000/month rice allowance on top 13th month bonus Salary review at 12 months Room to grow. If the account needs more of your time, we'll add hours and pay for them Long-term role. We want someone who's still here in three years, not a three-month contractor Direct access to the founder. Your recommendations get read and acted on Hours 15 hours a week to start, roughly 3 hours a day Monday to Friday. We'd like 2 of those hours to overlap with UK working hours (around 4–7pm Philippine time) so we can talk when we need to. The rest is yours to schedule. If the role grows into more hours we'll discuss it openly and pay accordingly — but we won't quietly expand the job without changing the money. How to apply Please start your application with the word KILN so we know you've read this properly. Then answer these five questions and include your portfolio. Short answers are fine — we'd rather have five honest paragraphs than a long CV. Which companies have you run paid media for, what did they sell, and at what price point? Name them if you can. What's the highest-value single product or service you've run ads for, and what was the typical time between someone first seeing an ad and buying? Our wheels are £1,499 and people take weeks to d ---------- . We get about 33 purchases a month across £5,300 of Meta spend, plus 269 leads at £20 each. What would you do differently here compared with a £40 product, and why? Describe a brand campaign you've run. What was the goal, and how did you know whether it worked? Which hours would you work, in Philippine time — and how many hours a week are you realistically available for if the role grows? Applications that don't start with KILN, or that skip questions 3 and 4, won't be read.

title: Funnel Builder (Funnelish / Shopify Experience Required)
description: We are seeking a skilled Funnel Builder to join our team full-time. Cloned assets are what gets a store hit with a takedown.

title: Media Buyer, Paid Social
description: NOTE: Please do not apply if you primarily have lead generation experience. About Lucyd Lucyd is a performance marketing and growth agency helping ambitious wellness brands scale through acquisition, retention, creative strategy, and conversion optimization. We specialize in building scalable growth systems for brands operating in policy-constrained wellness, including hemp, cannabis, telehealth (including GLP-1s and research peptides), supplements, and functional wellness products. We are more than an agency executing individual services. We operate as integrated growth partners embedded in our clients’ businesses, helping them solve challenges across the entire customer journey—from customer acquisition and retention to creative, websites, and conversion optimization. Our team moves quickly, communicates transparently, and operates with a high level of ownership and accountability. We care deeply about outcomes, strategic thinking, operational excellence, and long-term client partnerships. --- Why This Role Exists The Media Buyer, Paid Social is responsible for bringing growth strategies to life through exceptional execution on Meta. Working closely with a Growth Strategist, you’ll build, launch, optimize, and scale paid social campaigns that drive profitable growth for our clients. You’ll combine strong platform expertise with analytical thinking to make informed optimization decisions, uncover opportunities through data, and continuously improve campaign performance. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys executing at a high level, thrives in fast-paced environments, and takes pride in operational excellence. --- Working in Complex Advertising Environments Lucyd specializes in helping brands grow in industries where advertising is rarely straightforward. Many of our clients operate in highly regulated or policy-constrained categories, including hemp-derived cannabinoids, cannabis-adjacent products, telehealth services, GLP-1s, peptides, supplements, and functional wellness products. Success in these industries requires more than platform expertise. It requires curiosity, adaptability, strategic thinking, and a willingness to challenge conventional approaches while operating within evolving platform policies. We are looking for someone who enjoys solving complex advertising challenges and can consistently find innovative ways to help clients scale responsibly. --- What You’ll Own Campaign Execution & Optimization - Build, launch, manage, and optimize Meta advertising campaigns across a portfolio of DTC ecommerce clients. - Execute testing plans across audiences, creatives, placements, budgets, and campaign structures. - Monitor campaign performance daily and make data-driven optimization decisions that improve efficiency and profitability. - Manage campaign budgets and pacing while maintaining alignment with client performance goals. - Troubleshoot campaign delivery issues, tracking discrepancies, and platform-related challenges. Performance Analysis - Analyze campaign performance using Meta Ads Manager and supporting analytics platforms. - Identify trends across creative, messaging, audiences, offers, and funnel performance. - Understand *why* creative is succeeding or underperforming, using performance data to generate actionable insights. - Monitor key performance metrics including MER, aMER, CAC, bCAC, CPA, CPM, and other leading indicators. - Prepare performance updates and reporting for internal stakeholders and client-facing meetings. Cross-Functional Collaboration - Partner closely with Growth Strategists to execute paid media strategies across assigned accounts. - Collaborate with Creative teams by providing data-backed recommendations for new concepts, messaging angles, hooks, offers, and creative testing opportunities. - Contribute ideas during creative strategy discussions while helping ensure creative testing aligns with account priorities. - Communicate proactively with internal teams regarding campaign performance, blockers, and opportunities. - Participate in client calls as needed and communicate confidently in written client updates. --- What Success Looks Like Successful Media Buyers consistently: - Execute campaigns accurately, efficiently, and with exceptional attention to detail. - Achieve client MER, aMER, CAC and bCAC goals through disciplined optimization and testing. - Move quickly while maintaining a high standard of quality. - Communicate proactively and collaborate effectively across teams. - Complete work reliably, follow established processes, and demonstrate strong operational excellence. - Use data to identify opportunities, solve problems, and improve performance over time. --- What You Bring to the Table Required - 3+ years of experience managing Meta advertising for DTC ecommerce brands. - Agency experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously. - Experience managing six-figure monthly Meta advertising budgets. - Strong understanding of Meta Ads Manager, campaign structure, audience strategy, and optimization best practices. - Experience working with Shopify and/or WooCommerce ecommerce brands. - Ability to analyze creative performance and identify the drivers behind winning and losing campaigns. - Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign data and make informed optimization decisions. - Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail. - Strong written communication skills and comfort participating in client meetings when needed. - Experience working successfully in a remote environment. - Ability to manage competing priorities while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines. Preferred - Experience working with third-party attribution platforms such as Triple Whale, Northbeam, Hyros, or similar. - Experience advertising within policy-constrained wellness industries, including hemp, cannabis, telehealth (GLP-1s, peptides), supplements, and functional wellness. - Experience managing campaigns on TikTok, X, or Snapchat. - Familiarity with GA4 and ecommerce analytics. - Experience collaborating closely with creative teams on performance marketing initiatives. --- Who Thrives at Lucyd Successful Paid Social Media Buyers at Lucyd are proactive, detail-oriented operators who enjoy turning strategy into execution. They are analytical, adaptable, and naturally curious about what drives performance. They communicate clearly, take ownership of their work, and move quickly without sacrificing quality. They thrive in collaborative environments, enjoy solving complex problems with data, and embrace continuous learning as advertising platforms evolve.

description: ABOUT US We are an established Amazon seller running multiple private-label brands across the US, UK, CA and Australia marketplaces, plus our own Shopify brand stores. One job, stated plainly: take a product and turn it into a listing that sells. Copy, keywords, the full image gallery, A+ and Premium A+, and increasingly video - and we expect you to produce all of it yourself using AI, not to brief it out to a designer and wait a week. That combination is the whole role. If you can write Amazon copy but cannot make images, this is not for you. If you can make beautiful images but cannot write copy that ranks, this is not for you either. We are looking for the person who does both, because AI now makes that possible and we would rather hire one person who owns the whole listing than three who each own a slice. We start part-time (20 hrs/week) and move you to full-time once you have proven yourself. WHAT YOU WILL DO Create and optimize Amazon listings, end to end: Research - Teardown of top-ranking competitor ASINs: titles, bullets, images, review themes, price positioning - Keyword research with Helium 10 / Cerebro / Magnet, built into a prioritized keyword map - Read the sales and PPC data and work out WHY a listing is underperforming, not just report that it is Copy - SEO-optimized titles, bullets, descriptions and backend search terms that follow Amazon's style guide AND read like a human wrote them - Create the listing in Seller Central from scratch, flat file or manual, including attributes and variations - Know what you are not allowed to claim. Several of our categories are health and beauty adjacent, and compliant copy is not optional Visuals - made by you, with AI - The full 7-image gallery: main image, lifestyle, infographic, feature callouts, size/scale, comparison, packaging - A+ Content and Premium A+ (Super A+) modules - layout, copy and imagery - Product video, increasingly. AI video tools are getting good enough and we want someone who is already experimenting - Real fluency expected with Nano Banana / Gemini, GPT-Image, Midjourney, Photoshop generative fill, Canva. Give us a white-background product photo and you should come back with a complete, on-brand gallery - no freelancer, no week-long wait - Where AI genuinely cannot do it, brief and manage a freelancer. We fund that WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR Must have: - 2+ years hands-on Amazon listing creation (tell us how many listings you have personally created) - Excellent written English - near-native. Your copy goes in front of US buyers, so this is non-negotiable - Working knowledge of Amazon SEO / A9: indexing, keyword placement, relevancy, backend terms - Practical experience with Helium 10 or Jungle Scout - Demonstrable AI image creation for listings. This is the one we will push hardest on - be ready to show work and explain exactly how you got it - Ability to analyse a data export and reach a conclusion, not just describe it - Reliable internet, own computer, able to overlap a few hours with Australian business hours Nice to have - genuinely optional, do not skip applying if you lack these: - AI video generation and editing (Sora, Veo, Runway, CapCut, Premiere) - A strong self-teaching habit, especially on AI. If you have used Claude Code, Codex or Cursor for anything, tell us - we like that, but it is a bonus, not a requirement - Shopify build and optimization, keyword-driven blog writing - Amazon PPC, Google Ads / Google Shopping - Influencer / UGC outreach HOURS AND PAY Starting at 20 hours per week, $500 - $800 per month depending on experience. Full-time (40 hrs/week) available after the trial period for the right person, with pay adjusted accordingly. We pay for the AI tools you need. HOW TO APPLY Applications missing these will not be read. 1. Start your message with the word KANGAROO 2. Send 2 Amazon listings you personally wrote (ASIN links) and say what you optimized and what the result was 3. Send 1 A+ Content or Premium A+ page you designed 4. Send product images YOU generated with AI - ideally a main image and one infographic for the same product. Name the tools, and tell us what came out wrong on the first attempts and how you fixed it. That last part tells us more than the finished image does 5. Tell us which AI tools you use every week and what you use each one for 6. Your expected monthly salary in USD and your available hours Bonus, and the one that actually gets our attention: pick ONE product in a category you know and in 5 lines tell us what you would change about the current #1 listing and why. Please write your reply yourself. Using AI to draft an application for an AI-heavy role tells us you do not yet know when not to use it - and we do check. Shortlisted candidates get a test task on one real product of ours - one gallery, one listing.

description: Start your application with the word AMBER so we know you read this post carefully. Hi! If you only want to delegate from day one, this is not your job. If you want to build and lead something, it is. This is a stable, full-time, direct-hire position. No agency in between. WHAT YOU WILL DO PHASE 1 (roughly the first months): master the operation yourself • Own our customer service inbox (Gorgias: email, WhatsApp, social media). PHASE 2 (once you have proven you run the operation smoothly): build your team • Recruit a customer service member yourself: write the job post, screen, interview, and propose your hire to me for final approval. • Train them using the handbooks and processes you have mastered, and improve that documentation as you go. • Manage their daily work and quality, handle the difficult cases yourself, and stay the owner of the full operation: customer service, shipments, returns. • Report to me weekly in one clear overview: what runs well, what needs a decision, what you propose. WHO YOU ARE • You think like an owner, not a task-taker. You want to understand the whole machine, fix what is broken, and eventually lead people. Experience training or managing at least one other person is a strong plus; tell us about it. • You use AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT every day and can show it. This is a hard requirement. You will work in Dutch through AI, so "pretty good with AI" is not enough; we are looking for someone exceptional at it. • Solid hands-on experience running Shopify stores for brands doing $100,000+ per month in revenue, preferably in the European market. You know what daily operations look like at that level: order volume, returns, carriers, and customers who expect premium service. Tell us about these stores in your application. • 2+ years experience in e-commerce customer service. • Genuinely empathetic. Our devices cost up to EUR 1,500 and our customers are often dealing with health struggles. Warm, patient, premium communication matters more to us than speed. • Extremely organized and stable. You keep overviews, you close loops, you never leave a case half-finished. If you tend to disappear when things get busy, this is not the job for you. • Excellent written English (we work together in English; customers are handled in Dutch via AI). • Available full-time (40 hrs/week) with at least 4 hours of overlap with Amsterdam business hours (CET), roughly 3 PM to 7 PM Philippine time or more. • Reliable internet plus a backup plan for power/internet outages. WHAT WE OFFER • $800 to $1,200 USD per month depending on experience, paid on time every month, directly to you. • 13th month pay. • Paid Philippine holidays and paid leave after the probation period. • Yearly performance reviews with real raise potential as the company grows. • Extensive documentation and training: you will never be thrown in the deep end. • A calm, respectful, no-drama work culture. I care about doing things well, not about micromanaging you. HOW TO APPLY 1. Start your application with the word AMBER. 2. Answer these 5 questions (short and honest, no AI-written essays please; ironic, we know): Question 1: Describe a concrete example of how you use Claude or ChatGPT in your daily work. What exactly do you ask it, and how do you check its output? Question 2: Tell me about a time you handled an angry customer whose package was lost. What did you do, step by step? Question 3: How do you keep track of open cases so nothing gets forgotten? Name the actual system or method you use. Question 4: Which Shopify stores have you worked on? For each: the market (EU/US/other), the approximate monthly revenue, and what you were responsible for day to day. Question 5: Have you ever trained or managed another person (VA, agent, small team)? What did you learn about it, and why do you want a role where you first do the work yourself before you lead? 3. Include your expected monthly salary and your earliest start date. Applications that skip the word AMBER or the 5 questions will not be read. I reply personally to every serious application.

description: Location: Remote — Philippines Employment Type: Full-Time Start Date: Immediate Hire About the Role We’re looking for a Shopify Landing Page Builder / CRO Designer who can take a concept, reference, wireframe, or brief and turn it into a polished, high-converting Shopify landing page. This is not just a basic page-building role. You should have a strong eye for design, user experience, e-commerce, and conversion rate optimization. You’ll be working across different brands and products, creating landing pages designed to look premium while also driving sales. You should be comfortable working independently, moving quickly, taking feedback, and understanding that a beautiful page is only successful if it converts visitors into customers. What You’ll Be Doing Build complete Shopify landing pages and product pages Create pages using Shopify themes and popular page builders such as Replo, PageFly, GemPages, Shogun, or similar tools Turn Figma designs, competitor references, wireframes, screenshots, or written briefs into finished Shopify pages Design pages with a strong focus on conversion rate optimization (CRO) Structure landing pages using proven e-commerce principles, including: Strong hero sections Clear value propositions Product benefits Social proof and reviews Comparison sections Trust elements FAQs Offers and bundles Strong calls to action Ensure pages are fully optimized for desktop and mobile Improve existing Shopify pages based on conversion performance and feedback Make visual and structural improvements without needing every detail explained Work with copywriters, designers, marketers, and other members of the team Implement basic Shopify customizations when required Maintain consistent branding across each website QA pages before launch to ensure everything works correctly What We’re Looking For You should have: Strong experience working with Shopify Previous experience building Shopify landing pages A good understanding of e-commerce design Strong visual design skills and attention to detail An understanding of conversion rate optimization Knowledge of how customers behave on e-commerce websites Experience creating mobile-responsive pages Ability to recreate designs accurately from references or Figma Ability to work quickly without sacrificing quality Strong attention to spacing, typography, hierarchy, imagery, buttons, and overall page flow Ability to follow brand guidelines while still using your own judgment Good written and spoken English Strong communication skills Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines A proactive attitude — we want someone who can identify problems and suggest improvements rather than simply waiting for instructions Bonus Skills These are not essential, but they are a major advantage: Experience with Replo Experience with GemPages, PageFly, Shogun, Zipify, or similar Shopify builders Figma experience Basic HTML/CSS/Liquid knowledge Experience with Shopify 2.0 themes Experience working with DTC/e-commerce brands Understanding of A/B testing Experience using heatmaps or CRO tools Knowledge of upsells, bundles, subscriptions, and post-purchase funnels Experience building advertorials or dedicated paid-traffic landing pages Experience with beauty, supplements, consumer products, or other DTC brands What Good Looks Like in This Role You understand the difference between a page that looks good and a page that sells. You naturally think about questions such as: Is the offer immediately clear? Is the CTA visible enough? Does the customer understand the product within a few seconds? Is there enough trust and social proof? Are we addressing objections? Is there too much information? Does the page flow naturally toward the purchase? Does the mobile version feel as polished as desktop? What could we test to improve conversion? We want someone who thinks like both a designer and a marketer. Who You’ll Work Well With You’ll be a strong fit if you: Take ownership of your work Can receive feedback without taking it personally Communicate clearly when something is unclear Meet deadlines consistently Care about small design details Enjoy e-commerce and understand what makes people buy Are comfortable working in a fast-moving remote environment Can research competitors and bring ideas to the table Don’t need constant supervision
