title: Digital Marketing & E-commerce Specialist (Full-Time, Remote)
description: About the company At Miraco Nutripharm, we are dedicated to advancing health & improving lives. Our goal is to relieve 1 billion people worldwide of pain & discomfort. If you know of anyone who has been worried about or suffered from any health problems, join us in making a positive impact by reducing the pain & distress others have to endure. Job Description We are looking for an Digital Marketing & E-commerce Specialist to be the visionary link between our brand identity & measurable e-commerce performance. You will shape how our health brands communicate across Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & social media. This role is responsible for developing high-impact creative strategies & producing assets (visual, video, copy) designed to drive traffic, increase conversion rates & drive overall revenue growth for our Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & TikTok E-Commerce stores. You will work across multiple channels & markets to plan, create & optimize content that builds awareness, strengthens partnerships & supports the expansion of our business. You won't just be creating content; you will be engineering 'Performance Stories' that turn scientific evidence into consumer trust & measurable revenue. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing creativity, analytics & brand strategy in the health supplement industry. Key Responsibilities 1. Creative & Performance Strategy *Full-Funnel Content: Craft tailored strategies for B2C & B2B audiences optimized for platform-specific formats (e.g. Meta carousel ads, Meta/TikTok Reels, Shopee/Lazada e-commerce banners & Klaviyo email/whatsapp marketing) *A/B Testing & Data Insights: Develop clear hypotheses for creative elements (hooks, CTAs, visual styles) & run A/B tests to improve Click-Through Rates (CTR) & Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) *Audience Segmentation: Translate target audience data & segmentation provided by media buyers into resonant creative themes, ensuring content speaks directly to different stages of the marketing funnel (awareness, consideration, conversion) *Competitive Intelligence: Identify emerging hooks & messaging trends in the wellness/supplement industry to keep our brands ahead of the curve 2. In-House Content Production & Execution *Performance Creative Development: Lead end-to-end creative production for organic & paid media (Meta, TikTok, Google/YouTube) with a focus on high-volume, quick-turnaround testing *Video & Static Creation: Rapidly produce & edit native social content, including: -Video: Fast-paced assembly of UGC-style content, product demos & testimonials (CapCut/Premiere) -Static: Adapting product photography into high-performing ad variations & storefront banners *Generative AI Integration: Utilize AI tools & prompt engineering to efficiently generate high-quality video & image assets for rapid testing cycles *Copywriting: Write high-converting ad copy, landing page headlines & captions that align with brand voice & regulatory requirements *Asset Management: Ensure all campaign assets are correctly tagged, archived & deployed across Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & TikTok storefronts 3. E-commerce Growth & Social Account Management *E-Commerce Storefront Custodian (Shopify, Shopee, Lazada, TikTok): Integrate winning creative messages into e-commerce storefronts (product pages, banners) to ensure a seamless customer journey for maximum sales conversion *Social Accounts Ownership & Community Manager: Act as the "Brand Guardian" for Miraco’s official accounts on Meta (FB/IG) & TikTok. Ensure all profiles are optimized for conversion, featuring up-to-date bios, Linktree/Shopify integrations & high-lighted stories *Content Programming & Scheduling: Develop & maintain a consistent content calendar that balances "Digital Pearls" (educational), Lifestyle (relatable) & Promotional (sales-driven) posts *Active Social Listening: Use comments & DMs to identify "pain points" to fuel new content hooks *User Generated Content (UGC) Mining: Identify & curate customer testimonials from the community to use as high-converting growth assets *Growth Analytics: Monitor account health metrics (Follower growth, Engagement Rate, Profile Visits) & use these insights to refine the organic reach strategy *Data-Driven Optimization: Work with the Marketing Manager to analyze performance reports, identifying which creative variables are driving revenue on Shopify & Marketplaces. Apply insights & analytics to refine content effectiveness continuously 4. Performance Media & Technical Tracking *Paid Media Execution (Meta & Google): -Meta Ads Manager: Build, launch & manage conversion-focused campaigns (Advantage+ Shopping, Catalog Sales & Manual Retargeting) to drive traffic to Shopify & Marketplaces -Google Ads (PMAX & Search): Oversee Performance Max & Search campaigns to capture high-intent health & supplement queries *Precision Tracking & UTM Tagging: Implement a standardized UTM tagging nomenclature across all Digital Pearls, EDMs, WhatsApp blasts & Affiliate links to ensure 100% attribution accuracy in Google Analytics 4 (GA4) & Shopify -Monitor the "customer path" from the first touchpoint (e.g., a Meta post) to the final conversion (e.g. e-commerce purchase, loyalty program subscription, etc.) *Media Optimization: Manage ad spend budgets effectively, focusing on scaling winning creatives & "killing" underperforming ads based on real-time ROAS & CPA data 5. CRM, Loyalty & Lifecycle Marketing (Retention & CLV) *CRM Management, Loyalty & Monetization: Serve as the lead strategist for the CRM loyalty program, designing lifecycle journeys that move customers from "First-Time Buyer" to "Loyal Subscriber" - Develop loyalty-driven content that rewards repeat purchases & encourages long-term brand advocacy to maximize *Consumer Lifetime Value (CLV) Electronic Direct Mailer (EDM) & E-Newsletter Strategy: Develop & execute a high-frequency E-newsletter calendar via Klaviyo. This includes: -Educational Newsletters: Delivering "Digital Pearls" & expert insights from our HCP partners to build brand authority -Promotional EDMs: Creating high-converting seasonal offers & product-launch campaigns *Automated Flow Management: Design & execute end-to-end email & WhatsApp marketing automation (eg. Klaviyo) to nurture leads & re-engage existing customers -Automated Lifecycle Flows: Building "Welcome" series, "Post-Purchase" care, "Win-back" flows & "Replenishment Reminders" *Subscription & Monetization: Craft compelling creative & copy for "Subscribe & Save" programs, focusing on reducing churn & maximizing monthly recurring revenue (MRR) -Optimize the "Subscribe & Save" funnel through targeted email & WhatsApp triggers, focusing on increasing Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) & Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR) *WhatsApp Marketing: Integrate direct-to-consumer WhatsApp communication for personalized health consultations, loyalty rewards & rapid-response promotions *Data-Driven Personalization & Segmented Campaigns: Segment the CRM database based on health concerns, purchase behavior & engagement levels to ensure the right story reaches the right customer at the right time 6. Influencer & Affiliate Strategy (E-Commerce Growth & Acquisition) *Creator Partnerships: Identify & manage relationships with health influencers & HCP advocates via Shopify Collabs, TikTok Creator Marketplace & similar platforms *Affiliate Creative Kits: Develop high-converting "Affiliate Toolkits" (ready-to-use stories, hooks & banners) that empower partners to sell Miraco products effectively *Performance Tracking: Monitor affiliate-driven traffic & conversion data to optimize commission structures & creative briefs for better ROAS 7. Growth-Driven Storytelling *Translating Science to Story: Distilling complex clinical data & health benefits into relatable, high-impact stories that resonate with a consumer’s pain points & emotional aspirations *Narrative Funneling: Crafting story arcs specifically designed for the customer journey, from "educational hooks" that capture attention to "empathy-led consideration" to "urgency-driven conversion" *Growth-Centric CTAs: Developing persuasive, multi-variant Calls-to-Action (CTAs) that don't just ask for a click but provide a compelling reason to engage, directly impacting Click-Through Rates (CTR) & customer acquisition *Performance Iteration: The ability to pivot a brand story based on real-time data insights, identifying which "angle" or "hook" is driving the highest Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) *Omnichannel Cohesion: Ensuring a seamless visual & narrative experience across all touchpoints, from high-energy social media (Meta/TikTok) to professional platforms (LinkedIn) & offline trade materials *Compliance & Brand Integrity: Safeguarding brand credibility by ensuring all "Performance Stories" remain factual, align with company values & strictly compliant with regional healthcare advertising standards & product claim guidelines. Partnering with internal teams to audit content for accuracy & compliance prior to regional deployment Requirements: -3–5 years of experience in full-stack digital growth, with a track record of managing end-to-end performance campaigns (Meta/Google), official social accounts (Meta/TikTok) & e-commerce growth (Shopify is a plus) -Ability to move customers through the funnel—from initial awareness to community loyalty—ideally within the healthcare or wellness sectors -Proven experience managing or creating content for Shopify, TikTok, Shopee & Lazada ecosystems. Familiarity with e-commerce metrics (AOV, CR, ROAS) is essential -Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager & Google Ads -Strong understanding of social media trends & platform best practices (Meta, Google, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Generative AI) -Hands-on proficiency in Klaviyo (highly preferred), HubSpot, or Zoho CRM for email & mobile marketing -Track record of managing or growing a brand loyalty club with a focus on retention & community building -Experience navigating Shopify Collabs, TikTok Marketplace, or similar affiliate management software -A solid understanding of the "Growth Equation": CAC, ROAS, AOV & CLV -Expert in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, Premiere Pro), CapCut, Canva, Figma, or similar tools -Experience using Generative AI tools (e.g., Gemini AI, Midjourney, Sora/Runway) for rapid asset prototyping & production -Excellent writing, editing & visual storytelling skills. description: Read this part first Most support jobs are ticket jobs. You clear the queue, you hit a response time target, nobody notices you unless something goes wrong. This is not that. We sell consumer health products in the US on a monthly subscription. That means every single customer conversation is worth real money over time. A customer you calm down and keep stays with us for months. A customer you lose with a lazy reply costs us their entire lifetime value. Support is not a cost center in this business, it is where retention is won or lost. So we are hiring one person and paying them properly, instead of three people cheaply. We keep our brand name out of the public posting for competitive reasons. You get the full picture (brand, product, revenue, how we operate) on the intro call, and we will sign an NDA if you want one. A normal day You open the inbox. Overnight there are 40 to 70 messages from American customers. Some are simple: where is my order, can I change my address. Some are not: a failed payment on a subscription, someone who wants to cancel because they "did not see results yet", someone whose package says delivered but is not there, someone asking whether the product is safe alongside another supplement. You work through all of it. You handle the subscription changes yourself in Loop. You issue the refund in Shopify when it is the right call, and you find a better solution when it is not. You notice that eleven people this week asked the same confusing question, and you tell us, because that is a landing page problem, not a support problem. By the end of your day the queue is empty and nothing has been left for tomorrow. The tools you will live in Shopify, Loop Subscriptions, and a helpdesk (Gorgias or similar). If you have used Recharge, Skio or Bold instead of Loop, that transfers fine. If you have never touched a subscription tool, this role will be a hard climb. This job is for you if Your written English is genuinely native-level. Our customers are American and they will notice the difference. We test this before anything else. You have supported ecommerce brands before and can name them You can be trusted with a refund decision without asking permission every time You would rather own one brand deeply than juggle five clients You want a job you are still doing in two years, with more responsibility and more money each year This job is not for you if You are looking for something part time on the side You need to be reminded and followed up on Your plan is to use canned replies for everything You cannot overlap with US business hours at all Nice to have, not required German (we run other brands in Europe and we pay extra for it) Health, supplement or wellness niche experience Experience writing SOPs or macro libraries from scratch The money $1,000 to $1,400 per month, depending on what you bring. title: Link Acquisition & Digital PR Specialist
description: Build Authority. Earn Powerful Backlinks. Drive Real SEO Growth. Are you a Link Building Specialist who knows the difference between a backlink and a backlink that actually matters? At Penji, we're looking for an experienced Off-Page SEO & Link Building Specialist who can go beyond mass outreach and build a strong backlink profile through strategic prospecting, personalized outreach, relationship-building, and high-quality placements. If you know how to turn a cold email into a real conversation—and a conversation into a valuable backlink—we want to hear from you. YOUR MISSION Your goal isn't to build thousands of backlinks. Your goal is to build the right backlinks from the right websites that strengthen our authority, improve rankings, and contribute to measurable SEO growth. SECURE HIGH-AUTHORITY BACKLINKS Identify, qualify, and acquire quality backlink opportunities from reputable and relevant websites in areas such as: • SaaS • Marketing • Design • Technology • Startups • Business & Digital Marketing We're particularly interested in placements from websites with strong authority, relevance, organic traffic, and genuine editorial value. RUN SMART OUTREACH CAMPAIGNS Create personalized outreach campaigns that: • Get responses—not just opens • Start genuine conversations • Build relationships with publishers and website owners • Secure relevant editorial placements • Generate consistent backlink opportunities • Maintain long-term relationships with quality publishers No spam. No copy-paste outreach. No quantity-for-the-sake-of-quantity. PROMOTE LINK-WORTHY CONTENT Collaborate with our creative and marketing teams to promote content and assets such as: • Infographics • Original research • Data-driven content • Visual assets • Guest posts • Industry resources • Creative link-building campaigns Your job is to identify who would genuinely want to reference our content—and why. COMPETITIVE BACKLINK RESEARCH Use SEO tools to: • Analyze competitor backlink profiles • Discover new link opportunities • Identify link gaps • Find relevant publishers and websites • Evaluate backlink quality • Develop strategies to improve our overall domain authority WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR Required Qualifications • Proven experience in Off-Page SEO, Link Building, or Digital PR • Demonstrated success acquiring high-quality backlinks • Experience securing links from DR50+ websites is highly preferred • Strong understanding of White Hat SEO • Good knowledge of Google's link quality guidelines • Excellent written English communication skills • Strong research and prospecting abilities • Ability to build professional relationships with: o Website owners o Editors o Bloggers o Publishers o Journalists • Highly organized, self-motivated, persistent, and results-driven Tools & Platforms Experience with any of the following is a strong advantage: • Ahrefs • SEMrush • Hunter • BuzzStream • Pitchbox • Similar SEO, prospecting, and outreach platforms Important: You should know how to evaluate a backlink based on more than just Domain Rating. We want someone who understands relevance, organic traffic, topical authority, editorial quality, link placement, anchor text, and overall SEO value. BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE: • SaaS, technology, startup, or design industry experience • Digital PR experience • Journalist outreach experience • Guest posting expertise • Experience with niche edits and resource link building • Knowledge of topical authority and entity-based SEO • Experience creating creative or data-driven link-building campaigns • Proven ability to develop publisher relationships from scratch WHY JOIN PENJI? • 100% Remote • Work with a global brand • Long-term career growth opportunities • Collaborate with an experienced Creative & Marketing Team • Exposure to modern SEO, Content Marketing & Digital PR strategies • Supportive and results-driven remote culture THIS IS NOT A MASS-OUTREACH JOB. Build relationships that last. Earn backlinks that matter. Turn off-page SEO into measurable growth. If you're confident that you can do that, we'd love to see what you've accomplished. Submit your Link Building / Backlink Portfolio Please include actual backlink examples or case studies whenever possible. Don't just tell us you're good at link building. Show us the links you've earned, the strategy behind them, and the impact you've helped create. Apply today!

title: Content Writer Local SEO Focus
description: Fence & Deck Marketers is a digital marketing agency serving fencing, decking, and outdoor-living contractors across the United States. We are hiring a Content Strategist who can plan and produce content that ranks, gets cited, and brings in leads for local service businesses. About the Role: You will own Local SEO content strategy across our client accounts. That means d ---------- what gets written, what gets updated, what gets deleted, and why, based on data rather than guesswork. You report to the SEO Manager, who sets the guidelines and gives you direction on how we work. Inside those guidelines, we want your thinking. Your main contribution is your own understanding of how content builds a client's brand and supports their marketing as a whole, not just how it ranks in search. This is a lead role. You may have one to two people under you, so you will delegate tasks, build training for them, and review everything they produce before it goes out. Using AI is expected. Using AI without a system is not. We already have our own system in place, and we will train you. We still want to see that you have built one of your own: your own prompt guidelines, templates, and quality checks, and the ability to explain why you built them that way. That tells us we are hiring someone who thinks about the work, not someone who just uses AI. If your workflow is opening a chat window and asking for a blog post, this is not the role for you. What You Will Work On: You will create strategy for and produce: Blog posts Press releases written to earn citations, including from AI search Home page copy Service page copy Location page copy Social media content (a significant part of this role) Reddit posts Google Business Profile content What You Will Be Responsible For Quality assurance. This is the most important part of the job. Every piece of content that leaves the team goes through you. You catch spelling errors, grammar errors, factual mistakes, and anything that does not follow client or agency guidelines. Nothing ships with errors on it. Team leadership. You delegate work to one or two team members, create training and documentation so they improve, and give feedback that raises the standard of what they write. Local SEO content. You understand how local search works and how localized content differs from national content. You know what a homeowner in a specific city needs to see before they call a contractor. Content audits and decisions. You can look at an existing blog library and d ---------- which posts to target, which to refresh, which to consolidate, and which to remove. Data analysis. You are comfortable reading Google Search Console, Google Analytics, and Google Trends, and running keyword research in Ahrefs. You can turn that data into a content plan. Local research. You dig into the market, the competitors, and the area before writing, rather than producing content that could apply to any city. Topical authority and entity-based content. You understand how entities and topical coverage affect visibility, and you build content that strengthens both. You will not be figuring all of this out on your own. Your SEO Manager already knows this work well, so the two of you collaborate on these tasks. Requirements: 1) 3 to 5 years of content writing experience, specifically in local SEO or local markets 2) Experience editing and quality checking other writers' work, with an eye for spelling and grammar 3) Experience leading, training, or delegating to a small team is a strong advantage 4) A portfolio of published content you have written, with links 5) Hands-on experience with Ahrefs, Google Search Console, Google Analytics, and Google Trends 6) Excellent written and spoken English 7) Availability Monday to Friday during Eastern Time business hours Hiring Process: Apply with your resume and content samples Shortlisted candidates receive a skills assessment Candidates who pass the assessment move to an interview

title: Google Ads Strategist - Home Services (EST, Full Time)
job_title: Google Ads Strategist - Home Services (EST, Full Time)
description: If you cannot commit to working EST hours, do not apply. THIS IS NOT AN ENTRY ROLE. Sustain Media is a local SEO and Google Ads agency built only for home service businesses. Roofers, plumbers, HVAC companies, electricians, landscapers, restoration companies, and auto shops. Most of our clients are owner-operated businesses doing $2M to $10M a year. Our job is simple: more calls and more booked jobs. Ultimately, every metric has to connect back to qualified leads, booked work, and profitable growth. We're hiring a Google Ads Strategist to join our paid media team. What makes this role different We use AI agents to handle a growing share of the repetitive work most agencies still do by hand, including search term mining, campaign audits, performance diagnostics, and reporting data pulls. The systems get better every month. Right now, this role includes real implementation work. You'll build campaigns, write ads, make bid changes, and manage accounts directly. We're moving quickly on AI systems, and over the next few quarters the role should become increasingly focused on strategy rather than implementation. That strategy includes understanding why a plumber in Portland needs a different structure than an HVAC company in Fort Wayne, when to push budget into a seasonal spike, when to pull back, and how to turn performance data into a growth plan for every account you run. If you want the strategy-only version of this job on day one, this is not it. If you want to grow into it as the systems mature, keep reading. What you'll own Your own book of clients. You'll own your accounts end to end, working alongside another PPC specialist who manages a separate portfolio. You'll manage Google Ads across home service accounts with different trades, markets, budgets, and growth goals. Each account needs its own strategy. Lead generation. These campaigns exist to drive phone calls, form fills, and booked jobs. You need to know how to build for that and measure it the way a business owner does: qualified lead volume, acquisition cost, booked work, and return on spend, not clicks and impressions alone. Tracking and attribution. A dashboard saying Google is working means nothing if the client's phone is not ringing. You'll own conversion tracking on every account and know how to verify which campaigns drive real calls, form fills, and booked jobs. New account builds. When a client signs, you architect the account from zero, including keyword research, campaign structure, ad copy, bidding, geo-targeting, conversion tracking, and launch. Judgment calls. Our AI agent Viktor provides audits and diagnostics. You d ---------- what to do with them: which bid strategy fits an account with 20 conversions a month versus 100, when PMax is supporting the account, when it is obscuring poor lead quality or wasting spend, and when to restructure instead of continuing to optimize around a flawed setup. Landing pages and offers. You work with our development and SEO teams so ad traffic lands on pages that convert. You guide the messaging and structure, but you do not build the pages. Monthly reporting. Viktor pulls the data. You write the story, explain what changed, and lay out the plan for the next month. What success looks like In your first 90 days, you'll take full ownership of a portfolio, confirm that tracking is trustworthy, identify the largest performance opportunities, and establish a clear strategy for each account. Longer term, success means improving qualified lead volume and booked-job economics while keeping clients confident in the direction of their campaigns. What we're looking for Must-haves: - Proven results running lead generation campaigns for local home service businesses - Hands-on experience with Search, Performance Max, and Local Service Ads - A strong understanding of conversion tracking. When a client says the leads are not coming in, 'the dashboard looks fine' is not an answer. You know how to verify what is real. - The ability to build an account from zero and defend every major choice you made - The ability to read data and make strategic recommendations, not just report what a dashboard says - Strong communication skills. You'll be in Slack daily. Strong pluses: - Strong attribution skills, including tracing ad spend through call tracking and offline conversions to booked jobs - Experience with CallRail or similar call-tracking platforms - An understanding of how Google Business Profile and local SEO work together with paid search - Agency experience managing multiple accounts at once - Comfort working with AI tools. You do not need to build automations, but you should want to use them. The environment - Remote, international team - Contractor position, paid biweekly - Base range: $1,500 to $2,000 USD per month depending on experience - Revenue share: after a certain amount of time with a client, you will begin earning an ongoing monthly share tied to how long that client stays with us. Realistically, this adds $200 to $500 per month within your first year and keeps growing as your book matures. It is paid every month, for as long as the client stays. Daily tools: Google Ads, CallRail, Slack, Airtable, Google Sheets, and Viktor You can work from anywhere in the world, but you work U.S. Eastern Time (EST) business hours. This is a firm rule, not a preference. There is no time tracking, and there never will be, but the EST schedule is non-negotiable. If you cannot commit to working EST hours, do not apply. Our clients are month to month with no long-term contracts. We earn the business every 30 days, which means the work has to be good. Small senior team. You work directly with the founder and the operations team

title: AI-POWERED BUSINESS GENERALIST | OPERATIONS, GROWTH & AUTOMATION
job_title: AI-POWERED BUSINESS GENERALIST | OPERATIONS, GROWTH & AUTOMATION
description: AI-POWERED BUSINESS GENERALIST | OPERATIONS, GROWTH & AUTOMATION Remote | Long-term | Full commitment | € ---------- / week| Philippines IMPORTANT: THIS IS NOT A STANDARD VA ROLE We are looking for someone smart, ambitious and extremely eager to learn. Not someone who needs a perfectly defined task list. Not someone who wants to stay inside one area of expertise. And not someone whose main question is: "What are my working hours?" We are looking for someone who wants to understand how a business works, use AI to learn extremely quickly, improve the way work gets done and gradually take on more responsibility. Your exact role will partly depend on what you are good at. You might develop more towards: * AI, processes and automation * Growth marketing and analytics * Video editing and creative work * Business operations * Or a combination of these We are deliberately keeping that open. What matters much more is HOW YOU THINK, HOW FAST YOU LEARN AND HOW MUCH OWNERSHIP YOU TAKE. ABOUT VLYOU VLYOU helps companies improve and run their operations. We work on processes, operational execution, service delivery, AI, automation, marketing and business improvement. We are a small international team with ambitious plans. Our seven core values are: COLLABORATION We work as a team. We help each other, share information and make sure customers are never dependent on one individual. CURIOSITY We don't just want to know WHAT to do. We want to understand WHY. CREATIVITY If the obvious solution doesn't work, we look for another one. HONESTY Mistakes can happen. Hiding them is much worse. We need people who speak up. OWNERSHIP Do what you say and say what you do. Stay one step ahead and take responsibility for the outcome. WORLD-CLASS PERFORMANCE We continuously look for ways to improve quality, standardize work, reduce errors and work smarter. PASSION We want people who bring energy to their work and genuinely want to achieve something. WHAT WILL YOU ACTUALLY DO? There is no perfect answer yet. And that is intentional. We are hiring the PERSON first and will partly shape the role around your strengths, interests and development. At the start, you will spend part of your time working with our CargoCare team, a Dutch freight forwarding company. You do NOT need freight forwarding experience. CargoCare is partly your operational onboarding into how we work as a team: ownership, communication, quality, SOPs, deadlines, customer service and continuous improvement. At the same time, you will already start supporting other activities. Depending on your skills, this could include things such as: * Using Claude, ChatGPT and other AI tools to research and solve business problems * Improving processes and creating SOPs * Identifying work that can be standardized or automated * Building AI workflows and automations * Working with Claude Code or similar tools * Analyzing data and business performance * Google Ads / Meta Ads * GA4 and marketing analysis * Growth marketing * SEO or Search Console * Email marketing * Website improvements * Video editing * Creating visuals and marketing materials * Social media content * Supporting client projects * Operational or administrative work when needed We do NOT expect you to already be great at everything on this list. That would be unrealistic. We do expect you to be the type of person who can be given an unfamiliar problem and think: "Okay. I don't know this yet. How do I figure it out?" Then use AI, research, questions and critical thinking to get there quickly. THE PERSON WE ARE REALLY LOOKING FOR If we had to choose between: A) Someone with five years of experience who knows exactly how they have always done their job and B) Someone with less experience who is extremely smart, curious, energetic, analytical and learns incredibly quickly We would choose B. Without hesitation. You may only have 1-2 years of professional experience. That's fine. We don't require a university degree either. Your potential matters much more to us. The most important qualities for this role are: 1. INTELLIGENCE & ANALYTICAL THINKING You understand complex information quickly, recognize patterns and can break problems into logical pieces. 2. LEARNING AGILITY You can enter a subject you know little about and become useful surprisingly quickly. 3. DRIVE / ENERGY / PASSION You don't sit around waiting for someone to create work for you. You want to move things forward. 4. PROACTIVITY You ask questions, investigate problems, identify opportunities and keep people informed. 5. COMMUNICATION You communicate clearly and confidently in English and are not afraid to ask a clarifying question when something is unclear. 6. PROCESS THINKING You don't want to solve the same problem manually 50 times. You ask whether it can be standardized, documented, improved or automated. 7. RELIABILITY People should know where they stand with you. If something may go wrong or a deadline is at risk, you communicate BEFORE it becomes a problem. AI EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED You do not need to be an AI engineer. But if it is 2026 and you have barely used tools like ChatGPT or Claude, this role is probably not a good fit. AI is an important part of how we work. We expect you to have practical experience with prompting and to understand that good AI use is much more than asking one question and copying the answer. You should be comfortable with things such as: * Iterating until an AI output is actually useful * Asking follow-up questions * Providing proper context * Critically checking AI answers * Using AI to research unfamiliar subjects * Identifying which questions need to be answered * Comparing multiple possible solutions * Using AI to challenge your own thinking * Recognizing repetitive work that could be automated * Building reusable workflows instead of starting from zero every time Experience with Claude Code, automation, no-code tools, APIs, programming or SOP/process design is a strong PLUS. So is experience in digital marketing, Google Ads, Meta Ads, GA4, video editing or design. But those are NOT hard requirements. WORKING WITH ME / OUR CULTURE This part is important. We offer a lot of freedom. We also have high expectations. You should expect regular feedback and sometimes very direct feedback. That doesn't mean we want a negative working environment. Quite the opposite. I personally invest time in helping team members improve, understand why something could be better and develop new skills. If you respond well to that, you can have a very steep development curve here. But this environment is not for everyone. If critical feedback makes you withdraw, stop communicating or hide problems, you probably won't enjoy working with us. If your response is: "Okay, I understand. How do I make it better?" you probably will. You also need to be comfortable saying: "I don't fully understand the assignment yet." or: "I understand what you're asking, but I think there may be a better way to achieve the goal." We don't need blind obedience. We need people who think. SELF-STARTER DOES NOT MEAN WORKING IN SILENCE We want independence, but we don't expect you to read minds. Many of our projects are new. Sometimes there is no SOP yet. When an assignment is unclear, ASK. When you are making an important decision, KEEP THE RELEVANT PEOPLE INFORMED. When a deadline is at risk, SAY SO EARLY. When you see a problem, DON'T HOPE IT DISAPPEARS. Once objectives and expectations are clear, we want you to work independently. The amount of coordination should depend on the risk and uncertainty involved. WORKING HOURS & COMMITMENT OnlineJobs requires us to define working hours, so officially this is approximately a 40-hour-per-week position. But we do NOT want a shift mentality. We don't care whether one particular Tuesday contains exactly 8.00 hours of work. We do care whether: * Your responsibilities are covered * Your work gets done * Quality meets expectations * Deadlines are managed * Your colleagues can depend on you * You are available when coordination is needed There is significant flexibility in when you work. We require at least approximately 4 hours of regular overlap with Netherlands time between 09:00 and 22:00. Some assignments, such as operational work at CargoCare, naturally require more specific availability. Flexibility works both ways. If you need to move a few hours around, that is usually fine. Likewise, if something occasionally needs a little extra effort to deliver what was agreed, we expect ownership instead of clock-watching. We are looking for FULL COMMITMENT. This means no ongoing second job, freelance workload or study that competes with this role long term. COMPENSATION & GROWTH Starting rate: €4-6/hour depending on experience, skills and potential. Payment is weekly. Your first two weeks are a PAID ONBOARDING & ACCELERATION PERIOD. This is not designed as an elimination round where we expect half the people to leave. We use this period to: * Learn where your strengths are * See how you learn * Determine where you can add the most value * Give you the opportunity to prove yourself immediately Exceptional performance can result in an immediate salary increase. After that, there are regular opportunities to grow in both responsibility and compensation. We also offer: * Performance-based salary growth * Quarterly team bonus opportunities * Additional bonuses when appropriate * Increasing flexibility as trust grows * Paid vacation and sick leave after you have established yourself with the team If you perform well, there is a lot of upside. HARD REQUIREMENTS Please read these carefully. 1. ONLINEJOBS IQ SCORE: 120+ You must have completed the OnlineJobs IQ test and score at least 120. No test = rejection. Below 120 = rejection. 2. ENGLISH: MINIMUM C1 ON YOUR ONLINEJOBS PROFILE In practice, we expect near-C2 communication. You must be able to understand complex questions, communicate nuances and have a natural conversation in English. If something is unclear, we expect you to ASK rather than guess. 3. PRACTICAL AI EXPERIENCE You need actual experience using tools such as ChatGPT or Claude and understand basic prompting. 4. FULL COMMITMENT You must be able to make this your main professional commitment. 5. FOLLOW THE APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS We receive many applications. If you don't meet a hard requirement or ignore the application instructions, your application may be rejected without a response. HOW TO APPLY Start your application with the word: LEVERAGE Then answer ALL questions below in numbered format. Please don't give us generic answers about being "hardworking, passionate and a fast learner." SHOW US. 1. YOUR BACKGROUND Briefly introduce yourself. Include: * Your age * Your current work situation * Your most relevant previous roles * What type of work you believe you are unusually good at * Your expected hourly rate in EUR * When you could start Also confirm that you can make this role your main professional commitment. 2. AI Which AI tools do you currently use and what do you actually use them for? Give ONE specific example of a task where you used AI in a way that materially improved the quality or speed of your work. Explain what YOU did rather than only describing what the AI produced. 3. LEARNING Describe one situation where you had to learn something difficult that you initially knew very little about. What did you need to learn? How did you approach it? Which resources or people did you use? What did you do when something wasn't clear? How quickly were you able to become useful? 4. IMPROVEMENT Give one concrete example where you thought: "There has to be a better way to do this." It can involve a process, spreadsheet, repetitive task, marketing activity, communication flow, administration or anything else. What was happening? What did you change or propose? What was the result? 5. FEEDBACK Describe a situation where someone gave you feedback that you initially disagreed with or found difficult. What was the feedback? How did you respond? Did you change anything afterwards? 6. CHOOSE ONE Which direction currently interests you MOST? A. AI / AUTOMATION / PROCESSES B. GROWTH MARKETING / ANALYTICS C. DESIGN / VIDEO / CREATIVE D. OPERATIONS / BUSINESS SUPPORT E. I genuinely don't know yet and enjoy combining different areas Explain WHY in no more than 100 words. There is no preferred answer. Your answer helps us understand where your natural interests are. IMPORTANT You are allowed to use AI when preparing your application. In fact, we'd be surprised if you didn't. But remember: AI can make a weak answer sound polished. It cannot turn a weak example into a strong one. We are much more interested in your actual thinking, choices and experiences than in perfect wording. Candidates who pass this first screening will go through a few written rounds, followed by a practical AI/analytical assessment and an interview. We're looking for someone we can invest in for the long term. If you are extremely curious, learn fast, enjoy being challenged and want a role that can grow significantly with you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Senior Digital Marketer (Google Ads + SEO)
description: SENIOR DIGITAL MARKETER (GOOGLE ADS + SEO) 321 Web Marketing | Full-Time, Remote (Metro Manila, Philippines) Classification: Full-time Department: Marketing Reports To: Director of Marketing Positions: 1 Compensation: $10 - $15 USD per hour, 40 hours per week Location: Remote. Schedule: Full-time on U.S. Eastern Time (approx. 9:00 PM - 6:00 AM PHT, Mon-Fri) ===================================== THE ROLE We're looking for a Senior Digital Marketer who owns both sides of search: Google Ads and SEO. This is not a Google Ads-only role. You'll manage paid campaigns and execute organic search strategy for the same clients, and you need real hands-on experience in both. If you've spent your career exclusively in Google Ads and have never done keyword research for organic rankings, optimized a page for search, or worked inside Search Console and Ahrefs to grow organic traffic, this role is not the right fit. The candidate we're looking for also writes like a native English speaker, because content is how both channels get executed: landing page copy, blog posts, service pages, and ad copy that converts. This is a behind-the-scenes execution and strategy role. You will not present to clients or sit in client meetings. Instead, you'll be the engine behind our campaigns: building, optimizing, analyzing, and packaging insights so clearly that our U.S.-based account managers can walk into client meetings with confidence. Your work speaks through the numbers and through crisp, well-written internal reporting. You'll manage paid and organic search across a portfolio of U.S.-based B2B and B2C clients in industries like IT/cybersecurity, insurance, financial services, healthcare, and home services. Each account has different goals, budgets, and conversion economics. You'll learn those differences and manage each account like it's your own money. ===================================== WHAT YOU'LL DO OWN GOOGLE ADS END TO END - Build, launch, and manage Google Ads campaigns (Search, Performance Max, Display, and Remarketing) across multiple client accounts with monthly budgets of $5,000+ - Own account structure: campaign architecture, ad groups, keyword strategy, match types, negative keyword management, and audience segmentation - Write compelling, conversion-focused ad copy in clear, natural English - Manage bidding strategies, budget pacing, and quality score optimization to maximize ROI - Run structured A/B tests on copy, landing pages, and bidding approaches, and document what you learn EXECUTE SEO FOR THE SAME CLIENTS - Own on-page SEO execution: keyword research, search intent mapping, title tags, meta descriptions, header structure, internal linking, and content optimization - Conduct competitive analysis using Ahrefs and Google Search Console to identify organic growth opportunities and content gaps - Optimize new and existing website content and structure to improve organic rankings and traffic - Support link-building strategy in coordination with our content team - Monitor organic performance, diagnose ranking drops, and act on algorithm updates - Run paid and organic as one integrated search strategy per client: paid data informs SEO targets, and organic insights sharpen paid campaigns ANALYZE AND REPORT - Monitor performance daily across GA4, Google Ads, and Google Search Console - Set up and maintain accurate conversion tracking (including GTM-based tracking and offline conversion imports where needed) - Translate raw performance data into clear written insights and recommendations that account managers can relay directly to clients - Prepare monthly performance summaries: what happened, why it happened, and what we're doing next CREATE SUPPORTING CONTENT - Write landing page copy, ad copy variations, and conversion-focused website content that aligns with each client's brand voice - Produce SEO-informed blog posts and service page content that supports paid campaign themes and keyword strategy - Draft email and remarketing copy for lead nurture sequences tied to your campaigns - Adapt tone and voice across clients and industries. Content for a cybersecurity firm should not read like content for a home services company. - Use AI tools to accelerate drafting, but deliver content that sounds like a skilled human wrote it, because one did COMMUNICATE PROACTIVELY (INTERNALLY) - Surface problems early: budget anomalies, tracking breaks, performance dips, policy disapprovals - Keep your account managers informed without being prompted. If something changed in an account, they should hear it from you first. - Write clearly. Your Slack messages, reports, and documentation should be as sharp as your campaigns. Strong written English is essential in this role. ===================================== WHO YOU ARE - You're a Google Ads expert. 5+ years in digital marketing with deep, hands-on Google Ads experience. You've personally managed accounts with $5,000+ monthly budgets from strategy through optimization, and you can point to the results. - You're equally at home in SEO. You've personally done keyword research, on-page optimization, and organic performance analysis, not just watched an SEO team do it. You can open Ahrefs or Search Console and know exactly where to look. If we asked you why a page dropped from position 4 to position 11, you'd have a diagnostic process, not a shrug. - You think in ROI. You don't optimize for clicks or impressions. You optimize for cost per qualified lead and return on ad spend, and you can explain the difference in your sleep. - You're data-fluent. GA4, Google Ads reporting, Search Console, spreadsheets. You can find the story in the data and explain it in plain English. - Your written English is excellent, full stop. Not "good for a second language." Your writing is clear, natural, idiomatic, and free of the small tells that make copy feel off to a U.S. audience. This will be assessed rigorously at every stage of the hiring process. - You're a genuinely strong content writer. Beyond ad copy, you can write a blog post, a landing page, or an email sequence that reads like a skilled marketer wrote it. You understand voice, flow, and structure, and you adapt them per client. - You're self-directed. Give you an account, a budget, and a goal, and you'll come back with a plan and results. You don't need hand-holding, and you work well independently on a U.S. schedule. - You're detail-obsessed. Tracking pixels, UTM parameters, conversion actions, budget caps. The small things that break campaigns don't get past you. - You're AI-open. You use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) to accelerate research, copy iteration, and analysis, but your judgment drives every decision. ===================================== QUALIFICATIONS - 5+ years in digital marketing with a proven track record managing both Google Ads campaigns and SEO - Demonstrated experience managing ad accounts with budgets of $5,000+ per month from start to finish - Hands-on SEO execution experience: keyword research, on-page optimization, and organic performance analysis for real client or company websites (not coursework or certifications alone) - Proficiency with GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, and SEO tools (Ahrefs, Semrush, or Moz) - Demonstrated content writing ability: blog posts, landing pages, or marketing copy for English-speaking (ideally U.S.) audiences, with samples - Near-native written English. This is a hard requirement and will be assessed through a writing sample, a timed writing exercise, and interviews. - Based in Metro Manila, Philippines, with reliable high-speed internet and a professional home office setup - Able to work full-time on U.S. Eastern Time (approx. 9:00 PM - 6:00 AM PHT) PREFERRED - Google Ads and Google Analytics certifications - Experience with Facebook/Meta Ads, Microsoft Ads, or LinkedIn Ads - Experience working with U.S.-based agencies or clients - Familiarity with CRM and email platforms (HubSpot, MailChimp, Klaviyo) - Experience with call tracking platforms (CallRail or similar) ===================================== HOW WE'LL MEASURE SUCCESS During your first 90 days, we'll be looking at: - Account performance: Are CPL, conversion rates, and ROAS trending in the right direction on the accounts you own? - Organic execution: Are your on-page optimizations shipping consistently, and are keyword targets and content recommendations grounded in real research? - Tracking integrity: Is conversion tracking accurate and complete across your accounts? - Reporting quality: Can account managers take your written insights into client meetings without rework? - Content quality: Does your copy and content sound natural, on-brand, and ready to publish with minimal editing? Target is approval in one revision round or fewer after initial ramp-up. - Proactive communication: Do we hear about problems from you before we discover them ourselves? - Reliability: Do you meet deadlines, keep your queue clean, and hold your schedule consistently? - Initiative: Are you bringing optimization ideas and test proposals to the table, or waiting to be told what to do? ===================================== REPORTING AND GROWTH - Reports to: Director of Marketing - Collaborates with: U.S.-based account managers, SEO team, content team - Review cadence: Weekly 1:1 during first 60 days, biweekly thereafter - Compensation: $10 - $15 USD per hour, 40 hours per week ===================================== ABOUT 321 WEB MARKETING 321 Web Marketing is an inbound lead strategy agency. We help B2B companies generate qualified leads through SEO, PPC, content, and generative AI. Our clients are typically $5M-50M+ organizations that have invested in marketing but aren't getting the results they need. We're deliberate about what we take on, and we do it well. Our core values are active listening, drive, team accountability, proactive problem solving, growth through learning, and ROI-driven decision-making. We're a remote-first team that moves with urgency, not emergency. If that sounds like your kind of place, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Scientific Content Editor
description: About Us: At MSE Supplies, we power scientific breakthroughs. As a fast-growing supplier of advanced materials, lab equipment, and analytical instruments, we serve innovators in more than 70 countries—helping researchers, engineers, and manufacturers solve tough problems every day. We’re on a mission to make top-tier scientific tools more accessible, more responsive, and more personal. That starts with providing clear, accurate, and deeply reliable technical knowledge to the global scientific community. Position Overview: MSE Supplies LLC is seeking a detail-oriented Scientific Content Editor with a strong STEM background to oversee our technical blog production pipeline. In this role, you will take drafts generated by our AI workflows and custom internal AI tools, then transform them into polished, rigorously fact-checked, and engaging technical articles that resonate with researchers, lab managers, and materials engineers. You will collaborate closely with our dedicated SEO Specialist—taking their keyword roadmaps and content briefs and bringing them to life with high editorial standards, scientific accuracy, and natural tone. While we build the internal AI tooling and supply the SEO roadmap, you will be the editorial pilot overseeing the process: validating scientific claims, humanizing the prose, and maintaining our content pipeline. Responsibilities: ⚬ Fact-Check & Validate Scientific Content: Rigorously review AI-generated drafts for scientific accuracy, proper chemical/materials terminology, methodology context, and valid data interpretation. ⚬ Humanize & Polish Drafts: Rewrite and edit content generated by our internal AI tools to eliminate robotic phrasing, improve narrative flow, add authentic lab context, and ensure a credible, authoritative brand voice. ⚬ Oversee Content Operations: Manage the end-to-end editorial pipeline—from running topics through our internal AI generators to final publication—ensuring a consistent cadence and exceptional output quality. ⚬ Light Content Strategy & Ideation: Partner with our SEO Specialist to translate keyword clusters into practical article outlines, educational guides, and product-adjacent topic ideas. ⚬ Process Feedback & Refinement: Provide operational feedback on outputs from our proprietary AI tools to help our technical team refine generation quality over time. ⚬ Product Catalog Integration: Naturally integrate MSE Supplies’ product categories (e.g., advanced ceramics, single crystals, battery materials, and lab equipment) into educational content without sounding overly promotional. Qualifications and Skills: ⚬ Scientific Background: Degree or professional background in Materials Science, Chemistry, Physics, Chemical Engineering, or a closely related STEM field. Must be able to read and accurately interpret academic literature. ⚬ Editorial & Copywriting Excellence: Native-level English writing and editing skills with a sharp ear for voice, tone, and readability. Proven ability to translate complex lab concepts into clear, engaging prose. ⚬ Working AI Literacy: Comfortable using LLMs, AI writing interfaces, and internal automated content systems to oversee and guide production efficiently. ⚬ Editorial Pipeline Management: Experience managing a content calendar, technical blog pipeline, or scientific publication workflow. ⚬ Working SEO Literacy: Familiarity with on-page SEO basics (headers, internal linking, search intent) to execute direction provided by our SEO Specialist. ⚬ Self-Starter: Highly organized, proactive, and comfortable collaborating in a fast-paced, remote environment aligned with US business hours. What Sets You Apart: ⚬ Prior experience writing, editing, or peer-reviewing for scientific B2B brands, academic journals, or technical trade publications. ⚬ Familiarity with on-page SEO tools such as SEMrush, Ahrefs, or Google Search Console. ⚬ Direct experience testing or providing feedback on internal AI generation workflows or custom LLM tooling.

Research Skills: Ability to conduct thorough research and synthesise information into clear, compelling, and customer-focused narratives for B2B audiences. - Proven Copywriting Experience: At least 5 years of relevant experience in copywriting, content writing, marketing communications, or related fields. - Strong Writing Skills: Exceptional writing, editing, and proofreading skills, with a keen eye for detail and the ability to adapt tone and style across different channels, audiences, and stages of the marketing funnel. - Creativity: Innovative thinker with the ability to generate unique ideas, messaging angles, campaign concepts, and copy that differentiates gigCMO in the market. - Collaboration: Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with Lead Generation, HubSpot, marketing, sales, and leadership teams. - Time Management: Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects, competing priorities, and deadlines. - Analytical Skills: Proficient in using analytics tools to extract and measure copy performance metrics, including open rates, click-through rates, conversion rates, engagement data, lead quality, and search visibility. - Data-driven Thinking Skills: Ability to interpret, evaluate, and synthesise data findings and insights to inform strategic decisions, identify patterns, and improve copy, messaging, and campaign performance. - Product/Service Knowledge: Ability to rapidly build a deep understanding of gigCMO’s services and translate strategic marketing, fractional CMO, growth consultancy, and capability-building concepts into compelling, customer-centric narratives. - Strategic Vision: Ability to position each piece of copy within the broader context of the campaign strategy, marketing funnel, customer journey, sales process, and brand identity, recognising that copy does not exist in isolation. - Commercial Awareness: Strong understanding of how marketing supports revenue growth, lead generation, customer acquisition, and long-term business capability. - B2B Communication Skills: Ability to write confidently for founders, business owners, senior executives, and decision-makers across start-ups, scale-ups, and SMEs. This is not a position for someone learning Google Ads for the first time. Social Media & Content Creation You will help manage our TikTok, Instagram and Facebook accounts. Your responsibilities will include: * Creating and editing TikToks, Instagram Reels and Facebook content * Turning footage from our tyre fitting jobs into engaging content * Using Canva, CapCut or similar software * Creating captions, hooks and calls-to-action * Creating promotional and educational content * Researching trends and content ideas * Maintaining a consistent posting schedule * Helping turn social media viewers into paying customers Fleet Sales, Lead Generation & Cold Calling A major part of this position will involve helping TyreRush secure regular commercial and fleet customers. You will: * Research companies operating fleets of cars and vans * Identify relevant managers and decision-makers * Cold call potential business customers * Send professional outreach emails * Contact taxi companies, delivery companies, couriers, logistics companies, dealerships, garages, recovery companies, rental businesses, construction companies and other fleet operators * Introduce and promote our mobile tyre services * Build and maintain an organised database of potential customers * Follow up consistently with prospects * Arrange calls and meetings with interested companies * Search for fleet contracts and subcontracting opportunities * Develop relationships with potential commercial customers * Keep me regularly updated on promising leads and opportunities You must be confident speaking on the phone and comfortable cold calling UK businesses. Performance-Based Pay In addition to the $700 USD monthly base salary, this position includes additional performance-based earning opportunities. You will be rewarded for qualified leads and new business that you personally help secure for TyreRush, particularly commercial and fleet accounts. Performance bonuses may be awarded for: * Securing new fleet or commercial customers * Generating qualified leads that convert into paying customers * Helping secure ongoing or recurring fleet work * Bringing in valuable new business partnerships * Achieving agreed lead-generation or sales targets The exact performance-based structure will be discussed with the successful candidate. Customer Service & Aftercare Customer satisfaction is extremely important to us. You will: * Manage and follow up customer enquiries * Send thank-you emails or messages after completed jobs * Check that customers are happy with our service * Request Google reviews from satisfied customers * Follow up missed enquiries * Maintain relationships with previous customers * Help encourage repeat business * Bring complaints or important issues to my attention immediately Tyre Stock Management You will also help us keep our tyre stock organised. Your responsibilities will include: * Maintaining tyre stock records * Keeping stock spreadsheets up to date * Monitoring tyre sizes and quantities * Identifying stock that is running low * Keeping track of popular tyre sizes * Informing me when stock needs replenishing * Helping organise stock orders * Keeping supplier information organised * Comparing supplier prices when required Working Closely With Me This is an important part of the position. You will work directly with me throughout your working day and we will be in regular contact regarding the business. You will help me with: * Managing emails * Organising my schedule * Setting reminders * Keeping track of important tasks * Updating spreadsheets * Conducting online research * Preparing documents * Contacting suppliers * Following up with customers and businesses * Monitoring Google Ads performance * Monitoring fleet leads and follow-ups * Monitoring customer aftercare * Monitoring tyre stock * Keeping business information organised * Helping prioritise my workload * Providing regular updates throughout the day * Alerting me immediately when something important requires my attention I don’t want to have to constantly ask whether something has been completed. I am looking for someone who communicates well, keeps me updated and takes responsibility for their work. Over time, I want you to become someone I can trust as my right-hand person for the marketing, organisation and growth of TyreRush. Who We Are Looking For We want someone who is: * Experienced and confident with Google Ads * Able to demonstrate previous lead-generation results * Proactive * Highly organised * Reliable and trustworthy * A strong communicator * Confident on the telephone * Excellent in spoken and written English * Comfortable speaking with UK businesses * Sales and results focused * Creative * Comfortable working independently * Good with technology and spreadsheets * Able to manage several responsibilities * Interested in a long-term position Experience with Google Ads, B2B lead generation, cold calling, sales, Google Business Profile, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Canva, CapCut, SEO and Virtual Assistant work is highly desirable. What We Expect We do not want someone who waits all day for instructions. If Google Ads are not generating enough leads, investigate why and discuss improvements with me. If advertising money is being wasted, identify it and tell me. If a fleet prospect hasn’t replied, follow up. If you find a company with a large fleet that could benefit from our services, approach them. If a customer has completed a job, make sure they receive a thank-you message. If tyre stock is running low, tell me. If social media needs content, create it. If you see an opportunity to generate more business, bring it to me. If something important happens during the day, communicate it with me. We want someone who takes ownership of their responsibilities and actively thinks about how they can help TyreRush grow. How to Apply Please provide: 1. Details of your Google Ads experience 2. Examples or screenshots of Google Ads campaigns you have managed 3. title: SEO Outreach & Link Building Specialist
description: We are looking for a reliable, experienced SEO Outreach & Link Building Specialist to help us earn high-quality backlinks for a growing software discovery and cashback platform. This is not a role for someone who simply has a spreadsheet of websites selling guest posts. We are specifically looking for someone who can research relevant websites, identify real outreach opportunities, contact editors/site owners, follow up professionally, and build genuine relationships that can lead to guest posts, editorial links, resource links, expert contributions, statistics citations, and other legitimate placements. Your main responsibilities will include: - Researching relevant websites in SaaS, business, finance, ecommerce, marketing, technology, software, startups, and related niches - Finding websites that accept guest contributions or external expert content - Finding relevant resource pages and editorial link opportunities - Analysing competitors' backlinks to identify realistic opportunities - Identifying journalists, bloggers, editors and website owners worth contacting - Finding broken-link and resource-link opportunities where appropriate - Sending personalised outreach emails - Following up with prospects - Pitching guest articles, expert commentary, data and useful resources - Building and maintaining relationships with publishers - Recording all outreach, responses and opportunities in a spreadsheet - Recording websites that request payment for guest posts or placements - Reporting strong paid opportunities to us for separate review What We Are Looking For You should have previous experience with: - SEO outreach - Guest post outreach - Link building - Prospect research - Email outreach - Competitor backlink analysis Experience with tools such as Ahrefs, Semrush, Hunter, Apollo, BuzzStream, Pitchbox or similar tools is useful, although not all are required. Good written English is essential. Your outreach should feel like it was written by a real person. We do not want generic templates sent to hundreds of websites. We are not looking for hundreds of low-quality backlinks. We would rather earn 2 to 5 strong, relevant links than 50 poor links. A good opportunity should generally have: - Real organic traffic - Relevant content - Genuine authors or editors - Recently published and indexed articles - A sensible backlink profile - A real audience - Strong topical relevance to our company. We are not interested in: - PBNs - Link farms - Sites created primarily to sell guest posts - Spammy general blogs - Websites publishing casino, pharma, essay, adult or unrelated spam - Automatically generated websites - Bulk directory submissions - Comment backlinks - Forum spam - Automated outreach Do not optimise purely for Domain Rating or Domain Authority. A smaller, highly relevant website with genuine traffic can be much more valuable than a high-DR website with no real audience. You should be comfortable researching prospects manually rather than relying entirely on pre-existing databases. Each outreach campaign should have a clear reason why the website may want to work with us. We understand that cold outreach does not have a high success rate. We will judge performance primarily on the quality of your research, outreach and links earned, not simply the number of emails sent. We are initially looking for approximately: 12 hours per week, though this may increase if successful. Please include your requested hourly rate when applying. We will also offer a bonus for high-quality backlinks that we approve, in addition to your hourly rate. How to Apply Please answer the following questions in your application: 1) How long have you worked in SEO outreach or link building? 2) Describe how you normally find backlink prospects. 3) What makes a backlink high quality in your opinion? 4) What SEO/outreach tools have you used? 5) Approximately how many personalised outreach emails can you realistically research and send in a 10-hour week? 6) Give one example of a successful link-building campaign you have worked on. 7) How do you identify and avoid link farms or websites that exist mainly to sell backlinks? 8) What hourly rate are you looking for? We are looking for someone methodical, honest and capable of building a strong outreach process over time. This is not a volume link-building role. Quality, relevance and genuine outreach matter much more than raw backlink numbers. I look forward to receiving your applications.

description: We're ready to take our marketing to the next level and want someone who can build on what we've already got going, not wait to be handed a plan. You'll work hand in hand with the team member who's already built our apps, our AI integrations, and our website, and you'll own growing our social and digital presence: strategy, content, and execution, all in one seat. We're now expanding beyond that staffing model: our broader mission is finding real business solutions at every level using artificial intelligence, applied to the pressure points that actually slow a business down, not AI for its own sake. AI isn't a side interest here, it's built into how we work, and we want our marketing to reflect both what we do today and where we're headed. ABOUT THE ROLE This is a builder's role. We've had social and digital marketing running before, but the team behind it has since moved on, so it's not currently being pushed forward, and that's exactly the opportunity: you'll pick it up, sharpen the strategy, and grow it, setting the direction and running the channels and content yourself rather than inheriting a big pre-built org. A year from now, this person will have grown a consistent, professional social and digital presence across Instagram, Facebook, and other relevant platforms, a working 90-day marketing plan they authored and are executing against, and a library of reusable content and campaign systems the business can keep reusing and scaling. You'll partner closely with our in-house AI and web builder, and directly with leadership on positioning. You don't need to be a web developer yourself, but you do need to be fluent in how AI tools fit into modern marketing so you can move fast without a big team behind you. As we prove this out and grow, this role has a real path to Head of Marketing, building and leading the team that comes next. WORK HOURS Total workload is 40 hours/week, full-time. Because you'll be coordinating directly with our US-based leadership and the US medical practices we serve, this role needs a schedule with substantial daily overlap with US business hours — tell us your timezone and how much of that overlap you can commit to when you apply. WHAT YOU'LL DO • Pick up where our previous marketing efforts left off, build and pitch your own overall marketing strategy and 90-day plan rather than wait to be handed one, then execute against it. • Translate that strategy into tangible KPIs (leads, cost-per-lead, pipeline, engagement, and similar), and monitor and report against them on an ongoing basis, not just describe what you did. • Own our social media presence end to end across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and other relevant platforms, from content calendar through publishing and engagement. • Generate and nurture leads through email campaigns and LinkedIn/B2B outreach, not just brand-building content. • Plan, run, and optimize paid advertising campaigns across Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn, in addition to organic content, with a dedicated ad budget provided to test and scale what works. • Own our CRM and marketing automation setup (email sequences, lead tracking, campaign data) and keep it clean and running. • Coordinate with our web/tech lead on SEO and website content so our organic search presence keeps improving. • Plan, launch, and follow through on multi-platform marketing campaigns, not just the creative brief, but the full execution and results. • Use AI tools and large language models as a core part of your daily workflow, for research, content drafting, campaign ideation, and creative production. • Build repeatable marketing packages and content systems (templates, campaign frameworks, content libraries) the business can reuse and scale. • Partner directly with our AI/apps and website lead, and with leadership, to keep marketing aligned with what we're building on the product and tech side. • Help shape marketing and messaging as we expand beyond staffing into broader AI-driven business solutions and implementation work. • Track and report on performance across channels and campaigns, and adjust strategy based on what's actually working. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR REQUIRED • 4-7 years running marketing strategy, campaigns, and content for a real business, with genuine ownership of the work, not just executing someone else's brief. • Experience building the overall marketing strategy for a business, not just individual campaigns, and translating that strategy into tangible KPIs you then monitor and report against. • Experience running both organic and paid social media marketing on Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn, including managing paid ad campaigns and budgets on those platforms. • Experience with lead generation and B2B outreach, including email campaigns and LinkedIn-based prospecting or nurture. • Working knowledge of CRM and marketing automation tools (for example HubSpot or similar) for email sequences, lead tracking, and reporting. • Working knowledge of SEO fundamentals and how to coordinate website content and structure with a technical counterpart. • A track record of following campaigns through to completion and reporting on results, not just planning them. • Hands-on, everyday experience using AI tools and large language models (for example Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Grok) as part of your marketing work. • Strong content creation skills, written and visual, and the judgment to know what's on-brand. • A self-directed operator who can build a plan and run with it independently, not someone who needs to be told what to do next. You don't need deep expertise in every item above on day one. Real strength in a few of these, plus the judgment and AI fluency to handle the rest well, matters more to us than checking every box. PREFERRED (NICE TO HAVE) • Healthcare or medical industry marketing experience, including comfort with HIPAA-conscious marketing practices. • Experience picking back up and growing a marketing presence that had lost momentum, not just maintaining one that's already running at full speed. • Experience marketing for a staffing, recruiting, or BPO company. • Experience with marketing technology and business process implementation projects that involved AI. • Content creation experience specifically using AI generation tools (image, video, or copy). • Some programming or no-code/automation experience. Not required, but a plus. • Familiarity with a range of major and open-source LLMs beyond the ones listed above. TOOLS & PLATFORMS (NICE TO HAVE) Experience with any of these, or comparable tools, is a plus, not a requirement. You won't be expected to know our exact stack on day one. • Paid social & ads: Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, pixel/conversion tracking • CRM & automation: HubSpot, GoHighLevel/Zoho/Pipedrive, ActiveCampaign or Brevo, Zapier/Make/n8n • Email & B2B outreach: Mailchimp, Brevo, or MailerLite; Instantly, Smartlead, or ---------- • Social scheduling: Buffer, Later, Metricool, or Meta Business Suite • SEO: Google Search Console, Semrush or Ahrefs, Surfer SEO • Analytics & reporting: Google Analytics 4, Looker Studio, native platform dashboards • Design & content: Canva Pro, CapCut or Descript, Figma • AI for marketing: tools like AdCreative.ai, Midjourney/Firefly, HeyGen, or Perplexity, beyond the general LLMs you'll use daily COMPENSATION $7.00-$10.00 USD per hour (~₱432-₱618/hour), which works out to roughly $1,120-$1,600 USD per month (~₱69,000-₱99,000/month) at full-time hours.
