title: Guest Communications & Marketing Specialist
description: About us Luxury Mountain Destinations manages approximately 150 vacation homes in Park City, Utah — ski-in/ski-out properties in Deer Valley, homes near Park City Mountain, and a growing summer business built on hiking, biking, and the Utah backcountry. We're in the middle of a deliberate shift: moving more of our bookings away from the online travel sites and onto our own website. About half our business comes direct today. We want it to be sixty percent. We are building a small, senior offshore team — not a call center seat. You will be one of two people we're hiring in the Philippines this year. You and your counterpart will share the guest communications and reservations desk between you on staggered shifts, and each of you brings a second discipline to the team. Yours is marketing. This is a genuine two-sided role. Half your week is guests and reservations. The other half is marketing. Both halves matter and we staff, schedule, and measure them separately. An unusual note about experience You do not need vacation rental experience. We will teach you that half of the job. Guest communications and reservations are learnable, and we would rather train someone sharp, well-educated, and genuinely good with people than hire someone who already knows a different company's way of doing things. We have a structured six-to-eight week training program and we expect to use all of it. What we cannot teach is a real marketing foundation, exceptional English written and spoken, and composure with a demanding guest. Bring those and we'll handle the rest. What you'll do Guest communications and reservations — 50% of your time Voice (roughly half of this half). You'll take inbound reservation calls through our phone system. Someone calls asking about a five-bedroom home over Presidents' Week — you find out what they actually need, walk them through the right properties, quote it, and book it. You'll also take service calls from guests already in a home. Online. Inquiries and messages by email, text, and through online websites (eg Airbnb). Pre-arrival questions: arrival instructions, ski storage, parking, altitude tips, restaurant recommendations. In-stay issues — triage, enter tickets for and/or route to our Park City operations and maintenance team, follow up until the guest confirms it's resolved. Post-stay follow-up. Reservations administration. Modifications, cancellations, ancillary sales, date changes, and payment processing in our property management system and change requests in 3rd party systems (eg Airbnb). Reason-coding. Every inquiry that doesn't book gets a reason — price, dates unavailable, wrong property type, no hot tub, too far from the lift. Every time. This is one of the most valuable things you'll do and almost nobody in our industry does it. Marketing — 40% of your time Note: this role does not manage social media. That sits elsewhere. Your marketing work is direct-booking and owner acquisition demand, content, and lifecycle — the things that move guests from the travel sites onto our own site and bring them back – and the things that compel property owners to complete an introductory call with our Business Development team. Guest marketing Lifecycle email. Write and schedule campaigns in our CRM — shoulder-season pushes, repeat-guest offers, peak-week announcements, win-back sequences. Build and maintain the segments behind them. Property listing content. Write and maintain descriptions, amenity detail, and photo captions on our direct website. Our listings should be the best-written ones a guest sees that day, and there are 150 of them. Destination content and SEO. Local guides, seasonal landing pages, on-page SEO. Someone searching "Deer Valley ski-in rental" should find us. Direct-booking conversion. Landing pages, promotions and packages, booking-flow copy, and the offers that make booking direct obviously better than booking through an OTA. Owner marketing Owner communications. Newsletters, market updates, seasonal outlooks, and program announcements to the homeowners whose properties we manage. These are how an owner decides we're an asset manager rather than a booking agent. Owner acquisition. Nurture campaigns to prospective homeowners, realtor and broker referral outreach, and the market-report content that gets a second-home owner to call us instead of a competitor. Paid media Google Ads. Build, run, and optimize search campaigns against a monthly budget. Report on cost per booking, not clicks. Meta ads. Paid Facebook and Instagram campaigns for guest demand and owner acquisition, including audience building and creative iteration. Direct mail. Postcard and print campaigns to guest and owner lists — list segmentation, copy, coordination with the print vendor, and tracking what came back. Property onboarding When a new home joins the portfolio, you launch it: write the listing, coordinate photography needs, get it live and consistent across our site and every channel, and run the announcement campaign that gets it booked in its first season. A new property that sits unbooked for two months is a very unhappy owner. Reputation and reporting Reputation. Respond to public reviews across channels in our brand voice, and flag patterns worth fixing operationally. Reporting. Campaign performance, ad spend and return, direct vs. OTA mix, inquiry-to-booking conversion, owner-lead volume. Tell us what's working and what to stop doing. The advantage you have over any marketer we could hire separately is that you're on the phone and in the inbox every day. You'll hear what guests actually ask, in their own words, before you write a single subject line — and you'll know what they asked for that we don't have. Making it better — 10% Turn the questions guests ask most into templates, FAQ content, and listing improvements. Cover your teammate's desk during their time off and peak weeks — you are each other's backup. What we're looking for you to bring Education Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Advertising, Journalism, Multimedia Arts, English, or Business Administration. This is the one hard credential requirement. Certifications in Google Analytics or Google Ads are a plus but not required. Experience 2+ years in marketing, content, copywriting, or communications. Enough that campaign work, a CMS, and a reporting dashboard are familiar territory rather than concepts from a textbook. Language — this is the highest bar in the posting Excellent spoken English with a clear, neutral, easily understood accent. You will be on the phone with American guests spending thousands of dollars a week. We assess this on a live call. Exceptional written English. Not "good" — exceptional. You'll write copy representing a luxury brand and messages that resolve problems for demanding guests. Writing samples required. Foundation A portfolio: campaigns, listings, landing pages, articles, or long-form writing you actually wrote. Hands-on with an email platform and a CMS. Comfort with numbers — you can read a campaign report or a booking pace report and say something useful about it. SEO fundamentals: keywords, on-page structure, why a page ranks or doesn't. Disposition Composure. When a guest is upset at 8 PM about a cold hot tub, you stay calm and useful. Coachability. We are going to teach you an industry. You need to take feedback well and get better fast. Curiosity about a place you've never been. This matters more than it sounds like it does. Self-directed. We don't use time-tracking software and we don't micromanage. We need someone who doesn't require either. Setup Wired internet, 25 Mbps down / 10 Mbps up minimum, with a backup connection. A quiet, enclosed room — this is a voice role and background noise is disqualifying. A UPS or backup power plan for storm season (June–November). A quality headset. We'll reimburse it. A real plus, though not required Vacation rental, short-term rental, hotel, resort, or travel/hospitality marketing experience. If you've written listings, run a hotel's email program, or marketed a destination, say so prominently. Vacation rental software: Streamline, Guesty, Hostaway, OwnerRez, Track, Hospitable. BPO or call center experience on a U.S. voice account. Basic design in Canva. Comfort with AI tools — we use them daily and expect you to. We'll also expect you to know when the output sounds like AI and to fix it. Schedule This role works U.S. Mountain Time hours. Park City is 14–15 hours behind the Philippines, so your working day will fall outside standard Philippine business hours — overnight or early morning, depending on the shift. A shift differential applies. We staff this desk with two people on staggered shifts, so that between them we cover our full guest day and our busiest check-in days have two people on. Which shift and which days you take depends on the pair we hire and on how demand moves through the year, and schedules can change with reasonable notice. Expect some weekend coverage. We confirm your exact hours and days before you start. The U.S. observes daylight saving time and the Philippines does not, so the Mountain Time equivalent shifts by one hour in March and November. We adjust the Philippine-time schedule so your hours stay consistent. Compensation $1,200 USD per month. 13th month pay. 15 days (3 weeks) paid time off per year, plus Philippine regular holidays. $25 monthly internet and power allowance. Headset reimbursement. Shift differential. Performance bonus tied to direct-booking conversion. And/or owners that progress to sales call Annual performance and salary review. We pay on time, every time, and we're looking for someone who wants this to be a career, not a stopover. What's hard about this job The guests are wealthy and their expectations are high. When something goes wrong at 8 PM in a $4M house, you're the first person they talk to, and "I'll look into it" is not an answer they accept gracefully. Park City is a place you've probably never been. You'll need to learn a mountain town's geography, seasons, and rhythms well enough to advise someone on where to stay and what to do — from the Philippines. If that sounds tedious rather than interesting, this isn't your role. And the job asks you to switch between two modes: the interrupt-driven phone and inbox, and focused creative work. We protect the second on your calendar, but you have to be someone who can make that switch cleanly. How to apply Start your application with the word POWDER so we know you read this. Send us: A short note (under 300 words): your marketing education and background, and where you've dealt with customers, clients, or the public directly. Your resume, plus 2–3 writing samples. A 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and describing a place you love, as if you were recommending it to someone who's never been. Any format. This is required — we assess spoken English early because it's the hardest thing to teach. Write a 150-word description for a five-bedroom ski-in/ski-out home in Deer Valley with a private hot tub, a bunk room, and a view of Bald Mountain. Make us want to book it. Applications missing the keyword, the voice recording, or #4 will not be reviewed. Process: short screening call → work sample (campaign subject lines, a review response, two written guest messages, and a mock reservation call after we give you a property fact sheet) → final video interview with our leadership team. Luxury Mountain Destinations is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on demonstrated ability.

description: Job Title: SEO Content & Technical Specialist (Full-Time, Long-Term) Type: Full-time · 40 hours/week Salary: USD $1,700 – $2,000/month ID Proof required: Yes ABOUT US Integrity Home Exteriors is a family-owned home improvement company in Toledo, Ohio, USA. We have been in business since 2000, we have 80+ team members, and we won the 2025 Better Business Bureau Torch Award for Ethics. We install roofing, siding, windows, doors, gutters and insulation for homeowners in northwest Ohio. You'll work alongside an experienced SEO Manager who has been with our company for several years. This role works alongside him. We are looking for someone who wants a long-term home, not a short project. THE ROLE You will own the day-to-day execution of our SEO and content program. Our Marketing Director and SEO Manager set the strategy — which keywords, which topics, which cities. You do the work that makes it happen. Content production and publishing Write and publish 5 to 10 pieces per week, depending on page type — shorter service and product pages move quickly, while educational articles and cost guides for homeowners take longer Work from our writing templates and brand voice standards (we will give you these) Build and schedule finished content in HubSpot CMS Submit each week’s batch for review before anything publishes Technical SEO maintenance Run standing weekly and monthly checks on our site: index coverage, broken links, 404s, titles and meta, canonicals and slugs, internal links, schema, sitemap, robots.txt Own problems through to fixed. You are measured on how quickly issues are resolved, not on how quickly you report them. There is a defined set of changes you fix and publish yourself. Anything larger, you diagnose, prepare the fix, and hand off ready to go Verify pages against expected results after any bulk change or template update. We run scripts that touch 100+ pages at once. Catching a bad push the same day it happens is one of the most valuable things you will do here Log every issue with its severity and what caused it Local presence Monitor 3 Google Business Profiles daily — respond to reviews using our approved response standards, answer questions, report spam Monthly posts and photos on all profiles Maintain business listing and citation accuracy (NAP consistency, Bing Places, local directories) AI visibility measurement Run a fixed monthly test: ask the same 15 questions in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google, record whether we appear, capture dated screenshots, log the results exactly as found Other Some light marketing admin Occasional outreach for local directory and roundup listings. This is the lowest priority in the role and it comes last, after everything above is done WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE We would rather tell you this up front than have you guess. First 90 days — we are judging execution, not results. Is content shipping on schedule and passing review? Are the site checks running? Is anything broken and left broken? Six months and beyond — more homeowners finding us through Google search than the same months last year. Better positions in the eight towns we care most about. More activity on our Google listings and a steady flow of new reviews. The whole year — the number that matters most is how many leads come to us from organic Google search. It is our cheapest source of work, and growing it is the reason this role exists. We do not judge this role on how many articles get published. Four excellent pieces beat fifteen average ones. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR Required 3+ years hands-on SEO experience, including technical SEO — not just content writing, and not just keyword research Excellent written English. You will be writing for American homeowners. Your writing must sound natural to them, not translated and not obviously AI-generated Experience with Google Search Console, Google Business Profile, and at least one crawler (Screaming Frog, Sitebulb, Ahrefs, Semrush or similar) Comfortable working inside a CMS and publishing live pages carefully Detail-oriented and honest about your work. We verify everything, and we would much rather you tell us something went wrong than hide it Reliable internet and your own computer Hours are flexible, preferred hours are Tuesday through Saturday 8am EST to 5pm EST Nice to have HubSpot CMS experience Experience writing for home services, construction, or another trade industry Experience using AI writing tools well — meaning you use them and then fix what they get wrong, not paste and publish Local SEO experience across multiple locations or service areas Familiarity with schema markup Not required You do not need to be a strategist. We set direction. You do not need to manage anyone. You do not need US work experience. HOW WE WORK We want to be upfront about this, because it is not for everyone. We use an internal daily task platform. You log your work daily and attach proof — a link, a file, a screenshot. A checkbox with nothing attached does not count as done. Your work is reviewed weekly for quality by our SEO Manager before it publishes. For your first 30 days you prepare work and we publish it. After that, you earn the ability to publish certain changes yourself. We measure quality, not volume. Four excellent articles beat fifteen average ones, every time. Asking a question or escalating something is never held against you. Guessing and pushing something live is. If close accountability bothers you, this is not the right job. If you have been burned by vague expectations before, you will probably like it here. COMPENSATION AND SCHEDULE USD $1,700 – $2,000/month depending on experience Paid weekly, deposited every Friday via Wise 40 hours/week, Tuesday through Saturday, 8am EST to 5pm EST 40 hours of personal time off per year Independent contractor arrangement — you are responsible for your own taxes and contributions Annual review and renewal every April 30 HOW TO APPLY Please do not send a generic application. We read every one, and generic applications are the fastest way to get skipped. Put “GOLD STANDARD” in your subject line so we know you read the whole post. In your message, answer these four things: Send links to 2 pieces of content you personally wrote that rank. Tell us the keyword and roughly where it ranks. Describe one technical SEO problem you found and fixed. What was broken, how did you find it, what did you do? What tools do you use for SEO work, and how do you use AI in your writing process? Be specific and be honest. What time of day are you usually available in US Eastern time? Our Hiring Process 1. Initial Review & Recruiter Conversation We’ll start with a conversation to learn more about your background, experience, and goals while also reviewing the details of the role and what success looks like in this position. 2. Technical Interview & Paid Work Sample The next step is a technical interview with our SEO team. This stage includes a paid work sample using a real-world task related to the role. You will be compensated for your time, allowing you to experience how we work while giving us the opportunity to evaluate your approach and quality of work. 3. Final Interview & Culture Fit The final stage is a conversation with our Marketing Director to discuss team fit, communication style, and how you would align with our company. 4. Offer If selected, we will move forward with an offer to join our team. We believe in respecting candidates’ time and experience. Any work sample completed during our hiring process is paid — we do not ask candidates to perform unpaid work.

description: Apex Peptide Action Checklist ---------- WEBSITE & SEO [ ] 1. Get the site indexed Set up Google Search Console for ---------- , submit a sitemap. Check robots.txt isn't blocking crawlers, and check for stray 'noindex' tags. Once fixed, request indexing manually in Search Console. [ ] 2. Make page content server-rendered (fix the 'no text' issue) The homepage currently sends crawlers only a title/meta tag - real content isn't in the HTML the server returns. Fix: render product/category text server-side (or pre-render it) so it's in the page source, not only loaded later by JavaScript. The text must be genuinely visible to users too - do not hide text from users while showing it to crawlers (white-on-white, off-screen, display:none). That's treated as manipulation and risks the site being penalised or removed from the index entirely. [ ] 3. Build out real pages (target: 100+ indexed) One page per compound/product (mirrors competitors: BPC-157, TB-500, GHK-Cu, etc. each with their own URL). Category pages grouping products by research area (Fat Loss, Muscle Growth, Recovery, Skin & Anti-Ageing, etc.). A full catalogue plus categories and a handful of guide pages naturally clears 100 indexed pages - this is a byproduct of real content, not a target to hit directly. [ ] 4. Add visible trust signals COA per batch, HPLC/third-party testing, ISO status, company number, and address - in on-page text, on the homepage and every product page. [ ] 5. £5 discount for Telegram sign-up at checkout Add as a checkout-page offer once the core site/payment flow is stable. [ ] 6. Build content / FAQ pages Buying guides and FAQ pages answering common research questions (storage, what a compound is used for, delivery). Do this once the core catalogue (item 3) is live. [ ] 7. Open access to AI-search crawlers Allow GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, PerplexityBot in robots.txt. Add a short llms.txt and one clear 'About us' reference page. [ ] 8. Complete metadata on every page Unique title + meta description per page, plus full Open Graph and Twitter Card tags (title, description, image, site name). [ ] 9. Clean up brand confusion Several unrelated 'Apex Peptide' businesses exist ( ---------- , ---------- , ---------- ). Make the correct domain unmistakable across listings, citations, and social bios; check Google isn't surfacing the wrong business for branded search. PAYMENT PROVIDER [ ] 10. Confirm Jesse's rate, or set up 4 payment providers on rotation If Jesse's rate is competitive, move forward with him. Otherwise: set up 4 established payment providers on the checkout page, rotating/replacing as needed if one closes the account. SEQUENCING [ ] 11. Ads/funnel setup Once the site is indexed and running well, and payments are stable, build the funnel through to WhatsApp and on to the website/Telegram. Help design and write this funnel through compliant channels (organic search, WhatsApp/Telegram direct, email). I can't advise on running 'cloaking' accounts - showing ad platform reviewers different content than customers see to get restricted products approved is a direct breach of Google/Meta's terms, carries real account and legal exposure, and isn't something I can help set up. title: Strategy Manager — Research & Marketing Strategy
description: Strategy Manager — Research & Marketing Strategy Remote — Philippines | Full-Time About the Role If you are the person who reads three sources when one would do—and cannot let a “because that's how it works in this industry” go unchecked, this role may be for you. **Rohring Results** is a US-based marketing agency providing **SEO, Google & Meta Ads, social media, content, creative, email marketing, and web development** for clients across multiple industries. We are hiring a **Strategy Manager** to own the strategic direction behind our client work. This is **not a single-channel marketing role**. You will connect research, positioning, SEO, paid advertising, social media, content, email, creative, and web strategy into one coherent plan. More importantly: **This is a research job with a strategy title.** Your job is to find out what is actually true about a market, a buyer, a competitive landscape, and a client's position—and then determine what the client should do about it. When the research is strong, everything downstream becomes stronger. When the research is shallow, every channel can end up confidently solving the wrong problem. What You'll Actually Do 1. Lead Client Strategy You will own the strategy for new clients, including: * Developing the overall marketing strategy and direction * Connecting multiple channels into one integrated plan * Identifying the client's biggest growth opportunities * Determining what should be prioritized and why * Translating research into clear strategic recommendations * Making sure SEO, paid, social, content, email, creative, and web efforts work toward the same objectives 2. Conduct Deep Marketing Research You will personally conduct or direct research involving: * Buyer and audience research * Customer personas * Competitive analysis * Industry and market research * Brand positioning * Audience research for paid campaigns * Competitor messaging and offer analysis * Market trends and opportunities We are looking for someone who actually **does the research**, not someone who simply delegates it. You should be able to take a research project, explain your methodology, show your sources, challenge your assumptions, and explain how you determined that your conclusions were reliable. 3. Build Brand Foundations Many of our clients do not have clearly defined brand guidelines or positioning. You will help establish: * Brand positioning * Differentiation * Target audience * Brand voice * Key messaging * Value propositions * Messaging angles Our copywriters and designers will use these strategic foundations to create the actual deliverables. **You don't need to be the person writing every headline. You need to know which headline should exist and why.** 4. Review and Approve Content & Creative You will have real strategic authority over work before it reaches the client. You will: * Review content and creative deliverables * Identify when something does not align with strategy * Give clear and actionable feedback * Approve or reject work before client delivery * Explain *why* something needs to change * Ensure the final output reflects the research and strategy You should be comfortable telling someone, including someone who does not report to you, that their work is not ready—and giving them enough direction to fix it. 5. Direct Email Campaign Strategy You will determine: * Target audience * Campaign objective * Offer * Messaging angle * Sequence * Call to action Our copywriter will write the emails. **You provide the strategic brief and approve the final work.** 6. Analyze Client Performance You will produce and review client performance reports using AI-assisted tools. But generating a report is only the beginning. You will need to determine: * What actually happened? * Why did it happen? * Which numbers matter? * Which numbers are misleading? * What changed from the previous period? * What should we do next? * Does the data actually support the story the report is telling? We need someone who can **question the report, not just format it.** --- AI Is a Major Part of This Role Every agency says it uses AI. Here's what we actually mean. Our teams already use AI to draft, research, brainstorm, and refine work. That is not what makes this position different. **Your job is to be exceptionally good at getting reliable information out of AI tools—and knowing when the information is wrong.** You will be expected to: * Frame research questions that produce specific, useful answers rather than generic summaries * Build effective prompts and research workflows * Iterate instead of accepting the first response * Cross-check AI-generated information * Identify unsupported claims and hallucinations * Understand what an AI model can and cannot reliably know * Know when AI should **not** be used * Use primary sources, customer reviews, forums, sales calls, interviews, analytics, and other sources when appropriate * Turn research into documented, reusable strategic resources **Anyone can get an answer from AI. We need someone who can determine whether the answer is actually true.** During the hiring process, we may assess this skill directly. If you can describe a time when an AI tool gave you an answer that *looked correct but wasn't*—and explain how you caught it—we want to hear about it. --- What You'll Own * Overall marketing strategy for new clients * Integrated multi-channel strategy * Market and industry research * Buyer and audience research * Competitive analysis * Brand positioning and differentiation * Customer personas * Paid advertising audience strategy * Content and creative direction * Content and creative approval * Email campaign strategy * Client performance reporting * Strategic recommendations based on performance data * Ongoing independent research * Documentation of research methods and strategic frameworks Dedicated Research Time A portion of every week will be protected for **research that is not tied to a specific client**. This is intentional. We want someone who actively studies markets, competitors, technology, consumer behavior, marketing trends, and emerging opportunities. Nobody will necessarily be waiting for the output. That's the point. You need to be the kind of person who can take unstructured time and turn it into something valuable. --- What We're Looking For Required **Multi-Channel Marketing Strategy Experience** You have experience setting direction across multiple channels, ideally including: * SEO * Google Ads * Meta Ads * Social Media * Content Marketing * Email Marketing * Brand Strategy We are **not** looking for someone who specializes in one channel and simply coordinates the others. Strong Research Experience You have personally conducted work such as: * Market research * Competitive analysis * Customer research * Personas * Brand positioning * Audience research * Industry analysis Be prepared to walk us through a real project in detail. Genuine Curiosity One of the strongest indicators of success in this role is curiosity. We want someone who has gone deep into a subject simply because they wanted to understand it. It does not have to be marketing. Strong AI Research Skills You understand AI as a **research and reasoning instrument**, not simply a faster way to write. You should be comfortable: * Prompting * Iterating * Fact-checking * Comparing sources * Challenging AI outputs * Building repeatable AI research workflows We may assess this skill live. ### Strong Critical Thinking You naturally ask: * *How do we know this?* * *What is the source?* * *What assumption are we making?* * *What would prove this wrong?* * *Is there another explanation?* * *What information are we missing?* Comfortable Giving Direct Feedback You will have authority over work produced by other team members. You need to be comfortable saying: **“This isn't right yet.”** More importantly, you need to explain exactly **what needs to change and why.** Self-Directed Some of the most important work in this position will not come with a deadline. You need to be able to identify valuable work, prioritize it, and execute without someone constantly telling you what to do next. ### Communication * Excellent written English * Strong analytical communication * Comfortable working with US-based clients and colleagues * Able to explain complex strategic ideas clearly * Comfortable participating in client-facing discussions --- Nice to Have Experience with: * Digital marketing agencies * Google Ads * Meta Ads * Paid audience and targeting strategy * Google Search Console * GA4 * SEO platforms and analytics * Marketing dashboards and reporting * Competitive intelligence * Brand strategy * Marketing automation * AI research workflows * Creating documented processes that another person can follow --- What This Job Is NOT This may not be the right role if you are primarily looking for: * A content writing position * An SEO specialist position * A paid ads specialist position * A social media manager position * A role where someone else provides the strategy * A position where you simply execute instructions * A job where AI is used primarily to generate content faster **Our copywriters write. Our designers design. Our specialists execute.** **You determine what should be done, why it should be done, who it should reach, and how we know it is working.** --- About the Working Environment This is a senior individual contributor position There are no direct reports, but the role comes with real strategic authority. Client-facing work does not move forward without your approval. Rohring Results is a growing company, so not every process is perfectly established. Part of this role will involve helping us improve and document how strategy is developed and delivered. Our delivery team primarily works on **Philippine hours**, including daily stand-ups. Some client-facing meetings may take place during US hours. We will explain the expected schedule during the interview process. --- How to Apply Please submit your CV/Resume along with two short paragraphs answering the following: 1. A Research Question You Answered Well Tell us: * What were you trying to find out? * How did you conduct the research? * What sources did you use? * How did you evaluate the information? * How did you know your conclusion was reliable? * What decision did the research ultimately influence? 2. A Time AI Gave You the Wrong Answer Tell us about a situation where: * An AI tool gave you an answer that appeared reasonable * You discovered that it was wrong or misleading * Explain how you identified the problem * Explain how you verified the correct information * Explain what you changed in your process afterward **We read these answers before the rest of the application.** They will tell us much more about how you think than a generic cover letter. --- If you are naturally curious, skeptical of easy answers, comfortable with ambiguity, and genuinely enjoy figuring out *what is actually true*—we would like to meet you. Apply with your CV and the two requested responses above. send to ----------

title: Sales & Business Development Specialist
description: PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING We receive a high volume of applications that use the same generic AI-generated language. If your application reads like a template, simply repeats this job description back to us, or gives generic answers that could have been sent to any employer, your application will not be considered. AI may be used as a tool, but your application must reflect your real experience, judgment, communication style, and personality. We want to hear from you, not a polished generic application. A voice recording is also required as part of the application process. About Marketing Munster Marketing Munster is a growing, founder-led marketing agency serving businesses primarily in the United States. We provide a mix of marketing, lead generation, digital, advertising, CRM, automation, and growth services. We are a small, entrepreneurial team. We move quickly, communicate directly, learn constantly, and expect people to take ownership of outcomes rather than simply complete assigned tasks. We are looking for someone who can help us build a stronger and more consistent sales engine. The Role We are hiring a Sales & Business Development Specialist. Your primary responsibility is simple: Help create, manage, and close revenue opportunities. This is not a position where you wait for someone to continuously tell you what task to complete next. You will work both company-provided opportunities and opportunities you help create through prospecting, social media, partnerships, lead platforms, outbound outreach, referrals, reactivation, and other channels. You may also support outreach campaigns for Marketing Munster clients. This is a hands-on role involving prospecting, follow-up, appointment setting, sales conversations, pipeline management, partnership development, email outreach, and eventually greater ownership over the sales process. What You Will Own Sales & Pipeline You will help manage the full sales process, including: * Responding to inbound leads * Outbound prospecting * Following up with leads consistently * Qualifying prospects * Booking sales appointments * Conducting or supporting discovery calls * Following up on proposals * Helping move opportunities toward a yes or no * Reactivating older leads * Tracking opportunities in the CRM * Identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities * Supporting renewals * Asking for referrals * Helping build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline Your job is not simply to make calls. The goal is: Qualified conversations → appointments → opportunities → proposals → closed and collected revenue. Social Media Prospecting & Partnership Development We are especially interested in someone who has experience finding leads and opportunities through social media and online research. You may be responsible for: * Finding potential prospects through LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, directories, online communities/groups, and other platforms * Identifying businesses that fit our target markets * Researching potential referral partners * Finding strategic partnership opportunities * Identifying influencers or creators for campaigns * Conducting B2B outreach * Conducting B2C outreach when appropriate * Supporting influencer outreach * Developing partnership conversations * Following up with potential partners * Working with our Social Media Manager to identify and pursue opportunities * Turning social engagement and research into real conversations, appointments, partnerships, and revenue We want someone who knows how to find opportunities, not just work from a list someone else gives them. CRM, GoHighLevel & Email Outreach Experience with GoHighLevel (GHL) is strongly preferred. title: Google Ads Strategist - Home Services
description: Remote (Philippines) | Contract Sustain Media is a local SEO and Google Ads agency built only for home service businesses: roofers, plumbers, HVAC companies, electricians, landscapers, restoration companies, and auto shops. Most of our clients are owner-operated businesses doing $2M to $10M a year. Our job is simple: more calls and more booked jobs. Ultimately, every metric has to connect back to qualified leads, booked work, and profitable growth. We’re hiring a Google Ads Strategist to join our paid media team. What Makes This Role Different We use AI agents to handle a growing share of the repetitive work most agencies still do by hand, including search term mining, campaign audits, performance diagnostics, and reporting data pulls. The systems get better every month. Right now, this role includes real implementation work. You’ll build campaigns, write ads, make bid changes, and manage accounts directly. We’re moving quickly on AI systems, and over the next few quarters, the role should become increasingly focused on strategy rather than implementation. That strategy includes understanding why a plumber in Portland needs a different structure than an HVAC company in Fort Wayne, when to push budget into a seasonal spike, when to pull back, and how to turn performance data into a growth plan for every account you run. If you want the strategy-only version of this job on day one, this is not it. If you want to grow into it as the systems mature, keep reading. What You’ll Own Your own book of clients. You’ll own your accounts end to end, working alongside another PPC specialist who manages a separate portfolio. You’ll manage Google Ads across home service accounts with different trades, markets, budgets, and growth goals. Each account needs its own strategy. Lead generation. These campaigns exist to drive phone calls, form fills, and booked jobs. You need to know how to build for that and measure it the way a business owner does: qualified lead volume, acquisition cost, booked work, and return on spend, not clicks and impressions alone. Tracking and attribution. A dashboard saying Google is working means nothing if the client’s phone is not ringing. You’ll own conversion tracking on every account and know how to verify which campaigns drive real calls, form fills, and booked jobs. New account builds. When a client signs, you architect the account from zero, including keyword research, campaign structure, ad copy, bidding, geo-targeting, conversion tracking, and launch. Judgment calls. Our AI agent, Viktor, provides audits and diagnostics. You d ---------- what to do with them: which bid strategy fits an account with 20 conversions a month versus 100, when Performance Max is supporting the account, when it is obscuring poor lead quality or wasting spend, and when to restructure instead of continuing to optimize around a flawed setup. Landing pages and offers. You work with our development and SEO teams so ad traffic lands on pages that convert. You guide the messaging and structure, but you do not build the pages. Monthly reporting. Viktor pulls the data. You write the story, explain what changed, and lay out the plan for the next month. What Success Looks Like In your first 90 days, you’ll take full ownership of a portfolio, confirm that tracking is trustworthy, identify the largest performance opportunities, and establish a clear strategy for each account. Longer term, success means improving qualified lead volume and booked-job economics while keeping clients confident in the direction of their campaigns. What We’re Looking For We care more about demonstrated results than years of experience, but this is not an entry-level role. Must-Haves Proven results running lead generation campaigns for local home service businesses Hands-on experience with Search, Performance Max, and Local Service Ads A strong understanding of conversion tracking. When a client says the leads are not coming in, “the dashboard looks fine” is not an answer. You know how to verify what is real. The ability to build an account from zero and defend every major choice you made The ability to read data and make strategic recommendations, not just report what a dashboard says Strong communication skills. You’ll be in Slack daily. Strong Pluses Strong attribution skills, including tracing ad spend through call tracking and offline conversions to booked jobs Experience with CallRail or similar call-tracking platforms An understanding of how Google Business Profile and local SEO work together with paid search Agency experience managing multiple accounts at once Comfort working with AI tools. You do not need to build automations, but you should want to use them. The Environment Remote, international team Contractor position, paid biweekly Base range: $1,500 to $2,000 USD per month, depending on experience Revenue share: after a certain amount of time with a client, you’ll begin earning an ongoing monthly share tied to how long that client stays with us. Realistically, this adds $200 to $500 per month within your first year and keeps growing as your book matures. It is paid every month for as long as the client stays. Daily tools: Google Ads, CallRail, Slack, Airtable, Google Sheets, and Viktor You can work from anywhere in the world, but you must work U.S. Eastern Time business hours. This is a firm rule, not a preference. There is no time tracking, and there never will be, but the Eastern Time schedule is non-negotiable. If you cannot commit to working these hours, do not apply. Our clients are month to month with no long-term contracts. We earn the business every 30 days, which means the work has to be good. Small, senior team. You work directly with the founder and the operations team.

title: YouTube Automation Specialist / Video Editor
description: We are looking for an experienced YouTube Automation Specialist / Video Editor who understands how to turn scripts, raw footage, clips, screenshots, and research into engaging YouTube videos that keep viewers watching. This is not an entry-level position. We are looking for someone who already has experience editing professional YouTube content and understands that great YouTube editing is about more than cutting clips together. You should understand storytelling, pacing, audience retention, motion graphics, thumbnails, titles, and YouTube SEO. The Role Your main responsibility will be taking a story or script and figuring out what the viewer should be seeing throughout the video. You may receive a script along with clips, streams, social media posts, screenshots, articles, and other source material. You should be able to independently piece those materials together into a cohesive visual story without needing every edit explained to you. You will be responsible for: Editing long-form YouTube videos Finding and selecting the best clips and visual moments Structuring footage around the story being told Creating strong hooks and maintaining viewer interest Using B-roll, screenshots, social posts, images, captions, music, and sound effects effectively Creating motion graphics and animated visual elements Using animated text, callouts, timelines, maps, charts, overlays, tracking, masking, and other graphics when appropriate Recognizing slow or unnecessary sections that could hurt retention Using pattern interrupts without making videos feel over-edited Helping develop high-CTR thumbnails Developing compelling YouTube titles Understanding YouTube SEO and discovery Making revisions based on feedback and video performance What We're Looking For The ideal candidate understands the difference between simply editing a video and building a visual story for YouTube. You should understand concepts such as: Audience retention Hooks and introductions Story structure Pacing Curiosity and open loops Pattern interrupts Clip and B-roll selection Motion graphics Thumbnail psychology Click-through rate YouTube titles YouTube SEO Average view duration and retention analytics When there isn't an obvious clip available for part of the script, you should be capable of figuring out how to visually communicate that information through graphics, screenshots, animation, B-roll, or other creative techniques. Motion Graphics Motion graphics experience is required. We want someone who can go beyond basic cuts, transitions, and captions. Experience creating elements such as animated typography, social media animations, callouts, timelines, maps, charts, tracked graphics, screen replacements, overlays, and custom visual sequences is valuable. Experience with Adobe After Effects or comparable motion graphics software is strongly preferred. Graphics should serve the story and help maintain attention—not simply be added for decoration. Requirements Previous professional YouTube editing experience Strong portfolio of previous YouTube work Long-form YouTube editing experience Motion graphics experience Strong English comprehension Excellent visual storytelling skills Strong understanding of pacing and retention Ability to work independently Ability to take a script and determine the appropriate visuals Reliable communication Ability to consistently meet deadlines Comfortable receiving feedback and making revisions Experience with professional editing software such as Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or equivalent Experience working with YouTube automation, documentary, commentary, creator/internet news, entertainment, or similar channels is a major advantage. Schedule & Turnaround Hours are flexible. We care more about the quality of your work and your ability to deliver projects quickly than what hours you choose to work. However, quick turnaround is extremely important. Some of our content is based on timely or trending stories, so videos may need to be completed quickly. You should be comfortable receiving a project and getting started without extensive supervision. Who We're Looking For We are not looking for an editor who needs to be told: "Put this clip here, add this graphic here, and make this cut here." We are looking for someone who naturally thinks: "What should the viewer be seeing right now, and what will keep them interested in what happens next?" The ideal candidate combines the skills of a video editor, visual storyteller, motion graphics designer, and YouTube strategist. This can become a consistent, long-term position for the right person. Payment Payment is made once per month via Wise (formerly TransferWise). Applicants must be able to receive payments through Wise. Payment terms and the agreed rate will be discussed before starting the position. This is intended to be a consistent, long-term role for the right person. A small trial video will be required unless profolio shows outstanding work and track record. How to Apply Complete our short application below. Your portfolio and previous YouTube work are extremely important and will be one of the primary things we use to evaluate candidates. Previous experience is required. Please do not apply if you do not have previous work to show. Apply for the YouTube Automation Specialist Position ---------- After submitting the application, you will be given the opportunity to schedule a short interview.

job_title: Senior Off-Page SEO & Link Building Specialist
description: OnePet is a portfolio of digitally native pet brands, including Total Vet, CertaPet, and Honest Paws. We help pet owners discover, decide, and purchase trustworthy products and services for their pets. We're looking for a highly resourceful Off-Page SEO & Link Building Specialist to own link acquisition and off-site authority building across 3-4 primary domains. This is a hands-on, high-autonomy role. We're looking for someone who can identify opportunities, decide how to attack them, and execute - not someone who needs a large team, detailed SOPs, or constant direction. Buying links can be a tactic. It cannot be your entire strategy. What You'll Do Your job is straightforward: build a stronger, more diverse, and more valuable backlink and off-site brand profile that contributes to higher rankings and more organic traffic. Creative link acquisition: Develop campaigns and angles that give publishers a real reason to link - original data, statistics, surveys, resources, visual assets, tools, awards, rankings, expert contributions, or ideas we haven't thought of yet. Digital PR & media outreach: Find newsworthy angles, identify journalists and publishers, pitch stories and expertise, and turn those relationships into coverage, links, and brand mentions. Traditional link building: Execute competitive link-gap analysis, reclamation, broken-link opportunities, unlinked mentions, resource outreach, guest contributions, partnerships, directories, and other proven tactics. Paid placements: Identify worthwhile opportunities, evaluate quality and risk, negotiate pricing and terms, and determine whether the expected value justifies the cost. GEO & brand visibility: Pursue relevant brand mentions, citations, and off-site signals that can improve visibility across ChatGPT, Google AI experiences, Perplexity, and other answer engines - not just traditional search. Experimentation: Continuously test new approaches while maintaining reliable campaigns that produce consistent results. Not every experiment needs to work. The overall program does. How You'll Operate You'll have substantial freedom to determine how you get results. We expect you to understand the backlink profiles of the sites you're responsible for, identify the biggest opportunities, communicate what you're pursuing, and then execute. Use AI heavily. Automate where it makes sense. Build relationships. Negotiate. Develop assets. Run outreach. Find creative shortcuts. Use whatever legitimate resources and processes help you produce better results. You will not be micromanaged. In return, you'll be accountable for outcomes. If an opportunity carries meaningful SEO, reputational, or financial risk, we expect you to recognize it and discuss the risk/reward with us before proceeding. Otherwise, use good judgment and keep moving. How We'll Measure Success The primary scorecard starts with high-quality referring domains, links, brand mentions, and citations acquired. Quality and relevance of referring domains Number and diversity of links acquired Brand mentions and AI/answer-engine citations Growth and quality of our backlink profiles Cost and value of paid acquisitions Performance of different campaigns and tactics The goal is improved rankings, search visibility, and organic traffic. We'll have lightweight weekly and monthly reporting, and you'll maintain enough structured tracking for us to understand which sources, tactics, and campaigns are producing the best results. What We're Looking For We care more about what you've accomplished than how many years you've been doing it. Acquire high-quality backlinks through multiple strategies - not just paid placements or mass outreach. Evaluate whether a backlink opportunity is genuinely valuable using data and judgment. Develop and execute creative link-building campaigns from idea through acquisition. Conduct effective outreach to journalists, bloggers, publishers, website owners, and partners. Evaluate and negotiate paid placements rather than simply accepting quoted prices. Use competitive backlink analysis, reclamation, prospecting, and other core off-page SEO techniques. Understand GEO/AEO and the growing importance of off-site brand mentions and citations. Use AI to dramatically increase your research, prospecting, outreach, analysis, and execution capacity. Run multiple campaigns independently and prioritize your time based on expected impact. Communicate effectively in English internally and externally. Know when to experiment, when to scale something that works, and when to stop wasting time on something that doesn't. We don't care what industry you've worked in. We don't care whether you learned link building at an agency, in-house, independently, or somewhere else. We care whether you can produce results. Tools & Resources Ahrefs Google Search Console SEO Gets Claude company subscription If another tool or resource will materially improve results, make the case for it. The same applies to campaign and link-acquisition spend. We don't have a rigid price we're willing to pay for a link. Budget follows value. Find the opportunity, evaluate it intelligently, negotiate it well, and tell us why it's worth the investment. The Role in One Sentence Own off-page SEO across several domains, attack link acquisition from multiple angles, use AI and your own resourcefulness to execute at a high level, and be accountable for measurable results. If that's already how you approach link building, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Wix Website Designer – Long-Term Position

title: Entry-Level Technical SEO Specialist
description: Entry-Level Technical SEO Specialist We are looking for an analytical, detail-oriented Entry-Level Technical SEO Specialist to join our growing digital marketing team. If you are fascinated by how search engines crawl, render, and index websites, and you want to build a career optimizing the technical architecture of the web, we want to train and mentor you. In this role, you will look under the hood of websites to find and fix the structural issues that prevent them from ranking, working closely with our content team and web developers. Key Responsibilities Site Auditing: Assist in performing regular technical SEO audits using industry tools to identify crawlability and indexability issues (e.g., 404 errors, redirect chains, orphan pages). Performance Monitoring: Track website health and coverage errors using Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools. Page Speed Optimization: Help analyze Core Web Vitals and work with developers to improve site speed and mobile-friendliness. On-Page Technical Fixes: Review and optimize XML sitemaps, robots.txt files, canonical tags, and pagination. Structured Data: Assist in generating and implementing basic Schema markup (JSON-LD) to help win rich snippets in search results. Data Analysis: Use Google Analytics and Excel/Google Sheets to track how technical changes impact organic traffic and user behavior. Qualifications & Skills SEO Foundation: A clear understanding of basic SEO concepts and how search engines work (crawling, indexing, and ranking). Web Basics: Familiarity with fundamental web technologies, specifically HTML and CSS. (Basic JavaScript knowledge is a huge plus). Analytical Mindset: Comfortable working with data, spotting trends, and using spreadsheets (VLOOKUPs, pivot tables). Problem Solver: A curious mindset that enjoys troubleshooting technical puzzles and figuring out why a page isn't ranking. Attention to Detail: Meticulous execution, as technical SEO changes can significantly impact a live website.

title: SEO Specialist
description: The SEO Specialist is responsible for improving the company’s organic search visibility, increasing qualified website traffic, and supporting inbound lead generation through consistent SEO execution. This role owns the day-to-day implementation and monitoring of SEO initiatives, including keyword strategy, website optimization, content recommendations, technical SEO monitoring, reporting, and coordination with the broader marketing team. Success in this role is measured by consistent execution and measurable improvements in search visibility, organic traffic, rankings, and conversions — not simply by completing SEO tasks. Core Responsibilities 1. SEO Strategy & Execution - Conduct keyword research based on business priorities, target audiences, services, and search opportunities. - Develop and maintain a keyword strategy and keyword mapping system. - Optimize website pages, service pages, blogs, and landing pages for organic search. - Manage on-page SEO, including: - Page titles and meta descriptions - Headers and content structure - Internal linking - Image optimization - URLs - Keyword placement and search intent alignment - Identify opportunities to improve existing website content. - Develop SEO recommendations and briefs for new content. - Support off-page SEO initiatives, including backlink and partnership opportunities. - Monitor technical SEO issues that may impact search visibility and coordinate fixes as needed. - Monitor competitor SEO activity and identify opportunities for improvement. 2. SEO Performance & Reporting - Monitor organic traffic, keyword rankings, impressions, clicks, conversions, and other agreed SEO metrics. - Track whether SEO activities are contributing to qualified website inquiries and business growth. - Identify declining pages, ranking losses, technical issues, and other risks early. - Provide clear recommendations based on performance data. - Maintain visibility into SEO initiatives currently in progress, completed, blocked, or planned. - Prepare monthly SEO reports that explain: - What changed - What was completed - What improved or declined - Why performance changed - What will be done next 3. Content & Cross-Channel Alignment - Work with the content and marketing teams to ensure content supports SEO priorities. - Recommend topics based on keyword opportunities, search demand, competitor gaps, and business goals. - Provide SEO briefs before new website or blog content is created. - Ensure SEO priorities align with broader marketing campaigns. - Collaborate with Sales and Client Success when needed to understand common customer questions, search behavior, and lead quality. 4. Email Marketing & Automation Support Where applicable, the SEO Specialist will also support email marketing initiatives by: - Developing and maintaining email campaigns aligned with marketing objectives. - Segmenting audiences and personalizing messaging. - Building and maintaining welcome, nurture, reactivation, and other automation workflows. - Conducting A/B testing on subject lines, messaging, offers, and timing. - Monitoring open rates, click-through rates, conversions, and engagement. - Using SEO insights to support email topics and using email performance insights to inform content strategy. Key Deliverables Weekly - SEO activity/progress update - Current priorities and completed work - Keyword/ranking movement - Issues or blockers requiring escalation - Next week's priorities Monthly - SEO performance report - Organic traffic and conversion analysis - Keyword ranking report - Completed optimization summary - Recommended actions for the following month Quarterly - Updated keyword mapping - SEO strategy review - Competitor/search opportunity analysis - Content and optimization roadmap Performance Indicators (KPIs) The SEO Specialist will be evaluated based on both execution KPIs and outcome KPIs. Execution KPIs - % of planned SEO initiatives completed on time - SEO content/optimization deliverables completed - Reporting submitted on schedule - Technical SEO issues identified and resolved/escalated - Content briefs and recommendations completed - Responsiveness and cross-functional collaboration Outcome KPIs - Organic traffic growth - Growth in qualified organic inquiries/leads - Improvement in rankings for priority keywords - Search impressions and clicks - Organic conversion rate - Growth in ranking pages/keywords - Performance of optimized pages - Email open, click-through, and conversion rates where email is included in scope

title: Social Media Ad Designer / Creative Monster
job_title: Social Media Ad Designer / Creative Monster
description: Hi social media addict ???? Yes, we mean you. The person who spends way too much time scrolling Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and ---------- . Who notices weird ads. Saves clever creatives. Sees a meme and immediately thinks: “This could actually be an ad.” And who understands why some ads make you stop scrolling… while others disappear into the feed. We are looking for a creative / social media monster who can help us take our ads to the next level. Not just someone who knows Canva or Photoshop. And definitely not someone who takes a template, changes the colors and calls it a day. We’re looking for someone who understands advertising. Someone who can take an idea from us and turn it into something that makes people stop, look and understand the message within seconds. One VERY important thing: You need to understand the Dutch / European advertising style. Dutch ads are often cleaner, more direct, more subtle and less “salesy”. Typography matters. Spacing matters. Photography matters. The words you emphasize matter. We need someone who sees the difference between something that feels natural in the feed and something that immediately screams “advertisement”. You don't necessarily need to have worked for a Dutch company before. But you do need to be able to study our market, understand our references and adapt your design style to it. What will you create? Mostly social media ads for Facebook and Instagram. And we like experimenting. One day it might be a clean ad. The next day: * A fake WhatsApp conversation * A handwritten note * A timer inside a work van * A meme * A Reddit-style post * A screenshot-style creative * A realistic AI-generated scene * Or something completely new The concept comes first. We don't want every ad to look like an advertisement. Some of our best-performing ads don't. How we work Most of the time, we come up with the marketing concept. For example: “We want to show a mechanic sitting in his van with a timer counting down until he can finally go home.” Your job isn't just to execute it. We want your brain to start working too. What should it look like? What should someone notice first? How do we make it believable? Could the idea be even better? We don't need an order taker. We want a creative sparring partner. You might be our person if… * You regularly create social media ads * You understand what makes people stop scrolling * You follow memes, trends, formats and advertising concepts * You understand typography, hierarchy, spacing and composition * You know how to use text without turning an ad into a flyer * You understand that the prettiest ad isn't always the best-performing ad * You have a strong eye for photography and realistic imagery * You know when AI looks good and when it looks painfully fake * You use Canva, Photoshop, Figma or similar tools * You are comfortable using AI in your workflow * You can work independently * You aren't afraid to challenge an idea Experience with Meta Ads or performance marketing is a big plus. Things that make us cry Please don't send us: * Generic Canva templates * Stock photo + giant headline + icons + logo * Designs with six different fonts * Creatives with 37 things fighting for attention * Fake-looking AI people * Perfect designs that communicate absolutely nothing * Copies of other ads without understanding why they work We love AI. We use it ourselves every day. But AI should make your creative work better. It should never replace good taste. About us We create social media advertising campaigns for companies in the Netherlands. Our job is to make people stop scrolling, understand a message quickly and take action. You'll mainly work together with our Marketing Manager, who has been running Meta advertising campaigns for more than 10 years and loves testing new creative concepts. We're informal, ambitious and constantly experimenting. If something works, we improve it. If something doesn't, we kill it and try something else. No ego. Just better ads. Before you apply… Please do NOT send us a portfolio full of logos, business cards, menus and PowerPoint presentations. We're hiring you to make ads. So we want to see ADS. Send us 3–5 social media advertisements you personally designed. Preferably work aimed at Dutch or European audiences. For your strongest ad, briefly tell us: Why do you think this one works? We just want to understand how your brain works. And one final thing: Start your application with the word “Scrollstopper”. That way we know you actually made it this far. ???? If you live and breathe social media, love making ads and think you can surprise us creatively… We want to see your work.

title: Customer Service E-commerce (Fluent English, Weekend Availability Required)
job_title: Customer Service E-commerce (Fluent English, Weekend Availability Required)
description: Are YOU an experienced customer service representative who can read the emotion behind a two-line email and respond like a real, warm, thinking human being — not a copy-pasted bot reply? Can you handle a chargeback dispute on a digital product and actually have a shot at winning it, knowing exactly what evidence matters when there's no tracking number or delivery signature to show? If you answered an enthusiastic "YES" to both questions above, KEEP READING. We run multiple international companies in the ecommerce and digital education space, including a growing catalog of craft and DIY digital products, selling primarily to English-speaking customers in the US, UK, EU and Australia. We're looking for a Customer Service Representative to join our support team and take full ownership of the post-purchase customer experience. We need someone to take responsibility for: Inbox Ownership: Handling our daily support inbox end-to-end — order access issues, missing downloads, billing questions, refund requests, and general product questions — as the friendly, reliable human voice of the brand. Retention-First Problem Solving: Before ever processing a refund, identifying and offering the right retention or bonus-bundle offer per our SOP. A refund is always the last resort, not the first move. Chargeback & Dispute Defense: Responding to chargebacks and payment disputes on digital products with the right evidence (delivery confirmation, access logs, communication history, terms accepted at checkout) — you understand this is a different game than physical-product disputes, and you know a genuinely high win-rate claim doesn't exist in this space. Template Adaptation, Not Scripting: We provide a complete SOP with email templates for every common scenario. Your job is to use them as a base and adapt the tone naturally to each customer — never robotic, never obviously AI-generated or copy-pasted. Escalation Judgment: Knowing exactly when a situation (legal threat, unusual request outside our templates, a case that just doesn't smell right) needs to be flagged to us instead of improvised. Daily Reporting: Keeping a simple log of ticket volume and any recurring issues you notice, so we can fix problems at the source. Position Requirements: At least 2 years of specific customer service experience for digital products — not physical/shipping-based ecommerce. You must know the practical difference between a refund and a chargeback, and have direct experience responding to disputes where a tracking number isn't an option. Fluent English, 9/10 or above: natural, native-sounding phrasing — not translated-sounding sentences. As part of the application, you'll be asked to record a short 60-second video or voice response to a question you haven't seen in advance. This isn't optional — written answers alone won't be considered. A real thinking mind, not an AI-generated response: we will read your written answers closely, and generic, overly polished, ChatGPT-flavored replies will be filtered out immediately. We want your judgment, not a prompt's. Comfortable with our tools: Google Drive (sharing, permissions, troubleshooting access errors), PDF delivery, and a shared support inbox/helpdesk. Availability & Commitment: This role requires coverage 7 days a week, including Saturday and Sunday — no exceptions, no "9-to-5, Monday-Friday" mentality. Minimum 3 hours/day, structured as short check-ins spread across your day (morning / afternoon / evening, your own local time zone). Please tell us honestly: how many other clients/hours are you currently working, and would you see this growing toward full-time with us in the coming weeks or months? Obsessive Precision & Anti-Mediocrity: correct order numbers, correct links, zero copy-paste mistakes in a customer's name or order details. Mediocrity is not allowed in our team. What We Offer: A complete, ready-to-use Customer Service SOP with templates for every common scenario, plus clear escalation guidelines — you'll never be guessing. A short, paid trial period before any long-term commitment. Career Growth: real potential to become the lead/only customer service representative across our full catalog as it expands, with performance-based rate increases and a path toward full-time. Screening Questions (Upwork): Please write a 3-4 sentence sample reply to this customer message: "Hi, I purchased the ebook bundle two days ago but never received the download email. Can you help?" Have you handled disputes/chargebacks on digital products before? If so, roughly what percentage have you been able to win, and what evidence/approach did you use? (Be honest — we're checking for real experience, not a number.) What's your current workload with other clients (hours/week), and do you see yourself moving toward full-time with us in the coming weeks or months? This role requires 7-day-a-week availability, minimum 3 hours/day split into short check-ins across your day — not Mon-Fri only, and not one continuous block. Please confirm you're comfortable with this on an ongoing basis, and share your proposed check-in times in your own time zone. To Apply: Include the sample reply above directly in your application, along with a brief note on your relevant experience. Shortlisted candidates will be asked for a short 60-second video or voice response before moving forward.

title: Klaviyo Email/SMS Strategist — Full Migration + Ongoing Campaign Management (Shopify + Funnelish)
job_title: Klaviyo Email/SMS Strategist — Full Migration + Ongoing Campaign Management (Shopify + Funnelish)
description: We're a growing e-commerce brand in the craft-education space (digital products + a new physical product line, selling primarily in the US, UK, Australia, and Canada) looking for a Klaviyo expert to own our email/SMS channel end to end — not just execute a migration, but think strategically about how email drives revenue for us long-term. PHASE 1 — MIGRATION Migrate all existing flows from Omnisend to Klaviyo: abandoned checkout, abandoned cart, post-purchase (including cross-sell/upsell sequences to move customers into our other products), welcome series, win-back Full segmentation setup: customer behavior, product ownership, engagement tiers, subscription status Deep integration work: Shopify (Shopify Payments), Funnelish (our funnel builder — orders and events need to flow correctly from both platforms into Klaviyo, not just standard Shopify checkout events), Zapier (some of our automations, like community access provisioning, run through Zapier and need to stay intact) Subscription/recurring product flows (we have a subscription-based community product) SMS compliance setup (TCPA, proper opt-in) for US lists PHASE 2 — ONGOING (this is the core of the role) Plan and send 2-3 email campaigns per week beyond the automated flows — product launches, promotions, content-driven sends Continuously refine flows based on performance data, not "set and forget" Study our customer avatar and actually write/strategize around it — we need someone who understands who they're writing to, not just someone filling in a template Bring ideas to the table: new flow opportunities, segmentation we haven't thought of, testing strategy Comfortable using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) to work efficiently — we want someone who uses AI as leverage, not someone we have to explain AI to WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR Strong Klaviyo experience with measurable results (revenue attributed to flows/campaigns, list growth, open/click rates) — not just "familiar with the platform" Experience with Shopify; bonus if you've worked with a funnel builder (Funnelish, ClickFunnels, or similar) alongside a standard Shopify store Zapier / automation logic comfort This is a strategic role, not a copy-paste-template role — please don't apply if you're only comfortable executing exact instructions Genuine interest in understanding the product and the customer, not just the tool PROOF OF WORK Please share 1-2 examples where you owned an email/SMS channel strategically (not just built flows) — include what you changed, why, and the measurable outcome. ENGAGEMENT TYPE Freelance / ongoing contract, monthly retainer. Please share your rate expectations along with your application.

Direct Booking Growth & Lifecycle Marketing -Grow bookings on our direct website ( ---------- ), working alongside our paid-ads freelancer -Own the guest database: post-stay win-back campaigns, seasonal offers to past guests, and a repeat-guest recognition programme that shifts OTA guests to direct -Build a referral mechanism for guests and corporate contacts -Recapture lost demand: cancelled bookings, expired quotes and abandoned direct-site sessions get structured follow-up offers -Improve on-site conversion through offers, copy and booking-journey feedback 6. Occupancy Gap-Filling -Monitor the portfolio calendar weekly; identify soft periods 2–6 weeks out and act before they arrive -Sell gaps proactively: outreach to corporate contacts, targeted past-guest offers, location-hire placements, strategic LOS relaxation -Coordinate all tactics with the pricing strategy so gap-filling never erodes the rate position KPIs -RevPAR per property vs. target (the headline metric) -Incremental revenue generated per month, by stream -Portfolio occupancy vs. baseline, with rate integrity maintained -Direct booking share vs. OTA share -Upsell attach rate and ancillary revenue per booking -Repeat-guest rate and guest database growth -Number of active corporate/relocation/agency accounts producing bookings What We Are Looking For Must have -3+ years in revenue management, commercial or business development within short- term rentals, serviced apartments, hotels, corporate housing or relocation services -Demonstrable record of revenue you personally generated or grew — you will be asked for specifics and numbers -Working command of revenue metrics: occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, LOS, channel contribution, attach rate -Excellent spoken and written English; description: JOB OVERVIEW We are looking for a highly creative Short Form Video Editor to work long term with an independent Christian hip hop artist. Your Best 3 to 5 Relevant Videos Only include examples that represent the type of editing we are hiring for. We would rather see three incredible edits than twenty average ones. Please prioritize: • Music content • Artist content • Creator content • Gen Z content • Entertainment content • Fast paced short form videos • Creative social media edits Please DO NOT fill the folder with unrelated business or corporate work. 2. Short Introduction Include a short document answering: Why does this specific position interest you? What type of content do you personally enjoy editing? At that stage, we will evaluate whether your creative style fits what we are building. Some applicants may also be invited to complete a paid test edit. description: We are a Medicare-certified home health agency seeking a dependable and detail-oriented individual with Medicare home health experience to prepare and manage Pre-Claim Review submissions through the PGBA portal. Primary Responsibilities • Prepare Medicare Home Health Pre-Claim Review submissions through PGBA. • Gather and organize all required documentation for each submission. • Review clinical documentation for completeness before submission. • Identify missing, inconsistent, or potentially insufficient documentation. • Verify that required records are included, such as face-to-face documentation, orders, plans of care, certifications, OASIS assessments, and therapy documentation. • Upload documents accurately and in the correct order. • Submit Pre-Claim Review requests within established deadlines. • Monitor the PGBA portal for decisions, requests, and status updates. • Track submitted, affirmed, non-affirmed, pending, and resubmitted requests. • Download and properly file decision letters and related documentation. • Notify others promptly when documentation issues may delay submission or affect affirmation. • Maintain accurate internal spreadsheets and tracking systems. • Follow established workflows, checklists, and naming conventions. • Protect all patient information and follow HIPAA and company confidentiality requirements. Qualifications • Registered Nurse (RN) or Licensed Vocational Nurse (LVN) preferred. • Previous experience working with a Medicare-certified home health agency. • Reliable high-speed internet and a dependable computer. • Ability to work full-time during U.S. Central Time business hours. • Experience reviewing clinical documentation, physician orders, plans of care, certifications, OASIS assessments, visit notes, and related medical records. • Ability to recognize missing, conflicting, or potentially insufficient clinical documentation that is required for Pre-Claim Review. • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy. • Excellent English proficiency, both written and spoken. • Strong organizational and time-management skills. • Ability to manage multiple submissions and deadlines without losing accuracy. • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Teams, PDF documents, and web-based portals. • Direct experience with PGBA, Palmetto GBA, Review Choice Demonstration, or Medicare Pre-Claim Review submissions preferred. • Experience tracking Medicare affirmations, non-affirmations, resubmissions, ADRs, or other medical review activity preferred. • Experience with WellSky EMR preferred.

Property management accounting: Minimum three years of hands-on accounting or bookkeeping experience in residential property management or real estate. 14. We are looking for an easy-going, yet professional, friendly, and HONEST person. • You will be working from home. Customers should feel like they are talking to a person who is on their side. You stay calm with angry people. Some customers write in furious.
