We care about **quality appointments, not just quantity.** Strong performers will have opportunities for increased compensation and additional responsibility. ## Schedule This position requires working during **U.S. business hours**. I just wanted to ask you a couple of quick questions and see if we might be able to help. How old would you say your current HVAC system is?” We will evaluate your: * Spoken English * Pronunciation and clarity * Confidence * Conversational ability * Phone presence * Ability to sound natural rather than simply reading a script **Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.** We're looking for someone who wants a **long-term position**, is motivated by performance, and wants the opportunity to earn more as they produce results.

title: Senior Meta and TikTok Media Buyer
job_title: Senior Meta and TikTok Media Buyer
description: Second Screen Digital is a Los Angeles-based performance marketing agency looking for an experienced Paid Social Media Buyer who is equally comfortable developing high-level strategy and handling the technical details required to make campaigns work. This is a remote position, but you must be available to work consistent U.S. business hours and collaborate with our team and clients during the Pacific Time workday. We need someone who can do more than launch ads and report on ROAS. You should understand the full paid social ecosystem—from campaign structure, creative testing, and budget allocation to UTMs, pixel implementation, event tracking, attribution, catalog troubleshooting, and quality control. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys finding opportunities for growth but is also willing to dig into the less glamorous work behind the scenes. Sometimes the problem is the strategy. Sometimes it’s a broken event, an incorrect UTM, or a product catalog having a bad day. You should be comfortable diagnosing all of it. What You’ll Do * Develop and execute paid social strategies across Meta and TikTok * Build, launch, manage, and optimize campaigns based on each client’s objectives * Manage e-commerce and lead-generation accounts with varying budgets and levels of complexity * Create thoughtful campaign structures that support testing, scaling, and accurate reporting * Develop testing roadmaps for audiences, offers, messaging, formats, landing pages, and creative concepts * Analyze performance beyond surface-level platform metrics to identify what is actually driving results * Make strategic decisions about budget allocation, scaling, consolidation, and account structure * Translate performance data into clear, actionable recommendations for clients and internal teams * Collaborate with creative strategists, designers, editors, account managers, and other media buyers * Provide clear creative feedback based on performance trends and audience behavior * Monitor pacing, spend, efficiency, tracking accuracy, and campaign health * Identify performance issues early and take ownership of solving them * Stay current on platform changes, new ad formats, measurement updates, and paid social best practices Tracking and Technical Responsibilities You must be fully comfortable owning the technical details of paid social advertising, including: * Creating and maintaining accurate UTM structures * Installing, reviewing, and troubleshooting Meta Pixels and TikTok Pixels * Setting up and validating standard and custom conversion events * Working with Meta Conversions API and TikTok Events API * Testing events using platform diagnostic and event-testing tools * Reviewing event prioritization, deduplication, match quality, and attribution settings * Using Google Tag Manager and GA4 to support campaign tracking and reporting * Troubleshooting discrepancies between ad platforms, Shopify, GA4, Triple Whale, and other attribution tools * Setting up and troubleshooting product catalogs, feeds, and dynamic product ads * Conducting detailed pre-launch quality-control checks * Documenting tracking setups, campaign structures, tests, and account changes * Diagnosing technical issues instead of immediately assuming poor performance is a creative or audience problem What We’re Looking For * At least 3–5 years of hands-on paid social media buying experience * Strong experience managing both Meta Ads and TikTok Ads * Demonstrated success managing and scaling e-commerce campaigns * Experience with lead-generation campaigns is a plus * Strong knowledge of campaign architecture, testing methodology, attribution, and performance analysis * Hands-on experience with pixels, conversion events, UTMs, product feeds, and server-side tracking * Working knowledge of Shopify, Google Analytics 4, and Google Tag Manager * Experience with attribution platforms such as Triple Whale is a plus * Ability to distinguish between a creative problem, an offer problem, a landing-page problem, a tracking problem, and a media-buying problem * Strong analytical skills and confidence working with large amounts of performance data * Excellent attention to detail, particularly during setup and quality control * Clear written and verbal communication skills * Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities * A proactive, solution-oriented mindset * Willingness to take ownership of both strategy and execution * Reliable availability during U.S. business hours, with regular overlap during Pacific Time * Ability to attend scheduled team meetings and respond to time-sensitive client or campaign needs during the U.S. workday ## You’ll Be a Strong Fit If You * Can explain not only what happened in an account, but why it happened and what should happen next * Know when to follow platform best practices and when the data supports a different approach * Enjoy developing strategy but do not consider tracking, naming conventions, documentation, or QA “someone else’s job” * Can turn performance data into useful feedback for a creative team * Catch small errors before they become expensive ones * Communicate concerns early and arrive with potential solutions * Are comfortable being accountable for results without pretending every outcome is fully within the ad platform * Approach media buying with curiosity, discipline, and sound judgment * Work well with a distributed, international team while maintaining consistent U.S. working hours ## What Success Looks Like * Campaigns are launched accurately, on time, and without preventable tracking or setup errors * Client budgets are managed responsibly and paced appropriately * Testing is structured around clear hypotheses rather than random changes * Performance insights lead to better creative, stronger landing pages, and smarter account decisions * Reporting is accurate, meaningful, and connected to the client’s business goals * Account issues are identified and resolved proactively * Clients and internal team members understand what is working, what is not, and what we are doing next ## About Second Screen Digital Second Screen Digital is a Los Angeles-based performance marketing agency supporting growing brands through paid media, creative strategy, email marketing, SEO, and web design. Although our team works remotely, our clients and core operations are based in the United States. Team members in this role must maintain reliable availability during U.S. business hours and collaborate regularly with colleagues working in Pacific Time. We value integrity, excellence, clear communication, thoughtful problem-solving, and people who take genuine ownership of their work. This is not a role for someone who wants to press a few buttons, check the dashboard, and call it media buying. We are looking for someone who understands how strategy, creative, tracking, attribution, and execution work together—and is comfortable owning the details that make strong performance possible.

title: Full-time Bookkeeper
description: Who We Are - Hello; my name is Casandra Armstrong, and I am the President of Resilient Pro Group LLC. We are an accounting and tax firm based out of Phoenix, AZ (United States). We are a small, but growing company and are experiencing quite a bit of growth. This has pushed the need for us to hire you, our newest team member. We help small businesses, just like ours, maintain, manage, and grow their businesses by ensuring accurate financials, processing payroll for their employees, tax preparation and strategy. We ensure we can take as much off the owner’s plate as possible while building trust within our working relationships. You’re probably wondering if you would be our first Filipino team member? Actually, no. We currently have 4 team members who are from the Philippines like yourself. We have 2 bookkeeping specialists, a tax specialist, and an administrative specialist that are based in the Philippines as well. In addition to them, our operations manager is US based. If you’re wondering what you would be doing? The job title is Bookkeeping Specialist. I am looking for someone who can perform detailed bookkeeping for several small business clients. Your primary duties as a bookkeeper would include document processing, data entry, account reconciliation, ledger management, and financial report processing while understanding the business structure and needs. We are QuickBooks based, so a QuickBooks background is required. However, we will also train on processes. So, why should you join us over anyone and everyone else? If you would like… 1) a steady pay check with the chance for bonuses based on performance, 2) the opportunity to work from home without a boss breathing down your neck, 3) a team environment where you work with others to share the work, and 4 ) if you want to work for a stable, growing U.S. firm, …then this is a job you will enjoy and excel at. How to know if you’re qualified for this opportunity? We are looking for someone who has bookkeeping experience, complete understanding of debits and credits, assets and liabilities, inter-company transfers, problem solving skills, fluent in English speaking and writing with the experience of speaking directly with US clients, and most importantly someone who can work with little to no direction and meet deadlines. We do not expect you to know it all as we will train you in your position with everything you need to know about our clients and our field for you to be able to excel at your job. I do need you to be a good leader- someone who can effectively manage him or herself at the job as well as manage others; someone who has extensive attention to detail, can manage and meet deadlines, follow processes and provide ideas for enhanced processes, problem solve and troubleshoot on their own with little to no direction, be able to effectively resolve issues with upset clients. Intermediate bookkeeping/accounting experience, and QuickBooks experience is required. I also cannot teach you to have a good attitude and to be self-motivated. These are things you must demonstrate in the interview process. A successful applicant must be able to demonstrate: * A can do attitude, and the ability to work without constant supervision * Be able to speak in conversational English and write in passable English as well * Knowledge of Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, Dropbox, QuickBooks, and general ability to use windows based software * Have or be willing to obtain Internet fast enough to allow for virtual meeting such as zoom and VOIP phone calls without degradation * Working microphone and Internet video camera * Workstation with 2 monitors So, what are the working hours? As I stated before, our company is based in Phoenix, Arizona so we would require you to work during the US business hours, Monday to Friday 8:00am to 5:30pm Arizona Time What about pay? We are serious about hiring someone and are looking to fill this position ASAP. I also want this to be a real job that can meet your financial needs. Therefore, pay is negotiable but know I want you to be happy and satisfied working here, and a good pay scale is part of that. What about the 13th Month? Wondering if we pay the 13th month? Unfortunately, we do not. However, we do offer other benefits such as pay time off, holiday pay, and sick time for Full-Time positions. These benefits begin to accrue after your 90 days probation period of a full-time position. What happens next? Since our jobs are so popular we generally get deluged with applicants. So, I have designed a multi-part interview process to make the process as simple and efficient for all parties. The first part of the interview process is designed to examine your English-speaking & writing skills, personality type, internet speed and ability to follow directions. Please realize the initial application process will take a time commitment on your part of roughly 10-20 minutes. Since this job is intended to be well paying, I hope this time commitment is acceptable to you. Please be advised that those who submit incomplete applications will be passed over. If you make it through this first round, we will talk via video chat to answer any questions you may have as well as get to know you better. If this goes well, I will invite you to meet some other team members, as well as call your references to see if there is still a good fit. We will then ultimately hire someone. How to Apply Therefore, to submit your application for the job, please complete all of the following and email them to me at the reply to email address: ---------- Please send me all the following to applications at resilientpros dot com a. Your resume b. Link to your onlinejobs.ph profile and, c. Names with your relationship for 3 people I can contact whom would say good things about working with you. This could be a priest, former employer, bank manager, school teacher, but no more than 1 of these people can be a family member. 2. Please also complete the tests at the following link and provide a copy of your results: ---------- /leveltest/grammar_level_test.htm ---------- /disc-personality-test/ ---------- /tools/speed-test/work-from-home-speed Please be advised that incomplete applications will be ignored. I know this sounds harsh, but this is a detailed job, and I need to know you can follow directions.

job_title: Full-Stack Developer & Automation Engineer (Next.js, Supabase, Web Scraping & AI APIs)
description: We are launching a highly automated, global city event discovery platform. The platform relies entirely on programmatic data pipelines—scraping events from high-authority, premium sources (museums, galleries, established ticket hubs), using LLM APIs to automatically categorize, tag, and score them, and rendering them on a custom, ultra-fast color-coded visual interface. We are looking for a highly capable, autonomous Full-Stack Developer & Automation Engineer to build, launch, optimize, and maintain this system. You will be the sole technical engine behind this platform, working directly with the founder to scale it from London across Europe and the USA. Core Responsibilities: 1. Build & Maintain Scrapers: Design robust, automated scraping pipelines using Node.js, Puppeteer, or Playwright to ingest event listings from designated Tier-1 websites and APIs. 2. AI Pipeline Integration: Connect scrapers to the Gemini API (Flash/Haiku) to clean raw text, extract parameters, assign primary color categories based on strict priority logic, generate short summaries, and produce confidence scores. 3. Develop Frontend UI: Build and maintain an ultra-fast, mobile-first, interactive visual calendar grid using Next.js (React) and Tailwind CSS. 4. Programmatic SEO Optimization: Set up dynamic routing structures and ensure perfect, automated implementation of structured JSON-LD Event Schema on every listing page. 5. Database & Backend Architecture: Manage the PostgreSQL/Supabase database, configure automated cron jobs for data synchronization, and build a secure backend admin dashboard for anomaly verification. 6. Proactive System Monitoring: Monitor system health logs. If a source site changes its HTML structure and a scraper breaks, you must diagnose, patch, and rerun the pipeline autonomously. Technical Requirements: 1. Frontend: Expert-level Next.js (React), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS. Highly focused on web performance and Core Web Vitals. 2. Backend & DB: Proficient with Node.js, PostgreSQL, and Supabase (including Edge Functions and cron triggers). 3. Data Ingestion: Confident writing script scrapers that successfully handle dynamic, JavaScript-heavy sites (Playwright/Puppeteer) and bypass basic security blocks. 4. AI Frameworks: Hands-on experience working with LLM APIs, handling structured JSON outputs, prompt engineering, and optimizing token consumption costs. 5. SEO: Strong understanding of technical SEO principles, programmatic page generation, and structured microdata ( ---------- ). Soft Skills: 1. High Autonomy: Ability to take a conceptual workflow layout and build out the system infrastructure with minimal daily supervision. 2. Systems Thinker: You prefer fixing a prompt's underlying instruction logic over manually editing a single broken database entry.Excellent 3. English Communication: Clear documentation skills for codebases, system diagrams, and logging errors. HOW TO APPLY (Mandatory Screening Questions): Applications that do not explicitly answer the following 3 questions in their cover letter will be archived automatically without review. 1. In 2–3 sentences, explain your preferred approach for configuring a Node.js script to pass raw scraped text to the Gemini Flash API and guarantee it safely returns a structured JSON object every time. 2. description: We're a US-based video marketing agency producing cinematic short-form video ads for our clients. We're busy, which means steady, ongoing work for the right person. This starts as a part-time, per-video arrangement. If you're good and reliable, this grows. --- WHAT YOU'LL BE EDITING Short-form vertical video ads (1-2 minutes), typically built around a script OR unscripted testimonials with b-roll and stock footage layered in. Clean, cinematic, and premium-looking content. This is important: What we're NOT looking for is an editor who relies on flashy transitions, flying text, and motion effects to carry a video. If your best work is built around those things, we're probably not the right fit. If your best work is built around making footage feel intentional and polished - we want to hear from you. What we care about is the fundamentals: pacing decisions, choosing the best takes, b-roll selection, color correction, and clean storytelling. --- WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR We can teach technical skills. What's harder to find - and what we care about most - is two things: 1. Attention to detail and ability to learn from feedback. Before you send any edit, you've already watched it three times and caught every issue yourself. We understand mistakes happen, but we should never have to tell you something twice. 2. A good eye. Specifically when it comes to stock footage and b-roll. You know the difference between a clip that feels natural and cinematic versus one that looks awkward or like generic stock footage. --- PAY We pay $75+ per video depending on length and complexity. Editors who deliver clean, revision-light work that we can approve quickly become invaluable. If you takes pride in getting it right before it ever lands in our inbox, there's room to earn more here. REQUIREMENTS — Adobe Premiere Pro 2025 / 2026 (required) — The ability to edit at least 3-5 videos per week — Fluent English, written and spoken — Experience editing short-form testimonial videos, cinematic interview-style content, and lifestyle b-roll — A computer capable of storing and handling 4K footage and graphics smoothly — Strong communication and responsiveness - if we send a message, we expect a reply the same day — Open-minded and willing to learn new systems and workflows --- HOW TO APPLY Do not just send your resume. We receive a lot of applications and we read every one - but here's how to make sure yours gets noticed: Answer this question in your application: What is your favorite sport? title: Documentary Script Writer — Wildlife & Nature Storytelling (Human Writers Only)
job_title: Documentary Script Writer — Wildlife & Nature Storytelling (Human Writers Only)
description: Company: Eterna Animal --- Read this part first Most people would scroll past a video about ants. Then a guy in the Philippines spends thirty minutes talking about a 1,200-gallon glass box, and five million people find themselves emotionally invested in whether a colony of trap-jaw ants can hold their territory against carpenter ants. People cry over a colony collapse. In a tank. About bugs. That is not luck, and it is not the footage. It is the writing. That is the job we are hiring for. Who we are Eterna Animal is a wildlife and nature documentary studio built for YouTube and long-form streaming. We make films about animals, the people obsessed with them, and the moments where the two collide — the kind of stories that stick with someone for a week after they watch. We are currently in production on a feature documentary about the 2011 Zanesville exotic animal escape, alongside an ongoing series slate and an expert interview segment. We are small, we move fast, and the writing is the whole thing. What you'll actually be doing •⁠ ⁠Writing full documentary scripts, 10–30 minutes, from research to final narration draft •⁠ ⁠Writing serialized episode scripts where arcs, callbacks, and running threads carry across a season •⁠ ⁠Building cold opens that make someone stop scrolling in the first eight seconds — and earn the thirty minutes that follow •⁠ ⁠Researching deep: papers, archives, news reports, court records, primary interviews. Not the first page of Google. •⁠ ⁠Prepping interviews — background packs and question sets that get a real answer instead of a press release •⁠ ⁠Writing voiceover that a human being can actually say out loud without sounding like a textbook •⁠ ⁠Knowing when to stop writing and let the footage breathe The one hard rule: you write it, not a machine We have tried AI-written scripts. We are done with them. The facts came out fine. The sentences were clean. And every single one was dead on arrival — no pulse, no stakes, no point of view, no reason to care. Viewers left at forty seconds, and honestly, we would have too. Our audience needs to feel something. Awe. Dread. Grief. Delight. That comes from a person who noticed something and could not shut up about it — not from a model predicting the most average next word. *Our policy, plainly:* •⁠ ⁠Research tools, transcription, fact-checking, spell-check: fine. Use whatever helps. •⁠ ⁠The actual prose, the structure, the voice, the emotional turns: yours. Typed by you. Thought of by you. •⁠ ⁠We check. We ask you to explain your choices out loud. It's obvious very quickly. If your process is "prompt it, then clean it up," this role will make both of us miserable. No hard feelings — please skip it. What we're looking for •⁠ ⁠A voice. We can teach you our format. We cannot teach you a personality on the page. •⁠ Emotional honesty. You can make a stranger care about an animal they have never heard of and would have called ugly an hour ago. •⁠ ⁠Structure instincts. Hook, promise, tension, complication, turn, payoff. You feel where a scene sags. •⁠ Writing for the ear. Short sentences. Rhythm. Room to breathe. Read your draft aloud and you'll hear what's wrong. •⁠ ⁠Genuine curiosity about animals. You don't need a biology degree. You do need to be the kind of person who has fallen down a three-hour rabbit hole about a species nobody asked you about. •⁠ Strong conversational English. Warm and clear, not stiff and academic. •⁠ ⁠Reliability. You hit deadlines, and you tell us early when you can't. Nice to have (not required) •⁠ ⁠Background in biology, zoology, veterinary science, or conservation •⁠ ⁠Experience writing for YouTube specifically, and an understanding of retention and audience drop-off •⁠ ⁠Experience with interview or investigative writing •⁠ ⁠You already watch this kind of content for fun What we're not looking for •⁠ ⁠Blog writers pivoting to video with no ear for spoken language •⁠ ⁠Anyone whose samples all read in the same smooth, weightless, listicle voice •⁠ ⁠Writers who need a full brief spoon-fed before they can start •⁠ ⁠"SEO content specialists" How it works 1.⁠ Paid trial script. One episode, fully paid, real assignment, real feedback. 2.⁠ ⁠If it clicks: ongoing work with a steady script quota and a raise once you know the voice. 3.⁠ Long term: you become the lead writer on a series with your name on it. We want someone who grows into this, not someone who fills a slot. --- How to apply — read carefully, this is the filter Applications that skip any step get deleted unread. Sorry. It's the only way we find you. Subject line: ⁠ COLD OPEN — [the animal you chose] ⁠ Send us all four of these: 1. The test. Write a 150–200 word cold open about *an animal you have personally seen, in real life, that most people would find boring.* A gecko on your wall. A carabao. A stray dog. A moth. Make us care about it. This is the entire job in 200 words. 2. A voice recording, 2 minutes. Vocaroo or Loom, unscripted. Tell us why you picked that animal, and one line in your own draft you would cut and why. Just talk. We are not judging your accent — we are listening for the same person who wrote the script. 3. Your best existing work. A script, a video you wrote, an essay, anything. Plus one sentence on what you would change about it now. 4. Share the test as a Google Doc (link with comment access) rather than pasted text. We look at version history. Where to send: to this job posting We read every application that follows the instructions. If your cold open is good, you will hear from us within a week. --- Eterna Animal — wildlife documentaries for people who never bought that they were "just animals."

description: Full-Time Remote Position – Philippines Social Media | Photo Editing | Graphic Design | Video | Creative Content ABOUT THE ROLE Property Plus Real Estate is a growing Australian real estate business based in regional Victoria. We are looking for a talented, creative and highly organised Creative Content & Digital Marketing Specialist to join our team on a full-time remote basis. This role will be responsible for helping manage and grow our social media presence while producing high-quality visual content across photography, video and graphic design. The role is a combination of social media management, property photo editing, graphic design, short-form video production and creative content development. We already have systems in place that produce our standard property brochures and marketing material, so this is not a traditional graphic designer or virtual assistant role. Instead, we are looking for someone who can take property photography, raw video footage, information and ideas and turn them into professional, engaging content that represents the Property Plus brand. The successful candidate will work closely with our Australian team and become an important part of our ongoing marketing and content strategy. ROLE BREAKDOWN ???? Social Media Management & Content — 40% ???? Photo Editing & Graphic Design — 25% ???? Video Editing & Production — 25% ???? Creative Development — 10% 1. SOCIAL MEDIA MANAGEMENT & CONTENT 40% of the role You will help manage and grow Property Plus Real Estate's social media presence across: Facebook Instagram TikTok Responsibilities Schedule and publish social media content. Maintain a consistent content calendar. Prepare and refine captions. Create content for new property listings. Promote open homes. Create "Just Listed", "Under Offer", "Sold" and "Price Adjustment" content. Promote property campaigns. Create content featuring our agents and team. Promote company campaigns and initiatives. Research current social media trends. Identify new content opportunities. Monitor comments and engagement. Monitor basic social media analytics. Identify high-performing content. Recommend ways to improve engagement and reach. Help develop ideas to grow our social media audience. The successful candidate will not simply be expected to post content that has been provided. We want someone who understands what makes people stop scrolling, watch and engage. 2. PHOTO EDITING & GRAPHIC DESIGN 25% of the role Property photography is a major part of our marketing. You will be responsible for editing and preparing property photographs for use across our marketing channels. Photo Editing Responsibilities may include: Exposure and brightness correction. Colour correction. White balance correction. Contrast and tonal adjustments. Cropping and resizing. Perspective correction. Lens correction. Image optimisation for web and social media. Basic retouching. Removing distracting objects or imperfections where appropriate. Sky replacement where appropriate. Preparing consistent image sets for property campaigns. Batch processing and organising property photography. The objective is to ensure our property photography looks professional, consistent and ready for marketing. Graphic Design Our standard property brochures are produced through our existing CRM and marketing systems. The graphic design component of this role will therefore focus on occasional bespoke and promotional artwork, including: DL brochures for selected property campaigns. Flyers. Social media graphics. Promotional artwork. Campaign graphics. Agent marketing material. Open Home graphics. Sold and Under Offer graphics. Price Adjustment graphics. Company promotional material. Adapting existing Property Plus templates. Creating different versions of artwork for print and digital use. Preparing print-ready files when required. We are looking for someone with a strong eye for: Layout Typography Photography Spacing Colour Branding Overall visual presentation 3. VIDEO EDITING & PRODUCTION 25% of the role Short-form video is an increasingly important part of our marketing strategy. You will be responsible for turning supplied property footage and other video content into engaging 30–45 second social media videos. Responsibilities Edit property videos. Create Instagram Reels. Create TikTok videos. Create Facebook Reels. Edit agent videos. Create suburb and local-area content. Edit market update videos. Add captions and text overlays. Add music. Add appropriate transitions. Apply Property Plus branding. Select the strongest footage. Create engaging opening hooks. Format videos correctly for each platform. Repurpose longer footage into multiple pieces of content. The successful candidate should understand that good social media video is more than simply putting clips together. We want videos that capture attention quickly and encourage people to keep watching. 4. CREATIVE DEVELOPMENT 10% of the role This is an important part of the position. We don't want someone who simply waits for instructions. We want someone who can contribute ideas. You will be encouraged to: Suggest new social media ideas. Research successful real estate content. Identify current social media trends. Suggest new video concepts. Identify opportunities to improve existing content. Find ways to repurpose existing photography and video. Assist with marketing campaigns. Suggest new ways to promote properties. Experiment with different creative approaches. Explore AI tools and emerging technology. Find ways to make Property Plus content stand out from competing real estate agencies. We want someone who can say: "I've seen this working well online — I think we should try it." CONTENT REPURPOSING A key part of this role will be getting more value from the content we already produce. For example, one property listing could potentially become: Property Reel TikTok Facebook Reel Instagram Story Open Home reminder Property feature graphic "3 things we love about this property" video Agent video Sold campaign Additional social media posts We want someone who naturally looks for these opportunities. REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE Essential Experience managing social media accounts. Strong understanding of Facebook, Instagram and TikTok. Strong photo editing skills. Strong graphic design skills. Strong short-form video editing skills. Experience creating social media content. Excellent attention to detail. Strong written English. Ability to work independently. Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines. Ability to follow brand guidelines. Ability to respond positively to feedback and make revisions quickly. Highly Desirable Previous experience working with an Australian business. Previous real estate marketing experience. Experience editing property photography. Experience creating property marketing material. Experience producing real estate videos. Experience with social media strategy. Experience with paid social media advertising. Experience using AI creative tools. Understanding of social media analytics. SOFTWARE EXPERIENCE Experience with some or all of the following would be highly desirable. Photo & Graphic Design Adobe Photoshop Adobe Lightroom Adobe Illustrator Adobe InDesign Canva Video CapCut Adobe Premiere Pro Adobe After Effects Social Media Meta Business Suite Facebook Instagram TikTok Other Google Drive Google Workspace AI content creation and editing tools You do not need to be an expert in every program listed. ABOUT YOU We are looking for someone who is: Creative Reliable Self-motivated Organised Detail-oriented Proactive Comfortable working independently Comfortable receiving feedback Interested in social media and digital marketing Passionate about photography, design and video Willing to learn Interested in new technology and AI Able to meet deadlines Interested in becoming part of a long-term team Most importantly, you should take pride in your work. We want someone who will look at a finished piece of content and think: "Can I make this better?" WORKING ARRANGEMENT Full-time remote position. Based in the Philippines. Work directly with the Property Plus team in Australia. Working hours will include sufficient overlap with Australian business hours. Regular communication with the Australian team. PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS Performance will be assessed across four key areas. Social Media Consistency of publishing. Quality of content. Engagement and reach. Growth of social channels. Ability to identify successful content. Photo Editing & Graphic Design Quality of finished images. Consistency of property photography. Quality of artwork. Attention to detail. Brand consistency. Ability to produce print-ready artwork. Turnaround times. Video Quality of finished videos. Ability to create engaging short-form content. Editing quality. Appropriate use of music, captions and graphics. Turnaround times. Creative Contribution of new ideas. Awareness of current trends. Initiative. Ability to identify new content opportunities. Willingness to experiment and improve. APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS Applicants should provide a portfolio or examples of previous work. Please provide examples of: 1. PHOTO EDITING Examples of property, architectural, interior or other photography you have edited. 2. GRAPHIC DESIGN Examples of: Social media graphics Flyers Brochures Promotional material 3. VIDEO Examples of: Reels TikToks Short-form videos Property videos if available 4. SOCIAL MEDIA Examples of social media accounts you have managed or contributed to. Applicants should also provide a short response to: Why do you think you would be a good fit for this role? PRACTICAL SKILLS TEST Shortlisted applicants may be asked to complete a practical skills assessment. Candidates will be provided with real estate photography, raw video footage and property information. PHOTO EDITING Edit a selection of property photographs to a professional standard suitable for an Australian real estate listing. GRAPHIC DESIGN Create a simple DL promotional piece or social media graphic using supplied Property Plus branding. VIDEO Create a 30–45 second vertical social media video using supplied raw property footage. SOCIAL MEDIA Write a social media caption for the property and provide three additional content ideas that could be created from the same property. The assessment will focus on: Creativity Technical ability Photo editing Graphic design Video editing Understanding of social media Attention to detail Quality of work Ability to follow instructions Initiative Overall presentation THE PERSON WE ARE LOOKING FOR We are not necessarily looking for the person with the longest CV. We are looking for someone who is talented, creative, reliable and hungry to learn. Someone who enjoys creating content, understands social media, appreciates good photography and design, can edit engaging video and is confident enough to bring their own ideas to the table. If that sounds like you, we would love to hear from you. Property Plus Real Estate Real People. Real Estate.

title: Video Editor & Social Campaigns - AI Start Up
job_title: Video Editor & Social Campaigns - AI Start Up
description: EchoVerse Collective - Video Editor & Social Campaigns We build agents for humans. EchoVerse Collective is an AI-native media, content and intelligence company. Our flagship product is Dispatches - a personalised daily brief about AI, written by four AI columnists and approved by a named human editor before anything ships. You can read it at ---------- /dispatches. Alongside it we build document-automation and intelligence products for businesses. These are live products with real users, not prototypes. We publish something worth watching every single day, and almost nobody sees it. We have no real presence on any social channel. That is the job. THE WORK Video editing is the centre of this role. Most of your week is in the timeline. - Edit. Short-form vertical cuts from our daily articles and audio editions - the kind of thing that stops a thumb. Talking-head pieces from the founder. Product walkthroughs. Launch films. Subtitles, sound, pace, type, colour: all yours. - Run the channels. Plan and schedule what goes out, write the copy that goes with it, and hold a posting rhythm we can actually sustain. LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram - we will start narrow and expand. - Run paid campaigns. Build and manage paid social - audiences, creative variants, budgets, reporting. Tell us what the numbers say each week, including when the answer is that something is not working. - Build the machine. Templates, presets, caption styles, a shot library, prompt libraries for the generative tools. Anything you make twice becomes a template. It is the only way one person keeps a daily channel fed without drowning. You would be the only person doing this. Nothing you make passes through a committee or a three-week approval chain, because neither exists here. You make it, we look at it together, it ships. When it is wrong I will tell you that week, and then it is yours to fix, not mine to override. We are an AI-native company and we mean it. Generative tools - video, image, voice, avatar - are part of the craft here, not a shortcut we tolerate. We cover every tool and every credit. YOU WILL FIT IF - You are genuinely strong in an editing suite - Premiere, DaVinci Resolve or After Effects. Not "I can cut a clip". You have opinions about pace, about where a cut lands, about how type and sound carry a piece that has no budget for a crew. - You have made short-form video that performed, and you can tell us why it performed. A number is good. An explanation of the number is better. - You have run paid social campaigns with real money behind them - you have built audiences, tested creative, read the reporting, and changed what you were doing because of it. - You use generative tools well. You know which model to reach for and why, and you know when the output is not good enough to ship. If it looks like the AI made it, it does not ship. - You can write. The copy that goes with the video is part of the job, and it is in English. - You work well from short written briefs, you say plainly what is done versus in-progress versus not started, and you never report a result you did not verify. Tell us if you have any of these: motion graphics and kinetic typography; podcast or audio-led editing; YouTube specifically (thumbnails, retention, the long form); ElevenLabs, HeyGen or similar avatar and voice tools; Veo, Kling, Runway or Flow; analytics beyond the platform dashboards; email or newsletter growth. YOU WILL NOT FIT IF - You want a volume job. Forty ad variants a week, auto-captions, next one. We want four things a week that are right. - You need a detailed brief and a locked storyboard before you can start. - You describe your work by what you made rather than by what changed. - You would ship a generative clip because it was fast, not because it was good. DETAILS - POST TRIAL SUCCESSFUL - ONE CANDIDATE - PHP 45,000 to 70,000 per month, depending on experience. That is set deliberately above the domestic market for this work, because we are hiring one person, not three. - Full-time, fully remote, Philippines. Independent contractor, monthly invoicing, 13th-month bonus. - We are in London (GMT+1). We need three hours of overlap - your afternoon covers it. Around a launch, occasionally more. The rest of your week is yours to schedule; we count the work, not the hours. - Every tool and every credit is paid by us, from week one: your editing suite, the generative video, image and voice models, design tools, ClickUp, Claude. So is a machine that actually renders. - The package also includes private health cover for you and your family, a monthly family fund paid on top of salary with no receipts and no questions, protected learning time each week with a budget behind it, and paid leave we expect you to take. Base rises are reviewed at six and twelve months and go into your engagement letter as real numbers before you start. Every figure is on the table at offer stage. HOW TO APPLY - two things, both required 1. Three pieces of your work. Links, not attachments. Three maximum - pick the ones closest to short-form social video, and give us one line each: what it was for, and what you were trying to make the viewer do. 2. One written answer. Go to ---------- /dispatches, read one article, and tell us the 30-second vertical video you would make from it: the opening three seconds, what is on screen, where the words come from, and what you would want someone to do after watching. Do not make the video. Just describe it. A few hundred words is plenty. Applications missing either will not be read. SUBJECT LINE Dispatches video - [name] where [name] is the columnist who covers markets and capital. It is on the site. The wrong subject line is filtered automatically. WHAT HAPPENS NEXT From everyone who applies we shortlist five to eight people. Those people get a real edit: we send you footage, audio and a one-line brief, and you cut a short vertical piece. A few hours of work. We pay PHP 2,500 for that edit. Everyone who reaches that round is paid, on delivery, whether or not we hire you. It is not a competition prize and it is not conditional on us liking what you made. If we asked you for it, you are paid for it. From there, two or three people do a 45-minute call - you walk us through your edit and how you would build a campaign around it. One person gets the job. The whole process takes under two weeks.

Day1 Collective is a "store within a store"—it shares the same Shopify website but serves a different purpose and customer. FMB Apparel = Premium streetwear and elevated everyday essentials. Day1 Collective = Premium performance apparel designed for training, running, the gym, and an active lifestyle. One of the goals of this project is to improve how these two brands coexist within one website. Specific Improvements Homepage Refine the current homepage instead of replacing it. Improve visual hierarchy. Enhance spacing and layout. Create a stronger luxury feel. Improve brand storytelling. Better showcase both FMB Apparel and Day1 Collective while maintaining clear brand distinction. Improve calls-to-action. Make the homepage more engaging without making it cluttered. Navigation Simplify menus where appropriate. Improve customer flow. Make products easier to find. Create a clear shopping experience for both brands. Ensure customers immediately understand the difference between FMB Apparel and Day1 Collective. Product Pages Improve page layout. Enhance image presentation. Improve product descriptions and formatting. Create a more premium shopping experience. Add helpful trust-building elements where appropriate. Overall Design Improve typography. Improve spacing and alignment. Create better visual consistency. Refine colors and button styles. Maintain a clean, minimalist aesthetic. Ensure every page feels cohesive. Mobile Experience Review every page on mobile. Improve responsiveness. Make shopping easy on all screen sizes. Improve loading speed where possible. Design Direction The website should communicate: Luxury Minimalism Premium quality Editorial fashion Modern simplicity Confidence Clean architecture High-end shopping experience The objective is to create a timeless luxury shopping experience inspired by the best in premium fashion while remaining uniquely FMB Apparel and Day1 Collective. What I Am NOT Looking For A complete website rebuild. A new brand identity. A new logo. A new color palette. A different overall aesthetic. A generic Shopify template. Instead, I want someone who can recognize what is already working and elevate it through thoughtful refinements and professional design improvements. Deliverables A comprehensive audit of my current website. A prioritized list of recommended improvements. Implementation of approved enhancements. Improved homepage and collection pages. Better navigation and shopping flow. Enhanced product pages. Clear integration of both FMB Apparel and Day1 Collective. Mobile optimization. Performance improvements. Final testing and quality assurance. Required Skills Expert Shopify experience Shopify 2.0 Liquid HTML/CSS JavaScript UX/UI Design Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Luxury Fashion E-commerce Responsive Web Design Performance Optimization Please Include With Your Proposal Before submitting a proposal, please review my current website at ---------- . I am looking for thoughtful recommendations—not a generic proposal. Please include: A brief audit of my current website. Three to five specific improvements you would make. Examples of Shopify stores you have improved (not just built). Before-and-after examples of optimization work. Estimated timeline. Estimated project cost. Why you are the right fit for this project. Success Looks Like When customers visit FMB Apparel, they should immediately recognize they are shopping with a premium fashion brand. The website should feel sophisticated, easy to navigate, visually consistent, and effortless to shop. Customers should also immediately understand that Day1 Collective is FMB Apparel's premium performance division—a store within a store—without feeling like they have left the website. The objective is to elevate and perfect my existing website—not replace it.

title: QuickBooks Certified Ecommerce Bookkeeper Needed for 2 Small US LLCs -
job_title: QuickBooks Certified Ecommerce Bookkeeper Needed for 2 Small US LLCs -
description: We run two US LLCs and we want one person to own the books for both. Both are small - roughly $100,000 in annual sales each - so the volume is modest. What we need is accuracy and consistency. YUM CREATIVE LLC - digital content production Budget: $80/month Food photography and video production, around $100k/year. 3-4 bank and card accounts. Client invoicing and receivables, contractor payments, software subscriptions, equipment and shoot costs. Straightforward books, low transaction volume. JARGANIC LLC - ecommerce - $150/month Around $100k/year, but this is the demanding one. Accrual basis. Physical product inventory. 2 bank accounts and these sales channels: - Amazon - Walmart - Etsy - Shopify - Mirakl (Lowe's and JC Penney) TOTAL: $230/month for both entities. WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO EACH MONTH Both entities: - Categorise and reconcile every bank and card account - Close the month/quarter and deliver a full set of financial statements - P&L, balance sheet, cash flow - by an agreed date each quarter - Keep the chart of accounts tidy and consistent so the numbers stay comparable month over month - Maintain the fixed asset register and depreciation schedules - Flag anything that looks wrong before we have to ask Jarganic specifically: - Marketplace settlement accounting done properly - gross sales, refunds, referral fees, fulfilment fees, storage, advertising and reserve movements all broken out. The bank deposit is not revenue. - Inventory and COGS, with in-transit, FBA/WFS and 3PL stock tracked separately - Mirakl (Lowe's, JC Penney) has no off-the-shelf QuickBooks connector, but we may be able to connect via Shopify - you'll build and post those settlement journals from the remittance reports - Sales tax awareness (not filling yet): marketplace facilitator channels versus our direct Shopify sales - Correct month-end cutoff on settlement periods that straddle the month boundary ONCE A YEAR: THE TAX-READY PACKAGE. INCLUDED IN THE FEE. For each entity you deliver: - Final adjusted trial balance and year-end financial statements - Bank and credit card reconciliations tied out through 31 December - Inventory rollforward for Jarganic, agreed to the year-end count, with the landed-cost basis documented - Fixed asset roll: additions, disposals and the book depreciation schedule - AR and AP aging, loan and related-party balances - A schedule of transactions between each company and its non-US owner, since both are foreign-owned LLCs and those have to be reported. In other words: a clean, documented package a tax preparer can work from without coming back to us with questions. What is NOT included, because it needs a credential and carries filing liability: converting the book numbers to tax basis (MACRS, Section 179 and bonus depreciation elections), and preparing and signing the returns themselves. If you hold the credentials below, we will pay you separately for that. THE PART THAT MATTERS MOST TO US We are not looking for a data-entry service. We are looking for someone who thinks and remembers. Concretely, that means: 1. You propose, you don't just ask. When something unfamiliar hits the feed, you come back with "I've coded this to X because Y - confirm or correct," not "what is this?" 2. You ask once. Every recurring transaction gets a bank rule and a line in a written treatment log we can both see. We should never be asked about the same vendor twice. REQUIREMENTS Must have: - Active QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor certification. Send the link to your public Find-a-ProAdvisor profile. Intuit only publishes profiles for advisors with current, valid certification, so that link is how we verify. A screenshot of a badge is not enough. - Hands-on ecommerce bookkeeping experience: marketplace settlements, inventory, COGS - Accrual accounting, not cash basis - Fluent written and spoken English BIG PLUS: US TAX CREDENTIALS We do not need a US-based accountant and we are not looking for a US firm's pricing. We need someone who is credentialed to prepare US federal returns, and we do not care where you sit. Philippines, India, anywhere - if you hold one of these, say so clearly and we will treat your application as a priority: - IRS Enrolled Agent (EA). - US CPA licence. Give us your licence number and the state that issued it. - Active PTIN. Required for anyone we pay to prepare our federal returns. If you hold an EA or a CPA you will already have one - tell us your status either way. If you hold any of these, we will engage you separately to prepare and file the US returns for one of the companies. That is paid work on top of the monthly bookkeeping fee. OUR SETUP We hold and pay for the QuickBooks Online subscription. We will connect the bank feeds and the sales channel integrations so the mechanical work is automated as far as it can be. SCOPE AND MONEY, STATED PLAINLY - $80/month - Yum Creative LLC - $150/month - Jarganic LLC - $230/month - total for both, ongoing Not included in the monthly fee, quoted separately: - Initial setup, catch-up, or clean-up of historical books - Annual US tax return preparation (credentialed preparers only EA, CPA, PTIN, or AFSP) HOW TO APPLY Applications that skip these go straight in the bin. 1. Your Find-a-ProAdvisor profile link (with matching details). 2. If you hold an EA, a US CPA license, a PTIN, or an AFSP record, list them with the numbers so we can verify them. 3. What is your experience with e-commerce bookkeeping, inventory tracking, and accrual accounting? We read every application properly. We reply to the ones that answer the questions.

title: Brand & Marketing Manager/Head
description: Position Summary The Brand & Marketing Manager/Head leads The Brand Powerhouse as the centralized brand, creative, marketing, social media, and communications organization serving both the company portfolio and executive leadership. The role has two equal strategic mandates: 1. Build, launch, position, govern, market, and grow company and product brands. 2. Build the Founder/CEO's public positioning, reputation, authority, visibility, media presence, and thought leadership. Core Responsibilities 1. COMPANY & PORTFOLIO BRAND DEVELOPMENT Brand Strategy & Development -Develop complete brand strategies for new companies and existing portfolio businesses. -Establish positioning, target audiences, messaging, voice, naming direction, slogans, and brand architecture. -Lead visual identity and brand-standard development and maintain consistency across customer-facing channels. New Company Launches -Own the branding and marketing workstream for every new-company launch. -Coordinate identity, website direction, social accounts, launch campaigns, sales collateral, photography, video, and public launch readiness. -Maintain a standardized Brand Launch Checklist and launch calendar. Marketing & Growth -Develop marketing plans tied to measurable business and revenue objectives. -Oversee digital advertising, SEO, email marketing, lead generation, landing pages, retargeting, automation, and launch campaigns. -Coordinate with sales and operating-company leadership to align marketing activity with commercial priorities. Portfolio Governance -Maintain centralized brand guidelines, approved logos, messaging, photography, video, collateral, social accounts, campaign history, and content calendars. -Create repeatable standards so every company launches and operates at a consistent professional level. 2. FOUNDER & EXECUTIVE PERSONAL BRAND Executive branding is a primary responsibility of the position - not a secondary social-media assignment. The Director will develop and operate a deliberate executive-brand program designed to strengthen the Founder/CEO's credibility, visibility, influence, and long-term reputation. Executive Brand Strategy -Define executive positioning, public image, messaging, voice, core themes, audience, and long-term reputation strategy. -Develop clear boundaries between the executive identity and individual company brands while using each to strategically strengthen the other. -Create an annual Executive Brand Plan with quarterly priorities and measurable objectives. Executive Digital Presence -Own strategy and ongoing development of the executive personal website. -Manage executive presence across LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, and other appropriate channels. -Ensure biographies, profiles, photography, credentials, company affiliations, and public information remain current and consistent. Thought Leadership & Content -Develop executive thought-leadership themes covering business, leadership, entrepreneurship, industry expertise, -technology, company building, and other approved topics. -Coordinate articles, executive commentary, founder stories, short-form video, long-form video, interviews, and behind-the-scenes business content. -Maintain a separate executive content calendar and publishing cadence. Media, PR & Visibility -Develop and coordinate press opportunities, interviews, podcasts, speaking engagements, panels, awards, and other executive visibility opportunities. -Build relationships with relevant media, event organizers, industry organizations, and external communications resources. -Prepare executive talking points, biographies, media materials, announcements, and public-facing communications. Executive Reputation Management -Monitor executive brand consistency and public presentation across digital channels. -Identify reputation risks, outdated information, inconsistent profiles, or brand issues requiring correction. -Maintain a polished executive presence consistent with the scale and direction of the broader enterprise. Founder-to-Company Brand Connection -Use executive visibility strategically to support company credibility, launches, recruiting, partnerships, customer confidence, and market awareness. -Ensure operating companies can develop independent brand equity and are not unnecessarily dependent on the Founder/CEO's identity. -Coordinate major company milestones, launches, acquisitions, partnerships, and announcements through both corporate and executive channels when appropriate. 3. CREATIVE, SOCIAL & DIGITAL LEADERSHIP Creative Direction -Direct designers, photographers, videographers, editors, copywriters, and other creative resources. -Set the creative standard for websites, advertising, social graphics, presentations, proposals, campaigns, photography, and video. -Approve brand-facing materials and maintain quality control. Social Media & Content Operations -Develop differentiated strategies for each corporate brand and for executive leadership. -Build monthly content calendars and ensure content is created, approved, scheduled, published, and measured. -Coordinate production resources so content execution does not depend on executive leadership managing individual contributors. Websites & Digital Presence -Own messaging, brand direction, content hierarchy, calls to action, SEO direction, and conversion strategy for company and executive websites. -Coordinate with technology and development teams for technical execution. -Use analytics to continuously improve digital performance and presentation. Required Skills & Qualifications -7-10+ years of experience in branding, marketing, creative direction, digital marketing, communications, or a closely related discipline. -Demonstrated experience building or launching multiple brands, products, companies, or executive brands. -Strong creative judgment combined with measurable marketing and growth experience. -Experience developing executive/founder content, thought leadership, social presence, media strategy, or public-facing leadership communications. -Experience managing designers, content creators, developers, agencies, and outside vendors. -Strong understanding of social media, websites, SEO, digital advertising, analytics, marketing automation, PR, and content production. -Ability to manage multiple brands and simultaneous launches without losing quality or deadlines. -Experience working directly with founders, owners, or senior executive leadership strongly preferred.

title: Functional Business Analyst
description: We are seeking an experienced Functional Business Analyst to ensure that technology solutions meet business requirements, address user needs, and solve the intended operational problems. You will work directly with clients, end users, product owners, developers, and quality assurance teams to understand business processes, identify pain points, document requirements, and validate delivered solutions. This is a business-focused role. Coding and software development experience are considered assets but are not required. Key Responsibilities: - Gather, analyze, and document business and functional requirements. - Lead stakeholder interviews, discovery sessions, requirements workshops, and proof-of-concept discussions. - Understand and document current-state and future-state business processes. - Identify operational pain points, process gaps, and improvement opportunities. - Conduct fit-gap analysis between business requirements and proposed system functionality. - Prepare Business Requirements Documents, process flows, user stories, and acceptance criteria. - Translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements for product and development teams. - Collaborate with clients, product owners, developers, and QA teams throughout the solution lifecycle. - Perform functional testing and validate that system functionality meets business requirements. - Support User Acceptance Testing, including test scenarios, issue documentation, feedback coordination, and resolution validation. - Participate actively and contribute effectively during client meetings, demonstrations, and project discussions. - Ensure the delivered solution addresses the original business problem and end-user needs. Required Qualifications - 5 years of experience as a Functional Business Analyst - Proven experience as a Functional Business Analyst, Business Analyst, Business Systems Analyst, or similar role. - Strong understanding of business operations, workflows, requirements analysis, and process improvement. - Demonstrated experience gathering and documenting business and functional requirements. - Experience creating BRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, process maps, and workflow documentation. - Experience facilitating client meetings, stakeholder interviews, and requirements workshops. - Experience conducting fit-gap analysis. - Experience supporting UAT and performing functional system validation. - Ability to identify business pain points and translate them into practical functional requirements. - Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. - Confidence communicating directly with clients, end users, and technical teams. - Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and critical-thinking skills. - Basic understanding of software systems and technology concepts. Preferred Qualifications - Experience with software implementation, business automation, custom application development, or digital transformation projects. - Experience working in Agile or Scrum environments. - Familiarity with process-mapping, requirements-management, project-management, or collaboration tools. - Experience working with product owners, software developers, and QA teams. - Knowledge of databases, APIs, coding, or software development is an asset but not mandatory Ideal Candidate You are a business-focused analyst who can lead client discussions, ask thoughtful questions, understand complex workflows, and translate business needs into clear, testable requirements. You are comfortable working between business and technical teams and can take ownership of requirements from initial discovery through functional validation and User Acceptance Testing.

title: B2C Sales Closer - US Company
description: Closers only. If you have not carried a quota and closed on live calls, this one is not for you. This is a sales and activation role for our partner program. You close new Vea partners on a call, then you're the one who gets them actually selling. We're Vea, a telehealth practice in the US. Licensed clinicians, GLP-1s, peptides, sexual health. We do the prescribing, pharmacy, shipping, billing and support, so none of that touches you. Every single person you speak to has already applied to become a Vea partner and wants in. Coaches, nurses, trainers, the person their gym or their group chat already asks what to take. They found us, filled in an application, watched a video, and booked their own call. Nobody on your calendar is a stranger or a cold lead. No cold calling, no lists, no prospecting, ever. The calls run thirty minutes, ten to twelve booked on a busy day. Work out what the person actually wants, and tell them straight when we're not it. Then comes the harder half. You keep them. Code live, training done, first link sent, and you chasing them when they go quiet, which they will. Most of it happens over text, so you'll live in iMessage. What we'll judge you on: how many of your partners make a first sale inside 60 days. What you need to have done already. At least two years closing, on live calls or video, in a role where the number was yours. Consumer sales, not enterprise. You should be able to tell me roughly how many deals you have closed and at what price, without having to go and look it up. Hours. 9 to 5 Eastern or 9 to 5 Pacific, your pick. Pick one and hold it, because that's when people book. Don't apply if you want a script and a dial list, or if you think the job ends at the close. Applying. One video, two parts, and I need both parts in the same recording. Part one, about 30 seconds. Introduce yourself. Who you are, what you have sold, and why this one. Part two, about 90 seconds. You're 25 minutes into a call. She's a personal trainer, she's keen, she wants in. You get to the money and she says: "I'm in, I really am. I just don't get paid until next Friday." Answer her. Out loud, to camera, the way you would say it on the call. Don't describe your approach or talk me through your framework. Just handle it. One take, no script, phone footage is fine. Polish is not what I'm looking for and a produced video tells me less than a real one. Loom, unlisted YouTube, Drive, whatever you like. I watch this before I read anything else about you. No video, no read.

title: Executive Assistant
description: JOB OVERVIEW Mia is an AI agent transforming communication at car dealerships by acting as a super employee, handling phone calls, texts, emails, and more. We bridge the gap between modern customer expectations and the outdated communication systems of dealerships. Our mission is to make the car buying and servicing experience frictionless, scalable, and genuinely helpful. We're hiring a full-time Executive Assistant to work directly under our Chief of Staff, with support extending to the executive team. The person in this seat runs recurring programs end to end, owns documentation that other teams depend on, and is trusted with visibility into how the company operates. WHAT YOU'LL DO Executive & Calendar Support Manage inboxes, flag what's urgent, draft responses, and close the loop on follow-ups. Book flights and hotels for C-suite level. Schedule and coordinate meetings across multiple time zones. Prepare agendas, capture notes in meetings, and distribute clear action items afterward. Weekly Competitive Intelligence Own our weekly Competitive Matrix Report from start to finish. Each week you'll monitor a defined set of competitors across LinkedIn, press releases, company websites, and thought-leadership content; log every new item; and write a short analyst summary of what it means for us. Track follower counts and other movement signals week over week. Update the reporting dashboard and live tracker, then send the executive summary out every Friday. This is the most analytical part of the role. You'll be reading between the lines of competitor announcements, not just copying links. Cross-Functional Research Support Act as the interim research partner to Marketing and Product on competitor benchmarking, including feature comparisons, pricing signals, positioning shifts, and integration or partnership news. Documentation & Process Draft and maintain process documents and SOPs for the Chief of Staff. This means turning "here's how we do this" into a written page someone else can follow without asking questions. Keep company records, trackers, and filing systems organized and current. Prepare and format documents, spreadsheets, and presentations. REQUIRED SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS At least a year of experience as Executive Assistant, Administrative Assistant, or VA supporting senior leadership. Excellent written and verbal English. A large portion of this role is writing that executives will read. Strong organizational skills and the judgment to prioritize by being proactive. Comfort with Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, and Slack. High attention to detail, especially with numbers, names, and dates. Ability to work independently across a full day with limited overlap. Willingness to pick up new tools quickly. NICE TO HAVE Experience with Confluence and Jira. Familiarity with HubSpot or a comparable CRM. Comfort with Claude and AI tools for research, drafting, and summarizing. Prior competitive research, market research, or analyst-adjacent experience. WORK SETUP Full-time, 40 hours/ week based on Central time. (i.e., 8:30 AM - 4:30 PM CT, exact working hours TBC) Remote, Philippines-based. Starts as an independent contractor, paid weekly directly through your bank account. Strong potential to convert to an Employer of Record arrangement with full statutory Philippine benefits (SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG, 13th month pay) based on performance and business needs. Rate: USD 400/week How to Apply: Kindly follow the directions below for your application to be considered. Please use the subject title [First Name + Last Name: EA Vacancy] / example: Jane Doe: EA Vacancy - A short intro about your professional background and a recurring report or process you've owned, maximum 5 sentences. - A link to your latest resume (ensure that the link is open to public viewing)

Who Are We Looking For? We are looking for A-players — individuals who are hungry, curious, and take full ownership of their tasks. ● A Fast Learner: Picks up new tools and processes quickly and isn't afraid to ask questions. ● Highly Organized: Keeps track of multiple tasks, deadlines, and details without letting things slip through the cracks. ● Proactive: Anticipates needs and takes initiative rather than waiting to be told what to do. ● Dependable: Shows up consistently, meets deadlines, and can be trusted to follow through. ● Coachable: Takes feedback well and continuously improves their work. ● Detail-Oriented: Catches errors and inconsistencies before they become problems. ● A Strong Communicator: Keeps the team informed and asks clarifying questions when needed. ● Curious & Growth-Oriented: Eager to learn about digital marketing and grow into a more specialized role over time. Why Join Sparkblaze Digital ● Great Starting Opportunity: A supportive environment for fresh graduates to build real-world professional experience. ● Hands-On Learning: Exposure to digital marketing operations, tools, and client work from day one. ● Fast Career Growth: A clear pathway to more specialized roles (marketing coordinator, project management, or client support) as you grow. ● Supportive Environment: A skill-focused, collaborative work setup built for eager learners. If you're an organized, dependable self-starter who's excited to kick-start your career and grow alongside a fast-paced digital marketing team — we'd love to hear from you. Apply now and start your career journey with Sparkblaze Digital.

title: Appointment Setter
description: Financial Literacy Basics FINANCIAL PLANNERS Position: Appointment Setter / Business Development Representative Location Remote — Work From Anywhere Employment Type Independent Contractor (1099) Daily Activity Standard Minimum 100 dials per day — Target 100–300 with power dialer Contact Goal 20–30 live prospect conversations per day Compensation Monthly Retainer + Per Qualified Appointment Bonus Reports To Lead Financial Planner, Financial Literacy Basics Start Date Immediate ABOUT Financial Literacy Basics Financial Literacy Basics is a financial planning and education firm operating under the financial planning and education brand. We design retirement and wealth plans built to last — plans grounded in structural analysis, real math, and risks most advisors never address. We work with people at every stage of their financial journey who want to make sure their money is working as hard as they are. We are not a traditional financial advisory/planning firm. We are plan architectural engineers. Our work identifies the gaps, the blind spots, and the structural weaknesses in a client's current approach — and we build the framework to fix them. THE ROLE We are looking for motivated, self-directed individuals to join Financial Literacy Basics as Appointment Setters. Your role has two clear objectives: connect with prospective clients by phone, schedule a 20-minute discovery call with our lead planner, and collect basic financial profile data so the architect can make the most of that conversation. You do not need a financial background. You do not need sales experience. You need confidence on the phone, the discipline to make calls consistently, and the professionalism to represent the Financial Literacy Basics brand with integrity. This is a door-opening role. You are the first impression and the intake point. Your success is measured by two things: qualified appointments booked and prospect data collected accurately. RESPONSIBILITIES • Make outbound cold calls to prospective clients using a provided script and contact list • Deliver the Financial Literacy Basics opening script with consistency, confidence, and professionalism • Handle common objections using trained responses and redirect to appointment booking • Schedule 20-minute discovery calls between prospects and the Financial Literacy Basics lead architect • Collect basic financial profile data from each booked prospect — years to retirement, investable asset range, advisor status, and primary financial concern • Submit completed prospect data forms to the lead architect prior to each scheduled call • Leave professional voicemails and follow up with prospects on callback commitments • Log all call activity daily — dials, contacts, outcomes, appointments booked, and data collected • Maintain a minimum of 100 dials per day; target 100–300 using power dialer tools • Participate in brief weekly check-in calls to review performance and refine approach WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT This is strictly an appointment-setting and data collection role. You are not expected to discuss financial strategy, investment products, market conditions, or any aspect of retirement planning. If a prospect asks detailed financial questions, your response is: "That's exactly what the call is for — I'll let our lead architect walk you through it." • You will NOT provide financial advice or discuss investment strategies • You will NOT present or explain the Financial Literacy Basics plan methodology • You will NOT represent yourself as a financial advisor or planner • You will NOT make promises about outcomes, returns, or specific plan recommendations • You will NOT discuss fees or pricing — that is handled by the lead architect DATA COLLECTION RESPONSIBILITY Once a prospect agrees to a call and confirms their email, you will collect four data points before ending the conversation. This takes approximately 60 seconds and is framed as helping the planner prepare — which it does. Data Point Why It Matters Years to Retirement Determines planning horizon and urgency — shapes the entire architecture framework Has a Financial Advisor? Sets context for how the discovery call is framed — additive vs. first-time planning Investable Asset Range Establishes whether the prospect is qualified and helps architect tailor the conversation Primary Financial Concern Market risk, income, inflation, or legacy — allows architect to lead with what matters most to them If a prospect declines to answer, do not push. Note it as "declined" and move on. The appointment is always the priority — data collection is secondary. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR Required • Comfortable and confident speaking on the phone with strangers • Self-motivated — able to work independently without daily supervision • Disciplined — able to maintain 50+ dials per day consistently • Detail-oriented — able to accurately capture and submit prospect data after each booking • Reliable internet connection and a quiet, professional calling environment • Basic computer skills — email, calendar scheduling, simple spreadsheets or forms • Professional demeanor and clear verbal communication Preferred (Not Required) • Prior experience in cold calling, telemarketing, or phone-based sales • Background in insurance, annuities, or any financial services outreach • Experience using a CRM or power dialer platform (CloudTalk, HubSpot, etc.) • Demonstrated ability to handle rejection and maintain a positive, consistent approach COMPENSATION STRUCTURE Trial Period: Week 1 and 2: $35 per qualified appointment — no retainer Continuous Offer: Monthly Retainer $1000 – $3000 (based on performance, experience and availability) + $35-$40 per qualified appointment Per Qualified Appointment Bonus paid per appointment that is confirmed, shows, and includes collected data Definition of Qualified Prospect confirmed the call, provided contact info, attended the 20-minute discovery call, and basic data was collected prior Payment Schedule Monthly — net 15 following the close of the calendar month Classification Independent Contractor — 1099 issued annually Compensation details are finalized during the offer conversation. High performers who demonstrate consistency, data accuracy, and brand alignment will be considered for advancement with expanded responsibilities and increased earning potential. GROWTH PATH Financial Literacy Basics is building a distribution network. This role is the entry point. Strong performers advance through three stages — all based on performance, not time. 1 Appointment Setter Script-driven outreach. Book the call. Collect prospect data. Nothing more. 2 Junior Financial Planner Learn the Financial Literacy Basics language and methodology firsthand. Learn basic financial planning and budgeting. 3 Senior Financial Planner Present the plan framework to prospects with architect support. Expanded compensation and responsibility. HOW TO APPLY Send a brief introduction — no resume required — that answers the following three questions: • Tell us about a time you had to persuade someone or handle pushback in a conversation. • What does your current daily schedule look like and how many hours can you commit to this role? • Have you ever made cold calls or done phone-based outreach? If yes, describe the context. Submit to: ---------- with subject line: "Financial Literacy Basics — Appointment Setter"
