title: Business Loan Broker – US Small Business Financing (Remote, Experienced Only)
job_title: Business Loan Broker – US Small Business Financing (Remote, Experienced Only)
description: About the Role Our company works with a national network of independent business brokers who regularly come across business owners who need capital — whether that's an SBA loan, a merchant cash advance, equipment financing, a line of credit, or debt consolidation. We're hiring an experienced, seasoned loan broker to be the voice these business owners talk to when they're ready to explore financing. **This role requires real, hands-on experience brokering business loans.** This is not an entry-level calling job — you should already be comfortable discussing SBA loans, MCA, equipment financing, lines of credit, and consolidation loans with a business owner, understanding their numbers, and knowing which financing option actually fits their situation. This is a phone-based role. You'll split your time between two types of conversations: 1. **Broker referrals** — when one of our brokers flags a business owner who's mentioned needing financing, you'll follow up quickly and walk them through their options. 2. **Warm outreach calls** — using a list we provide of business owners who have previously shown interest in financing, you'll reconnect with them, refresh their situation, and see where they stand today. Early on, most of your day will be outreach calls from the list we supply. As your pipeline of broker referrals grows, your day will shift more and more toward following up on those warmer, referred leads. You won't be doing this cold. Our CRM (GoHighLevel) supports you with proven scripts, drafts follow-up emails after every call, and runs multi-channel follow-up — calls, texts, and email — plus an autoresponder that keeps dripping helpful information on every lead in the background. Your job is to bring the loan expertise and the relationship-building; the system handles a lot of the repetitive follow-up work for you. We're a close-knit team based in the Philippines, hand-picked personally by the business owner. We're not looking to fill a seat for a few months — we're looking for someone who wants a long-term career with our company and who genuinely enjoys being part of a tight team. ## What You'll Do - Call business owners from provided lead lists and warm broker referrals - Use your loan expertise to ask sharp discovery questions and understand each owner's real financing need - Explain financing options (SBA loans, MCA, equipment financing, lines of credit, consolidation loans) and match the owner to the right fit - Work from GHL-provided scripts as a foundation, adapting them with your own broker experience and judgment - Review and personalize AI-drafted follow-up emails generated from your call notes - Layer in additional calls and texts on top of the automated multi-channel and drip follow-up already running for each lead - Log every call, outcome, and next step in our CRM - Schedule qualified business owners for next steps with our financing partners - Hand off document collection to our in-house documentation expert once a business owner is ready to move forward — she's been with our company for nearly two years and knows exactly what to ask for and how to get it, so you can stay focused on the conversations and the deal, not paperwork chasing - Follow up consistently — most deals come from the second, third, or fourth conversation, not the first ## What We're Looking For - **Must have prior, hands-on experience brokering business loans** (SBA, MCA, equipment financing, lines of credit, or consolidation loans) — this is non-negotiable - Excellent spoken and written English - Strong outbound calling, negotiation, and closing skills - Comfortable talking to US-based small business owners and building quick rapport - Organized, detail-oriented, and reliable with follow-up - Comfortable working inside a CRM (we use GoHighLevel — platform-specific training provided, loan expertise is on you) - Self-motivated; you'll often be working from a list independently - Genuinely enjoys working as part of a close team — this is not a lone-wolf role - Looking for a long-term career, not a short-term gig ## Schedule Full-time, US business hours (details discussed during interview) ## Compensation - Competitive hourly base pay - Additional commission paid on every loan that successfully funds as a result of your calls - The more consistently you work the list and follow up on referrals, the more your funded-deal commissions grow over time ## Why This Role This isn't a cold-calling grind. You'll have real system support behind you — scripts, AI-assisted follow-up emails, automated multi-channel touches, and a drip campaign working every lead even when you're not on the phone with them. Once a deal is moving, our in-house documentation expert — already on staff for nearly two years — takes over collecting the paperwork, so you're not stuck chasing statements and tax returns. That means you can spend your energy on what an experienced broker actually does best: understanding the business owner and closing the right financing for them. And as our broker network grows, so does the volume of warm referrals coming your way — meaning more conversations with people who already want to talk to you. You'll be joining a small, hand-picked, close-knit team — if you're looking for a real long-term career with strong team dynamics, not just a job, this is built for you. ## How to Apply Please respond with: 1. Your work history 2. Number of years of experience brokering business loans 3. The types of loans you have experience with (e.g., SBA, MCA, equipment financing, lines of credit, consolidation)

title: Financial Controller
description: Ikigai Cases is hiring a Controller! Location: Remote / Work From Home Reports to: CEO About the Company Ikigai Cases ( ---------- ) is a fast-growing ecommerce brand manufacturing aerospace-grade aluminum pill cases. Founded in December 2021 by two brothers after their father’s neurological diagnosis led them to discovering the issues with plastic pill organizers, we’ve built a multi-million dollar business in just over four years with a team of 25 across the globe. Our mission is simple: make exceptional pill cases and provide exceptional customer service. We deliver on this by managing in-house fulfillment at our Washington, DC facility (including custom engraving) and maintaining obsessive attention to detail. About the Role We are hiring a Controller to take complete ownership of our financial operations - accounting, reporting, payroll, budgeting, cash flow, tax coordination, and financial systems. This is a critical senior role, and we’re looking for someone whose professional identity is built around three things: the integrity of the numbers, running the finance function end-to-end, and providing strategic financial insight to the CEO. The ideal candidate has served as a Controller (or equivalent) for an e-commerce or DTC brand in the $10–30M revenue range. You understand the financial rhythms of e-commerce: Shopify revenue recognition, inventory accounting, seasonal cash flow swings, sales tax across multiple states, and the speed at which decisions need to be made. If you’ve done this before at a similar-sized company, you already know what we need. We need someone who builds systems, not just operates inside them. You’ll report directly to the CEO and work hand-in-hand with our external financial advisor. No layers of management between you and the decisions your work supports. Core Responsibilities Monthly Close & Financial Reporting: Close books by the 10th of every month. Produce reviewed P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statements in Finaloop. Resolve misclassifications proactively. Maintain a clean chart of accounts. No CEO intervention required. Budgeting & Financial Planning: Prepare and maintain monthly, quarterly, and annual budgets. Own budget vs. actuals: produce variance reports monthly alongside the P&L close with plain-language explanations. Update balance sheet items and expenses weekly inside the company’s financial models. Cash Flow Management & Forecasting: Maintain the 13-week cash flow forecast weekly and proactively. Flag upcoming cash movements, exposure, and risks before they become surprises. This is one of the most critical tools the CEO uses for capital allocation. Payroll Operations (Zero-Error Standard): Own bi-weekly payroll across ADP (US) and Deel (Philippines). Submit the morning of payroll day, every cycle. PTO, overtime, and deductions captured before submission. You catch discrepancies before they reach the CEO. Tax Coordination & Compliance: Own the relationship with Numeral on multi-state sales tax filings. Maintain the estimated tax payment tracker. Coordinate with our external CPA on annual filings. Flag tax exposure and timing proactively. Vendor Payments, Disbursements & Financial Systems: Execute and double-check all vendor payments (Venmo, PayPal, wire). Track owner distributions and related-party transactions. Manage Finaloop, Shopify revenue reconciliation, and Google Sheets financial modeling. Manage financial admin including insurance, vendor accounts, and benefits. CEO Reporting & Ad Hoc Analysis: Weekly: 13WCF update, flagged variances, upcoming cash movements. Monthly: clean financial statements with brief narrative. As needed: ad hoc financial analysis without requiring a detailed spec. Why You Should Take This Role -You’ll work at a brand obsessed with its customers, with a loyal following. Read the reviews: ---------- /pages/reviews -A company that’s scaled rapidly in 4 years and is aggressively investing in growth. -You’ll work hand-in-hand with the founder, not through layers of management, with full autonomy to own your domain. -The company was founded to solve a personal problem - Tavish’s father battled a neurological condition for a decade and the family discovered the issues with plastic pill organizers. -You’ll own the entire financial function for a company on a trajectory from $11.5M to $30M - a career-defining role for the right person. Required Experience & Skills -5+ years in accounting, bookkeeping, or finance operations -Prior Controller or senior finance role at a company doing $10M+ in annual revenue - you’ve owned the full financial function, not just pieces of it -E-commerce or DTC company experience strongly preferred - Shopify revenue recognition, inventory accounting, seasonal cash flow, multi-state sales tax -Experience closing books independently, on a monthly cadence, without supervision -Demonstrated accuracy record - you should be able to speak to this specifically -US GAAP familiarity (CPA not required, but you must understand the principles) -Experience preparing monthly, quarterly, and annual budgets -Payroll experience across multiple platforms -Advanced Google Sheets / Excel (SUMIFS, financial modeling, pivot tables) -Strong proficiency with Finaloop, QuickBooks Online, or equivalent cloud accounting platform -Strong written and verbal English; ability to explain financial insights to non-financial stakeholders Nice-to-Have Experience -Experience working remotely for a US-based company from the Philippines -Exposure to sales tax compliance across multiple US states -Experience using Notion (or similar task management software) -EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System) familiarity -Prior experience coordinating with external CPAs and tax advisors What We’re Really Looking For -Technical skills get you in the door. These traits determine whether you succeed: -Detail orientation as professional pride - you catch your own errors before they go out, and you change your process so they don’t recur. -Proactive disclosure - you surface problems before being asked, even when it’s uncomfortable. -Ownership without supervision - if it’s due, it’s done. title: Social media manager/editor
description: Elite Peak Performance (EPP) is a premium personal training and performance coaching company based in the Netherlands. We primarily work with Dutch entrepreneurs and professionals who want to improve their physical performance, health and lifestyle. Our brand is professional, premium, clean and performance-driven. Our social media content is primarily in Dutch. You do not necessarily have to be a native Dutch speaker, but you must be comfortable working with Dutch-language content and be willing to carefully check translations, spelling, grammar and context before anything is published. We are looking for a Social Media Manager & Content Editor who can take ownership of our social media and help us grow the EPP brand. The Role This is not a position where you will receive detailed instructions for every single post. We are looking for someone who can understand our brand, learn from feedback and gradually manage our social media independently. Our goal is simple: we want someone who takes work off our plate. You will receive raw content, brand guidelines, ideas and occasional direction from us, but we expect you to turn this into high-quality content without needing constant supervision. Responsibilities You will be responsible for: * Editing short-form videos / Reels * Creating premium Instagram posts and carousels * Creating and working with Dutch captions, hooks and on-screen text * Checking Dutch text for spelling, grammar and consistency * Planning the content calendar * Scheduling and publishing content * Repurposing raw footage into multiple pieces of content * Maintaining a consistent premium visual identity * Coming up with new content ideas proactively * Reviewing your own work before submitting or publishing * Learning from feedback and applying it to future work * Keeping track of content, deadlines and approvals * Helping improve the overall EPP social media strategy Depending on your skills, the role can grow into managing more of our complete social media operation. Working With Dutch Content This is an important part of the position. Almost all content you create for EPP will be published in Dutch. You may use translation and AI tools to support you, but simply copying an automatic translation is not enough. You are responsible for checking whether the final text sounds natural, professional and appropriate for a premium Dutch brand. If you are unsure about a Dutch sentence or its meaning, we expect you to research and check it before submitting the content. What We Are Looking For We are looking for someone who: * Has experience with social media management and content creation * Is a strong short-form video editor * Has a good eye for premium and professional design * Understands Instagram and Reels * Can work with Canva and professional video editing software * Can create strong hooks and content concepts * Is comfortable working with Dutch-language content * Knows how to use translation/AI tools effectively and critically * Is highly detail-oriented * Can work independently * Takes initiative instead of waiting for instructions * Checks their own work carefully * Remembers and applies previous feedback * Communicates clearly in English * Meets deadlines * Is interested in fitness, performance, business or premium brands Very Important We do not want someone who needs step-by-step instructions for every task. Of course, we will provide guidance and feedback while you learn the EPP brand. However, we expect you to become increasingly independent. Before sending something for approval, you should ask yourself: Does this fit the EPP brand? Does it look premium? Does the Dutch text make sense? Is the spelling correct? Have I checked every detail? Is this actually ready to publish? We value ownership, consistency and attention to detail more than simply completing tasks quickly. What You Can Expect From Us * Fully remote work * Long-term opportunity * Clear brand direction * Direct feedback * Room to develop your skills * Increasing responsibility when you perform well * Opportunity to grow together with EPP How to Apply Please send us: 1. A short introduction about yourself 2. Your relevant experience 3. Examples of social media accounts you have managed 4. Examples of Reels/videos you personally edited 5. Examples of designs or carousels you created 6. The tools/software you use 7. Your experience working with foreign-language content Important: Start your application with the words “PEAK PERFORMANCE” so we know you have read the full job description. Selected candidates will be invited for a short interview and may be asked to complete a paid trial assignment before we make our final decision.

Lead the Marketing Growth of an Established Service Business Cooper Roofing is an award-winning roofing company serving Greater Vancouver and the Lower Mainland. We are bringing our marketing operations in-house and looking for an experienced Digital Marketing Manager to lead measurable growth through Google Ads, SEO, conversion optimization, and marketing analytics. This is not a Social Media Manager position. We already have one in place. We need someone who can take ownership of our paid and organic search strategy, improve lead generation, strengthen attribution, and help build a scalable customer-acquisition system. You will report directly to the Founder and CEO. Key Responsibilities Reactivate, manage, and optimize Google Ads using six years of historical campaign data. Develop and lead technical, on-page, local, and off-page SEO strategies. Manage Google Local Services Ads and Meta Ads where appropriate. Improve landing-page conversion rates through testing and optimization. Manage GoHighLevel tracking, dynamic number insertion, number pools, UTMs, and nurture sequences. Maintain accurate attribution between marketing spend, leads, sales, and closed revenue. Own Google Business Profile optimization, review generation, and local reputation strategy. Conduct competitor analysis across advertising, SEO, offers, and positioning. Develop seasonal lead-generation campaigns for roofing demand cycles. Provide clear SEO and development direction to our web developer. Direct the Social Media Manager's output where it supports the wider marketing strategy. Produce weekly reports connecting marketing performance to actual business results. Present results, explain performance, and recommend next steps directly to the CEO. What We're Looking For Strong Google Ads and SEO experience is essential. We are specifically looking for someone with: Demonstrated experience independently managing and optimizing Google Ads. Strong technical, on-page, local, and off-page SEO knowledge. A proven track record of generating qualified leads and revenue for a service-based business. Strong understanding of CPL, CPA, conversion rates, ROI, ROAS, and revenue attribution. Experience with conversion tracking, call tracking, Google Analytics, Search Console, and Google Business Profile. Experience developing SEO strategies and directing web developers. Experience with GoHighLevel or a comparable CRM and marketing automation platform. Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn campaign data into clear decisions. Excellent written English and strong organizational skills. Experience managing contractors, content creators, or other marketing team members. Experience in roofing, construction, home services, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, remodeling, landscaping, or another local B2C service industry is highly valued. Familiarity with JobNimbus, JustCall, Local Services Ads, structured data, AI-search optimization, or conversion-rate optimization is also an asset. Who This Role Is Not For This role is not primarily focused on: Social media posting Content scheduling Graphic design Influencer marketing Community management Brand-awareness campaigns without measurable lead-generation responsibility We already have social media support. We need someone whose strongest skills are Google Ads, SEO, analytics, attribution, and growing a service business through measurable digital marketing. Pay and Benefits Full-time independent contractor position. Base salary: $1,000-$1,500 USD per month, paid bi-weekly, depending on experience and demonstrated ability. Salary paid bi-weekly. Thirteenth-month bonus for candidates based in the Philippines; an equivalent structure may be discussed for candidates located elsewhere. Direct access to the Founder and CEO. Access to six years of historical campaign data, an existing Social Media Manager, and a web developer. Ongoing professional development and meaningful ownership of a major business function. Final candidates may be invited to complete a paid skills assessment. Applicants must consistently provide at least three hours of overlap with Vancouver business hours. Candidates working from the Philippines should be comfortable maintaining the required evening or overnight schedule long term. Why Cooper Roofing? We are looking for someone who wants genuine responsibility for business growth. Success in this role will be measured by qualified leads, customer acquisition cost, revenue, and growth, not social engagement metrics. If you have strong Google Ads and SEO experience and can demonstrate how your marketing work has helped a service business generate leads and revenue, we want to hear from you. Cooper Roofing encourages applications from qualified candidates of all backgrounds and experiences.

title: Real Estate Assistant
description: About the Job I am looking for one experienced Real Estate Assistant to join our growing remote marketing team, Engageify Marketing. This is a full-time, hands-on support role for someone who has previous experience working with real estate professionals, real estate teams, brokerages, or real estate clients. You should understand how the real estate industry operates and be familiar with the communication, organization, follow-up, documentation, scheduling, and administrative support required to keep real estate activities moving efficiently. You will assist with client communication, lead management, appointment coordination, CRM updates, transaction-related organization, database management, document preparation, reporting, and other administrative responsibilities. We are looking for more than someone who can complete basic administrative tasks. You should be able to understand instructions within a real estate context, recognize priorities, keep information organized, communicate professionally, and handle confidential client and business information responsibly. Because you may support multiple clients and projects, strong organization, attention to detail, reliability, trustworthiness, communication, and the ability to work without constant supervision are essential. This is a long-term opportunity for someone who wants to grow with Engageify Marketing and take on increasing real estate, client support, and operational responsibilities as their skills and performance develop. What You’ll Do 1. Real Estate Client and Lead Support * Assist with communication and follow-up for real estate leads, prospects, clients, agents, and other contacts. * Respond to routine client questions professionally and escalate important or sensitive concerns when necessary. * Follow up with new leads through email, SMS, phone calls, or CRM tasks based on established procedures. * Help ensure that every lead receives timely and appropriate communication. * Update lead statuses, notes, contact details, appointments, and follow-up activities inside the CRM. * Organize leads according to their stage, interest, timeline, location, property needs, or other relevant information. * Monitor follow-up tasks and help prevent leads or client requests from being overlooked. * Assist with buyer, seller, recruiting, referral, and past-client databases when needed. * Maintain a professional and helpful client experience throughout every interaction. * Handle client and business information with care, professionalism, and confidentiality. 2. Real Estate Administrative Support * Provide day-to-day administrative support for real estate agents, teams, brokerages, and client accounts. * Manage calendars, appointments, consultations, showings, meetings, interviews, and follow-up schedules. * Prepare and organize real estate documents, forms, checklists, templates, presentations, and client materials. * Review documents and information for missing details, errors, inconsistencies, or incomplete requirements. * Maintain accurate client records, contact information, property details, transaction notes, and activity histories. * Organize digital files, folders, documents, images, contracts, and client records using consistent naming systems. * Assist with data entry, spreadsheet updates, database cleanup, and record management. * Prepare meeting notes, task summaries, status updates, and basic reports. * Track deadlines, appointments, pending documents, follow-up dates, and assigned responsibilities. * Help create and maintain standard operating procedures, checklists, and administrative systems. * Support additional real estate and operational tasks as needed. 3. CRM and Database Management * Add, update, and organize contacts inside GoHighLevel or other real estate CRM platforms. * Maintain accurate contact records, tags, notes, pipeline stages, opportunities, and assigned tasks. * Review databases for duplicate contacts, incomplete information, incorrect tags, or outdated records. * Monitor pipelines and identify leads or clients who require follow-up. * Create and assign tasks based on lead activity, appointment status, or client needs. * Assist with basic email and SMS follow-up campaigns. * Help manage appointment confirmations, reminders, rescheduling requests, cancellations, and no-show follow-up. * Confirm that forms, calendars, notifications, and automated follow-up systems are working correctly. * Assist with importing, exporting, organizing, and reviewing contact lists. * Maintain accurate and confidential records across multiple client accounts. 4. Transaction and Listing Coordination Support * Assist with organizing transaction files, property information, client documents, and important deadlines. * Help track required documents, signatures, inspections, appraisals, financing updates, closing dates, and other transaction milestones. * Coordinate with agents, clients, lenders, title companies, inspectors, photographers, vendors, and other parties when instructed. * Prepare transaction checklists and follow up on outstanding items. * Assist with listing preparation, including gathering property details, photos, descriptions, disclosures, and marketing information. * Review listing information for accuracy before it is submitted or published. * Help schedule property photography, inspections, showings, open houses, and other appointments. * Maintain organized records for active, pending, closed, cancelled, and expired transactions. * Provide regular updates regarding outstanding documents, approaching deadlines, and incomplete tasks. Any activity requiring a real estate license must be handled by a properly licensed real estate professional. The Real Estate Assistant must follow all applicable company policies, legal requirements, and instructions regarding licensed and unlicensed activities. 5. Marketing and Operational Support * Assist with preparing property flyers, listing presentations, buyer guides, seller guides, newsletters, and other real estate materials. * Help organize property photos, videos, listing details, agent profiles, testimonials, and marketing assets. * Support social media scheduling and basic content posting when needed. * Assist with email campaigns, client updates, event invitations, and follow-up communication. * Help format and update information on landing pages, websites, forms, calendars, and CRM systems. * Review marketing materials for spelling, formatting, contact information, property details, and overall accuracy. * Coordinate administrative and marketing tasks across multiple real estate client accounts. * Communicate project progress, questions, missing information, and concerns proactively. * Support additional client, marketing, recruiting, and operational projects as needed. The Ideal Candidate Will Have * Previous experience working as a Real Estate Assistant, Real Estate Virtual Assistant, Transaction Coordinator, Listing Coordinator, Administrative Assistant, or similar role. * Experience supporting real estate agents, teams, brokerages, buyers, sellers, or other real estate clients. * A practical understanding of real estate terminology, client processes, transactions, listings, appointments, and follow-up. * Experience communicating professionally with real estate leads, clients, agents, and vendors. * Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks, clients, deadlines, and priorities. * Excellent attention to detail and the ability to identify missing, incorrect, or inconsistent information. * A trustworthy and professional approach to confidential client, transaction, and business information. * Ability to follow instructions, checklists, workflows, and standard operating procedures accurately. * Ability to work independently and complete responsibilities without constant supervision. * Ability to recognize urgent tasks and prioritize work appropriately. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Strong follow-up habits and a commitment to completing assigned tasks. * Professional judgment when handling client concerns, sensitive information, or unexpected situations. * Experience using CRM platforms, spreadsheets, calendars, email systems, and cloud-based file storage. * Strong data entry, documentation, and file organization skills. * Ability to learn new real estate systems, processes, and software quickly. * A reliable computer suitable for remote administrative work. * A stable internet connection and professional remote work environment. * Availability to consistently work from 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM Eastern Time, Monday through Friday. Strongly Preferred Tools and Experience Experience with several of the following will make you a stronger candidate: * GoHighLevel * Google Workspace * Google Drive * Google Docs * Google Sheets * Google Calendar * Microsoft Office * Microsoft Excel * Outlook * Zoom * Canva * Real estate transaction coordination * Listing coordination * Buyer and seller lead follow-up * Appointment management * Database organization and cleanup * CRM pipeline management * Email and SMS communication * Real estate recruiting support * Real estate marketing support * Document and contract organization * Client care and customer service * Vendor coordination * Reporting and spreadsheet management * Agency or multi-client support **NOTE:** Candidates do not need to be experts in every platform listed above. We place greater importance on relevant real estate experience, organization, attention to detail, trustworthiness, communication, reliability, professional judgment, and the ability to learn new tools and processes quickly. Candidates should be comfortable sharing their screen during the interview and demonstrating how they organize client information, manage a CRM, track follow-ups, maintain transaction or listing checklists, and handle multiple priorities. We want to understand not only which tools you have used, but also how you stay organized, prevent mistakes, protect confidential information, communicate with clients, and make sure important tasks are completed on time. Compensation $6.00 USD per hour How to Apply Please send the following: * Your resume or a summary of your relevant work experience. * A brief introduction describing your experience in the real estate industry. * A description of the real estate professionals, teams, brokerages, or clients you have previously supported. * Details about your experience communicating with real estate leads, buyers, sellers, agents, or vendors. * A short explanation of your experience with real estate transactions, listings, or client follow-up. * A list of the real estate CRM and transaction management platforms you have used. * Details about your experience using GoHighLevel or other CRM platforms. * Examples of the administrative systems, spreadsheets, checklists, or reports you have managed. * A short explanation of how you organize multiple tasks, clients, and deadlines. * A description of how you protect confidential client and business information. * Your current internet speed and computer specifications. * Confirmation that you can work from 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM Eastern Time, Monday through Friday. * Confirmation that you are willing to participate in a virtual interview with structured questions and a practical skills demonstration. * Please include the phrase **“Real Estate Assistant”** in the subject line of your application. Applications without relevant real estate experience may not be considered. Who We Are Engageify Marketing is a full-service marketing team that helps businesses generate leads, strengthen their brand, and grow through connected marketing systems.We bring together strategy, paid advertising, funnels, CRM, automation, content, creative, and performance tracking so every part of the customer journey works together.We value people who take ownership, think creatively, communicate proactively, and care about doing great work. Our team combines creativity, technical skill, accountability, and continuous improvement to deliver meaningful results for our clients. title: Shopify Expert
description: Shopify Developer / Technical Specialist We are looking for an experienced Shopify developer to help maintain, troubleshoot, and improve an established eCommerce website. This is not primarily a product-entry, merchandising, or general Shopify administration role. We need someone who is comfortable working at the technical level of Shopify: themes, Liquid, JavaScript, third-party applications, collection and filtering logic, performance, and technical SEO. What You’ll Be Working On The immediate project involves troubleshooting several issues on an existing Shopify store, but we’re looking for someone with the broader technical expertise to identify the underlying causes and implement solutions safely. Responsibilities may include: * Troubleshooting and configuring third-party Shopify apps and integrations, including search, autocomplete, filtering, and merchandising applications * Working with Shopify themes, Liquid, JavaScript, CSS, templates, sections, and related theme code * Diagnosing conflicts between apps, theme customizations, and Shopify’s native functionality * Configuring and troubleshooting Shopify Search & Discovery functionality and third-party search platforms such as Searchanise * Troubleshooting collection pages, including incorrect products appearing in collections, collection rules, tags, metafields, filtering, and product sorting * Understanding and correcting automated and manual collection logic * Investigating problems where theme or application changes unexpectedly affect templates, collection content, navigation, or other areas of the site * Reviewing and addressing technical issues identified through SEO/site audits * Identifying urgent technical SEO problems versus issues that can reasonably be addressed during a future site redesign * Improving site performance, crawlability, structured data, redirects, indexing behavior, and other technical Shopify/SEO issues where appropriate * Maintaining existing functionality while making changes rather than solving one problem at the expense of another Safe Development & Testing Is Important We need someone who follows a proper Shopify development workflow. Changes should generally be made to a duplicate/unpublished theme first, thoroughly tested, and presented for review before anything is deployed to the live site. You should be comfortable: * Duplicating, managing, and cleaning up Shopify themes * Developing and testing against unpublished themes * Previewing changes without affecting the production storefront * Testing changes across product, collection, search, navigation, and other relevant templates * Identifying potential dependencies before modifying theme code * Deploying approved changes to production safely * Rolling back changes when necessary We specifically want to avoid making experimental changes directly to the live theme. Current Priorities Our first priority is an existing Searchanise implementation. Searchanise has updated its integration for Shopify, and the store needs to be configured so features such as search autocomplete, SKU/product matching, search suggestions, menus, and filtering operate correctly. A previous attempt to implement the recommended changes caused unintended problems elsewhere on the site, including collection pages and collection-page content. We need someone capable of understanding the integration rather than simply following installation instructions and hoping it works. Our second priority is diagnosing problems with Shopify collections and product sorting. Some collection pages currently display products that clearly do not belong in those collections. We need the collection rules, product data, filtering, sorting, theme logic, and any app involvement investigated and corrected. We also have a technical site audit identifying additional issues. We’d like the developer to review these findings, determine which require immediate attention, and fix urgent problems. Less critical items may be incorporated into a larger upcoming site redesign. Skills We’re Looking For Strong experience with: * Shopify theme development * Shopify Liquid * HTML/CSS * JavaScript * Shopify’s collection and product architecture * Automated and manual collections * Metafields and product data * Search and filtering systems * Third-party Shopify app integrations * Debugging theme/app conflicts * Shopify Search & Discovery * Technical SEO for Shopify * Performance troubleshooting * Safe staging, testing, and deployment practices Experience with Searchanise specifically would be a strong plus, but we’re more interested in finding someone who understands Shopify well enough to diagnose integration problems properly. What We’re Looking For in a Developer We’re looking for someone who can investigate a problem, determine why it is happening, and recommend the correct solution—not someone who needs every change specified line by line. You should be comfortable inheriting an existing Shopify site, reading and understanding work done by previous developers, and distinguishing between theme problems, Shopify configuration problems, product-data problems, and third-party app problems. Good communication is also important. Before making significant changes, we’d like a concise explanation of what you found, what you recommend changing, and whether there are any risks or dependencies. When Applying Please briefly describe: * Your experience developing and troubleshooting Shopify stores * Your experience with Liquid and custom Shopify themes * Your experience troubleshooting third-party Shopify apps * Any experience with Searchanise or similar search/filtering applications * Your experience diagnosing collection/filtering issues * Your familiarity with technical SEO on Shopify * How you normally develop and test changes before deploying them to a live Shopify store Please include examples of Shopify sites you’ve worked on and, if possible, examples of troubleshooting or repair work rather than only new site builds.

title: Meta Ads Designer
description: READ THIS FIRST!! We are looking for a part-time Meta Ads Designer for approximately 20 hours per week, with the potential to grow into a full-time position. We are looking for someone who wants to become deeply involved in the brand — not someone who simply waits for a design brief, creates exactly what they're told, and moves on. Creative initiative is extremely important to us. We want a designer who looks at an idea and thinks: “I know how I can make this stronger — and I already have three other versions we should test.” You should be able to execute creative direction AND bring your own ideas to the table. If you're looking for a role where you can take ownership, develop your creative skills, learn what actually makes advertising perform, and potentially grow into a full-time position with a fast-growing brand, keep reading. How to Apply Please send us: Show us your strongest work. We are especially interested in Meta ads, ecommerce advertising, direct-response creative, DTC, beauty, skincare, wellness, or consumer brands. Whether you have strong, reliable internet Confirm your availability and hours Confirm your skills to use Figma Confirm you are interested in doing the test project If your portfolio looks like a fit, we'll send you a test project right away With design, we believe the fastest way to identify great talent is to see the actual work. We're not interested in multiple interviews or hypothetical questions. Resume + Portfolio → Test Project → Offer If your test project is great, we'll move quickly toward an offer. About MyMagicHealer MyMagicHealer is a fast-growing consumer skincare company with a mission to help people stress less over their skin. We sell across Shopify, Amazon, and TikTok Shop and have served hundreds of thousands of customers. Meta advertising is an important part of our growth, and we're looking for a talented designer to help us consistently produce exceptional advertising creative. What You'll Own Your primary responsibility will be designing high-performing Meta ad creatives. You will work closely with our creative and growth team to turn customer research, hooks, offers, creative concepts, winning ads, and performance insights into new advertising creative. You will: Design static ads for Meta Turn creative briefs and rough ideas into polished ads Create multiple variations of winning creatives Come up with your own visual concepts and advertising ideas Research competitor ads and successful DTC brands Study our winning and losing creatives Use performance learnings to improve future designs Test different layouts, headlines, product presentations, testimonials, benefits, offers, and visual approaches Iterate quickly based on feedback Keep creative files organized Consistently deliver work on time We Don't Just Want Someone Who Makes Things Pretty A beautiful ad that doesn't communicate anything isn't a successful ad. We are looking for someone who understands that Meta ads need to get attention, communicate quickly, and ultimately drive action. You should naturally think: Why would someone stop scrolling? What's the first thing their eye sees? Is the message immediately clear? How could I make this concept stronger? What else could we test? You don't need to be a media buyer. But you should be genuinely curious about what happens after your ad launches. Did it perform? Why? What can we learn? What should we create next? What We're Looking For You should have: Strong graphic design skills Excellent visual taste Experience designing digital or social advertising A strong understanding of typography, hierarchy, composition, contrast, and layout Experience with Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, Canva, or similar tools Ability to work quickly without sacrificing quality Strong attention to detail Ability to follow brand guidelines while still thinking creatively Strong organization and time management Ability to receive feedback and iterate quickly Curiosity about advertising, consumer psychology, and creative performance Experience with Meta Ads, ecommerce, DTC, skincare, beauty, wellness, supplements, or consumer brands is highly preferred. Creative Initiative Is Extremely Important We will give you: Creative strategy Customer research Hooks Messaging Winning ads Performance insights References Product information But we do not want someone who needs every design decision explained to them. We want you to bring ideas too. You should regularly be looking at: Meta Ad Library Competitors DTC brands Creative trends Winning ads Customer reviews Our own creative performance …and thinking: “What should we test next?” What Success Looks Like An exceptional person in this role will: Consistently produce strong new Meta creatives Deliver work on schedule Quickly turn winning concepts into new iterations Proactively bring new visual ideas to the team Improve their creative based on performance data Become increasingly independent Understand our brand and customer deeply Become someone the team can trust to take an idea and run with it For the right person, there is an opportunity for this position to grow from approximately 20 hours/week into a full-time role as the company and creative needs continue to grow. NON-NEGOTIABLE: Strong & Reliable Internet This is extremely important. Because this is a remote position, you MUST have strong and reliable internet. You will regularly need to: Download and upload large creative files Work in cloud-based tools Attend team calls Communicate with the team Access shared drives and project management systems Repeated internet issues that prevent you from attending calls, uploading files, or completing work efficiently will not work for this role. Please make sure you have a reliable internet connection and working setup before applying. You Will Probably Love This Role If... You constantly notice ads while scrolling. You save interesting creatives because something about them catches your attention. You enjoy figuring out why an ad works. You get excited when something you designed performs well. You don't need someone else to come up with every idea. You're fast. You're curious. You're reliable. You like feedback. And when someone gives you one concept, your brain immediately starts thinking about five other ways to execute it. You Should NOT Apply If... You only want to execute exactly what is written in a brief You need extremely detailed instructions before starting You don't proactively bring creative ideas You dislike receiving feedback or making iterations You regularly miss deadlines You aren't interested in understanding how your creative performs You have unreliable internet You struggle to communicate consistently while working remotely You cannot reliably commit approximately 20 hours per week One Last Thing We're not hiring someone simply because they know how to use Photoshop, Canva, or Figma. We're looking for a creative thinker who happens to be an excellent designer. Someone who can execute. Someone who brings ideas. Someone who wants to know whether their work actually performed. And someone who has the potential to grow with us from this part-time role into an important full-time member of our creative team.

title: Looking for AI-Assisted YouTube Thumbnail Designer
job_title: Looking for AI-Assisted YouTube Thumbnail Designer
description: Job Overview: We’re looking for a talented Thumbnail Maker to join our team and create high-quality visual content for our YouTube channels, both focused on movie and entertainment content. You’ll be responsible for creating eye-catching, high-converting YouTube thumbnails, while also helping with other visual content such as LinkedIn posts and carousel images. We have AI tools available that you can use to speed up your workflow, including LoveArt and Google AI Studio. However, we’re looking for someone who has strong design skills and can use Photoshop when thumbnails require additional editing, compositing, or refinement. Pay: ???? $40–$60 per month with potential for increases based on performance ???? 9 thumbnails per week initially, with more work/channels available based on performance Responsibilities: Create high-converting, scroll-stopping YouTube thumbnails for our Youtube channels. Use LoveArt and Google AI Studio to assist with thumbnail creation and visual concepts. Edit and refine AI-generated images using Photoshop when needed. Follow each channel’s established thumbnail style, branding, and visual guidelines. Create thumbnails that match the topic, title, emotion, and story of each video. Create visual content for LinkedIn posts and carousel images. Collaborate with the team to improve designs and ensure content matches our creative direction. Deliver final files in the correct size, format, and quality. Organize thumbnail files and other visual assets properly in Google Drive. Requirements: Proven experience creating YouTube thumbnails. Good Photoshop skills — this is important as some thumbnails will require manual editing. Good understanding of visual hierarchy, composition, contrast, and text readability. Experience using AI image/design tools such as LoveArt, Google AI Studio, Midjourney, or similar. Able to combine AI-generated assets with Photoshop editing to create polished final thumbnails. Strong understanding of what makes a thumbnail clickable. Creative, detail-oriented, and able to follow an established visual style. Able to work independently and consistently meet deadlines. Good English communication skills. Nice to Have: Experience designing thumbnails for movie, entertainment, or YouTube automation channels. Experience creating LinkedIn graphics and carousel posts. Familiarity with CTR optimization and A/B testing. Experience analyzing successful thumbnails and using those insights to improve designs. Ability to create original thumbnail concepts rather than simply following templates. Tools We Provided: LoveArt AI Google AI Studio Brand templates, fonts, and design guidelines Google Drive for file organization You don’t need to pay for these AI tools yourself. We will provide access to the tools needed for the work. Application Instructions: If you’ve read the full job description, please include: Links to your best YouTube thumbnail designs or portfolio. Examples of thumbnails you personally created using Photoshop. Examples of any AI-assisted designs you have created, if available. A brief description of your experience with AI design tools. Applications without thumbnail samples or a portfolio will not be considered. We’re looking for someone who can become a long-term part of the team, with the opportunity to handle more channels and more work based on performance.

job_title: Appointment-Setting Call Agent -- US Aesthetics / MedSpa (Cosmetic Bookings)
description: Full-time. Must work US Eastern business hours (about 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM ET). For most of the Philippines this is an evening/overnight shift -- please only apply if that schedule genuinely works for you long-term. ABOUT US We're a busy South Florida aesthetics and med-spa practice -- injectables, laser, skin treatments, and more (we're part of a dermatology practice, so there's a medical side too, but this role is all about our cosmetic and med-spa services). People call and message us every day curious about these treatments, and a lot of them just need a warm, confident person to answer their questions and get them on the schedule. That's the job. REQUIRED -- please don't apply without this: - Appointment-setting / front-desk / patient-coordinator experience in a med-spa, plastic surgery, cosmetic dermatology, or aesthetics practice. This is a hard requirement, not a preference. You must have actually booked cosmetic consults and treatments before -- talked about injectables, laser, and skin services with real clients, handled their price questions, and moved them onto the schedule. If your experience is only general customer service or non-aesthetic industries, this role isn't the right fit. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Answer inbound calls and messages from people interested in our cosmetic and med-spa services, and turn that interest into booked appointments and consultations. - Make outbound follow-up calls to people who inquired but haven't booked yet -- gently, professionally, never pushy. - Answer common questions about our aesthetic services, pricing, and what to expect. - Keep the schedule full: confirm appointments, fill cancellations, and follow up so leads don't go cold. - Log every call and follow-up cleanly so nothing falls through the cracks. - Keep all client information completely confidential. WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR - A natural closer with a soft touch. You turn "just checking" into a booked consult without ever sounding like a pushy salesperson. Warm, confident, patient. - Excellent spoken and written English -- clear, warm, and professional on the phone. - Common sense, maturity, and the ability to work independently -- you can read a situation, make a sensible call, and keep things moving with no supervisor standing over your shoulder. - Organized and reliable -- you follow through on every callback and confirmation. - Comfortable learning new software quickly (we'll train you on our scheduling and phone systems). NICE TO HAVE (a plus) - Familiarity with specific aesthetic brands and treatments (Botox/Dysport, filler, laser devices, etc.). - Experience with a CRM, scheduling platform, or EHR. REQUIREMENTS Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet place to take calls, a working headset. Backup power/internet is a plus. TO APPLY Start your message with the exact phrase "Let's get them booked!" (this is how we know you read the whole post). Then (1) attach your CV/resume, and (2) in 2-3 sentences, name the med-spa / plastic surgery / cosmetic / aesthetics practice you did appointment setting for, and tell me about a time you turned a hesitant or "just asking" caller into a booked appointment there -- what they were unsure about and how you got them on the schedule. Applications that skip the phrase, the CV, or the aesthetic-practice experience won't be reviewed.

Monitor AI platform presence and citation rates and adjust content strategy based on findings - Stay ahead of how AI search behavior is evolving and bring proactive recommendations to the team **Content Strategy and Production Support** - Build and manage content calendars targeting non-brand organic keywords and AI-answer queries - Brief or write content that ranks, earns citations, and supports the buyer journey from awareness through conversion - Identify content gaps across client sites and prioritize based on traffic potential, competition, and revenue opportunity **Reporting and Analytics** - Report on organic traffic, keyword rankings, CTR, Core Web Vitals, AI citation presence, and revenue contribution - Connect SEO performance to bottom-line outcomes using available analytics data - Translate data into clear insights and prioritized next steps for both internal teams and clients ## What You Bring - Proven experience managing technical SEO for e-commerce websites that generate organic traffic and revenue - Familiarity with AI visibility tools such as Scrunch AI, Profound, or similar platforms - Background in performance marketing or growth analytics alongside SEO - Experience supporting site migrations or platform transitions with zero organic traffic loss - Prior agency experience managing SEO across multiple e-commerce client accounts simultaneously ## How to Apply Please include: 1. Your **updated resume** 2. A **link to 2 to 3 examples of SEO work** you owned including the URL, the target keyword or initiative, and the measurable outcome 3. A **short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes)** introducing yourself, walking through one technical SEO or AIO win you are proud of, and explaining how you connected it to a business outcome **Only candidates who submit both work examples and a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.**

We are looking for an exceptional Project Manager who will oversee projects from contract through final installation while ensuring every customer receives an outstanding experience. This is not a position for someone who waits to be told what to do. We are looking for a proactive, organized, detail-oriented individual who takes ownership of their work, communicates exceptionally well, and enjoys solving problems before they happen. ____ About You You are someone who: - Takes ownership of every project. - Is highly organized and detail-oriented. - Communicates professionally and confidently with customers and team members. - Thrives in a fast-paced environment. - Learns new software and processes quickly. - Can prioritize multiple projects without missing deadlines. - Thinks ahead and identifies potential issues before they become problems. - Is resourceful, dependable, and accountable. - Continuously looks for ways to improve systems and processes. ____ Responsibilities As a Project Manager, you will be responsible for coordinating projects from the time the contract is signed until the project is successfully completed. Responsibilities include: - Managing multiple projects simultaneously. - Coordinating project schedules with customers and field personnel. - Scheduling templating, fabrication, deliveries, and installations. - Communicating with customers throughout every stage of the project. - Coordinating with sales, templators, fabricators, installers, and subcontractors. - Reviewing project documentation for accuracy before production. - Following up on customer approvals and outstanding items. - Tracking project progress daily and ensuring deadlines are met. - Identifying scheduling conflicts and resolving issues proactively. - Maintaining accurate project notes and documentation. - Ensuring all projects follow Stone Creation's internal procedures and quality standards. - Providing exceptional customer service from start to finish. ____ Qualifications Required - Previous experience managing construction projects or stone fabrication/tile projects. - Experience in the stone, tile, cabinetry, kitchen & bath, General Construction, or remodeling industry. - Excellent written and spoken English. - Outstanding organizational and time management skills. - Strong customer service and communication skills. - Ability to multitask and manage multiple deadlines. - Strong problem-solving skills. -- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision. - Highly proficient with computers and learning new software. ____ Preferred - Software Experience - Experience with any of the following is a plus: - Any construction management platform whether stone based or GC based - Slack - Microsoft Office - Google Workspace - Zoom Don't worry if you haven't used every program—we're looking for someone who learns quickly. ____ What Success Looks Like Our ideal Project Manager: - Keeps projects moving without being reminded. -Anticipates problems before they affect the customer. -Communicates proactively with customers and the internal team. - Maintains accurate schedules and documentation. - Takes pride in delivering an exceptional customer experience. - Helps improve our processes as the company continues to grow. ____ What We Offer - Full-time, long-term employment. - Opportunity for growth within a rapidly expanding company. - Performance-based raises. - Paid time off. - Ongoing training and development. A supportive team environment where your ideas and contributions matter. We are building a team for the long term and are looking for someone who wants to grow with us. ____ How to Apply Please submit: - Your resume. - A short introduction about yourself. - Why you believe you would be a great fit for this role. - A brief description of the most challenging project you've managed and how you successfully handled it. Important: To show that you pay attention to detail, please include the words "Stone PM Ready" as the first line of your application. Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered. We look forward to welcoming an exceptional Project Manager to the Stone Creation team.

description: Please just send us any message if you're interested, and we will send you a Google Form. All applications will be considered through the form. Why strong setters join us We built a role where your results are directly reflected in what you earn — with a guaranteed base, clear performance bonuses, and a team that genuinely invests in your growth. title: Microsoft 365 Administrator, Level 3 (Part-Time)
description: Part-Time Microsoft 365 IT Technician - Level 3 Architecture & Security Operations About the role RankStudio is hiring a part-time Level 3 Microsoft 365 IT Technician to own architecture and security operations for a growing portfolio of small biotech and pharma client environments. This is a hands-on, senior technical role - not a ticket-support seat. You will design and implement M365 architecture, own security operations end-to-end, and build the automation that keeps client environments compliant and secure. You will work independently under the direction of RankStudio's CEO, who serves as the senior technical advisor across all engagements. This role is designed for an experienced practitioner with an existing day job, freelance practice, or flexible schedule who wants meaningful architecture work at a boutique AI consulting firm. It is not a full-time seat, and it is not a bridge to full-time employment. What you will own: .Architecture - Design Microsoft 365 tenant configurations, security baselines, and compliance postures for biotech and pharma clients across 5-15 client environments. You own the design; the CEO reviews it. Security operations - Own vulnerability management, i ---------- response, and security posture monitoring across client tenants. Not alert triage as a ticket-taker - SecOps as the responsible technician. Infrastructure as code - Build and maintain Bicep, ARM, or Terraform templates for repeatable tenant deployments. Version-controlled in GitHub. Reviewed for consistency across client environments. PowerShell automation - Write PowerShell scripts and Microsoft Graph SDK workflows from scratch for tenant configuration, user lifecycle, license management, security policy deployment, and compliance reporting. This is a build role, not a run-existing-scripts role. Microsoft Purview architecture - Design and deploy sensitivity labels, DLP policies, retention schedules, eDiscovery workflows, and Insider Risk Management for regulated clients (21 CFR Part 11, HIPAA). Entra ID architecture - Design conditional access frameworks, PIM configurations, access review cycles, and identity governance for client tenants. Intune deployment architecture - Design BYOD and corporate device management approaches including App Protection Policies for regulated data on personal devices. Deploy compliance policies, configuration profiles, and app management workflows. Defender for Endpoint and Defender for O365 - Own policy design, tuning, and i ---------- response ownership. Not queue watching. Documentation - Author architecture decision records, runbooks, and configuration baselines that other technicians can operate from. Required experience: 4+ years hands-on M365 tenant administration, at least 2 of which in a managed services or multi-tenant consulting context. PowerShell scripting from scratch - you can sit down and write a working script for an M365 admin task without starting from a template or AI-generated skeleton. You use documentation and AI tools to accelerate your work, but the underlying capability is yours. Infrastructure as code exposure - you have deployed at least one production environment (Azure resources, M365 baselines, or comparable) via Bicep, ARM, Terraform, or M365 DSC, and can explain the trade-offs of the tool you used. Hands-on Intune - you have deployed compliance policies, configuration profiles, and App Protection Policies (MAM without enrollment) in production. Hands-on Entra ID / Azure AD - you have designed conditional access frameworks, deployed PIM, and run access reviews in production. Working Purview knowledge - you have deployed sensitivity labels, DLP policies, or retention schedules in production. Purview forensics-only experience (eDiscovery for hard-deleted data) does not qualify. Security operations ownership - you have owned vulnerability remediation, security i ---------- response, or compliance posture for at least one production environment as the responsible technician, not as a ticket-response contributor. Excellent written English - has good writing and communications skills Reliable home internet (50 Mbps minimum) and a personal computer capable of running M365 admin centers and a virtual desktop. Strongly preferred: Microsoft certifications - MS-102, SC-300, SC-400, AZ-104, AZ-500, MD-102. Full stack not required; two or three genuine, in-date certs are stronger signal than a long list of stale ones. Past role at a Microsoft Partner or MSP serving SMB or mid-market clients across multiple tenants. Experience with M365 backup tooling - Veeam M365, AvePoint, Druva, or Spanning. Healthcare or life sciences client experience - 21 CFR Part 11, HIPAA, or GxP compliance context. Ticketing systems- Freshdesk, Zendesk, ConnectWise, or HaloPSA administration (as the person configuring the tool, not the person filling tickets in it). Workflow automation exposure - n8n, Power Automate, or Logic Apps for admin task automation. Disqualifiers: Primary career experience is ticket / desk / support work, even if the resume shows M365 admin-center exposure. This role is architecture and SecOps ownership. Section titles matter: "IT Service Desk Analyst," "Technical Support Engineer," "Help Desk Technician" as the dominant career pattern will not fit, regardless of how the current job is titled. Cannot write PowerShell without templates or AI-generated skeletons. AI-assisted scripting is expected. Inability to write from scratch is disqualifying - the role requires building automation others will run. No production infrastructure-as-code experience. Training or self-study on IaC is not sufficient. No hands-on Intune configuration profile or App Protection Policy deployment. Reading Microsoft Learn on Intune is not the same as deploying it. Purview knowledge limited to eDiscovery forensics. The role requires deploying labels, DLP, and retention — governance, not just search. Cannot commit to consistent weekly hours during Pacific business hours overlap. The role is asynchronous but requires reliable availability during the overlap window. Requires this role as primary income. The compensation and hours are structured for candidates with an existing income base. Engagement and pay Independent contractor agreement 100% Remote Part-time commitment: 20 hours per week, flexible scheduling with required overlap during Pacific business hours (specific overlap window to be agreed with the CEO). Fixed monthly retainer: USD 900 to 1,000 per month, paid in USD via Wise.

title: MEDIA BUYER | GOOGLE ADS + TAG MANAGER + TRACKING
job_title: MEDIA BUYER | GOOGLE ADS + TAG MANAGER + TRACKING
description: MEDIA BUYER | GOOGLE ADS + TAG MANAGER + TRACKING | PART TIME INTERNAL ROLE $9 USD/hour to start | 10 hours per week | Long-term | Internal Legacy Growth team role JOB OVERVIEW This is not a client placement. You would be joining the Legacy Growth team directly and working alongside our founders on paid media across our client accounts. We are looking for a seasoned media buyer who wants a focused part time role with a team that will actually respect your expertise. You will not be handed a checklist. You will own the paid side, tell us what you are seeing, and tell us when we are wrong. Google Ads is the requirement. Meta is a plus. We need someone who genuinely knows Google Ads, not someone who has run a few campaigns inside a dashboard. Just as important, we need someone who understands everything sitting underneath the campaign. When a conversion stops firing, when tags break after a site change, when the numbers in the ad account do not match the numbers in the CRM, you should know where to look and be able to fix it yourself. You should have advanced, repeated, hands on experience with Google Ads campaign builds and Google Tag Manager setups. Not once. Several times, for real clients, from scratch. The technical side matters as much as the buying side. That includes Google Tag Manager container builds, GA4, conversion tracking and enhanced conversions, event setup, tracking that connects the ad account to a CRM, and diagnosing tracking that has silently broken. If your answer to a broken tag is to ask someone else to look at it, this is not the right role. Reliability is the other half of this job. Ten hours a week does not mean ten hours in one sitting. We need you present and responsive five days a week, because ad accounts do not wait. Spend does not pause while someone is offline. We need someone who checks in consistently, flags problems the same day, and never goes quiet. We are looking for someone to start as early as September 1. WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING Building, launching, and managing Google Ads campaigns across multiple client accounts. Google Tag Manager container setup, conversion tracking, and GA4 configuration. Troubleshooting tracking, tags, conversions, and integrations when they break. Monitoring spend and performance, and adjusting before problems compound rather than after. Reporting clearly on what is working, what is not, and what you recommend changing. Working directly with our founders on strategy and account decisions. Meta ads work as a secondary responsibility if that is in your skill set. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR At least 5 years of hands on paid advertising experience. Deep Google Ads expertise. This is not negotiable for this role. Advanced Google Tag Manager and conversion tracking experience, done repeatedly for real clients. Strong troubleshooting instincts across the full tracking stack, not just the ad platform. Meta ads experience. This is a plus, not a requirement. Reliable presence and responsiveness five days a week. Strong written and spoken English and genuine comfort communicating with U.S. clients and founders. Availability to start as early as September 1. ABOUT LEGACY GROWTH Legacy Growth Consulting is a U.S. based marketing and technology agency with a distributed team across the U.S. and Philippines. We build marketing ecosystems, content engines, and systems for coaches, consultants, and service based businesses. This role sits on our internal team, not with a single client. You would be working across our accounts alongside our founders and our existing team of strategists, builders, and creatives. We care about skill, but we also care deeply about communication, honesty, initiative, ownership, and finding people we genuinely want to work with long-term. We want someone who grows with us. HOW TO APPLY Please DO NOT apply through OnlineJobs.ph. Apply here: legacygrowth.life/ph After applying, email ---------- with the subject "Google Ads Media Buyer." In that email, please send us all of the following: A live link to your resume. Check the link works and is set to public before you send it. A live link to your portfolio or case studies. Your years of Google Ads experience and your years of Meta Ads experience, listed separately. Examples of ad accounts you have managed. Tell us the industry, the monthly spend you were responsible for, and what results you produced. A specific description of Google Tag Manager and conversion tracking setups you have built from scratch, including what you configured and what platforms you connected. One example of a tracking or conversion problem you diagnosed and fixed. Tell us what broke, how you found it, and what you did about it. Your email address and your phone number with WhatsApp. Your earliest available start date. A brief video introduction. For the video, walk us through a Google Ads account you have actually run and a Tag Manager setup you have actually built. Screen share if you are able to. We care less about polished production and more about seeing how you think, how you diagnose a problem, and how you communicate. We are hiring now and will move quickly for the right person.

You speak and write fluent English and know how to communicate clearly, professionally, and compassionately. A people person. You genuinely enjoy helping others and understand that every patient interaction is an opportunity to build trust. Extremely organized. You love checklists, calendars, follow-ups, detailed notes, and making sure every task gets completed. Tech-savvy. description: Hey! I’m looking for someone who can help me aggressively generate high-quality leads for my online fitness coaching business through Instagram. This is more than just responding to DMs. I’m looking for someone who can actively hunt for potential clients every day and consistently build a pipeline of prospects. Your responsibilities would include: • Engaging with every new follower I receive and starting conversations with them when appropriate. ( I have saved replies you can easily click on as well for the initial message) • Scrubbing Instagram for high-intent prospects — for example, finding people commenting things like “COACH,” “INFO,” “HOW,” etc. under posts from larger fitness/bodybuilding/fitness coaching accounts, since these people are actively showing interest in coaching. • Cold outreach at high volume — sending as many quality DMs as Instagram reasonably allows each day while still making the messages personalized enough to actually start conversations. • Finding potential clients through Instagram search, hashtags, followers of relevant fitness accounts, engagement on fitness content, and similar sources. • Following high-quality potential leads to get on their radar and engaging with their content where appropriate. • Unfollowing low-quality/unresponsive prospects after an appropriate period so the account stays organized and the following list doesn’t become cluttered. • Tracking conversations and prospects so we know who has been contacted, who responded, who is interested, who needs follow-up, and who is no longer a prospect. • Following up consistently with people who showed interest but didn’t book or move forward. • Ultimately, the goal is to identify people who are likely to need online coaching, start conversations with them, qualify them, and get qualified prospects onto calls with me. I’m looking for someone who is very proactive. I don't want someone who sits around waiting for followers or inbound messages. I want someone who is constantly looking for new opportunities and finding people who could realistically become coaching clients while I handle pushing out quality content. I’m especially interested in someone who can work consistently every day, handle high DM volume, stay organized, and focus on quality prospects rather than just sending random messages. For example, if you know how to find qualified prospects through LinkedIn, Facebook, TikTok, Reddit, or other platforms and successfully direct them to my Instagram or coaching website, that would be extremely valuable. If you have experience using AI tools, automations, or other software to find, research, qualify, or generate high-quality leads, that is an even bigger plus. I’m especially interested in someone who can leverage AI to make the lead-generation process more efficient and consistently bring in more qualified prospects. I’m looking for someone who can think outside the box and continuously find new ways to generate qualified leads, rather than being limited to one platform or method. The more value and qualified leads you’re able to bring to the business, the more your pay will increase and your performance will be rewarded. Please tell me, how many hours per day you can work, and roughly how many qualified prospects you believe you can find/contact per week.
