title: Operations Team Lead (Remote)
description: Operations Team Lead(Remote) for SteelSafe Self Storage Pay: up to $2,000 / month Schedule: 8:00 AM–6:00 PM EST (Mon–Fri), 1 hour lunch Work Location: Remote (Philippines) At SteelSafe we get things get finished. Leads don’t sit. Follow-ups don’t disappear. Customer problems don’t get “noted” and forgotten. If you’re the type of manager who needs constant reminders or gives status updates without results, this won’t be a fit. If you like building a strong team, coaching people to improve, and running a clean system where nothing falls through the cracks, keep reading. What you’ll be doing -You’ll manage a team of remote CSRs in the Philippines and help us build a reliable sales and service engine. -You will also take calls. Our volume is manageable (usually around 15 calls per CSR per day). We expect you to lead by example, not just by telling people what to do. What you’ll own (non-negotiables) -You will make sure no rentals are missed. Every day you will check every lead source and make sure every opportunity has a real outcome. -You will review website form submissions and confirm whether they rented. If they did not rent, you will call them, log them properly in CallPotential, and document the result and next step. -You will review CallPotential leads and reservations daily, make sure the status is correct (Lead vs Reservation), verify outcomes, and follow up to close. -You will review inbound sales calls and make sure non-renters are called back with a real attempt to convert, and you will document what happened. -Every lead must end the day as one of three things: rented, didn’t rent (with the reason), or a scheduled follow-up with a specific date and time. -You will run a real call review and coaching system. This is not “we’ll review calls when we have time.” -The expectation is that you review sales calls daily (or meet a minimum standard if call volume spikes), and you review at least five service calls per day looking for service recovery issues. -When calls are weak—missed close, wrong information, tone problems, or a bad customer experience—you will send short, clear coaching feedback, coach the CSR directly, and make sure the correction shows up within the next 24–48 hours. -You will also save coaching examples into a simple training library so the whole team improves over time. -You will handle escalations and service recovery. -If someone is upset, did not rent because of the experience, or has a sensitive issue, you will personally follow up, fix the issue, and turn it into a win when possible. -You will make sure escalations are actually resolved, not just “handled.” -You will set the standard, train people, enforce quality, and hold the line. That includes hiring and training when needed, assigning tasks and expectations clearly, correcting problems quickly when performance slips, and keeping the team professional and consistent. -A non-negotiable part of this job is “close-the-loop” control. -You will review each CSR’s daily update. We do not accept status-only updates. -Every item must have a result or a next step. -Anything labeled “pending customer response” must have a follow-up plan and a scheduled date. -If something is not confirmed complete, it must be assigned a next action with an owner and a due time. -No dropped balls. No silent failures. Reporting (daily + weekly) -Each day you will post a simple daily report so leadership has clarity and the team stays sharp. -That daily report must include: forms reviewed, leads and reservations reviewed, new rentals closed, open follow-ups, calls listened to, calls flagged, the patterns you are seeing, which CSRs missed closes, what coaching was given, unhappy customers identified and recovered, anything left open, and tomorrow’s focus. -Each week you will produce a scorecard showing leads vs rentals and conversion percent by source (website, CallPotential, inbound calls), performance by CSR (calls, rentals, conversion percent), top wins, and the top focus areas for next week. You’re a great fit if… You take ownership and solve problems instead of passing them around. You’re a real coach who is clear and helpful, but firm when needed. You like numbers and performance tracking. Your spoken and written English is excellent, and you’re confident on the phone. You can lead with high standards without being toxic. Small business reality Random urgent things will come up sometimes. We want someone who stays calm, proposes options, makes decisions, and follows through. This is not an executive assistant role, but it is a role for someone who solves problems. How to apply (required) Please send your resume, and let us know what ownership means to you!

I need someone who is genuinely good with numbers and understands the short-term rental business from both sides — the spreadsheet and the listing. The company operates across three core businesses: Luxury Fashion Film & Entertainment Music These are separate businesses, but they are being built as parts of one interconnected cultural world. A film can connect to a collection. Music can connect to a film. Content, campaigns, events, partnerships, and releases can all reinforce one another. We need someone who can see the entire board. What You’ll Do You will work directly with the founder to: Translate vision and ideas into clear priorities and execution plans Maintain a master roadmap across fashion, film, music, content, events, and company initiatives Coordinate different teams and ensure projects do not develop in isolation Track deliverables, owners, deadlines, dependencies, and outstanding decisions Run regular project and leadership check-ins Follow up relentlessly and make sure decisions become action Identify problems, conflicts, and delays before they reach the founder Maintain continuity across creative and business decisions Organize company strategy, documentation, and institutional knowledge Determine what requires founder involvement and what can move forward independently Connect opportunities across different parts of the company Build systems and processes as the organization grows Help protect the founder's time and attention You will have visibility into nearly everything being built. Who We’re Looking For You are extremely organized, but you are not simply a project manager. You think strategically. You can understand why something matters, how it connects to the larger vision, and what downstream consequences a decision might create. You have strong creative instincts and genuine interest in fashion, cinema, music, culture, storytelling, and brand building. You are comfortable working with a founder who moves quickly, generates a high volume of ideas, and is deeply involved in the creative direction of the company. Most importantly, you are someone who takes ownership. When an objective is established, you don't wait to be told every individual step required to accomplish it. Ideal Experience Experience in one or more of the following would be valuable: Chief of Staff / Founder’s Office Entertainment or film development Luxury fashion Music / record labels Media companies Creative agencies Production Brand strategy Founder-led startups You do not need to be an expert in fashion, film, and music simultaneously. What Success Looks Like Within 30 days, you should understand the company's vision, major projects, teams, priorities, deadlines, and current bottlenecks. Within 60-90 days, the founder should be able to communicate an objective to you and trust that you can help turn it into an organized plan across the appropriate teams. What founder-led company or creative institution do you believe has done an exceptional job building across multiple areas of culture? Why? Why does this role specifically interest you? We care significantly more about how you think than perfectly polished answers. Engagement We are looking to begin on a contract basis, with the potential to develop into a substantial long-term leadership role for the right person. This position requires genuine availability and commitment. We are not looking for someone juggling a large roster of unrelated clients. We are looking for someone who wants to go deep, understand the vision, take ownership, and help build something from the ground up.

job_title: Business Operations Manager | Revenue, Systems & Execution
description: A small, established U.S. services company is hiring a full-time operator in the Philippines to make the business run with greater clarity, follow-through, and discipline. We serve customers through several physical locations and a substantial remote program. We also work with international partners and are building internal software to replace fragmented tools and make the operation easier to manage. We are keeping the company name private in the public advertisement and will share it with selected interview candidates. This is an operating seat, not an executive-assistant queue and not a CFO or controller position. You will work directly with the founder, but you will not wait for a daily task list. Your job is to understand how customers, money, work, and commitments move through the company, identify what is stuck or unclear, and bring it to a responsible conclusion. WHAT YOU WILL OWN - Maintain one dependable view of customer status, open opportunities, onboarding, delivery, billing, receivables, risks, owners, and next actions. - Pursue loose ends with customers, staff, partners, and vendors until each item is resolved, deliberately deferred, or escalated with a recommendation. - Make sure inquiries, purchases, renewals, refunds, billing questions, and collection items do not disappear between systems or people. - Prepare a short weekly founder brief covering cash, expected receipts, urgent obligations, customer risks, decisions, and unresolved exceptions. - Keep the operating cash calendar current, including expected receipts, invoices, rent, payroll inputs, recurring bills, and unusual commitments. - Perform light bookkeeping and finance operations: review invoice support, track AP and AR, match payments to customers or invoices, code straightforward expenses, perform basic reconciliations, investigate exceptions, and keep documentation organized. - Coordinate with the bookkeeper, controller, payroll provider, and tax professional. You are not expected to replace technical specialists, but you are expected to give them complete records, ask good questions, and follow their open items to completion. - Build practical SOPs, checklists, dashboards, escalation rules, and handoffs after you understand the real work. - Become a serious daily user of our emerging internal operating platform. Identify missing states, controls, reports, and automations, test improvements, and explain what the system needs to support the business. - Lead or coordinate additional support later when the workload justifies it. The role begins hands-on. WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT - It is not calendar management, inbox triage, or a collection of unrelated assistant tasks. - It is not a pure project-management role where updating the board counts as finishing the work. - It is not a senior-finance title that delegates all transaction-level work. - It is not the sole technical accounting seat. Historical cleanup, formal close, tax work, and complex accounting remain with qualified specialists. FIRST 30 DAYS By day 30, the successful operator will have: - Produced a clear operating map of customers, revenue flows, recurring obligations, systems, access needs, owners, and unresolved risks. - Established and consistently used one follow-through system plus a concise founder communication rhythm. - Completed a books and finance-operations diagnostic, organized the available support, resolved routine discrepancies within the role’s scope, and created an owner, priority, and target-date plan for specialist items. - Documented at least three high-priority SOPs selected with the founder and created a practical improvement backlog. Success does not mean that every inherited problem must be solved in 30 days. It means demonstrated ownership, useful discovery, dependable communication, sound escalation, and concrete progress on these outcomes. WHAT STRONG EVIDENCE LOOKS LIKE - At least five years in business operations, customer operations, revenue operations, practice or agency operations, account management, implementation, project operations, or a comparable role with real ownership. - A history of personally rescuing stalled work, revenue, customer commitments, or cross-team projects and changing the process so the same failure became less likely. - Clear spoken and written English with U.S. customers and a founder. - Comfort with CRM, billing, task, documentation, spreadsheet, and automation tools. Experience with QuickBooks Online, Xero, Stripe, or similar systems is useful. - Enough bookkeeping fluency to follow an invoice or payment from source record through the books, find a mismatch, and know when to involve an accountant. - Good judgment with customer, employee, and financial information. - The ability to give a concise recommendation when facts are incomplete, distinguish an assumption from a fact, and escalate early when risk is material. - Interest in one primary, long-term operating role rather than adding another client to a crowded schedule. No CPA is required. We care more about personally owned outcomes, clear mechanics, and trustworthy judgment than titles or polished generalities. PRACTICAL ARRANGEMENT - Full-time primary commitment: 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday - Eight consistent working hours per day - At least five consecutive hours must fall between 7:00 AM and 7:00 PM U.S. Pacific and remain on the Pacific clock when daylight-saving time changes - Compensation: PHP 100,000 per month during a paid 30-day initial performance period. Beginning on day 31, compensation becomes PHP 120,000 per month if employment continues and the stated first-month outcomes have been met, plus 13th-month pay - Long-term remote position in the Philippines - Company identity shared with selected interview candidates - References and a paid, controlled work simulation may be requested only at a later stage HOW TO APPLY Start your reply with OWN THE OUTCOME and answer these four questions. Do not include confidential customer or employer information. 1. Describe one messy business situation that crossed people or departments and had no clear owner. What was stuck, what systems or records did you use, what did you d ---------- and do personally, and what measurable result followed? 2. Describe one customer, billing, collection, renewal, or revenue item that would have been lost without your follow-through. How did you find it, who did you involve, and how did you close it? 3. What bookkeeping or finance-operations work have you personally performed? Name the tools, records, and exact scope. Include one payment, invoice, AP/AR, cash, or reconciliation mismatch you investigated, and be clear about what an accountant or another team member handled. 4. List all current jobs, clients, businesses, and recurring obligations with weekly hours. Then state the exact eight-hour Pacific-time schedule you would work, your earliest start date, and whether you accept PHP 100,000 for the first 30 days and PHP 120,000 beginning day 31 after successful completion of the initial performance period and can later provide two professional references. Never send passwords, credentials, unredacted financial records, or confidential customer data.

title: Shopify Store Operator — AI-Driven Store (Systems-Minded, Full-Time)

description: FIRST — PLEASE ANSWER HONESTLY: This is a full-time role, about 40–50 hours per week, working US Eastern business hours (this is a night shift in the Philippines). Can you genuinely commit to that long-term? Put YES or NO at the very top of your reply — only say yes if you truly can. About us We're a USA-based premium contemporary home décor brand — sculptural furniture, lighting, mirrors, and wall art. Our product pages read like a design gallery, not a discount store. We're looking for one sharp, detail-obsessed person to help us run and grow the store. You'll work US-friendly hours; we'll confirm the exact window. What you'll do • Operate our AI-driven store (the core). We run a custom dashboard, an AI agent system, and automation that does a lot of the work. Your job is to understand how it all fits together and run the machine — the right tool, the right step, in the right order. • Run the AI listing pipeline. Our AI generates the product listings; you operate the workflow, push products live, and keep them flowing as new products arrive. You operate it — you don't write the copy. • Quality-check for accuracy. Catch the factual errors that matter — wrong dimensions, wrong price, wrong product — before anything goes live. • Own the store day to day. Handle whatever the Shopify store and storefront need; you're the go-to operator for "the store." • Troubleshoot. When something looks off (wrong stock on the site, a product not showing, automation acting up), figure out where the problem is and drive the fix or flag it clearly. This is NOT a copywriting job (the AI writes), NOT customer support, and NOT a basic listings job. It's a run-the-system role for someone who likes understanding how things work. Who you are • You're systems-minded and tech-comfortable. You enjoy learning how a complex setup works and can reason about how the pieces connect. You don't need to code — you need to "get" how things run and operate inside them. This is the most important thing. • You use AI tools (ChatGPT / Claude) daily, know how to drive them to a good result, and can tell when the output is wrong. • You're comfortable in Shopify (products, variants, collections, the draft-to-active flow). • You're a troubleshooter — when something breaks, you trace it instead of guessing. • You're adaptable — happy owning "the whole store," not just ticking off a fixed task list. • You're meticulous about accuracy. A wrong dimension or price drives you crazy. • Your written English is strong enough to communicate clearly. (You won't be writing product copy — the AI does that — so polished marketing writing is not required.) What we offer • Competitive pay with real raises as you grow. • Full-time, long-term, stable work with one company (not juggling clients). • 13th-month pay / year-end bonus plus performance bonuses. • A founder who values good work and gives clear direction. HOW TO APPLY (please read — applications that skip a step won't be reviewed) 1. Start your message with the word ATELIER so we know you actually read this post. 2. Tell us: in 2–3 sentences, describe a system, tool, or automated workflow you learned and operated — and how you used an AI tool (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) in your work. 3. Quick reasoning question. Imagine a store set up like this: a dashboard pushes inventory to Shopify; an AI tool drafts the product listings; nothing goes live until a person approves it. A customer reports that a product shows the wrong stock number on the website. In a few sentences: how would you figure out where the problem is? (We're not looking for a "correct" answer — we want to see how you think through a system.) We read every application that follows these three steps. We're excited to meet you.

Your overall objective will be to help us increase brand awareness, grow our social-media presence, improve our website, drive qualified traffic and ultimately increase online sales. The Role You will take ownership of key areas of our online presence, including social media, content, our Shopify website, SEO, email marketing and influencer outreach. You will then take it from there - editing, developing the hook, adding on-screen text, creating covers/graphics, writing captions and calls-to-action, scheduling/publishing and monitoring performance. You will also create professional Canva graphics, carousels, Stories, infographics, promotional content and other digital marketing materials. The aim is for you to lead the content process, rather than wait for the founder to continuously provide ideas. Website, Shopify & Conversion You will also take an active role in developing and improving our Shopify e-commerce website. We want someone who regularly reviews the website from both a customer and commercial perspective and proactively identifies improvements. This may include: Improving the overall look and presentation of the website Improving product and collection pages Improving navigation and the customer journey Product merchandising and presentation Reviewing product descriptions and website copy Improving mobile shopping experience Identifying friction in the purchasing journey Recommending and implementing conversion improvements Creating landing pages or promotional pages when required Keeping the website looking professional, current and consistent with the brand Using analytics and customer behaviour to identify opportunities for improvement The goal is not simply to maintain the website. We want you to help make it easier to discover, easier to shop and better at converting visitors into customers. SEO & Organic Growth You will work on improving our organic search visibility over time. Responsibilities may include: Keyword and competitor research On-page SEO Optimising product and collection pages Improving page titles, meta descriptions and website copy Identifying search opportunities relevant to our products Developing SEO-friendly content where appropriate Monitoring organic performance Identifying technical or content-related SEO issues Making ongoing recommendations to increase organic traffic You do not necessarily need to be an advanced technical SEO specialist, but you should have practical e-commerce SEO experience and understand how to improve the organic visibility of a Shopify store. Email Marketing & Customer Retention You will help develop our email-marketing strategy rather than only sending occasional promotional emails. This may include: Planning email campaigns Creating branded email designs Writing engaging email copy Product and promotional campaigns Customer-retention emails Developing and improving automated email flows Monitoring open rates, click-throughs, conversions and sales Testing and improving campaigns based on performance Influencer & UGC Growth You will identify suitable influencers, micro-influencers and UGC creators who align with the brand and our target customer. You will help: Research potential creators Manage outreach Identify collaboration and gifting opportunities Develop campaign ideas Maintain relationships with creators Track collaborations and results Identify opportunities to repurpose UGC across our social media, website and advertising Who We're Looking For We are looking for someone with proven hands-on experience, rather than someone hoping to learn these skills for the first time. Ideally, you will have previously worked with an e-commerce, fashion, beauty, lifestyle or female-focused consumer brand and can demonstrate the impact of your work. You should have strong experience with: Instagram and TikTok Social-media growth and content strategy Short-form video editing using CapCut or similar Canva and visual content creation Shopify E-commerce website optimisation Conversion optimisation SEO and keyword research Email marketing Influencer/UGC outreach Analytics and performance reporting Excellent written and spoken English is essential. You should also have a strong visual eye and understand how to maintain a professional and consistent brand aesthetic. Most importantly, you must be proactive, creative, organised and commercially minded. We don't want to provide you with a detailed task list every morning. We want someone who can look at our social media, website, competitors and performance and say: "I've identified an opportunity. Here's what I recommend we do, why I think it could work and what I need from you to execute it." We want someone who is comfortable bringing ideas to the founder, rather than waiting for the founder to bring every idea to them. Working Arrangement & Salary This is a full-time, remote and long-term position. You will work closely with the founder but will be expected to manage your workload independently and take ownership of your areas of responsibility. We are currently a small/start-up brand, so we're looking for someone who understands the realities of working with a growing business and is genuinely excited about helping build something. For the right person, there is significant opportunity for the role, responsibilities and compensation to grow alongside the business. How to Apply Please include the following with your application: CV/resume and portfolio. Links to social-media accounts, e-commerce stores or websites you have personally worked on. title: Linux Server admin (experienced) GIG
description: Overview A US-based technology services company is seeking an experienced Linux/DevOps professional to serve as a live technical advisor during the deployment of a pre-written Standard Operating Procedure (SOP). This is not a hands-on-keyboard role. You are the expert in the room (virtually), guiding and validating the work as it's executed. ________________________________________ Work Arrangement • Fully remote – you will join a live screen-share session (e.g., Zoom, Meet, or similar). • Estimated total time: ~21 to 25 hours, broken into 7-8 scheduled sessions (not one marathon block). Could be faster because you are watching and talking to the user. • Flexible scheduling – sessions are coordinated in advance around mutual availability. • 8 3 hours sessions you will be paid $125.00 after 3 sessions then 125.00 after four more sessions. Then after 25 hours you will get paid 9.00 USD per every extra hour. • 250.00 USD for 25 hours or less • If it goes longer than 25 hours you will be paid 9.00 USD an hour each extra hour ________________________________________ What You'll Be Doing • Watch the operator's screen as they work through the pre-written SOP, executing each copy-paste code block and configuration step. • Answer technical questions in real time (e.g., "Is this the right flag for pg_dump?" or "Should this UFW rule come before or after that one?" or "This output looks different from what the SOP says—am I okay to continue?"). • Make suggestions where you see a safer, cleaner, or more efficient approach than what's in the SOP. • Flag errors or unexpected outputs before they get locked in. • Validate accuracy of commands, configurations, and outputs as each step is executed. • Help troubleshoot if a code block doesn't behave as the SOP describes. • Keep the tone collaborative – you're a trusted second set of eyes, not a micromanager. ________________________________________ Technical Areas Covered in the SOP (Your Expertise Should Span These) Area What We Need You to Know Linux Administration Ubuntu Server: users/permissions, systemd services, package management, cron, log analysis (journalctl, /var/log), resource troubleshooting (CPU/RAM/disk) Docker & Docker Compose Deploy, update, restart, and debug multi-container stacks; read/write compose files; manage volumes and networks PostgreSQL Routine admin: dumps/restores (pg_dump), user/role management, verifying backup integrity Reverse Proxy & TLS Caddy or Nginx: virtual hosts, automatic HTTPS / Let's Encrypt renewal, redirect rules Firewall & Hardening UFW/iptables, SSH key-only authentication, fail2ban, disabling root login, least-privilege user setup Monitoring & Alerting Uptime Kuma (or Prometheus/Grafana): configuring checks, alert channels, status pages Backups & Disaster Recovery Scripted backups (bash + cron), off-server copies (rsync/rclone/object storage), and actual restore drills DNS Management A/CNAME records, TTLs, subdomains, nameserver changes (Cloudflare experience preferred) Bash Scripting Write and maintain small maintenance/backup scripts; read and modify existing scripts safely Git Clone, commit, push – all configuration changes tracked in a private repository Documentation & English Clear written English; every step must be documented. "If it isn't documented, it didn't happen." Nice to Have (Not Required) • Experience with self-hosted workflow-automation tools • Familiarity with transactional email services and deliverability basics • Familiarity with budget VPS providers (InterServer, Hetzner, DigitalOcean, Vultr) • Basic understanding of webhook-based application integrations ________________________________________ What This Role Does NOT Include • You are not writing or building the SOP – it's already done with copy-paste code blocks. You're advising while it's deployed. • No independent server access – you observe the operator's session only. ________________________________________ How to Apply Please include the following: 1. A 60–90 second voice recording: Introduce yourself, summarize your technical background, and explain which of the listed areas you're strongest in. Speak naturally – no scripts. 2. Proof of hands-on experience: GitHub profile, scripts, homelab write-up, or relevant certifications. ________________________________________ This is a focused, short-term advisory engagement. The SOP is written. The code blocks are ready. We just need a sharp, patient expert watching over the shoulder to make sure every step lands cleanly. If that sounds like your kind of afternoon, apply. .

We want people who are hungry to learn, grow, and improve our systems every day. **Positive Energy:** Property management sometimes involves surprise challenges. Pipes burst, tenants stop paying. We value collaboration, open communication, and a "can-do" spirit. **A Relationship, Not a Transaction:** We want a years-long partnership where you feel supported, trusted, and empowered to make decisions. **Impact Over Activity:** We value outcomes. You won't be micromanaged; you will be given clear goals and the freedom to execute, along with the support to be able to succeed. This role will be 40 hours per week, once fully trained. Your compensation will reflect your experience, initiative, growth, and contribution to the business's success. **Schedule:** Monday through Friday, 10:00AM to 6:00PM US Eastern time. These hours exist so you can reach US contractors, tenants, and agencies during their business day. **What you'd own:** **Operations (60%):** The "Loop-Closer": When a task comes in, you manage the communication, the schedule, and the reporting in ---------- and in daily report-outs to the team. Your job is to make sure work moves from "reported" to "fully completed" as efficiently as possible, and that everyone involved has what they need to do their jobs. Tenant communication, coordinating repairs and vendors, lease renewals and lease compliance, rent tracking and follow-up on outstanding balances, coordinating with housing assistance agencies, preparing eviction documentation when needed, move-in and move-out procedures and inspections, and keeping everything moving in ---------- . **Systems and finance (20%):** You are confident with numbers, bookkeeping software, and general bookkeeping. You coordinate with our accountant to ensure any questions they have are answered so our books stay accurate. You support the build of new systems and initiatives, as well as handling invoices, expense tracking, owner statements, paying invoices, updating tenant ledgers, and working within our financial SOPs. **Communication (20%):** Warm, calm, and professional with tenants, contractors, and owners. You respond promptly, warmly, and correctly to tenant maintenance requests and contractor messages. You know how to present yourself in a warm, calm, professional manner no matter the situation, including when a conversation is difficult. You'll thrive here if you're proactive and detail-oriented, comfortable making decisions without being micromanaged, hungry to learn, and looking for a long-term partnership rather than a transaction. **Must have:** reliable high-speed internet with a backup connection, and comfort working US hours. **ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS:** 3+ Years working in a US-Based Business with operations responsibility. **Fluency in English:** Confident in multi-person meetings, initiating phone calls, and in non-scripted situations in English. **The "Loop-Closer" DNA:** You live by the 24-hour no-update rule. If a project is open, you provide an update before we have to ask. **Comfortable with Numbers:** You can categorize expenses accurately and notice when a figure doesn't look right. Formal bookkeeping experience is a plus, not a requirement. **Highly Detail-Oriented and Organized:** Able to track tasks across multiple properties and follow up on outstanding issues. Skilled at prioritizing tasks based on urgency and importance. You have a positive growth mindset. **Strong communication skills:** you are a proactive communicator who doesn't wait to be asked for updates. You're eager to participate in ongoing discussions about improving communication protocols and systems, and receptive to feedback. **The Tech Stack:** While we use REIhub and ---------- , we value your property management and accounting experience over your specific software experience. If you are an expert in the industry and familiar with competitor tools (Innago, AppFolio, Buildium, Yardi), we can train you on our specific stack. **MUST HAVE reliable internet connection with backup.** Proficiency with Google Drive, WhatsApp, and ability to quickly learn ---------- . **A note on AI:** we use it too, so use whatever tools help you. We ask one thing in return: be straight about what you've actually done and how you actually communicate. **HOW TO APPLY:** To verify your attention to detail, please follow these steps exactly: **Subject Line:** Include the name of the original bass player for the Grateful Dead. **Cover Letter (Paragraph 3):** Include the phrase "closing the loop." In your response, confirm you are available for the days and times described in this position. Please answer the following questions in your cover letter: 1) Describe a specific time you solved a contractor or tenant problem without waiting for direction. How did it start, what steps did you take, how was it resolved? 2) A tenant in Hutchinson, Minnesota reports on a Tuesday morning that their furnace has stopped working. You have never worked in that town, you have no vendor list there, and I am not available. Walk me through exactly what you do: how you find contractors, how you d ---------- which ones are legitimate, how you handle quotes, and how you get someone scheduled by Friday. 3) At any moment you'll have multiple open items running across different properties, say a repair waiting on a contractor, a tenant who owes rent, and a move-out inspection all live at once. Two things: (1) What system or tools do you personally use to track these so nothing slips and everyone gets an update before they have to ask? (2) When you can't get to everything, how do you d ---------- what comes first? Give a real example that shows both in action. 4) If your past experience is not in property management, how does it set you up for success in this role? **AI:** Tell us two things: how you used AI to put this application together, and how you'd use it in the day-to-day of this role. Please include a resume or summary of your background. Also name ONE reference from a role like this one: their name, their role, and their company. title: Operations Execution Coordinator
description: Operations Execution Lead Compensation: $1,400/month Mission Turn priorities into finished results. SteelSafe operates self-storage properties across the United States. There is always work that needs to get done: property issues, vendors, purchases, projects, recurring operations, and problems that cross multiple people or systems. Your job is to own that execution. Some work you will do yourself. Some you will delegate to team members, boots on the ground, or vendors. Either way, you own the result. When leadership hands you an outcome, we should be able to forget about it until you come back with the finished result. Operating Rules Own the result. Do not pass problems. Assigning is not completing. Delegated work is still your responsibility. Asana is the system of record. If it is not in Asana, it does not exist. No proof = not done. Move fast. Small problems get expensive when they sit. No silent failures. Surface risks early with a recovery plan. Bring solutions. If leadership must d ---------- , bring the options and your recommendation. Close loops. Nobody should have to ask, “Whatever happened with that?” Build better systems. The better you get, the less time the same work should require. What You Own 1. Property & Rent-Ready Execution Drive property work from problem to verified completion. Examples: Get unavailable units back to Rent-Ready. Coordinate cleanouts. Get doors, locks, leaks, roofs, gates, cameras, fencing, weeds, trash, signs, electrical issues, and other property problems resolved. Coordinate vendors, quotes, scheduling, execution, and proof. The process is: Problem → Owner → Quote → Approval if needed → Schedule → Execute → Verify → Close Every unavailable unit must have a reason, owner, next action, and deadline. Do not report that a unit is stuck. Get it unstuck. 2. BOTG & Vendor Management Own the people who execute work locally. Find and hire BOTG and vendors. Give clear scopes and deadlines. Get quotes. Follow up. Verify work. Correct poor work. Replace underperformers. Maintain backup options. “I asked them” is not a result. The work being completed correctly is the result. 3. Projects & Procurement Own independent projects from idea to completion. Examples include: Source and purchase supplies or equipment. Order signs, locks, parts, cameras, and materials. Research and negotiate vendors or services. Sell unused assets. Coordinate property improvement projects. Build new operational processes. Complete one-off projects leadership assigns. You are expected to figure out the path forward without needing step-by-step direction. 4. Operational Problem Resolution When a customer or company issue requires operational action, own the execution. Investigate the problem, determine what needs to happen, coordinate the people involved, and drive it through resolution. Leadership owns unusual policy, legal, financial, or strategic decisions. Once the decision is made, you own getting it done. What Winning Looks Like Work gets completed on time. Projects do not stall. Rent-Ready units do not sit because nobody followed through. Vendors and BOTG are held accountable. Problems are surfaced before deadlines are missed. Completed work is actually complete. Asana reflects reality. Recurring work becomes simpler and requires less manual effort. This Role Is a Fit If You Are a doer. Take ownership without reminders. Finish what you start. Can manage a small team and still execute personally. Can take an unfamiliar project and figure it out. Follow up relentlessly. Make good decisions independently. Keep many moving pieces organized. Communicate problems early. Hold vendors and teammates accountable. Care about details and proof. Enjoy turning messy work into reliable systems. Own the result, not the clock. Do what it takes to get the job done. Then improve the system so the same result takes less time and effort next time.

Book, reschedule, cancel, and confirm appointments. - Sort every call using a written procedure we will train you on, and route the ones that need our dentist or surgeon straight to him. - Answer questions about hours, location, and what to bring, from a written office profile. - Take clear messages for the morning team. - Log every single call, including short ones. Insurance, nightly: - Log in to insurance company portals and pull benefit breakdowns for the next day's patients. - Enter what you find into our practice management system. - Flag any patient whose coverage will not cover their planned treatment. - Call the insurance company when the portal does not have the answer. Surgical coordination, daily and weekly: - Send medical clearance requests to patients' doctors and cardiologists, using a packet our surgeon has already approved. - Chase an outstanding clearance on day 3, day 7, and day 10 until it arrives. - File each returned clearance and flag it for the surgeon to read. - Confirm anesthesiologist availability against the surgical calendar and send the confirmed case list. - Confirm with patients that they have followed their fasting instructions and have a ride home. THE TWO SENTENCES THIS JOB IS BUILT AROUND You will learn a written procedure, and almost all of it comes down to knowing which of these two things to say. When a patient describes trouble breathing, swelling in the neck or tongue, or bleeding that will not stop: "Hang up now and call 911, or go straight to the nearest emergency room. I am telling the doctor right now." Then you hang up so their line is clear, and you contact the surgeon immediately. You do not stay on the phone talking. You do not take a message. Getting that person to emergency services in the next thirty seconds is the whole job in that moment. When a patient has any other medical question, and most of them will: "I am not able to answer that, and I do not want to guess. Let me get the doctor for you." Pain that is not controlled, swelling on day three, a stitch that came out, a question about medication. None of that is a 911 call, and sending those patients to an emergency room would be its own kind of harm. Those calls go to the surgeon. WHAT YOU WILL NEVER DO - You will never give medical advice, of any kind, to anyone. - You will never tell a patient that a symptom is normal, or that it is serious. - You will never say anything about medication, dosage, or timing. - You will never read a medical clearance and d ---------- whether surgery can go ahead. - You will never d ---------- , on your own, that a call is not worth passing on. If you are unsure which of the two sentences a call needs, you use the first one. Nobody here will ever criticise you for sending someone to an emergency room, or for waking the surgeon. We are hiring someone who can say both of those sentences calmly, at 11pm, for the fourth time that night, without feeling bad about either one. WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR This is a dental role. We are not hiring a general virtual assistant and training them on dentistry. Required: - At least 2 years working with US dental insurance. Verifying benefits, calling carriers, reading a breakdown, understanding annual maximums, deductibles, waiting periods, and downgrades. This is the part of the job we cannot teach you quickly, so it is the part we will test hardest. - Hands-on experience in a dental practice management system, working a live schedule: booking, moving, and cancelling real patients without breaking the day. - Excellent spoken English. Clear, calm, easy to understand on a phone line. We will screen this by phone, so please do not apply if writing is your strength and speaking is not. - At least 2 years in a role where you spoke to customers or patients by phone in English. - Comfortable being the only person on duty, making decisions from a written procedure without anyone to ask. - Persistent. A large part of this job is getting an answer from an office that has not called you back three times. - Careful with details. Wrong insurance information causes a real problem for a real person. Strongly preferred: - Open Dental specifically. That is what we run, in both of our offices. If you have used Dentrix or Eaglesoft instead, still apply. Insurance knowledge is what we are screening for, and we will train you on our system. - General dentistry, Oral surgery, periodontics, or another surgical specialty. Not required: - A clinical or nursing background. This is not a clinical role and we are not asking you to be one. EQUIPMENT AND CONNECTION You are the only person answering the phone. If your connection drops, nobody answers. - Reliable wired internet, 20 Mbps or better, with a second connection you can switch to. - Backup power that keeps your computer and internet running for at least 3 hours. - A quiet room with a door. Not a shared space, not a cafe. - A noise-cancelling USB headset. - A working computer, plus a phone you can use as a backup for calls. Tell us in your application what your backup plan is when the power goes out. We ask everyone. PAY AND TERMS - $1,900 per month, for 40 hours a week, 160 hours a month. - Independent contractor. You work from the Philippines. - Paid every week for the first month, then twice a month. Fixed dates. We have never missed one and we do not intend to. - Paid through Wise. We pay the transfer fee, so the amount above is what lands in your account. - A retention bonus each December, equal to one month's fee. In the Philippines this is what 13th month pay does. As a foreign client hiring a contractor we are not covered by that law, so we pay it as a bonus instead, and we intend to pay it every year you are with us. - Paid trial task before any offer, described below. - Long term. We are hiring one person to grow with this practice, not filling a gap. Because you will handle US patient information, before you start you will sign a confidentiality agreement and a US healthcare privacy agreement, complete a short HIPAA training we provide, and give us a current NBI clearance issued within the last six months. We reimburse the fee. You will get your own named logins, and we do not share accounts with anyone. HOW WE HIRE 1. We read your application. Most are rejected here, because most do not follow the instructions below. 2. A phone interview, in English, scheduled during your proposed shift hours. 3. A paid trial: a set of recorded practice calls where you handle scenarios from our written procedure. No real patient information is used. We pay you $50 for the trial whether or not we hire you, in the same week you complete it. 4. Offer in writing, with the scope, shift, rate, and payment dates all stated. About the NBI clearance. If we move forward after the phone interview, we will ask you to start your NBI clearance then rather than after an offer, so that a name match does not push back your start date. Most clearances are released the same day, within about half an hour of biometrics. A name match sent for manual review can take 5 to 15 working days, which is why we ask early. If yours is already current and issued within the last six months, send it and skip this. We reimburse the fee either way, including if we do not end up hiring you. HOW TO APPLY Applications that skip any step are not read. This is the first test. SUBJECT LINE: `EVENING COORDINATOR - [your city] - [your internet speed]` In your message, answer these five, briefly: 1. Describe a time you needed information from someone who kept not responding to you. What did you actually do, step by step, and how did it end? 2. A patient calls you at 10:00 PM. She had surgery this morning. She says her face is swelling and she is having trouble breathing. What do you do, in order? 3. Which dental practice management systems have you worked in, and for how long in each? 4. A patient's plan has a $1,500 annual maximum with $400 already used this year, and a $50 deductible not yet met. The planned treatment is $1,200, covered at 80%. What does the plan pay, and what does the patient owe? 5. What is your backup plan when your power or internet goes out during a shift? ATTACH A VOICE RECORDING, 90 seconds maximum. Any format. In it: - Say your name and where you live. - Read both of these aloud, as if you were saying them to a real patient on the phone: (a) "Hang up now and call 911, or go straight to the nearest emergency room. I am telling the doctor right now." (b) "I am not able to answer that, and I do not want to guess. Let me get the doctor for you." - Then answer, in your own words: why do you want a job where you are told not to help with the hardest question a caller will ask you? We reply to every applicant who completes all of the above.

I want something that looks premium, professional, trustworthy, modern and high-end. This is a PAID GIG PROJECT. If you do an excellent job, I have MORE PAID WORK TO COME. COMPANY / BRAND STYLE Business: MBP Consultant LLC I will provide my current logo for you to use as a branding reference. Preferred colors: BLACK WHITE GREEN GRAY I want a designer who can take these colors and create something professional and powerful. The banners should look: Premium Clean Professional Modern Trustworthy High-End Easy to Read Attention-Grabbing I want people walking through a trade show to notice my booth from across the room. PROJECT: 2 RETRACTABLE STAND-UP BANNERS I need TWO DIFFERENT BANNER DESIGNS. The banners should look like they belong to the same company, but I do NOT want two identical-looking banners. Each banner needs to have its own purpose. BANNER #1 – CREDIT REPAIR / CREDIT RESTORATION The purpose of this banner is to immediately show people what we do and get them interested in starting the credit repair process. Possible headline ideas: READY TO FIX YOUR CREDIT? LET’S BUILD YOUR CREDIT BACK STRONGER BETTER CREDIT. BETTER OPPORTUNITIES. YOUR CREDIT DOESN’T HAVE TO STAY WHERE IT IS. These are only ideas. If you are a creative designer and have a better headline or concept, I WANT TO SEE IT. SERVICES WE PROVIDE Our services may include: Credit Repair / Credit Restoration Collections Charge-Offs Late Payments Repos Hard Inquiries Negative Account Review ChexSystems Removal Early Warning Services / EWS Removal Child Support Credit Issues Credit Building Credit Education Personal Funding Preparation Business Funding Preparation Home Buying Preparation Vehicle Buying Preparation The designer does NOT need to put every service on the banner. I do not want the banner overcrowded. Use your graphic design and marketing experience to determine what information should be highlighted and how it should be presented. QR CODE #1 – CREDIT REPAIR INTAKE FORM I need a QR code created for: START YOUR CREDIT REPAIR or SCAN HERE TO GET STARTED LINK: ---------- This QR code needs to be clearly visible and easy to scan at an event. BANNER #2 – CREDIT MONITORING / ONBOARDING / PAYMENT The second banner should focus more on getting the customer to TAKE ACTION. Possible headlines: START YOUR CREDIT JOURNEY TODAY KNOW YOUR CREDIT. BUILD YOUR CREDIT. CHANGE YOUR OPTIONS. BETTER CREDIT CAN CREATE BETTER OPPORTUNITIES. YOUR NEXT LEVEL STARTS WITH YOUR CREDIT. Again, these are ideas. I want the designer to bring creativity to the project. QR CODE #2 – CREDIT MONITORING / NEW CLIENT ONBOARDING I need a separate QR code for our credit monitoring service. Suggested wording: ACTIVATE YOUR CREDIT MONITORING 7 DAYS FREE THEN $29.90 LINK: ---------- QR CODE #3 – PAYMENT LINK I also need a separate QR code for customers who are ready to make their payment. Suggested wording: READY TO GET STARTED? SCAN HERE TO MAKE YOUR PAYMENT or SECURE YOUR SPOT TODAY PAYMENT LINK: ---------- VERY IMPORTANT – QR CODES There will be 3 different QR codes associated with this project. Each QR code has a different purpose: 1. START CREDIT REPAIR Intake Form 2. ACTIVATE CREDIT MONITORING 7 Days Free, then $29.90 3. MAKE PAYMENT Secure Payment Link I do NOT want random QR codes dropped onto the banners. They need to be professionally incorporated into the design. Each QR code needs a clear call to action so customers know EXACTLY what they are scanning. All QR codes must be: Large enough to scan easily Clearly labeled Professionally placed High resolution Tested before final delivery Working correctly when printed YOU MUST TEST EVERY QR CODE BEFORE SENDING ME THE FINAL DESIGN. I WANT A DESIGNER WHO THINKS I am giving you the company information, services, links, branding and overall direction. I do NOT want to have to design the banners for you. I want you to bring ideas to me. If you believe something should be: Shortened Moved Made bigger Removed Reworded Presented differently Tell me. A NOTE ABOUT AI We’re completely fine with using AI as a tool for brainstorming and efficiency, but we are not looking for generic AI-generated content. title: Social Media Scout | $3-$5/hr + Bonuses & Residual Earnings
job_title: Social Media Scout | $3-$5/hr + Bonuses & Residual Earnings
description: THIS IS NOT A TYPICAL SOCIAL MEDIA JOB. Are you the kind of person who can find almost anything online? Do you know how to find real conversations happening in Facebook Groups, Reddit, ---------- , YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Quora, or X? More importantly, can you recognize when someone is actively looking for help, join the conversation naturally, and make a useful recommendation without sounding like an advertisement? TaskNuts is hiring Social Media Scouts. TaskNuts is a U.S.-based home services marketplace that helps homeowners get repairs and maintenance handled while connecting contractors with real jobs. We are building a human-powered organic customer acquisition team. We are NOT looking for someone to create content calendars, schedule posts, grow followers, or spam links. WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO Your job is to find existing online conversations where there is already real intent. For example: A homeowner posts: "Can anyone recommend a reliable handyman? I have several small repairs I need done." A person asks: "Does anyone know a plumber who will actually show up?" A contractor says: "I'm tired of paying for leads that never turn into jobs." Your job is to find these conversations, determine whether TaskNuts is genuinely relevant, and participate naturally and helpfully. You'll primarily be searching for U.S. homeowners who need home repair, maintenance, or improvement services. You may also recruit contractors when TaskNuts is actively seeking additional contractors in a particular market or trade. YOU DON'T NEED TO BE GREAT AT EVERY PLATFORM We actually prefer specialists. Maybe you know Facebook Groups extremely well. Maybe Reddit is your world. Maybe you're great at finding communities on ---------- . Maybe you understand TikTok or YouTube search and comments better than everyone else. We are hiring multiple Scouts with different strengths. Tell us which platform you are exceptionally good at. PAY Base Pay: $3 USD/hour We are open to starting at approximately 10–20 hours per week during the initial training/performance period. Scouts who demonstrate strong performance can quickly move to up to 40 hours per week. But the hourly rate is only one part of the compensation. You can also earn performance bonuses and ongoing residual bonuses from qualified homeowners and contractors you bring to TaskNuts. HOMEOWNER BONUSES $2 for each qualified homeowner signup with a verified property $20 when that homeowner completes their first TaskNuts job within 60 days $10 if their first completed job occurs after 60 days $10 for each subsequent completed job CONTRACTOR BONUSES When contractor recruitment is open for the applicable market/trade: $2 for each qualified contractor signup $30 when that contractor completes their first TaskNuts job $2 for each subsequent completed job THE RESIDUAL OPPORTUNITY This is what makes the Scout Program different. Qualified homeowners and contractors you acquire remain attributed to your Scout account while you remain eligible under the TaskNuts Scout Program. If a homeowner you recruited returns months later and completes another job, that activity can generate another bonus for you. If you recruit a great contractor who goes on to complete many TaskNuts jobs, their future completed jobs can continue generating bonuses for you. The goal is to build a growing book of TaskNuts users, not simply work hours. Performance and residual earnings are not guaranteed and are subject to TaskNuts Scout Program qualification rules and continued good standing. YOUR SCOUT PORTAL Every Scout receives their own TaskNuts Scout Portal and unique referral links. You'll be able to see: Homeowners you've acquired Contractors you've acquired Qualified signups Completed-job activity Bonuses and residuals you've earned Your referral links TaskNuts Share Center resources We handle the attribution and tracking so you can focus on finding opportunities. WHAT WE DO NOT WANT We do not want spam. No fake testimonials. No pretending to be a TaskNuts customer. No fake U.S. identities. No mass copy-and-paste comments. No indiscriminate link dropping. No bots or automated mass posting. No circumventing Facebook Group, subreddit, ---------- server, or other community rules. We want Scouts who understand how to become useful participants in online communities. WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR You should have: Strong written English A good understanding of natural U.S. online conversation Excellent internet research skills Resourcefulness Good judgment An understanding of online communities The ability to recognize real buying intent The ability to work independently A performance-driven mindset Experience with social media, lead generation, community management, online research, or customer acquisition is helpful, but resourcefulness matters more to us than your previous job title. HOW TO APPLY Start your application with the exact words: I FOUND THE CONVERSATION Then answer these 5 questions: 1. Rank these platforms from strongest to weakest for you: Facebook, Reddit, ---------- , YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Quora, X. Which ONE are you exceptionally good at, and why? 2. A homeowner in a U.S. Facebook group posts: "Can anyone recommend a reliable handyman? I have several small repairs." Write EXACTLY what you would reply if you wanted to naturally introduce TaskNuts. 3. You are assigned St. Louis, Missouri and need to find homeowners actively looking for repair help. Describe 3 specific ways you would find these conversations using your strongest platform. 4. What accounts would you actually use to perform this work? Tell us whether they are existing personal/professional accounts, approximately how established they are, and whether you currently participate in U.S.-focused communities. Do not create fake U.S. identities or accounts for this application. 5. You work 15 hours during your first week but generate zero qualified signups. What would you analyze, change, or test during week two? We are looking to hire quickly and want Scouts interested in building a long-term position and a growing book of residual earnings with TaskNuts.

title: Senior Australian Public Practice Bookkeeper | Remote Independent Contractor – Philippines
job_title: Senior Australian Public Practice Bookkeeper | Remote Independent Contractor – Philippines
description: Senior Australian Public Practice Bookkeeper Remote Independent Contractor – Philippines Location: Philippines – 100% Remote Engagement Type: Long-term Independent Contractor Service Days: Monday to Friday Reports To: Australian Client Manager Client Contact: No direct client communication required About the Role We are an Australian accounting practice seeking an experienced Senior Australian Public Practice Bookkeeper based in the Philippines to support a portfolio of Australian clients. This is a hands-on, non-client-facing role. You will work directly with an Australian Client Manager, who will manage all external client communication and provide instructions, priorities and review feedback. You will be responsible for delivering accurate bookkeeping, payroll, BAS/IAS preparation, reconciliations, month-end work and accounting support across multiple Australian entities. This opportunity is suitable only for candidates with substantial recent experience working within, or directly supporting, an Australian accounting firm, bookkeeping practice or public practice environment. Key ResponsibilitiesBookkeeping and Reconciliations · Manage end-to-end bookkeeping for multiple Australian clients. · Complete bank, credit card, loan and merchant facility reconciliations. · Reconcile payment platforms such as Stripe, Square, PayPal, Shopify and Wise. · Process accounts payable and accounts receivable. · Process supplier bills, sales invoices, credit notes, refunds and payments. · Review aged receivables and aged payables. · Process journals, accruals, prepayments and accounting adjustments. · Reconcile director, shareholder, beneficiary and intercompany loan accounts. · Maintain fixed asset registers and assist with depreciation schedules. · Investigate unreconciled, duplicated, missing or incorrectly recorded transactions. Account Code and GST Code Review This is a senior-level role. You must be able to review the quality and technical accuracy of bookkeeping work. You will be required to: · Review and correct account codes. · Review and correct GST tax codes. · Identify incorrect use of GST on Income, GST on Expenses, GST-Free, Input Taxed and BAS Excluded codes. · Review the GST treatment of overseas transactions, exports, reimbursements, disbursements, insurance payments and government grants. · Identify personal, capital, private and non-deductible transactions. · Review general ledger accounts for unusual balances and incorrect classifications. · Review suspense, clearing and uncategorised transaction accounts. · Self-review all work before submitting it to the Client Manager. · Review work prepared by junior bookkeepers where required. Australian Payroll · Process weekly, fortnightly and monthly payroll. · Set up and maintain employee payroll records. · Process ordinary hours, overtime, allowances, bonuses, deductions and reimbursements. · Process annual leave, personal leave and termination payments. · Prepare Single Touch Payroll reporting and year-end STP finalisation. · Calculate and reconcile PAYG withholding. · Calculate and reconcile employer superannuation. · Review superannuation clearing house payments and identify rejected or unpaid amounts. · Reconcile payroll reports, payroll journals and payroll liability accounts. · Assist with payroll tax, workers compensation and other payroll compliance requirements. BAS, IAS and Compliance Support · Prepare BAS and IAS workpapers for internal review. · Reconcile GST, PAYG withholding and PAYG instalment accounts. · Review GST reporting under both cash and accrual methods. · Reconcile BAS figures to the general ledger. · Identify prior-period errors and transactions requiring GST adjustments. · Assist with PAYG instalment variation calculations. · Assist with Taxable Payments Annual Reports. · Prepare supporting documents and schedules for the firm’s accountants and tax agents. · Monitor internal deadlines and escalate missing information promptly. Month-End and Year-End · Complete monthly, quarterly and annual bookkeeping files. · Reconcile all material balance sheet accounts. · Review payroll, GST, superannuation and PAYG liabilities. · Prepare accruals, prepayments and other adjusting journals. · Review accounts payable and accounts receivable cut-off. · Reconcile fixed assets, inventory and cost of goods sold where applicable. · Prepare year-end workpapers and supporting schedules. · Ensure client files are ready for financial statement and income tax return preparation. Financial Reporting · Prepare Profit and Loss Statements and Balance Sheets. · Prepare cash flow and management reports where required. · Compare results with prior periods, budgets or forecasts. · Identify unusual movements, negative balances and potential accounting errors. · Provide clear internal explanations and supporting schedules to the Client Manager. Tax Return Experience – Highly Regarded, but not essential Experience preparing Australian income tax returns or tax workpapers is not essential but will be a strong advantage. Relevant experience may include: · Individual and sole trader tax returns. · Company tax returns. · Trust tax returns and distribution workpapers. · Partnership tax returns. · Rental property schedules. · Depreciation and capital allowance schedules. · Tax reconciliation workpapers. · Xero Tax, MYOB Practice, HandiTax or BGL. Essential Experience and Skills Applicants must have: · At least five years of recent Australian public practice bookkeeping experience. · Experience managing bookkeeping for multiple Australian clients. · Advanced practical experience using Xero. · Strong practical experience using MYOB. · Strong practical experience using QuickBooks Online. · Experience preparing BAS and IAS workpapers. · Strong knowledge of Australian GST and account coding. · Demonstrated experience reviewing and correcting GST codes. · Strong Australian payroll, STP and superannuation experience. · Advanced reconciliation and problem-solving skills. · Experience preparing month-end and year-end workpapers. · Excellent written and spoken English. · Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy. · The ability to work independently and manage multiple deadlines. · High standards of confidentiality, integrity and professional conduct. · Ability to use AI tools Experience limited to internal bookkeeping for one Australian business may not satisfy the public practice experience requirement. Qualifications The following qualifications are highly regarded: · Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or Commerce. · Diploma or recognised qualification in Accounting or Bookkeeping. · CPA, Chartered Accountant or equivalent studies. · Xero Advisor Certification. · MYOB or QuickBooks certification. Software You must be confident using: · Xero · MYOB · QuickBooks Online Independent Contractor Arrangement This is an independent contractor opportunity and not an employee position. The contractor will: · Provide services remotely from the Philippines. · Provide their own computer, secure workspace, internet and backup power arrangements. · Be responsible for their own business registration, taxation, invoicing and insurance obligations. · Issue a valid monthly contractor invoice. The contractor will ordinarily provide services Monday to Friday and maintain regular overlap with Australian business hours. The parties will agree on a daily core collaboration window for meetings, questions and internal communication. Outside that window, the contractor may arrange their own working schedule, provided all deadlines and service requirements are met. Timesheets and Work Records The contractor must complete a daily timesheet recording: · Date. · Client or entity. · Task performed. · Time spent. · Work completed. · Outstanding issues and next steps. Timesheets are used for client costing, workflow management, capacity planning and supporting the contractor’s invoice. They are not intended to operate as employee attendance records. Remote Work Requirements Applicants must have: · A reliable computer or laptop. · Stable high-speed internet. · Backup internet. · A quiet and secure home office. · A suitable headset for online meetings. · The ability to use multi-factor authentication and secure password systems. · A strong commitment to privacy, confidentiality and data security. How to Apply Please submit: · Your current resume. · A brief cover letter of your Australian public practice experience. · Details of your Xero, MYOB and QuickBooks Online experience. · Details of your BAS, IAS and Australian payroll experience. · Details of any Australian tax returns you have prepared. · Your expected monthly contractor fee in Philippine pesos. · Your earliest available commencement date. · Confirmation of your internet. · Confirmation that you can issue invoices as an independent contractor. Pay: Php70,000.00 - Php80,000.00 per month

title: Product Research & Development Associate
description: # Product Research & Development Associate **Full-time | Remote | Product Department** We are a UK-based e-commerce company operating across the USA, UK and EU, with a growing portfolio of health and children's products. We are looking for a highly **curious, analytical and commercially minded** person to identify the next generation of products for our business. Your job is to find opportunities, investigate them deeply and determine **whether they are actually worth pursuing**. ### What You Will Do **Product & Market Research** * Research new product opportunities within our niches * Identify trends, customer needs and market gaps * Find product variations, line extensions and improvements * Research competitors, pricing, positioning and features * Analyse customer reviews to understand what people love, dislike and want improved **Validate Product Opportunities** Before we invest time and money developing a product, you will help determine: * Is there genuine demand? * What problem does it solve? * Who is the target customer? * What are customers currently buying? * What are competitors failing to solve? * What could we do differently? * How competitive is the market? * What price could we sell at? * What are likely product costs and margins? * Is this opportunity commercially worthwhile? We don't want research for the sake of research. We want to know: **“Should we make this product — and why?”** ### Customer Insight You will also become responsible for systematically learning from our existing customers. You will: * Collect and analyse customer reviews and complaints * Identify recurring product problems and requested features * Categorise feedback and identify patterns * Track changes in customer feedback * Turn customer insights into product improvement recommendations You will pass these insights to our **China-based Product Development Specialist**, who will investigate and solve the physical product issues. ### Product Development & Pipeline Once a product is approved, you will continue supporting development with: * Customer research * Competitor analysis * Target customer requirements * Feature recommendations * Pricing and positioning research * Market trends * Key problems the product must solve You will also maintain our **product opportunity pipeline**, research documents, customer feedback and project information, ensuring important insights and decisions don't get lost. ### We Are Looking For Someone Who * Is naturally curious and constantly asks **“why?”** * Has excellent research, analytical and critical-thinking skills * Thinks commercially rather than simply finding “interesting” products * Can distinguish a genuinely attractive opportunity from a bad one * Is comfortable with numbers, spreadsheets and data * Can turn large amounts of customer feedback into clear insights * Has excellent written communication and organisation skills * Is proactive and takes ownership * Has strong attention to detail Experience in **e-commerce, Amazon, product research, market research, product management or consumer products** is strongly preferred. Experience with Amazon research tools, Google Trends, competitor intelligence tools and spreadsheets is an advantage. ### The Type of Person We Want We are **not looking for someone who simply searches Amazon and produces product lists.** If you see a product with 10,000 reviews, we want you asking: **Why is it selling? Who is buying it? What are customers complaining about? What are competitors failing to solve? Could we build something meaningfully better? Would customers pay enough for it to be profitable?** You should be comfortable challenging assumptions and telling us when an idea **isn't good enough to pursue**. We are a remote female team that moves quickly, takes work seriously and invests in training and development. **We do not do graveyard hours.** **Full-time | Competitive salary based on experience** ### To Apply Please send: 1. Your resume 2. 2 examples of product research you personally completed and the conclusions you reached 3. One product opportunity you identified and why it was commercially attractive 4. One customer problem/insight you identified from reviews and what action you recommended 5. One product you think is currently poorly designed or underserved and how you would improve it
