title: Editor
description: Here’s a tighter, compelling version designed to attract a storyteller, not just a technician. PART-TIME VIDEO EDITOR & STORYTELLER Help us turn a real family journey into a growing media brand. We’re looking for a talented part-time video editor with strong storytelling instincts to help us document an unusual season of family life, business, travel, faith and personal growth. This isn’t a role for someone who simply cuts clips together. We need someone who can watch raw footage and recognise: There’s a story in here. Then bring it to life. ABOUT US We are The Banfords, an Australian family currently spending an extended period in Thailand, primarily Phuket. A lot of our content currently follows Laura and her 10-year-old son Harrison as we live, work, train and learn together. We’re documenting: * Travelling and living through Thailand * Homeschooling on the road * Muay Thai, boxing and fitness * Thai culture and everyday life * Building and running businesses remotely * Discipline, confidence and resilience * Mother-and-son conversations and family moments * Our Christian faith as it naturally appears in our lives * The wins, mistakes, difficult days and funny moments along the way At the centre of what we do are Faith, Family, Fitness, Freedom and Purpose. We don’t want fake influencer content. We don’t want cheesy family-vlogger content. And we don’t want everything polished to the point where it stops feeling real. Our style is honest, grounded, hopeful, strong and conviction-led. THE OPPORTUNITY We’re looking for an editor who wants to become part of building something over time. Initially, this is a part-time remote role, but there is significant potential for the workload to grow as our YouTube channel, family brand and personal brands develop. We will send you raw footage from phones, cameras and potentially action cameras. Your job is to turn that footage into finished, platform-ready content that requires little or no additional editing from us. Content will include: * Instagram Reels * Facebook Reels and video * YouTube Shorts * Longer-form YouTube episodes You need to understand that editing a 30-second Reel and building an engaging 15-minute YouTube episode require very different storytelling skills. WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING You’ll be responsible for: * Reviewing raw footage and identifying the strongest moments * Finding hooks, storylines and emotional beats * Cutting unnecessary footage * Creating engaging pacing without making everything frantic * Knowing when to edit quickly and when to let a moment breathe * Building strong opening hooks and maintaining retention * Music selection * Sound design * Colour correction and basic grading * Captions and subtitles * Clean transitions * Basic motion graphics where they genuinely add value * Formatting videos correctly for each platform * Turning longer footage into multiple short-form pieces where appropriate * Delivering finished exports ready to upload * Potentially helping with YouTube titles, hooks and thumbnail concepts For thumbnails, we generally favour simple, bold, high-contrast concepts built around ONE clear idea rather than cluttered designs. THE EDITING STYLE Think: Documentary storytelling meets modern social-media editing. One video could be Harrison training Muay Thai, travelling somewhere new or taking on a challenge. The next could be Laura and Harrison having a conversation about confidence, a difficult homeschooling day, a reflection on faith, a business discussion or a moment that is genuinely emotional. We need an editor with enough judgement to know the difference. We are not looking for someone who adds transitions, emojis, graphics, zooms and sound effects every two seconds because they can. Story comes first. The edit should enhance what happened — not overpower it. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR Ideally, you: * Have proven professional video-editing experience * Understand Instagram, Facebook and YouTube * Understand hooks, retention and modern social-media behaviour * Have strong storytelling instincts * Understand longer-form YouTube structure * Can work independently without needing every edit explained * Are reliable with deadlines and turnaround times * Communicate clearly * Are comfortable receiving large amounts of raw footage * Are organised with files and projects * Have excellent attention to detail * Are willing to understand our family, values and bigger mission * Can develop and maintain a consistent editing style over time Most importantly, we want someone who cares about the story. BONUS SKILLS Experience in any of the following would be valuable: * YouTube channel editing * Documentary editing * Travel content * Fitness or combat-sports content * Family/lifestyle content * Personal brands * Christian or faith-based content Faith is part of our story, but we are not trying to make every piece of content feel like a religious advertisement. You do not need to share all of our beliefs, but you do need to respect our Christian values and be comfortable editing content where faith naturally appears. WHAT THE CONTENT CAN LOOK LIKE One week you might be editing: A high-energy Muay Thai training session. A funny travel moment. A challenge Harrison takes on. A Thailand adventure. Another week it might be: A mother and son talking honestly about life. A difficult day homeschooling. A reflection about faith. A conversation about business, purpose or discipline. A quiet family moment that doesn’t need much editing at all. We want somebody who can recognise what each story needs rather than forcing every video into the same template. HOURS & WORKING ARRANGEMENT * Part-time initially * Fully remote * Flexible location * Ongoing weekly content * Potential to develop into considerably more work over time We are much more interested in building a long-term relationship with one great editor who understands our style than constantly cycling through freelancers. HOW TO APPLY Please send us: 1. A short introduction about yourself 2. Where you are based 3. Your editing experience 4. Links to 3 examples of your BEST work 5. At least one strong short-form example 6. At least one longer-form storytelling example, if available 7. Your usual turnaround time 8. Your preferred pricing structure — hourly, per video, weekly retainer or monthly retainer 9. What editing software you use 10. Why you believe you would suit this specific project PLEASE DO NOT SEND US 30 RANDOM VIDEOS. We would rather watch three exceptional edits that clearly demonstrate your taste, judgement and storytelling ability. Quality over quantity. PAID EDITING TEST Applicants who make the shortlist will be invited to complete a small paid editing test using footage supplied by us. We may give the same raw footage to several shortlisted editors. This allows us to compare how each person interprets the exact same material — including: * Story selection * Opening hook * Pacing * Music * Creativity * Emotional judgement * Retention * Overall feel We’re not looking for someone to simply copy our instructions. We want to see what you see in the footage. WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT This isn’t just another freelance editing job. You would be helping shape the way a real family story is documented while we travel, homeschool, train, build businesses, raise a son, explore faith and figure things out as we go. There will be great moments. There will be difficult moments. There will be funny moments. There will be stories we probably don’t even realise we’re capturing until a great editor sees them. If you’re the type of editor who watches raw footage and immediately starts thinking about story, emotion, tension, character and what happens next, we’d love to hear from you. Come help us build the story of The Banfords.

description: Performance Creative Strategist & Meta Ads Operator Full-Time Remote $800/month + Uncapped Performance Bonuses ABOUT THE POSITION We are looking for a highly creative, performance-driven person to take ownership of the creative pipeline for a profitable digital product advertised primarily through Meta Ads. This is NOT a traditional Media Buyer position. Your main objective is simple: Find and create winning ads — and produce them at scale. We already have a product that converts and profitable Meta campaigns. Our biggest bottleneck is creative volume. We want to go from testing a handful of ads to continuously testing new concepts, angles, hooks and formats every day. WHAT YOU WILL DO You will own the creative process from research to launch: * Research competitors daily using Meta Ad Library and other sources * Identify winning advertising concepts, formats, hooks and angles * Understand WHY competitor ads work instead of simply copying them * Develop new advertising angles for our product * Create video ads * Create static/image ads * Create UGC-style and native-looking ads * Use AI image/video tools to dramatically increase creative output * Write hooks, headlines and ad copy * Create multiple variations of promising concepts * Upload and launch creatives directly inside Meta Ads Manager * Analyze CTR, CPC, CPA, ROAS and creative-level performance * Identify winning creatives * Iterate aggressively on winners * Kill weak ideas and continuously replace them with new tests EXPECTED CREATIVE OUTPUT We operate with a high-volume testing philosophy. You should be capable of producing approximately 5–10 new ad variations per working day. This does NOT mean inventing 10 completely new concepts every day. For example: 3 new concepts x 3 different hooks/variations = 9 ads to test Speed and iteration are extremely important. We would rather test 100 good ideas quickly than spend one week making one "perfect" advertisement. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR You should understand: * Meta Ads * Direct-response advertising * Creative testing * Hooks * Marketing angles * Customer psychology * UGC advertising * Video editing * Static ads * Meta Ad Library research * CTR / CPC / CPA / ROAS * Creative iteration Experience with tools such as CapCut, Premiere Pro, Canva, Photoshop or similar is useful. Experience using AI tools for image generation, video generation, voice generation or UGC production is a major advantage. We care about performance, not beautiful branding. An ugly ad generating a 3.0 ROAS is more valuable to us than a beautiful ad generating a 0.8 ROAS. COMPENSATION Base salary: $800 USD/month PLUS performance bonuses. There is no fixed ceiling on your compensation. Examples of monthly scaling bonuses: $10,000+ ad spend while maintaining 1.50+ ROAS = $200 bonus $20,000+ ad spend while maintaining 1.50+ ROAS = $400 bonus $30,000+ ad spend while maintaining 1.50+ ROAS = $600 bonus $50,000+ ad spend while maintaining 1.50+ ROAS = $1,000 bonus Exceptional performance can result in additional bonuses. WINNING CREATIVE BONUS You can also receive bonuses for individual winning concepts. A creative that reaches meaningful spend while remaining profitable can qualify for an additional performance bonus. The better the creatives perform and the more we are able to scale, the more you earn. Our goal is to create a situation where a great Creative Strategist can earn significantly more than the $800 base salary. IMPORTANT We are NOT looking for: * A generic Social Media Manager * Someone focused on organic Instagram content * Someone who only knows graphic design * Someone who needs detailed instructions for every creative * Someone who creates beautiful videos but doesn't understand performance marketing We ARE looking for someone who thinks: Research → Hypothesis → Creative → Test → Data → Iteration → Scale You will have significant creative freedom. If you see an interesting advertising format from another industry, test it. If you see a competitor doing something interesting, understand why it works and adapt the principle. If one of our ads starts performing extremely well, create new iterations of it. We want someone obsessed with finding the next winning creative. HOW TO APPLY Please send: 1. Examples of Meta ads you personally created. 2. Screenshots of Ads Manager results associated with your creatives, if available. 3. Your experience with Meta Ads. 4. The AI tools you currently use for creative production. 5. Your experience with video editing. 6. Your experience researching competitors and Meta Ad Library. Finally, choose one advertisement from your portfolio and explain: * Why you believe it performed well * What its main hook/angle was * What 3 variations you would test next Applications without examples of previous advertising work will not be considered.

KEY BULLET POINTS - Required: You edit in Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve. A portfolio link is welcome but not required. - Which software you use (Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve) and your timezone. - Confirm you can receive PayPal payments. title: Supply Chain & Logistics Lead (Amazon FBA Private Label Brands)
job_title: Supply Chain & Logistics Lead (Amazon FBA Private Label Brands)
description: We run two complementary Amazon FBA brands: one in a premium giftable category with strong Christmas seasonality, one in sports & fitness. We are at ~200 SKUs today, with a clear roadmap to ~500. We sell on ---------- , . ---------- , ---------- , manufacture in China, and ship into FBA, AWD, and 3PLs across the US, UK, and Canada. ** THE ROLE ** This is a senior role. The CEO and Head of Operations are looking for a trusted operator to take ownership of the supply chain and logistics function, “end-to-end”, from initial forecasting -to- factory floor -to- FBA shelf. Someone we can hand the keys to and trust to drive it forward with little oversight. You'll inherit a well-documented operation, with a structured onboarding: our current Supply Chain Manager will support your transition, transferring knowledge of both brands, our suppliers, and our systems so you can take the reins with confidence. We also expect you to work AI-first. The best person for this role uses AI daily: to pressure-test forecasts, draft communications, build formulas, and automate the repetitive parts of logistics coordination. At the same time, you verify every output before it touches a decision. AI leverage is how one sharp operator runs what used to take a full department. ** WHAT YOU WILL OWN ** — Supply chain strategy and execution across both brands, “end-to-end”. Each runs its own forecasting methodology; you'll master both and standardise where it genuinely helps — Demand forecasting and order planning for 200 SKUs (scaling to 500), built in Google Sheets with the backing of solid data flows — China manufacturer relationships: production scheduling, inspections, quality, MOQ and pricing negotiation, alternate sourcing — International freight and logistics coordination: coordinator of carrier selection, cost vs. transit time, customs compliance, freight forwarders, 3PLs — FBA inventory health: 45 to 90 days cover, avoiding stockouts and overstock, inbound receiving discrepancies, reimbursements, cases with Amazon — The small, critical details: barcodes, FNSKUs, shipment labeling, compliance documentation, tracking reconciliation. You are the last line of defense — A performance dashboard you build and own: forecast accuracy, inventory turnover, lead time, on-time-in-full, stockout rate, shipping cost per unit, cashflow planning — Alignment with marketing and sales, so inventory matches promotional plans and seasonality. Flagged early, with numbers — Task and process management in ClickUp: every shipment, order, supplier action, and follow-up lives in ClickUp so the whole team has visibility and nothing falls through the cracks. You will be expected to maintain it rigorously, not treat it as optional — Proactive communication: updates prior to asking, risks flagged early, follow-through without being chased ** WHAT OWNERSHIP MEANS HERE ** In supply chain management, small mistakes compound: one wrong barcode or missed reorder point can be costly. So we work to a clear standard. Sanity checking is built into how you operate: reconciling totals, second-passing formulas, and gut-checking outputs against reality before they drive a decision. Occasional errors are part of the job; what we can't carry is the same error recurring, going unnoticed, or going unexplained. When something does go wrong, you own it: what happened, why, the impact, and the fix that stops it repeating. Work like that, and you'll have our full backing when things go sideways. ** MUST HAVES: SKILLS & EXPERIENCE ** — 4+ years in supply chain, with 2+ years personally running an Amazon FBA supply chain “end-to-end” (Bachelor's in Supply Chain or related field is a plus) — Proven experience managing 100+ SKUs; multi-brand portfolios a plus — Deep international logistics knowledge: sea freight, customs, import/export compliance — Strong Seller Central command: restock/capacity limits, IPI, shipment creation, FNSKU and barcode management, AWD vs. FBA — Advanced Google Sheets/Excel. You build models, not just populate them (array formulas, pivot tables, QUERY, XLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH, IMPORTRANGE). We will ask to see analyses you've built. — Demonstrable AI fluency: real examples of AI saving you hours, and of catching it when it was wrong or hallucinating — Experience with seasonal products and Christmas demand spikes — Comfortable delegating and reviewing the work of others when needed — Fluent English, written and verbal (Mandarin/Chinese a bonus for supplier communications in their native language) ** WORK SETUP ** Reliable electricity and 50+ Mbps internet, your own computer, and a quiet workspace. We run all tasks, processes, and reporting through ClickUp: it is our central hub for visibility across the team, and strong comfort with it is a requirement, not a nice-to-have. Working hours must cross over with China and UK hours (e.g. roughly 2pm to 10pm PH time, or a split shift like PHT 10am to 2pm & 6pm to 10pm). We're flexible on the shape, as long as the crossover is there. ** PERSONALITY WE'RE LOOKING FOR ** A logician's mind: structured, methodical, rigorous. Obsessively detail-oriented, so spotting an off barcode or an ambiguously worded supplier quote is your default mode, not an effort. The right fit is someone with real agency: you push for action, take ownership without waiting to be asked, and juggle parallel priorities without losing oversight of the details. An independent operator and self-starter who stays calm under pressure during peak-season spikes and shipping delays. Fully accountable. Always improving the system. ** NOT A FIT IF YOU ** — Need step-by-step instructions — Are a generalist VA with peripheral supply chain exposure — Have not personally managed an FBA supply chain “end-to-end” — Find details tedious, or paste AI output without checking it — Are juggling multiple other clients ** THE PACKAGE ** — Full-time, 40 hrs/week; bi-weekly salary (3rd and 18th of the month) — $1,900 to $2,400/month base (PHP 120,000 to 150,000), equivalent to $11 to $14 per hour, depending on experience — 13th-month pay, pro-rated each December — Health reimbursement up to $50/month (HMO, PhilHealth, Maxicare, etc.) ** HOW TO APPLY ** Complete the application form below. It includes a few short questions and two brief video uploads (you can submit partially and return to finish later): Apply via this link: ----------

job_title: ***TOP PAY*** - Business Development & Marketing VA | Cold Calling + AI
description: Business Development & Marketing VA | Cold Calling + AI **Full-Time | Remote | $5-$9 USD Per Hour** **PLEASE READ THE ENTIRE POST BEFORE APPLYING. APPLICATIONS THAT DO NOT FOLLOW THE INSTRUCTIONS MAY NOT BE CONSIDERED.** We are a growing Arizona restoration and construction company looking for an exceptional full-time Virtual Assistant who wants to become a long-term member of our team. This is NOT a traditional administrative VA position. Your primary goal will be helping us **generate more customers, leads, appointments, and referral relationships** through cold calling, prospecting, follow-up, LinkedIn, email, SMS, marketing, AI, and technology. We don't expect you to be an expert at everything. We DO want someone who is **smart, resourceful, creative, tech-savvy, dependable, comfortable talking to people, and capable of figuring things out without needing constant direction.** # EXCELLENT ENGLISH IS REQUIRED This is extremely important. You will regularly speak with American homeowners, customers, business owners, and potential referral partners. You must have **excellent spoken and written English** and be able to communicate clearly, naturally, confidently, and professionally. You will be making outbound calls to people who have never spoken with you before. If your spoken English or accent makes it difficult for American customers to easily understand you, **please do not apply.** Spoken English will be evaluated during the first round of our hiring process. We don't expect an American accent. We simply need customers to easily understand you and feel comfortable having a conversation with you. # Cold Calling & Business Development You MUST be comfortable picking up the phone and talking to strangers. You may: * Make outbound calls * Prospect for new business * Contact homeowners and potential customers * Contact plumbers, property managers, and other referral partners * Follow up with leads * Handle basic objections * Schedule appointments * Follow up by phone, email, SMS, and LinkedIn * Research potential prospects * Manage follow-up in our CRM * Help develop new ways to generate business Previous **cold calling, outbound sales, appointment setting, lead generation, or business development experience is strongly preferred.** We don't want someone who simply reads a script. We want someone who can listen, ask questions, think on their feet, build rapport, and have a natural conversation. # AI & Technology Technology will be a major part of your job. We want someone who actively uses AI and enjoys learning new technology. You may work with: * ChatGPT * Claude * Gemini * GoHighLevel * Dialpad * Canva * LinkedIn * CRM systems * Email/SMS marketing platforms * Automation tools * ---------- * New AI tools as they become available **GoHighLevel experience is a plus, but it is NOT the main reason we will hire you.** We are not primarily looking for a web designer, funnel builder, or GHL technician. We would rather hire an excellent communicator who is resourceful, great with people, comfortable with technology, and capable of learning. # Marketing & Outreach You may also help with: * LinkedIn outreach and networking * Social media * Email marketing * SMS campaigns * Lead nurturing * Content creation * Canva graphics * Marketing materials * CRM campaigns * Follow-up sequences * Tracking campaign performance We want someone interested in understanding **what is working, what isn't, and what we should improve.** # The Person We're Looking For You should be: * Resourceful * Creative * Tech-savvy * Confident * Organized * Dependable * Accountable * Adaptable * Curious * A fast learner * Comfortable receiving feedback * Comfortable working independently * Willing to take ownership * Interested in long-term employment If you don't know how to do something, that's okay. We care about what you do next. Do you research it? Ask AI? Watch tutorials? Test solutions? Figure it out? We want someone who can eventually be given the **desired result** and determine how to accomplish it. # Schedule * Full-time, approximately 40 hours per week * Monday through Friday * Must work during Arizona business hours * Remote * Long-term opportunity # Pay **$5-$9 USD/hour depending on experience and ability.** Please include your desired hourly rate. # HOW TO APPLY We intentionally keep our first-round application relatively simple. Please submit ALL of the following: ### 1. Resume Attach your current resume showing your previous work experience. ### 2. Answer These 10 Questions 1. Where do you currently live, and what hourly rate are you requesting? 2. Can you work 40 hours per week, Monday-Friday, during Arizona business hours? 3. Are you currently working for another company or client? If yes, explain your schedule. 4. Describe your previous **cold calling/outbound experience**. Who were you calling, what were you trying to accomplish, approximately how many calls did you make, and what results did you achieve? 5. What experience do you have with **lead generation, appointment setting, prospecting, or business development?** 6. Which AI tools do you regularly use for work? Give us **two specific examples** of how you've used AI to improve your work. 7. What experience do you have with **GoHighLevel or other CRM/marketing automation platforms?** Be specific about what you personally did. 8. What experience do you have with **LinkedIn, social media, email marketing, SMS marketing, Canva, or content creation?** 9. Tell us about a time you were given a goal but weren't told exactly how to accomplish it. How did you figure it out? 10. Why do you believe you would be a great fit for THIS specific position? ### 3. Short Video Submit a **2-3 minute video**. Please record it in **one take without reading from a script.** Professional editing is not necessary. Answer: 1. Tell us your name, where you're from, and a little about yourself. 2. Give us a quick overview of your professional background. 3. Tell us about your cold-calling/outbound experience. 4. Tell us about your experience and why you would be a good fit for this role? 5. What do you want to tell us about yourself that you think we should know? 6. Why should we hire you? We want to hear how you naturally communicate in English. ### 4. Workspace Photo Send us a current photo of the workspace where you would normally work. We are simply looking to verify that you have a professional environment suitable for full-time remote work and phone calls. ### 5. Internet Speed Test Send us a screenshot of a current internet speed test showing: * Download speed * Upload speed * Ping Also tell us what backup internet option you have if your primary internet goes down. # IMPORTANT APPLICATION INSTRUCTION At the **very beginning of your initial message**, write: **VA BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT** This helps us confirm that you carefully read the entire posting. Your application should include: * **VA BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT** at the beginning * Resume * Answers to all 10 questions * 2-3 minute video * Workspace photo * Internet-speed screenshot * Desired hourly rate Incomplete applications may not be considered. # What Happens Next? Applicants who pass Round 1 may be invited to complete a second-round skills assessment involving **marketing, AI, problem-solving, business development, and communication.** Finalists will then be invited to a live video interview. We're looking for someone who wants more than another temporary VA job. We want someone who can become an important long-term member of our team, continue developing their skills, take on greater responsibility, and help our company grow.

title: Finance & Accounting Specialist — Xero Bookkeeping + P&L Management (Ecommerce, Digital & Physical Products)
job_title: Finance & Accounting Specialist — Xero Bookkeeping + P&L Management (Ecommerce, Digital & Physical Products)
description: Are YOU someone who can look at a P&L and immediately spot the number that doesn't add up — not because it's flagged in red, but because you actually understand what should be there? Can you tell the difference between a simple average and a volume-weighted average, and explain in one sentence why the difference matters for a business spending real money on ads every day? If you answered an enthusiastic "YES" to both questions above, KEEP READING. We run an international ecommerce operation selling both digital and physical products (educational content, online courses, and physical craft kits) to English-speaking customers in the US, UK, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand. We're looking for a Finance & Accounting Specialist to take real ownership of our bookkeeping in Xero and our profit & loss reporting — not just data entry, but someone who understands what the numbers mean. This is not a role where you disappear for a month and hand us a spreadsheet. We need daily visibility into where the money is going and whether it's going where it should. We need someone to take responsibility for: -Xero Bookkeeping & Reconciliation: Own our Xero setup end-to-end — bank feed reconciliation (Airwallex, Shopify Payments, PayPal), categorization via bank rules, and monthly close. We keep our accounting deliberately lean: most recurring expenses (ad platforms, software subscriptions) are automated through bank rules, but genuine supplier invoices (physical product COGS) need to be entered and tracked properly as bills — this is the part we can't afford to get wrong. -P&L Ownership, Not Just Reporting: Compile and maintain our profit & loss across all revenue and expense sources — Meta Ads, Google Ads, physical product supplier costs, team/contractor payments, software costs. You understand that a simple average across days with different volumes produces a misleading number, and you know how to build (or maintain) a weighted-average model instead. -Daily Check-In, Weekly Deep Work: This role is structured as roughly 1 hour/day, every day including Saturday and Sunday — not because we expect 7 hours of heavy reconciliation work daily, but because we need a daily pulse on cash flow, ad spend, and a specific internal profit-tracking mechanism tied to one of our business units (details shared after initial screening). The deeper reconciliation and P&L update work happens in 1-2 more substantial sessions per week. We'll agree on the exact rhythm together, but daily presence is non-negotiable. -Data Reading, Not Just Data Entry: We don't just want someone who inputs numbers correctly — we want someone who reads them. If ad spend efficiency drops, if a category of costs creeps up, if something in the P&L looks off compared to last week, we want you to flag it before we ask. -Documentation Judgment: You understand which expenses need a formal invoice/bill (e.g., physical product suppliers) and which don't (e.g., ad platform charges captured via bank feed, contractor payments already documented through time-tracking software). You don't create unnecessary paperwork, but you never let something slip through without a proper trail either. -Precision, Always: Correct categorization, correct currency handling across multiple payment processors, zero tolerance for reconciliation errors that go unnoticed. If a number is wrong, it should never be us who catches it first. Position Requirements: -Proven hands-on experience with Xero — not "I've used accounting software before," but specifically Xero: bank feeds, bank rules, multi-currency setup, and monthly reconciliation. Be ready to describe a real setup you've managed. -Experience with ecommerce/multi-channel businesses, ideally with exposure to platforms like Shopify, PayPal, or similar payment processors, and comfort with multi-currency transactions. -Real understanding of P&L construction beyond the software — you can explain concepts like weighted averages, margin by product line, or CAC/AOV in your own words, not just recite the terms. -Fluent English, written and verbal — you'll communicate numbers and flags clearly, not just deliver spreadsheets. -Daily availability, 7 days/week, structured around roughly 1 hour/day with flexibility on exact timing (your own time zone), plus 1-2 longer weekly sessions for deeper reconciliation work. Please tell us honestly: how many other clients/hours are you currently working? -Obsessive precision. This is a business where a wrongly categorized expense or a missed reconciliation isn't a small thing — it compounds. Mediocrity is not allowed on this team. -Comfortable working with a lean, mostly-automated setup — this isn't a role drowning in manual invoice processing; it's a role that requires judgment on the few things that actually need hands-on attention. What We Offer: -A clearly defined, lean accounting structure already mapped out (bank rules, integrations, and processes) — you're not building chaos into order, you're maintaining and improving an already-sensible system. -A short, paid trial period before any long-term commitment. -Real potential for the role to grow in scope as the business scales across multiple entities and revenue streams, with performance-based rate increases. -Direct visibility into how the business actually runs financially — this isn't a role kept in the dark about the bigger picture. To Apply: Tell us briefly about your experience with Xero and with ecommerce/multi-channel businesses. Shortlisted candidates will be asked for a short follow-up call or recorded response to a P&L scenario before moving forward.

title: Shopify Store Builder and Creative Strategist
job_title: Shopify Store Builder and Creative Strategist
description: About the role: We run a portfolio of direct-to-consumer Shopify brands. We build new stores, test products, and scale the winners with paid ads on Meta. Your primary job is building Shopify stores. When we have a store in the queue, that's what you're working on, and we expect them built fast and built well. Between builds — and there will be real stretches between them — you shift to our second priority: static creative. Ad images that run on Meta, and on-site graphics that make our product pages look like real brands instead of dropshipping stores. On the creative side, we want an owner, not a pair of hands. We'll give you the product, the market research, the customer angles, and examples of what's worked before. From there we expect you to do your own research into what's currently winning in the category, decide what's worth testing, and hand back finished creatives. If you need a detailed spec for every asset, this isn't the right role. If you already spend time in the Meta Ad Library because you find it interesting, keep reading. So: a builder first, a designer second, and someone who can switch between the two without losing a day to context switching. What you'll do: Shopify store building (primary): Build and launch new stores from a theme: home page, product pages, collection pages, policy pages, and the full navigation. Install and configure apps (bundles, cart drawer, upsells, reviews, email) following our documented setup. Set up product listings: variants, pricing, images, descriptions, SEO fields, and inventory settings. Make sure every page looks correct on mobile first, then desktop. Most of our traffic is mobile. Clone and adapt proven page layouts across new stores instead of reinventing each one. Speed comes from reuse. Maintain live stores: fix broken sections, spacing problems, slow-loading images, misaligned buttons. Keep our build process documented so each store goes faster than the last. Static creative (between builds): Design ad creatives for Meta in 1:1, 4:5, and 9:16 using our brand templates and safe-zone guidelines. Research what's working right now in our categories: competitor ads, adjacent niches, ad libraries, TikTok and Instagram creative trends. Keep an organized swipe file we can all use. Bring us new static concepts with a one-line rationale for each — new angles, new hooks, new formats. Iterate on winners: when an ad performs, produce the variations that extend its life (new hook, new headline, new background, same winning structure). Create on-site graphics: comparison charts, benefit icon rows, "how it works" strips, guarantee badges, review and testimonial cards, bundle graphics, size and spec charts. Retouch and clean up supplier product photos — remove backgrounds, fix lighting, composite products into lifestyle scenes. Organize every asset in our shared Drive with a consistent naming convention so we can trace which creative won. Requirements: Must have: 2+ years building Shopify stores. You know the theme editor cold and have shipped stores end to end, not just edited someone else's. You're fast. Tell us honestly how long a full store build takes you from empty theme to launch-ready. 2+ years designing static ads for ecommerce — direct response, not brand or social content. You understand that an ad's job is to stop the scroll and sell, and your work shows it. You can look at an ad and explain why it works: the angle, the hook, the visual hierarchy, the offer. We will ask you to do this in the interview. A working habit of researching creative on your own — ad libraries, competitor tracking, saving what you see. Fluent in Canva and at least one of Photoshop, Figma, or Illustrator. You already use AI tools daily — Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent — and you're good at it. We use AI throughout our operation: product research, ad copy, page copy, image generation and editing, troubleshooting Shopify issues, and speeding up repetitive work. We expect you to reach for these tools on your own, not wait to be told. Be ready to tell us specifically how you use them and where they save you time. Solid written English. You'll be pitching creative ideas in writing, not just receiving instructions. Reliable internet and a computer that can handle design work without crashing. Genuinely self-directed. You plan your own week and report progress without being chased. Nice to have: Basic HTML/CSS for small theme tweaks. Experience with page builders (GemPages, PageFly, Replo, Shogun). Familiarity with conversion apps: bundle widgets, cart drawers, post-purchase upsells, review apps. Experience running or managing Meta ads yourself, even at small scale. Copywriting for ads — headlines, hooks, overlay text. AI image generation and editing for creative work (Midjourney, Flux, Nano Banana, Photoshop generative fill, or similar). Basic video editing or motion (a plus, not required — we have a separate editor). Tools you'll use: Shopify, Canva, Photoshop or Figma, Claude and ChatGPT, AI image tools, Meta Ad Library, Google Drive, Google Sheets, Slack or WhatsApp, Loom, and a handful of Shopify apps we'll train you on. What it's like working with us: We give you the product, the research, and the goal — then get out of your way. Fast feedback and no ambiguity about what "done" means. We're direct. If something isn't working we'll tell you plainly, and we expect the same back. If you think one of our ideas is weak, say so. Reliable pay, on schedule, every time. Long-term role. If you're good, your scope and rate grow — we'd rather raise one strong person than cycle through five cheap ones. How to apply: Applications that don't follow these steps will not be read. 1. Put "BEESWAX" as the first word of your application so we know you read this. 2. Send a portfolio link with at least 3 Shopify stores you built (live URLs) and at least 5 static ads you designed for ecommerce brands. Tell us specifically what you did on each. Answer these questions: 1. How long does a full store build take you, from empty theme to ready to launch? Walk us through your process briefly. 2. Go to the Meta Ad Library, pick any direct-to-consumer product you find interesting, and find one static ad you think is performing well. Send us the screenshot and 3–4 sentences on why you think it works. 3. Where do you look for creative inspiration and competitor research? Name the actual sources you use. 4. Which AI tools do you use in your day-to-day work, and give us one concrete example of a task you've made faster with them. Generic answers ("I use ChatGPT for content") tell us nothing. 5.Which are you stronger at — store building or creative? Be honest. Tell us your hours in PHT, and your monthly rate for full-time work. Shortlisted candidates get a small paid test project: build one product page from a reference, and — given a product and our market research — come back with three ad angles you'd test plus two finished statics. We pay for it whether or not we hire you.

COMPENSATION * $480 USD monthly performance-based base salary * Approximately $480–$960 USD in additional monthly commission * Approximately $960–$1,440 USD total OTE monthly target earnings * Progression into TL / other roles may eventually be possible The full base salary is dependent on consistently meeting the position’s minimum performance standards, and will not be paid if these quotas are not hit (100% of our current team can meet them daily). We will give you a few days / a week to ramp, then this will become active. * Minimum standard: 10 qualified meetings per day * Target performance: approximately 12-15 qualified meetings per day * Strong performance above target creates greater commission potential (on top of the $960-$1,440 ceiling) These figures are projections, not guaranteed earnings (outside of base). If your appointments consistently produce revenue, we want that reflected in what you earn. ENGLISH AND COMMUNICATION STANDARD This is a customer-facing position speaking directly with US business owners. You must be: * Natural, confident and conversational * Extremely comfortable speaking English and charismatic * Easy for US business owners to understand immediately * Able to maintain strong conversational flow, pacing and control * Able to respond naturally without sounding scripted * Comfortable handling objections in real time (we provide this) * Free from frequent grammatical errors, long pauses or hesitation Being technically understandable is not enough for this position. REQUIRED EXPERIENCE You must have: * More than 3 months of cold-calling or appointment-setting experience * Experience speaking directly with business owners or decision-makers * Previous booking numbers, KPIs, call recordings or another form of proof (something) * Experience making a high volume of outbound calls * Confidence handling objections and rejection * Familiarity with CRM systems and appointment booking * The ability to follow a proven script while still sounding natural Applicants with 3 months of experience or less will not be considered. ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS You must have: * A reliable computer * A professional-quality headset * Fast and stable internet * A quiet working environment * Reliable electricity or a backup solution * Strong attendance and punctuality * The ability to make hundreds of dials per day (minimum is 150 conversations a day) * A coachable attitude * The ability to follow instructions and apply feedback quickly * A genuine interest in developing into a long-term, high-performing SDR No manual lead sourcing is required. title: TikTok Creator Business Development Specialist (BD)
description: About the Role We are looking for a results-driven TikTok Creator Business Development Specialist who understands the TikTok Shop ecosystem and excels at creator outreach, relationship building, and partnership conversion. This is not a traditional BD role focused solely on creator sourcing and contract negotiation. You will support creators throughout the full partnership lifecycle—from discovery, screening, outreach, and onboarding to post-signing development, campaign matching, sample fulfillment, and long-term relationship management. You will work closely with creators to understand their content niches, LIVE capabilities, product interests, and growth goals. Through product and campaign opportunities, samples, training, one-on-one coaching, and practical content recommendations, you will help creators become more active, improve their commercial performance, and build sustainable partnerships with our agency. The ideal candidate combines a strong sense of ownership and commercial awareness with the patience and communication skills needed to build genuine, long-term creator relationships. Key Responsibilities Creator Sourcing and Outreach - Identify and recruit suitable TikTok Shop creators in the U.S. market through TikTok, creator databases, social media, referrals, and other relevant channels. - Evaluate creators based on content quality, niche, audience profile, engagement, sales potential, LIVE experience, and overall partnership fit. - Build and maintain a healthy creator pipeline, from initial outreach through onboarding and long-term collaboration. - Develop personalized outreach strategies and communicate with creators through email, Lark, TikTok Shop, and other approved channels. - Follow up consistently and move qualified creators from initial contact to active partnership. Partnership Development and Onboarding - Clearly communicate the agency’s partnership model, creator support, expectations, and collaboration process. - Understand each creator’s needs, concerns, working style, and commercial goals. - Address common questions and objections professionally while avoiding unrealistic promises regarding samples, traffic, sales, or income. - Support creators throughout the onboarding and signing process. - Maintain accurate records of creator status, conversations, follow-up actions, and next steps. Post-Signing Creator Development - Build ongoing relationships with signed creators and maintain regular, meaningful communication. - Learn each creator’s main category, preferred content format, LIVE frequency, product interests, and development goals. - Help creators identify suitable products, campaigns, sample opportunities, and content directions. - Coordinate one-on-one account reviews, content feedback, training sessions, workshops, and other creator development initiatives. - Encourage consistent participation, content creation, LIVE activity, and campaign engagement. Campaign and Product Matching - Match creators with suitable TikTok Shop products and campaigns based on their niche, audience, content style, and performance. - Share relevant product and sample opportunities in a clear and compelling way. - Verify current campaign requirements, product availability, commission terms, and sample conditions before communicating them to creators. - Work with internal teams to support creator applications, campaign participation, and partnership execution. - Track creator interest, applications, approvals, and participation status. Sample Fulfillment and Performance Follow-Up - Coordinate sample requests and follow up on approval, shipping, delivery, and content fulfillment. - Remind creators of pending deliverables in a professional and supportive manner. - Identify delays, communication issues, or fulfillment risks and escalate them when necessary. - Follow up on published videos and LIVE activity, and provide practical feedback based on available performance data. - Help creators improve content quality, product demonstrations, presentation, and conversion potential. Relationship Management and Internal Collaboration - Maintain positive, professional, and long-term relationships with creators. - Respond to creator questions promptly and coordinate with internal teams when additional support or verification is required. - Collaborate with Creator Operations, Campaign, Brand Partnership, and Project teams. - Keep creator records, follow-up notes, campaign status, and action items accurate and up to date. - Share recurring creator questions, challenges, and market feedback to help improve internal processes and creator support. Qualifications - Experience in creator partnerships, influencer marketing, business development, affiliate marketing, social commerce, or creator operations. - Good understanding of TikTok, TikTok Shop, short-form video, livestream commerce, and the U.S. creator ecosystem. - Strong communication, relationship-building, negotiation, and follow-up skills. - Ability to manage multiple creators, conversations, campaigns, and deadlines simultaneously. - Strong ownership and the ability to move opportunities forward without constant supervision. - Organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable maintaining accurate tracking records. - Able to evaluate creator potential using both quantitative data and qualitative judgment. - Professional working proficiency in English. - Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where campaign details and priorities may change. Preferred Qualifications - Previous experience working with TikTok Shop creators, MCNs, agencies, brands, or affiliate programs. - Experience recruiting and supporting both short-video and LIVE creators. - Familiarity with creator outreach tools, CRM systems, spreadsheets, or creator-management platforms. - Understanding of sample fulfillment, campaign coordination, and creator performance tracking. - Spanish proficiency is a strong plus, as we work with both English-speaking and Spanish-speaking creators in the U.S. market. - Existing relationships within the U.S. TikTok Shop creator community are a plus. What Success Looks Like Success in this role is not measured only by the number of creators contacted or signed. We will also evaluate: - The quality and relevance of creators added to the pipeline. - Outreach response and partnership conversion rates. - The number of creators who complete onboarding and become active. - Creator participation in campaigns, samples, short-form videos, and LIVE opportunities. - Sample and content fulfillment rates. - Creator retention, responsiveness, and long-term engagement. - The accuracy and timeliness of creator records and follow-ups. - The ability to identify high-potential creators and help them grow into reliable long-term partners. Who We’re Looking For You may be a strong fit if you: - Enjoy talking with creators and building relationships—not just sending mass outreach. - Know how to follow up consistently without making the conversation feel transactional. - Can balance creator needs with campaign requirements and business goals. - Are comfortable using data while still recognizing creative potential. - Take initiative, solve problems, and keep projects moving. - Want to help creators grow from initial contact into active, long-term commercial partners.

title: Social Media Manager for Content Agency

description: Join a high-output creative team running fast-growing social channels for U.S.-based expert and media brands. Your job is simple to define and hard to do: own the content calendar, own the numbers, and turn attention into measurable growth for our clients. We specialize in transforming social feeds into growth engines, consistently driving 50%+ reach increases in the first 90 days. You will: * Own daily content output across Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok. * Coordinate with our editing/design team, not just “post what you’re given.” * Make decisions from data, not vibes. * Communicate clearly with founders, clients, and teammates in real time. What We Offer * Full-time role with clear advancement paths as we grow. * Work with a sharp, global creative and operations team. * Direct line of sight from your work to client revenue and impact. * Access to systems, training, and playbooks on cutting-edge content and monetization. title: Software Engineer — Full Stack & AI
description: Early-Career Engineers Welcome | High Ownership | Build Real Products Location: Remote Employment: Full-Time Experience:0–3+ years preferred, but **demonstrated ability matters more than years of experience About the Opportunity We are looking for a Founding Software Engineer to join our growing software company and help turn business ideas into real, production-ready software. This is an opportunity for an ambitious engineer who wants to do more than work through a list of tickets. You will work directly with the founder and have significant responsibility for the company's technology. The founder understands business, customers, sales, and product strategy—but does not have a traditional technical background. That's where you come in. You will help translate business ideas into technical solutions, make engineering decisions, build products, deploy them, and continuously improve them. This is not a traditional junior developer position. We are open to engineers early in their careers who have demonstrated exceptional initiative through **personal projects, freelance work, internships, startup experience, open-source contributions, or applications they have built independently.** We care more about what you can build and how you think than the number of years you've worked. What You'll Be Doing You will help take products from: Idea → Plan → Design → Code → Test → Deploy → Improve** Your responsibilities will include: * Turning business requirements into technical requirements * Designing application architecture * Building modern web applications * Developing frontend and backend systems * Designing databases and APIs * Integrating third-party services * Building AI-powered features * Implementing authentication and user permissions * Developing administrative dashboards * Building payment functionality * Improving application performance * Implementing technical SEO * Testing and debugging applications * Deploying applications to production * Monitoring and maintaining production systems * Documenting important technical decisions * Evaluating new technologies * Improving existing products You will have the opportunity to influence how we build our products, not simply implement decisions made by someone else. What We Mean by "Founding Engineer" We don't expect you to know everything. We expect you to be able to figure things out For example, the founder may tell you: "We need businesses to be able to create profiles, customers need to search those businesses, companies should be able to purchase premium listings, and we want AI-generated content for the profiles." We don't expect you to wait for someone to give you a technical blueprint. We expect you to think through: * What should the architecture look like? * What database should we use? * What APIs are needed? * How should authentication work? * How should payments work? * How should the user experience work? * How should the system be secured? * How should the pages be optimized for SEO? * Where should AI be used? * How should the application be tested? * How should it be deployed? * What could go wrong? Then you'll explain your recommendations to the founder in clear, understandable language and build the solution. Technology You'll Work With Our technology stack will evolve as the company grows, but experience with the following is highly valuable. Frontend * React * Next.js * TypeScript * JavaScript * HTML/CSS * Responsive design Backend * Node.js * Python * REST APIs * Authentication * Authorization * API integrations ### Database * PostgreSQL * SQL * Database design * Relationships * Indexing * Migrations AI We are actively incorporating AI into our products. Experience with: * OpenAI APIs * Claude or other LLM APIs * Prompt engineering * Structured outputs * AI-generated content * AI-powered search * Embeddings * RAG * Vector databases * AI automation * AI agents is a strong plus. You do not need to be an AI researcher. We want someone who understands how to use AI to build **useful products and business features**. --- Cloud & Deployment You should be interested in learning how software gets from your computer into the hands of customers. Experience with any of the following is valuable: * Vercel * AWS * Google Cloud * Azure * Docker * GitHub Actions * CI/CD * Environment variables * Domains and SSL * Logging * Monitoring * Database backups You don't need to be a DevOps expert. You do need to be comfortable taking ownership of getting your work into production. SEO & Web Performance Our products will depend heavily on web traffic and organic search. Experience with: * Technical SEO * Server-side rendering * Dynamic metadata * ---------- * XML sitemaps * Robots.txt * Canonical URLs * Internal linking * Core Web Vitals * Page performance * Programmatic SEO is a major advantage. The Person We're Looking For We're looking for someone who is: Curious You enjoy learning technologies you haven't used before. Independent You don't need someone standing over you telling you what to do every hour. Resourceful When you encounter a problem, your first instinct is to investigate, research, test, and find a solution. Practical You understand that the best technical solution isn't always the most complicated one. Accountable You take ownership of your work and the results. A Strong Communicator You can explain technical decisions to someone who isn't an engineer. Product-Minded You care about whether the product actually solves the customer's problem—not just whether the code works. AI-Curious You understand that AI is changing how software is built and you're excited to learn how to use it effectively. You Don't Need to Know Everything If you don't know AWS, that's okay. If you've never used a vector database, that's okay. If you've never built a payment system, that's okay. If you've never worked with Next.js, that's okay. What matters is whether you can say: I haven't done that before, but I can learn it. We want someone who can research documentation, experiment, build prototypes, ask good questions, and eventually own the solution. What We Consider a Strong Candidate You may be a great fit if you have: * 0–3+ years of professional experience * A computer science or related degree **or equivalent practical experience** * Strong programming fundamentals * Experience with React or another modern frontend framework * Backend/API experience * SQL/database experience * Git/GitHub experience * At least one meaningful project you've built * Experience deploying an application * Strong problem-solving ability Even better: You've independently built something such as: * A SaaS application * AI application * Marketplace * Business directory * E-commerce platform * Mobile application * Automation tool * Chrome extension * Internal business application * Open-source project Show us what you've built. That's more important to us than having a perfect resume. We Encourage Non-Traditional Candidates You do not need a perfect career history to apply. We are interested in: * Recent graduates * Self-taught developers * Bootcamp graduates * Freelance developers * Startup engineers * Developers with strong personal projects * Engineers transitioning into software development * Open-source contributors * People who have built products independently If you can demonstrate that you can **learn, build, solve problems, and take ownership**, we want to hear from you. What Success Looks Like After joining the company, we want you to eventually be able to receive a business objective and turn it into a working product. For example: Founder: "Customers need a better way to find and compare companies." You: "Here's how I recommend we build it." Then you: Design → Build → Test → Deploy → Measure → Improve That's the level of ownership we're building toward. How We'll Evaluate You We don't believe resumes tell the whole story. Our hiring process may include: 1. Introductory Interview We'll learn about you, your interests, and what you've built. 2. Technical Conversation We'll discuss real engineering problems rather than simply asking trivia questions. 3. Project Review We'll ask you to walk us through something you've built. We want to understand: * What did you build? * Why did you build it? * What technology did you choose? * What problems did you encounter? * How did you solve them? * What would you change? 4. Practical Technical Exercise You may be asked to build a small application or feature. The goal isn't to trick you. We want to see how you: Think → Plan → Build → Debug → Explain 5. Final Founder Interview You'll meet directly with the founder and discuss the company's vision and the role you'll play in building it. Important: AI Is Allowed We don't expect candidates to pretend AI doesn't exist. Modern engineers use tools such as AI coding assistants, LLMs, documentation tools, and automated development tools. We care about whether you understand the code you produce Using AI to increase productivity is encouraged. Submitting AI-generated code you don't understand is not. Why Join Us? This role offers something that is difficult to find early in a software engineering career: Real ownership. You won't simply be one developer among hundreds working on a tiny piece of a massive system. You'll have the opportunity to: * Build products from scratch * Work directly with the founder * Influence technical decisions * Work with AI * Learn full-stack development * Work across frontend and backend * Deploy real applications * See your work used by customers * Develop product and business judgment * Grow rapidly as an engineer If you want to spend the next few years simply completing assigned tickets, this may not be the right role. If you want to build things, solve difficult problems, learn quickly, and have a meaningful role in a growing company, we want to meet you. The Bottom Line We are looking for an engineer who doesn't say: Tell me exactly what to code. We are looking for someone who says: Tell me what problem we're trying to solve, and I'll figure out how to build it If that's you, Apply When applying, please include: 1. Your resume 2. GitHub or portfolio, if available 3. One project you're particularly proud of 4. A brief explanation of what you personally built 5. Links to any live applications you've deployed We care more about what you've built than how many years you've been employed.

title: Account Manager / Print Estimator – UK Printing Company
job_title: Account Manager / Print Estimator – UK Printing Company
description: # Account Manager / Print Estimator – UK Printing Company **Full-Time | Remote | Philippines | UK Working Hours** ## About Us Swytch Graphics is a UK-based commercial printing and visual communications company specialising in **large-format digital print, retail displays, point-of-sale (POS), signage, graphics and fabricated display products**. Your role will be to help manage existing customers and incoming enquiries, understand what the customer needs, prepare quotations and help progress work from initial enquiry through to production. You will communicate directly with UK customers by email and, once confident, potentially by telephone or Teams. A typical enquiry might be: * 500 printed retail display panels * 2,000 point-of-sale graphics for stores * Printed and CNC-cut Foamex boards * Acrylic cosmetic display components * Window vinyls and self-adhesive graphics * Large-format banners and display graphics * Printed PETG or polycarbonate components * Retail lightboxes or fabric graphics * Bespoke printed and fabricated display products You will need to understand how a product should be manufactured and then use our estimating system to calculate the price. ## Key Responsibilities You will: * Respond to incoming customer enquiries * Read and understand customer specifications and briefs * Review dimensions, quantities, materials and finishing requirements * Prepare accurate quotations using our MIS/estimating system * D ---------- the most appropriate production method for each job * Calculate material requirements and production processes * Request additional information from customers when a specification is incomplete * Prepare clear and professional quotations * Follow up outstanding quotations where appropriate * Convert successful quotations into production jobs * Work closely with our UK account management and production teams * Check artwork and job information is complete before production * Help customers identify more economical or practical ways of producing projects * Maintain accurate customer and project information * Develop strong relationships with regular customers As your technical knowledge develops, we want you to become capable of managing your own portfolio of customers and enquiries. ## Who We Are Looking For The most important requirement is **commercial printing or signage industry experience**. Ideally, you will already have worked for a: * Commercial printer * Large-format printing company * Signage company * Display / exhibition company * Packaging or POS manufacturer * Print estimating company Previous experience estimating print jobs would be particularly valuable. You should understand at least some of the following: * Large-format digital printing * Flatbed printing * Roll-to-roll printing * Vinyl printing * Laminating * Mounting * CNC cutting * Laser cutting * Routing * Acrylic fabrication * Foamex / PVC board * Correx / corrugated plastic * Dibond / aluminium composite * PETG * Self-adhesive vinyl * Posters and display graphics * Retail POS / point-of-sale displays You do **not** need to know everything on this list. We have an experienced UK team who can provide training on our equipment, materials, processes and estimating system. However, previous print industry knowledge will make a significant difference. ## Systems We use **PrintIQ** as our Management Information System and estimating platform. Previous PrintIQ experience would be extremely useful but is **not essential**. Experience with other print MIS or estimating systems such as Tharstern, Optimus, EFI Pace, PrintSmith, Avanti, Clarity or similar would also be relevant. You should also be confident using: * Microsoft Outlook * Excel * Microsoft Teams * Web-based business software ## Your English Must Be Excellent You will communicate directly with UK customers, so you must have: * Excellent written English * Strong spoken English * Good grammar and attention to detail * Confidence communicating professionally with customers * The ability to understand sometimes complex written specifications You must also be comfortable asking questions. We would much rather you ask for clarification than make assumptions when preparing a quotation. ## The Type of Person We Want We are looking for someone who is: * Intelligent and quick to learn * Technically minded * Extremely organised * Comfortable working with numbers * Accurate and detail-focused * Commercially aware * Confident communicating with customers * Able to manage multiple enquiries at the same time * Proactive rather than waiting to be told what to do * Interested in building a long-term career with our company This is an important position within our business and we are looking for someone who wants to become a genuine member of our team rather than simply complete outsourced tasks. ## Working Hours This is a **full-time remote position working alongside our UK team**. You will therefore need to work predominantly **UK business hours**. Our normal UK office hours are approximately: **8:00am – 5:00pm UK time, Monday to Friday** We can discuss the exact working pattern with the successful candidate. ## Training We appreciate that every printing company works differently. Full training will therefore be provided covering: * Our products * Materials * Printing equipment * Finishing processes * Production methods * PrintIQ * Our estimating procedures * Our customer base We expect the successful candidate's technical knowledge and responsibilities to increase considerably over time. ## Career Opportunity We are looking for somebody **long term**. Our business is growing and this position has the opportunity to develop into a senior offshore account management / estimating role as we expand the team. For the right person, we want this to become a career rather than a short-term freelance position. ## How to Apply When applying, please tell us: 1. What experience you have within the **printing, signage, POS or display industry** 2. Whether you have previously prepared **print estimates or quotations** 3. Which printing processes and materials you are familiar with 4. Which MIS / estimating systems you have previously used 5. Your current employment situation 6. Your expected monthly salary in PHP 7. Whether you are comfortable working UK business hours Please also start your application with the words: **“PRINT ESTIMATOR”** This simply confirms that you have read the full job description. We are particularly interested in applicants with genuine print industry experience, so please explain your experience in detail. **Job Type:** Part time to start moving to Full-Time, Permanent Remote Position **Location:** Remote **Industry:** Commercial Printing / Large Format Print / Retail POS & Displays

title: Website QA & Remediation Specialist (WordPress / Elementor)
description: Website QA & Remediation Specialist (WordPress / Elementor) Find it. Fix it. Prove it's fixed About the Role Eden Digital manages SEO, content, and web operations for a portfolio of client websites — healthcare and behavioral-health practices, home-service companies, and local businesses. We run structured, audit-driven workflows: every site gets crawled, proofread, and technically audited, and the output is a prioritized findings list (CSV/GitHub issues) with exact quotes, URLs, and suggested fixes. Your job has two halves: FIND the issues and FIX them — carefully, verifiably, and without breaking anything. Sometimes we hand you a completed audit and you work the list down to zero. Just as often, you are the audit: you take a client site cold, sweep it end-to-end (copy, links, technical SEO, brand/design conformance), build the findings list yourself, and then remediate it. This is not a design role and not a dev-from-scratch role. It is a precision QA + remediation role: you detect an issue ("this FAQ answer is pasted from the wrong page," "this button dials the wrong number," "this section's background color is off-brand," "this link 404s on 49 pages"), document it, and fix it at the right level — page, template, or global — then prove it's fixed. What You'll Fix (real examples from our audits) Copy errors at scale: typos ("therpay"), grammar ("at it's roots"), wrong credentials in author boxes, sitewide footer typos — fixed once at the template level where possible, or via careful WP-CLI search-replace across Elementor JSON data. You can use AI to help you correct these issues, they just need to get done! Wrong-page content: FAQ answers pasted under the wrong question, sections copied from another service page, a team bio describing a different company, lorem ipsum and writer instructions left live Factual drift: program hours, durations, phone numbers, service claims that contradict the client's canonical fact sheet — every instance verified against the brand repository before editing Broken links and redirects: internal 404s, malformed hrefs, nav/footer links that pass through redirect chains, dead outbound citations Technical SEO cleanup: duplicate meta-description emitters, missing metas and H1s, broken JSON-LD schema, sitemap hygiene (dead URLs, duplicates, noindex conflicts), image alt text Design and brand corrections: wrong background colors, off-brand section styling, spacing and contrast issues, text below our 16px minimum, mobile responsiveness defects — corrected against each client's documented brand guide without redesigning anything Accessibility basics: contrast, alt text, focus states, readable font sizes Responsibilities Finding (QA / auditing): Run full-site QA sweeps on assigned client sites: crawl every page (sitemap + link discovery), proofread copy word-by-word, test all internal/external links, and check titles, metas, H1s, canonicals, schema, and sitemap hygiene Verify site copy against each client's canonical fact sheet in our brand repository (services, hours, phone numbers, credentials, service-area claims) and flag every contradiction Do visual/brand conformance passes against each client's documented brand guide: background and section colors, typography, spacing, contrast, minimum text size, mobile rendering Compile findings into our standard format (severity, URL, exact quote/screenshot, issue, suggested fix) in CSV/GitHub/Notion — organized so template-level fixes are identified as one item, not fifty Fixing (remediation): Work prioritized findings lists (yours or ours) and close items in fix-order: template-level one-shot fixes first, then page-level edits D ---------- the correct fix level — global template/theme, Elementor template, reusable widget, or individual page — so one edit fixes every instance Execute bulk copy corrections safely: staging first, full backup, WP-CLI wp search-replace with dry runs, aware that Elementor stores content as JSON-escaped strings in postmeta Verify every fix on the live page (fresh, uncached) and mark it done with a before/after note; regenerate Elementor CSS and purge caches as needed Flag judgment calls instead of guessing — e.g., when a "wrong" fact might describe the industry generically rather than the client, or when two pages contradict each other and the client must d ---------- which is true Never alter established brand elements (colors, typography, photography) except to restore them to the documented standard Maintain redirect maps and update internal links at the source rather than stacking redirects Log all work in our systems (GitHub, Notion) with clear, reviewable change notes Required Skills & Experience 3+ years hands-on WordPress experience, including deep Elementor fluency: global templates vs. page-level widgets, theme builder parts (header/footer), reusable sections, custom CSS placement, CSS regeneration Comfortable with WP-CLI (search-replace with dry-run, db export) and staging → production workflows; understands serialized/JSON data risks in bulk replacements Working knowledge of technical SEO: meta tags, canonicals, robots directives, XML sitemaps, JSON-LD schema (able to find and fix a parse error), Rank Math or Yoast Solid HTML/CSS (able to trace which stylesheet or widget sets a background color and override it in the right place, not with !important patches) Meticulous written English — you catch typos other people miss, and your change notes are precise Able to run site audits independently with tools like Screaming Frog, Sitebulb, or equivalent scripts — link status, metadata, crawl comparison — and turn raw output into a clean, prioritized findings list Process discipline: backups before bulk edits, dry runs, verification, documentation — every time Strongly Preferred Experience with healthcare, behavioral-health, or other YMYL websites (accuracy and compliance sensitivity; adults-only service boundaries; no invented clinical claims) Familiarity with GitHub-based content workflows (branches, PRs, review comments) Experience with call tracking (CallTrackingMetrics) and GA4 — enough to know why replacing a tracked phone number with an untracked one is a serious error Comfort using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) to accelerate QA passes — paired with the judgment to verify everything before publishing Basic accessibility (WCAG) literacy Cloudflare / caching stack familiarity (knowing the difference between "fixed" and "fixed but cached") What Success Looks Like 30 days: the current backlog's template-level and high-severity items are closed and verified; zero regressions 60 days: full findings list for the first site closed; you've completed your first cold-start audit of a second site (found the issues yourself) and built a reusable audit + fix-verification checklist 90 days: you run the full find-and-fix cycle across multiple client sites independently, catch issues before clients report them, and flag client-decision items with clear framing What We Are NOT Looking For Redesigners — the brands' colors, typography, and photography are fixed; your job includes restoring them, not reinventing them "It works on my machine" fixers — every fix is verified on the live, uncached page Bulk find-replace cowboys — anyone who runs a production-wide search-replace without a dry run and backup is an immediate mismatch Hiring Process Application with 2–3 short examples of QA/remediation work you've done (before/after screenshots or descriptions are fine) Paid trial task (~2 hrs): we give you a staging site with ~10 seeded errors from the categories above. You find them, document them in our findings format, fix what's safe, flag what needs a decision, and note anything you couldn't fix and why Contract start with a real, prioritized findings list from day one

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Phase 1 — Launch Planning - Build a comprehensive launch roadmap covering every step from production coordination to live Amazon listing - Identify all requirements, timelines, potential blockers, and dependencies upfront -
