Projects, Optimization & Automation • Lead cloud migration and optimization projects for MSP clients. • Optimize Microsoft 365 environments for security, performance, and cost efficiency. • Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts to automate Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, and related administrative tasks. • Recommend improvements, standards, and long-term strategies to MSP partners. • Stay current on Microsoft 365 feature changes and emerging cloud technologies. description: Cold Caller / Outbound Appointment Setter Location: Fully Remote (Ph) Schedule: Monday–Friday, 10:00 AM–6:00 PM EST (approximately 11:00 PM–7:00 AM Manila time — this is a night shift) Compensation: $1,000 USD per month base + $25 USD per qualified appointment that shows + $100 USD per client that signs About T3 Tech Partners T3 Tech Partners is the team MSPs rely on when challenges exceed Tier 2 or internal expertise. We operate as a Fractional Tier 3 partner, delivering advanced Systems Administration, Infrastructure, Networking cloud, and security expertise to MSPs supporting diverse client environments. Our engineers are trusted technical partners — leading implementations, resolving complex escalations, and working directly with MSP clients to execute real-world solutions. Our outbound team is the first voice those partners hear, and that first impression matters. Role Overview We are seeking an experienced Cold Caller / Outbound Appointment Setter to drive outbound prospecting into Managed Service Providers and IT firms across the United States. You will own the top of the funnel — building call lists, making high-volume outbound calls, handling objections in real time, and booking qualified discovery meetings for our leadership team. This is a voice-first, customer-facing role. Native-level spoken English is a hard requirement, not a preference. You will be speaking with US-based business owners, IT directors, and MSP principals every day. Applicants with a noticeable accent that impedes clarity, or with hesitant, scripted-sounding delivery, will not be advanced. This role requires resilience, independence, and the ability to hold a confident business conversation with senior technical decision-makers without a script to hide behind. Key Responsibilities Outbound Calling & Prospecting Make a high volume of outbound cold calls per day to MSPs, IT service firms, and internal IT departments across US time zones. Open conversations confidently with owners, principals, and IT decision-makers. Qualify prospects against our ideal-client profile (company size, service mix, existing Tier 3 gaps). Availability & Support Expectations Standard working hours are 10:00 AM–6:00 PM EST, Monday through Friday. This is a night shift in the Philippines — roughly 11:00 PM to 7:00 AM Manila time. title: Technical Generalist - Web Ops & CMS Maintenance (Python/JS, AI-assisted)
job_title: Technical Generalist - Web Ops & CMS Maintenance (Python/JS, AI-assisted)
description: A US sports talent agency running two connected web properties: a main booking site on Strapi, and a growing portfolio of individual websites for the athletes we represent, running on a custom platform we built ourselves (Python/FastAPI backend, React admin, HTML template layer). Right now every problem across both — a wrong career stat, a booking form that stopped submitting, a template that renders badly on mobile, a CMS field behaving strangely — routes to one person. We are hiring the person it routes to instead. THE WORK, ROUGHLY IN ORDER OF VOLUME 1. Content operations. Adding athletes to the CMS from source material we provide: bio, career credits, photos, video embeds, category tagging, fee and availability fields. Publishing short news items to a spec. Keeping existing profiles current. This is the steady baseline and it needs no code. 2. Troubleshooting. "The booking link on this page goes nowhere." "This section renders wrong." "The CMS will not save this field." You diagnose it, decide whether it is content, configuration or code, and fix it or escalate with a clear description of what you found. 3. Code fixes, by pull request. Small, scoped fixes against either codebase. You work on a branch, you write the PR, you explain the change, you test it before pushing. You will not have merge rights — every PR is reviewed and merged by us. 4. Template changes. Changes to the shared templates that affect every athlete site at once. These are the highest-blast-radius work we have, and they are the reason this role is technical rather than administrative. Developed against a local stack, verified on a private canary site, and approved before they reach real athletes. HOW YOU ARE EXPECTED TO WORK AI-first. We run this operation with AI assistance throughout and we expect you to do the same — Claude, Cursor, Copilot, whatever you are fluent in. This is not a tolerance, it is a requirement, and your throughput will be measured against what the same work takes us with AI assistance. The corollary matters more than the tool: you are accountable for what you ship, including the parts an AI wrote. We want someone who can tell when a generated fix is right, when it is plausible and wrong, and when it works for a reason they cannot yet explain — and who slows down at exactly that third case. These are public pages about real, named, recognizable people. A confidently wrong career stat on someone's own website is worse than a slow turnaround. THE TRUST LADDER Everything starts gated. Early on, template and code changes come to us for approval before they go anywhere. As you demonstrate judgment, categories of work get released to you: first "do this without asking", then "you decide whether this needs asking." We are not looking for someone to stay at step one. HOW WE HIRE — YOU GET PAID FOR THE TEST We do not run unpaid test tasks. We have a genuine backlog and the trial is real work from it. You are paid your normal rate for every stage and we keep and use the output whether or not you advance. Stages will cover a variety of tasks. We run this with three to four candidates in parallel and compare directly. Being paid throughout is what makes that fair. AFTER THE TRIAL A fixed monthly block of hours, ongoing — predictable for you, predictable for us, and it means you build real familiarity with the systems rather than context-switching in cold each time. Scope and autonomy grow on merit. WHAT WE NEED YOU TO HAVE - Comfortable reading and modifying both Python and JavaScript. You do not need to be strong in both; you need to be unafraid of either. - Git and pull requests as normal daily practice, not something you looked up once. - Genuine fluency with an AI coding assistant, including its failure modes. - Enough HTML/CSS to change a template and know what you broke. - Care about factual accuracy in writing about real people. - Working hours with at least a few hours of overlap with US business hours. Strapi, FastAPI or React experience specifically is a bonus, not a requirement. TO APPLY Please answer all six of these in your application. We read the answers, and applications that skip them will not be reviewed. 1. Begin your reply with the name of one sport you follow closely enough to spot an error in a player's career summary. 2. Describe a change you shipped recently where you used an AI coding assistant, and be specific about the moment you had to override or correct what it produced. What made you distrust it? 3. You receive a ticket that says, in full: "The booking link on his page is broken." No other detail. What are your first three steps, in order? 4. You need to change a shared template that renders 20 live websites. Walk us through how you would get that change to production without breaking any of them. 5. From source material we provide, how many athlete profiles — bio, career credits, one photo, correct category — could you complete to a publishable standard in one hour? What would slow that number down? 6. Your hourly rate, your time zone, and whether you can commit to a recurring monthly block of hours.

title: Unreal Engine Game Developer
description: Who We Are: At Happy Little Games, games are art. We are an independent studio built by gamers, for gamers, making the kinds of games we would want to play ourselves. We care about creating games that are fun, memorable, and worth the time players spend with them. Every project is a chance to build something distinct that we are genuinely proud of. Why Work Here: If you love games and enjoy building things, this is a place where you can do both in a flexible, supportive environment. We are fully remote, you can set your own schedule, and we do not believe in crunch. We care about the quality of your work and whether you get things done, not how many hours you sit at a desk. You also get to work closely with a small team and decide how you want to grow. You can deepen your expertise in the work you already enjoy, explore other areas of game development, or grow into a different role over time. Being good at one thing does not mean you have to do only that thing forever. Role Overview * Build and prototype gameplay features in Unreal Engine using Blueprints. * Work on gameplay systems, basic AI, physics, interactions, and related gameplay functionality. * Create focused test environments that clearly show how a feature works. * Test and debug your own work before submitting it for review. * Keep implementation focused on the requested scope and avoid unnecessary files, systems, or dependencies. * Document what you build, how it works, and how it should be tested. * Manage assigned user stories, communicate progress, and raise questions, blockers, or risks early. * Learn and follow the studio’s technical standards, workflows, and development practices. What You Need to Bring: You do not need to know every Unreal Engine system before joining us, but you should already be able to work productively without constant step-by-step instruction. You should already be able to: * Work comfortably within Unreal Engine. * Build functional gameplay features using Blueprints. * Build simple gameplay systems and basic AI behavior. * Apply basic software-development principles, including logic, data flow, organization, and debugging. * Test and debug your own work before submitting it for review. * Test both the expected behavior and a basic control case where the feature should not activate or behave the same way. * Research unfamiliar but well-documented problems and make reasonable progress independently. * Manage your own time and keep assigned work moving toward completion. * Keep your work focused on the requested scope. * Ask useful questions when requirements or technical direction are unclear. * Communicate progress, blockers, and risks early. * Create and maintain basic documentation for your work. * Keep project files and implementation reasonably clean and organized. * Explain how your work functions and why you made important implementation decisions. * Remain professional, dependable, and honest about what you do and do not know. What You Can Learn Here: You are not required to already know every tool, framework, or production practice used by the studio. You can learn or further develop the following after joining: * Git and the studio’s source-control workflow. * Notion and the studio’s user-story workflow. * Agile and Scrum practices. * The Gameplay Ability System and how it is used within our projects. * The studio’s architecture, naming conventions, and technical standards. * Formal system-design and diagramming practices. * Stronger documentation practices. * Multiplayer replication. * Basic C++ as your responsibilities grow. * More advanced gameplay, AI, animation, physics, and Unreal Engine systems. You should be willing to research these areas, learn from available documentation and examples, and apply feedback to future work. Compensation: Your final hourly rate will be based on your experience, demonstrated skills, technical ability, communication, and level of independence. We will determine the appropriate rate through the interview and trial process. Work Progression: New developers begin with a trial project so we can evaluate how they work, communicate, and deliver against a real set of requirements. Developers who complete the trial successfully may continue with project-based work. From there, strong and consistent contributors may move into hourly work as availability and studio needs allow. As the company grows, hourly developers may also have the opportunity to move into a full-time role if both sides are interested. How to Apply: Please apply through OnlineJobs.ph whenever possible and include your resume, portfolio, and any relevant Unreal Engine work samples. If you are unable to contact us through OnlineJobs.ph for any reason, you may also reach us via email. Please include the position you are applying for in the subject line.

description: EXPERIENCED VIDEO EDITORS ONLY We are looking for a full-time professional video editor who specializes in creating attention-grabbing short-form social media content. WHAT YOU WILL DO We will send you raw video clips, and your responsibility will be to take that footage and create a completely edited, polished, ready-to-post social media video. You need to know how to: • Find the strongest parts of the raw footage and put them together correctly • Create a strong attention-grabbing hook within the first 1–3 seconds • Use eye-catching effects that keep viewers engaged • Add attention-grabbing sounds such as clicks, dings, pops, swooshes, typing/mouse sounds and other effects when appropriate • Create fast, clean and smooth transitions • Use zoom-ins, zoom-outs and movement to emphasize important moments • Create professional animated captions and subtitles • Highlight important words and phrases within captions • Add graphics, images, icons, arrows, emojis, callouts and visual effects when appropriate • Use B-roll and other visual elements when they improve the video • Remove pauses, dead space and unnecessary footage • Understand fast-paced social media editing • Use pattern interrupts and visual changes to keep the viewer’s attention • Add appropriate background music and sound effects • Properly balance music, voice and sound effects • Clean and enhance audio when necessary • Color-correct and improve footage when needed • Properly format content for vertical 9:16 social media videos • Deliver high-quality finished videos that are ready for us to post WE WANT SOMEONE WHO UNDERSTANDS ATTENTION We are NOT looking for someone who simply cuts clips together and adds subtitles. You need to understand modern social media editing and why someone stops scrolling and continues watching a video. You should understand how and when to use: HOOKS • CAPTIONS • SOUND EFFECTS • ZOOMS • B-ROLL • GRAPHICS • ANIMATIONS • TRANSITIONS • PATTERN INTERRUPTS • TEXT EFFECTS • VISUAL EFFECTS Effects should be eye-catching and professional, not random or overdone. We are looking for someone to become our long-term video editor, learn the style of content we like, and eventually understand what we are looking for without needing detailed instructions every time. PAID VIDEO EDITING TEST After reviewing applications, resumes and previous work samples, we will select the applicants we feel are qualified to move forward. Qualified candidates will be asked to complete a PAID editing test. We will provide raw footage and ask you to create approximately 2–3 sample edited videos so we can see your actual editing ability using our content. You WILL be paid for these test videos. The test will allow us to evaluate your: • Creativity • Editing quality • Hooks and attention-grabbing ability • Captions • Graphics and visual effects • Sound effects • Transitions • Zooms and movement • Pacing • Attention to detail • Ability to follow instructions • Overall understanding of short-form social media content We are not looking for free work. title: Apparel Graphic Designer (Hand Illustration) for US Coastal Lifestyle Brand. Paid Test Project, Then Ongoing Work.
job_title: Apparel Graphic Designer (Hand Illustration) for US Coastal Lifestyle Brand. Paid Test Project, Then Ongoing Work.
description: I run ATEOTD, a coastal lifestyle apparel brand in the US. Think of brands like Vuori, Faherty, and Quicksilver: quiet, premium, restrained. Small placements, limited ink colors, nothing loud. The brand has a second layer. Our phrases come from scripture, but they are chosen so that a stranger with no faith background would read them as simply well written. We never print verse citations on garments. If a design feels "churchy," it has failed. If it feels like a great vintage surf graphic that happens to carry weight, it has succeeded. I am hiring one illustrator, starting with a single paid test design. If the work is strong, this becomes ongoing per-design work. I only run one design at a time, and I am honest with you up front: I am picky. What I offer in return is clear briefs, fast decisions, and steady work if we fit. The Work Hand-illustrated graphic tees. Surf, and minimal coastal styles. Designs print DTG on garment-dyed tees, so: Maximum 2 to 3 ink colors per design No fine details below roughly 1.5mm (they will not print reliably) Designs must work on muted garment colors (dusty blue, khaki, seafoam) Hard Requirements No AI-generated artwork. None. Not as a base, not "cleaned up," not for reference compositing. Original illustration only. I will ask to see process work (sketches, WIP screenshots) and I check. Editable source files. Layered Adobe Illustrator files (vector, with both outlined and live-text versions where type is used), plus print-ready PNG at 300 DPI on transparent background. You must be comfortable working from written briefs in English. Sample Brief (this is the actual test design) Phrase: "Let the sea roar" Direction: A contained emblem in the retro surf style: an ocean scene built from flat, layered organic shapes inside an arch frame. A breaking wave as the focal point, a low sun, and a simple horizon. Four flat ink colors maximum, drawn from a muted coastal palette (dusty blue, sage, ochre, cream). No gradients, no outlines doing heavy lifting, no fine detail. The phrase is part of the lockup, either arced along the inside of the frame or set beneath the scene like a badge, never floating as a caption. A slight handmade quality at the edges is welcome; sterile vector perfection is not. Back print, roughly 10 to 12 inches tall Three links to hand-illustrated apparel or print work you made (not a full portfolio dump, your three best) Two or three sentences on your illustration process, including what tools you draw in Confirmation that you understand and agree to the no-AI rule How many days you would need for the test design Applications that skip these steps will not get a reply.

title: Apparel Blank Sourcing Assistant — Research & Supplier Outreach
job_title: Apparel Blank Sourcing Assistant — Research & Supplier Outreach
description: I run an independent apparel brand in the US. I buy blanks and finished pieces, then distress and finish them by hand. I need someone to find me pieces with better cuts and better fabric than what's easy to find, at small quantities. The standard I'm aiming at Fashion-forward streetwear silhouettes, not basic promotional blanks. Reference points: Off-White, Acne Studios, mnml, Who Decides War, Evisu, and Marithé + François Girbaud jeans from the 2000s. Heavyweight, boxy, oversized, baggy. If it looks like a Gildan, it's wrong. Categories T-shirts, crewnecks, hoodies, thermals, joggers, pants, jorts (baggy denim shorts), jeans, hats. I buy small — keep minimums low Most of my orders are 10 to 20 pieces. Low minimums are a priority, but not a hard rule. If a supplier has a 16 or 24 piece minimum and the product and price are genuinely better, include it and note the MOQ clearly. What I don't want is 50 or 100 piece minimums — that's out of range. Always record the exact MOQ for every supplier. It's one of the first things I look at. What you'd do — Find suppliers who sell fashion-forward streetwear at low minimums — Email and message suppliers directly to get pricing, minimums, catalogs, and lead times. A lot of this isn't published, so you'll have to ask. — Build one comparison sheet: supplier, style number, category, fabric weight (GSM or oz), fiber content, size L measurements (body length, chest width, shoulder-to-shoulder, or waist and inseam for bottoms), MOQ, price at 1 / 6 / 12 / 24 units, lead time, ship-from location, link, and notes — Use the notes column to tell me why something is worth a look, especially if the minimum is higher but the product or price is better — Because I'm often buying without seeing the piece first, note the quality of each listing's photos and any reviews or ratings the supplier has. Flag anything that looks sketchy. — Later on: research overseas cut-and-sew manufacturers for custom production Two things that decide everything Minimum order quantity. Always record it, exactly. Lower is better, but a great piece at a slightly higher minimum is worth showing me. Measurements. A boxy oversized fit and a regular fit can carry the same size label. The size chart is the only way to tell. Always pull it. What actually matters — You read spec sheets carefully. Careful beats fast. — You write clear, professional emails to suppliers and follow up when they don't reply. — You tell me when you can't find something instead of guessing. A blank cell is better than a wrong one. You don't need apparel experience. You need to be organized, precise, and willing to learn a narrow subject well. Hours and pay Paid 2-week trial, 10 hours per week. If it works, ongoing at $250–300/month for 10 hours a week, growing with the brand. How to apply Start your message with the words DROP SHOULDER. Then answer briefly: Find me one pair of blank oversized baggy denim jorts (baggy denim shorts, men's). Send the supplier, style number, price per unit, the minimum order quantity, and the size L waist measurement and inseam. In your own words, what makes a garment read as oversized versus just a bigger size? What would you use to build and share the comparison sheet? Applications that don't start with DROP SHOULDER will be deleted unread.

You will: * Transfer existing product information * Organize product images * Improve titles and descriptions where necessary * Create platform-appropriate product descriptions * Add variants/SKUs * Organize products into collections * Ensure pricing and product information are accurate * Optimize listings for each platform * Maintain consistent branding across channels ### Walmart Marketplace Help establish and configure our Walmart Marketplace presence, including: * Seller account setup/verification assistance * Store configuration * Product listing creation * Product categorization * Images and descriptions * Shipping settings * Return settings * Inventory configuration * Order-management configuration * Troubleshooting listing errors or rejected products * Ensuring listings comply with Walmart requirements Experience with Walmart Seller Center is strongly preferred. ### TikTok Shop Set up and optimize our TikTok Shop, including: * TikTok Shop Seller Center configuration * Business/store profile setup * Product uploads * Product descriptions * Categories * Shipping settings * Returns * Inventory * Storefront organization * Linking products to TikTok content * Basic TikTok Shop optimization Experience with TikTok Shop in the **United States market** is highly preferred. ### Multi-Channel Integration We would prefer someone who understands how to connect these systems efficiently rather than managing everything manually. You should be able to recommend and/or implement the best way to synchronize: **Amazon + Shopify + Walmart + TikTok Shop** This may include: * Inventory synchronization * SKU consistency * Order management * Product feeds * Shipping workflows * Pricing updates * Analytics * Marketplace integrations/apps You should be able to explain which tools you recommend and why. ## What We Will Provide We can provide: * Existing Amazon product listings * Product images * Product information * Pricing * SKUs * Business information * Branding/logo * Required business documents * Access to the necessary platforms You should be capable of taking this information and independently completing most of the setup without needing detailed instructions for every step. ## Ideal Candidate We are looking for someone who has **actually launched e-commerce stores before**, not someone who is simply willing to learn Shopify. Strong candidates should have experience with several of the following: * Shopify * Walmart Seller Center * TikTok Shop Seller Center * Amazon Seller Central * Marketplace product listings * E-commerce integrations * Inventory synchronization * Product SEO * Shopify themes * Canva/basic graphic design * Product page optimization * Google Analytics * Meta Pixel * TikTok Pixel * Shipping and fulfillment configuration Amazon Seller Central experience is helpful because our existing Amazon listings will serve as a major source for the new stores. ## Project Goals At the end of the initial project, we expect to have: **1. Shopify** A professional, fully functional Shopify website ready to accept orders. **2. Walmart** Our Walmart Marketplace account/store properly configured with approved products live or submitted for approval. **3. TikTok Shop** A functioning TikTok Shop with products uploaded and the storefront properly configured. **4. Integration** A practical system for keeping inventory, SKUs, pricing, and orders organized across the different platforms. **5. Documentation** A simple document explaining the setup, integrations used, and anything we need to know to operate the stores afterward. ## IMPORTANT: Application Requirements Please do not apply if you have only general VA experience. We specifically want someone with hands-on **e-commerce store setup experience**. When applying, please answer: 1. How many Shopify stores have you personally built? 2. Please send links/screenshots of Shopify stores you have worked on. 3. Have you personally set up a Walmart Marketplace seller account? 4. Have you personally set up a U.S. TikTok Shop? 5. title: Coverage Virtual Assistant
description: About the Role We are hiring reliable Coverage Virtual Assistants to provide dependable on-call support during assigned coverage hours. This is a request-based role. You are not expected to continuously monitor systems or stay busy when there is nothing to do. Instead, you are expected to be available during your assigned shift and respond promptly when a request comes in. When there are no active requests, you are free to work on other jobs, clients, or projects. The goal is to provide reliable coverage across the team without requiring someone to sit idle waiting for work. How the Role Works During your assigned coverage hours: Be reachable and available. Check communication channels when requested or when a new request comes in. Acknowledge requests promptly. Handle straightforward requests when appropriate. Escalate or assign more complex requests to the correct person. Follow through until the request is either completed or clearly handed off. Provide a brief handoff at the end of your shift if anything remains open. When there is no request requiring your attention, you may work on other flexible projects. Your outside work must not prevent you from responding promptly when needed. Responsibilities You may be asked to: Check email, messages, calendars, documents, systems, or accounts upon request. Respond to incoming team requests during your shift. Complete simple administrative or operational tasks. Make small updates or corrections. Locate information or documents. Route requests to the appropriate team member. Escalate urgent matters quickly. Follow up on specific outstanding items when asked. Record important updates for the next person. Make sure open requests are properly handed off before your shift ends. Responsiveness Standard Responsiveness is the most important requirement for this role. You do not need to spend your entire shift actively watching communication channels. However, when a request is sent during your assigned coverage hours, you should be reachable, acknowledge it promptly, and begin handling or routing it without unnecessary delay. If another project regularly prevents you from responding when needed, this role will not be a good fit. What You Are Not Expected to Do You are not expected to: Continuously monitor systems all day. Create unnecessary work when there are no requests. Personally complete every complex project. Stay focused exclusively on our business during quiet periods. The role is intentionally designed to allow you to work on other flexible projects when our team does not need assistance. Your Role When a Request Comes In The process should generally be: Request Received → Acknowledge → Handle if appropriate → Escalate or assign if needed → Confirm status → Handoff if still open Complex work will normally be handled by the primary team or specialist responsible for that area. Shift Handoff If anything is still open when your shift ends, provide a short handoff including: What was requested What has already been done What is still pending Whether anything is urgent Who should handle the next step The next Coverage VA or team member should be able to pick up the request without starting over. What We Are Looking For We want someone who is: Reliable Responsive Organized Comfortable working independently Able to follow instructions Able to recognize urgency Comfortable escalating instead of guessing A strong written communicator Comfortable using Google Workspace, messaging platforms, AI tools, and common business software Success in This Role You are succeeding when: You are available during your assigned coverage hours. Requests are acknowledged promptly. Straightforward requests are handled efficiently. Urgent matters are escalated quickly. Complex requests reach the correct person. Nothing important is forgotten during handoffs. You remain dependable while still having the flexibility to work on other projects during quiet periods. Compensation: $350/month. This role is especially well suited for freelancers or virtual assistants who already have flexible work and want an additional long-term on-call position.

title: Executive Assistant to the CEO
description: Location: Remote (Philippines-based VAs only) Read this whole thing before you apply. If you skim it, you'll fail step one. Smartland manages 1,400+ rental homes and apartments. The CEO moves fast and d ---------- faster. This role exists to make him faster still: to remove friction, anticipate the next three steps, and never let a ball drop. You are his memory, his logic check, and his second brain. This is not a calendar-and-coffee job. If that's what you're looking for, stop here. What you'll actually do: Run the CEO's day so he doesn't have to think about logistics: calendar, travel, prep, follow-through. Catch things before they become problems. We expect you to flag what we missed. Hold the full picture in your head: who owes what, what's due when, which thread is still open. Turn vague direction into a finished result without being walked through it. Build and maintain checklists for everything, because nothing falls through a good checklist. Who we're looking for: You think fast and you think clearly. Sloppy logic is a dealbreaker. Your memory is sharp. People are surprised by what you remember. You are relentlessly organized. You love checklists, genuinely, not as a line on a résumé. You're proactive. You'd rather ask forgiveness than wait for instructions on the obvious. You think strategically. You see why a task matters, not just what the task is. When the standard template doesn't fit, you build a better one. Do not apply if: You need detailed instructions to start. You've ever said "that's not my job." You drop tasks and blame the volume. You're hoping to wing it. We will find out by week one. English Communication Requirement Candidates must have strong English communication skills, with a minimum expected level of B2; C1 is preferred. You should be able to communicate clearly and professionally in both written and spoken English, understand instructions accurately, and communicate effectively with clients, prospects, and internal team members. An English proficiency test result is not required at the time of application. However, Smartland may request proof of English proficiency later in the hiring process, including after the interview, if needed. English proficiency will be evaluated throughout the screening and interview process. Please do not apply if you do not feel confident communicating professionally in English at a B2 level or higher. title: Amazon Online Arbitrage Product Researcher — US Market
job_title: Amazon Online Arbitrage Product Researcher — US Market
description: Join an established, long-term Amazon business. We have been operating for over 4 years and are building a stable remote team, not hiring for a short-term, high-turnover role. One of our current team members will reach 3 years with us this October. We offer structured on-boarding, ongoing support, performance reviews and genuine opportunities to increase your earnings as you grow in the role. Salary: ₱30,000 per month Performance review: Salary increase review within the first 3 months, based on performance Bonuses: Generous monthly performance-based bonus scheme, available from day one Other benefits: 22 days paid leave, 13th-month pay and long-term progression opportunities Location: Remote - Philippines-based applicants We are an established US-focused Amazon online arbitrage business looking for an experienced, detail-oriented Amazon Product Researcher to join our remote team. Your role will be to find profitable products from US online retailers and analyse them for resale on Amazon US. This is not an entry-level role. We are looking for someone who already understands US online arbitrage and can confidently assess leads using the relevant software and Amazon data. title: Senior DaVinci Resolve Studio 21 Documentary Editor / Finishing Artist
job_title: Senior DaVinci Resolve Studio 21 Documentary Editor / Finishing Artist
description: I am looking for a highly experienced DaVinci Resolve Studio 21 editor and finishing artist to give a substantially completed long-form historical documentary its final creative and technical polish before publication. The film is a faceless documentary centred on Cornelius Vanderbilt, the Gilded Age and the rise of an American fortune. It is approximately one hour long. The narration, story structure, music, media and main edit are already in place. I will complete my remaining manual timing corrections before handing over the project. This is not a start-from-scratch edit. The film has a strong narrative foundation, but it now needs an expert artistic eye to make it feel richer, more cinematic, atmospheric and visually engaging. I need someone who can recognise sections that feel static, repetitive or overly reliant on basic imagery—and improve them without changing the documentary’s identity or over-editing it. CREATIVE DIRECTION The established visual style is “The Gilded Ledger”: an elegant, cinematic Gilded Age aesthetic using: • Deep black and charcoal backgrounds • Antique gold and warm ivory typography • Archival photographs and historical footage • Newspapers, maps, documents and financial ledgers • Subtle film texture, depth, shadow and restrained movement • Sophisticated chapter cards and period-inspired graphics • A dramatic but intelligent sense of wealth, power and history The finished film should feel like a premium historical documentary rather than a generic YouTube compilation. I do not want excessive transitions, constant zooming, distracting effects, template-heavy editing or fast TikTok-style pacing. Every creative choice should support the narration, atmosphere and story. THE WORK WILL INCLUDE • Watching and assessing the complete documentary • Identifying visually weak, repetitive or slow sections • Improving visual pacing and continuity while protecting the narration • Replacing or strengthening unsuitable B-roll where necessary • Adding tasteful movement to archival images using masking, depth, parallax and controlled camera animation • Refining typography, title cards and chapter sequences • Creating appropriate Fusion graphics for maps, dates, documents, timelines and historical information • Using DaVinci Resolve Studio features creatively where they genuinely improve the film • Improving transitions between scenes and chapters • Creating a consistent cinematic colour treatment • Correcting differences between archival sources • Refining sound design and completing a professional Fairlight mix of narration, music and effects • Checking the final film for technical or visual problems before export This position requires genuine experience across the Edit, Fusion, Color and Fairlight pages—not simply basic cutting or the use of pre-made templates. REQUIREMENTS • Advanced knowledge of DaVinci Resolve Studio 21 • A legitimate DaVinci Resolve Studio licence • Strong Fusion motion-graphics experience • Confident colour-grading and Fairlight audio skills • Proven experience editing long-form documentaries or cinematic historical content • Excellent visual storytelling and artistic judgement • Strong English comprehension • Ability to take over and safely manage an existing Resolve project • Reliable communication and careful version control • Respect for deadlines and project confidentiality All newly introduced footage, music, fonts, graphics and other assets must be properly licensed or confirmed as suitable for commercial YouTube use. Any third-party plugins, fonts or generated assets must be disclosed before they are added. DELIVERABLES • A clean and fully relinked DaVinci Resolve Studio 21 project • Project archive or project file with all newly added media • Final master export at the existing timeline resolution and frame rate • YouTube-ready export • List of any new assets, fonts or plugins introduced • Brief summary of the principal changes made • One reasonable revision following my review PAID TEST Shortlisted applicants may be invited to complete a paid 60–90 second creative test using a selected section from the documentary. This will allow me to assess artistic judgement, technical ability and compatibility with the established style. No unpaid test work will be requested. HOW TO APPLY Begin the first line of your application with the words “GILDED 21” so I know you have read the complete description. Please include: 1. Your exact DaVinci Resolve Studio version. 2. Direct links to two or three relevant long-form documentary projects. 3. A clear explanation of your personal contribution to each example. 4. Details of your Fusion, Color and Fairlight experience. 5. Your hourly or project rate. 6. Your availability and earliest possible starting date. 7. A short explanation of how you keep an archival documentary visually engaging without over-editing it. A general showreel alone is not sufficient. I need to see complete documentary sequences demonstrating pacing, atmosphere, motion graphics and storytelling. This is initially a single finishing project. However, strong work could lead to ongoing documentary editing opportunities for the right person.

Sometimes the stronger video is built around a gaming setup, laptop, phone, IRL situation, meme, challenge, POV, trend or relatable idea. → Your job is to know the difference. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ◆ CONTENT CAN INCLUDE • Single-game videos • Multi-game videos and lists • Gameplay • Challenges • Memes • POVs • Gaming setup / desk setup videos • Laptop, monitor and phone footage • Gaming room / RGB setup footage • IRL videos filmed at home, schools, cafés, malls, outdoors, etc. • Voiceover or no voiceover • Trend-based concepts • Videos built around a joke, situation or trend instead of only gameplay If you have a good-looking gaming setup, desk, room, laptop or another visually interesting environment, we want you to use it. title: Media Buyer & Conversion Specialist (Google Ads + Meta) | NZ Agency
job_title: Media Buyer & Conversion Specialist (Google Ads + Meta) | NZ Agency
description: We're a small marketing agency in New Zealand. We do marketing for financial advisers, mostly mortgage and insurance advisers and KiwiSaver specialists. We're looking for someone to help run the ad accounts (with our overseeing) so we can focus on growing the business). *What you'd actually be doing* Taking over the day to day of our client accounts across Meta, Google and Bing. We set the strategy and the budgets, and we sign off anything significant. Past that, the accounts are yours. You decide what runs, what gets paused, where the money moves, and which keywords are wasting it. The other half of the job is what happens after the click. Our funnels and landing pages are built in GoHighLevel, and you'd be reviewing and improving them. Form flow, drop-off, question order, layout, load speed. There's not much point winning the auction if the page loses the lead. Please read this bit before applying: Nearly half of what we manage is search rather than social, and search is where we need you strongest. We see a lot of applications from Meta specialists who have picked up a bit of Google along the way. There's nothing wrong with that, but it isn't this job. If your search experience is "I've run some campaigns", please save us both the time. We do test this properly, and there's no clever way to talk your way around a search terms report. *What we need* - 3+ years running paid campaigns with real budgets. Agency-side ideally, since you'd be moving between clients here - Real Meta Ads Manager experience and real Google Ads search experience. Both of them, not one and a bit of the other Lead generation rather than ecommerce. We're not selling products, we're getting people to pick up the phone, and the levers are different - GoHighLevel, or another CRM and funnel builder you picked up quickly - Good written English. You'll be documenting every change you make and you'll be in our Slack every day - Online 7am to 11am Manila time. We're based in New Zealand and need to be able to communicate during business hours. Nice to have but not required: financial services, mortgage or insurance advertising. GA4 and Tag Manager. Any landing page testing background. Meta or Google certifications. *What we're like to work for* Our clients are licensed financial advisers, which means there are real legal rules about what their ads can say. So anything a consumer will read, ad copy, headlines, anything mentioning rates, comes to us first. Everything else you just get on with. Every change gets logged with the date and the reason you made it. That's the one thing we're strict about. It's how we stay out of your way without losing track of what's happening. If something breaks or a cost per lead jumps, tell us the same day. Nobody here gets in trouble for bad news arriving early. You'll always know what you're aiming for, because every client has a target cost per lead written down. This is part-time and long-term, a direct contract with us. No agency in the middle taking a cut. Paid every fortnight through Wise on the 15th and the 30th. We've never paid anyone late and we don't intend to start with you. *How to apply* Please don't send a template. We read every application and we can spot one from the first line. Tell us about an account you took over that wasn't working. What was wrong with it, what you did, what happened to the numbers afterwards. Under 250 words, and use real numbers rather than "improved significantly" Tell us honestly whether you're stronger on Meta or on Google search, and why. Your CV or profile, any certifications, and the hourly rate you're looking for in USD Start your message with the word ORCHARD so we know you got this far If you're shortlisted we'll send you a real account to look at. It takes about 90 minutes and we pay you your rate for it, because your time is worth something before you work here as well as after. Then a video call. We're hoping to have someone chosen by mid September. Looking forward to hearing from you!

title: Senior Funnel Builder
description: Senior Funnel Builder Remote | USD $5–$8/hour We’re looking for a Senior Funnel Builder who thinks beyond the build. Yes, you should know how to build and maintain high-performing funnels. But more importantly, you should understand why a funnel converts, what makes a product win, and how to turn those insights into new opportunities. If you enjoy looking at data, spotting opportunities, testing ideas, and turning one successful concept into several strong variations, we’d love to hear from you. Review funnels from both a technical and conversion-focused perspective. Analyze winning products and funnels to understand what is driving their performance. Create meaningful variations of winning funnels, products, and offers without losing what made the original successful. Test new angles, offers, hooks, messaging, positioning, and funnel structures. Write and refine conversion-focused copy, including headlines, hooks, CTAs, offers, upsells, and product messaging. Use testing and performance insights to continuously improve conversion rates. Help establish and maintain strong funnel-building and optimization practices across the team. What We’re Looking For - 2+ years of experience building and optimizing sales funnels. - Strong hands-on experience with Funnelish, or the ability to become highly proficient with it quickly. - Strong conversion-focused copywriting skills. - A solid understanding of funnel structure, customer journeys, offers, and conversion principles. - Experience with winner optimization, A/B testing, and developing variations from successful funnels or products. - The ability to think beyond simply changing colors, layouts, or buttons—you should be able to develop new angles, offers, hooks, and messaging based on what the data is telling you. - A strong eye for design, usability, and detail. - Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. - Someone who is proactive, reliable, curious, and comfortable working independently. - CheckoutChamp experience is a plus, but not required. What Makes You a Great Fit You don’t just know how to build a funnel, you understand why it converts. When you see a winning product, you naturally start asking: Why is this working? What angle is resonating with customers? Which part of the offer is driving the conversion? What other hooks or messages could we test? How can we create new variations without losing what made the original winner successful? You’re comfortable bringing together technical execution, copywriting, conversion strategy, analysis, and creative testing. Most importantly, you know how to take one good winner and turn it into multiple opportunities. How to Apply When applying, please tell us about your experience with: 1. Funnelish 2. Winner optimization 3. Conversion-focused copywriting 4. Shopify automations 5. Creating variations from successful products or funnels 6. title: SEO Expert
description: About RemovalistNow RemovalistNow is an Australian removalist comparison platform that helps people planning local, interstate, home, apartment and office moves compare removalist options and make more informed decisions. We are seeking a proactive SEO Outreach & Backlink Specialist to build relevant publisher relationships and strengthen our organic visibility. This is not a bulk-email or spam role. We want someone who can find high-quality opportunities, write personalised outreach, manage conversations and keep precise records. The role covers both earned editorial backlinks and paid placement coordination. Quality, relevance and careful execution are more important than sending a high volume of emails. Core Responsibilities You will research relevant websites, publishers, journalists, bloggers and content creators for RemovalistNow. The best opportunities will be related to moving house, relocation, property, first-home buyers, home improvement, interiors, local services, real estate and Australian consumer advice. You will pursue unpaid editorial opportunities through personalised outreach. This can include resource-page inclusions, expert quotes, useful moving guides, original guest articles, local-business features, relevant partnerships, broken-link opportunities and genuine editorial mentions. Your role is to create a compelling reason for the publisher to mention a useful RemovalistNow resource. You will also coordinate paid link insertions and sponsored guest-post opportunities. For each offer, you will collect the exact article URL, placement location, price, target audience, link type, duration, renewal terms and proposed anchor text. You will prepare a clear opportunity summary for approval before any deal is accepted. You will maintain a detailed Google Sheet that records every prospect, contact name, email, publisher website, article URL, website topic, country/audience if available, outreach date, follow-up date, reply status, price, proposed link target, anchor text, placement details and final live-link status. You will send approved personalised outreach emails and professional follow-ups. You will also coordinate the submission of approved guest articles and confirm each placement after it is published by checking the live destination URL, anchor text, page context and link attribute. Quality Standard We only want links that are relevant, visible and useful to readers. A strong opportunity normally has an existing article about moving, home ownership, relocation, property or a related home-service topic. The preferred placement is a natural, in-body contextual link on a permanent page. You must avoid generic directories, link farms, irrelevant lifestyle sites, casino/adult/CBD content, automated mass outreach and sites where the proposed placement cannot be verified. Do not recommend an opportunity only because it is cheap or claims to offer a do-follow link. Approval Rules You may research, draft emails, follow up and manage the outreach spreadsheet independently. However, you must receive written approval before you accept a paid offer, agree to a price, provide final link instructions, submit an article, promise a publication date, make a payment or share payment information. You must never pay invoices, enter payment details, access financial accounts, create website logins, publish content on our website or change RemovalistNow pages. You must not promise search rankings or use misleading outreach claims. Skills and Experience You must write excellent English and be confident communicating with website owners and editors. You should have practical experience in manual SEO outreach, digital PR, guest-post outreach, editorial link building or publisher relationship management. You should be comfortable researching websites with Google, Google Sheets, Gmail and SEO tools such as Semrush, Ahrefs or equivalent platforms. You need to understand the difference between a genuine editorial in-body link and a low-value directory or generic paid-post listing. Experience working with Australian websites, home services, property, real estate, local services, moving or relocation content is an advantage. Strong attention to detail, reliable follow-up and good judgement are essential. Initial Paid Trial The successful applicant will begin with a two-week paid trial. During the trial, you will research high-quality prospects, build a clean outreach sheet, draft personalised outreach emails and follow up only on approved conversations. A successful trial will demonstrate that you can identify relevant articles, explain why a placement is valuable, write professional outreach and follow processes carefully. Quality and accuracy matter more than the number of emails sent.

job_title: Project Manager | Ecommerce Agency Full-Time | Remote
description: About the Role We’re looking for a highly organized, proactive Ecommerce Project Manager to keep multiple client projects moving from 0 to 100. We are a well-staffed agency with dedicated teams across sourcing, branding, Shopify development, marketing, and account management. This role is not about doing everyone’s job, it’s about making sure everyone is doing their job, projects stay on track, communication is clear, and nothing falls through the cracks. You’ll be the connective tissue between different teams and stakeholders. You’ll coordinate timelines, follow up on deliverables, identify bottlenecks, communicate clearly with clients and internal teams, and make sure projects continue progressing without unnecessary delays. We work with a steady flow of ecommerce clients, with approximately 9 clients currently in various stages of offboarding and new clients coming in every month. This is a fast-moving environment where priorities can change quickly, so we need someone who can bring structure without becoming rigid. What You’ll Be Doing Own project coordination from kickoff through completion Keep multiple ecommerce projects moving simultaneously Coordinate across sourcing, branding, Shopify development, marketing, and account management Make sure every stakeholder knows what needs to happen, who owns it, and when it is due Track project timelines, milestones, dependencies, and deliverables Follow up proactively when something is late, unclear, or at risk Identify potential bottlenecks before they become major problems Communicate updates clearly between internal teams, clients, and account managers Hand projects and key information off smoothly to the appropriate Account Manager Work closely with Account Managers so they can focus on higher-level client relationships and strategy Keep ClickUp and project documentation organized and up to date Help onboard new clients and coordinate the moving pieces during offboarding Manage multiple projects without losing track of details Jump into the weeds when necessary to solve problems and keep things moving Use AI tools to improve project management, communication, documentation, research, and workflows Continuously look for ways to make the agency more efficient and scalable You’ll Work Across Teams Including: Sourcing Team Product sourcing, supplier communication, product information, timelines, and deliverables. Branding Team Brand strategy, creative direction, assets, revisions, and approvals. Shopify Development Team Website builds, development tasks, integrations, revisions, QA, and launch timelines. Marketing Team Marketing assets, campaigns, content, launch requirements, and ongoing deliverables. Account Management Ensuring projects are properly coordinated and handed off so the Account Manager has everything they need to manage the client relationship effectively . What We’re Looking For You’re a strong communicator. You can communicate clearly and professionally with different personalities, teams, and stakeholders. You know how to ask the right questions, clarify ambiguity, and make sure everyone understands the next step. You’re highly proactive. You don't wait for someone to tell you that a deadline is approaching. You see it coming, follow up, and make sure the work gets done. You understand ecommerce. You don't need to be an ecommerce expert or Shopify developer, but you should understand the basic ecosystem of an ecommerce business — products, sourcing, branding, websites, Shopify, marketing, launches, and the general flow of getting an ecommerce project from idea to execution. You’re comfortable managing complexity. You may have multiple clients, teams, deadlines, revisions, and moving parts happening at the same time. You can prioritize without becoming overwhelmed. You’re willing to roll up your sleeves. This is not a "send a few Slack messages and update a spreadsheet" PM role. When something gets stuck, you investigate. When information is missing, you find it. When a process breaks, you help fix it. You’re comfortable getting into the details when necessary to keep the larger project moving. You have strong ownership. You take responsibility for the outcome of the project, not just your individual task list. You naturally think: "What needs to happen next, and how do I make sure it happens?" Required Qualifications 3+ years of experience in project management, operations, account coordination, or a similar role Experience working with ecommerce, digital agencies, Shopify, or online businesses Excellent written and verbal English Strong communication and stakeholder management skills Excellent organization and attention to detail Comfortable managing multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously Experience coordinating across multiple departments or teams Strong follow-up and accountability skills Comfortable working in a remote, asynchronous environment Comfortable learning new software and AI tools quickly Experience with project management platforms such as ClickUp, Asana, ---------- , or similar Our Tech Stack You’ll work primarily with: ClickUp — project management Slack — team communication Google Sheets / Google Workspace — tracking and documentation Claude — AI-assisted research, documentation, communication, and workflows Various AI and automation tools You don't need to know every tool on day one. What matters is that you're tech-savvy, curious, and comfortable using AI to work faster and smarter. What Success Looks Like After you’re fully ramped up, projects should feel like they are constantly moving forward. Deadlines don't sneak up on the team Stakeholders know what they need to do Bottlenecks are identified early Clients aren't left wondering what is happening Account Managers receive clean, organized handoffs Teams have the information they need to execute Projects move from 0 → 100 without unnecessary delays Nothing falls through the cracks You will become the person the team can rely on to make sure things keep ticking along. Schedule & Availability This is a full-time remote position. You must be available for sufficient overlap with the team. The preferred schedule includes availability of at least 4 hours in the US (EST/ CST) for crossover, and the rest can be on any relevant time during the Philippine timezone. After the 60 day onboarding, an early-morning or split-shift schedule may be considered depending on the candidate and team requirements. Because we work across multiple teams and client accounts, flexibility and responsiveness during agreed working hours are important. Time Tracking This position requires diligent and accurate time tracking through Time Doctor. We value productivity, accountability, and transparency, and time tracking is an important part of how we manage remote team performance. Who Will Thrive in This Role This role is a great fit for someone who: Loves turning chaos into organized action Naturally follows up with people Doesn't need to be micromanaged Can communicate with both strategic and execution-focused people Enjoys working across multiple departments Is comfortable with fast-moving ecommerce businesses Uses AI as a productivity multiplier Notices problems before others do Is comfortable saying, "This is stuck — here's what I'm doing about it." Takes ownership instead of making excuses Is willing to get into the details when needed Who This Role Is NOT For This probably isn't the right role if you: Need someone to give you a checklist every morning Prefer working on one task at a time with minimal interruptions Don't enjoy following up with people Avoid difficult conversations or accountability Are uncomfortable working across multiple teams Consider project management purely administrative Wait for problems to become urgent before addressing them We already have strong people on our teams. We need someone who can bring those people together and make the entire machine run better. Why This Role Matters We are growing, onboarding new clients every month, and managing increasingly complex ecommerce projects. The right Project Manager will have a meaningful impact on how efficiently we operate. You won't be hired simply to "manage tasks." You'll be responsible for keeping projects moving, connecting teams, removing bottlenecks, and helping turn client projects into finished results. Reply with a cover letter, why you're a fit for this role, and the name of your favourite country in the subject line.
